### [1] [GeoISF: Instance Semantic Forest Inspired Large-Scale Cross-View Geo-Localization via Ground LiDAR-to-Satellite Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28371)
*Di Hu,Xia Yuan,Chunxia Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GeoISF，一种大规模LiDAR点云与卫星图像跨视角地理定位方法，通过构建基于WordNet的实例语义森林增强语义表示，在KITTI数据集上R@10指标提升13.22倍。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有LiDAR到图像的跨视角定位方法在大规模场景中面临语义对齐有限以及点云与卫星图像之间的模态差距问题，难以实现有效的大规模定位。

Method: GeoISF引入基于WordNet构建的实例语义森林，通过整合多帧的语义树来增强时序语义表示和判别能力，利用环境语义表示作为共享媒介，弥合模态差距并提升语义匹配精度。

Result: 在KITTI数据集上，GeoISF在大规模跨视角定位中表现优越，R@10指标相比并行LiDAR-to-image方法提升13.22倍。

Conclusion: GeoISF有效填补了大规模LiDAR-to-image跨视角定位的空白，为该场景下的计算和精度挑战提供了鲁棒解决方案，并将开源代码以供社区使用。

Original Abstract: The problem of localization on a large-scale satellite image given a frame of query ground view point clouds remains challenging. Existing LiDAR-to-image cross-view localization methods struggle in large-scale scenarios due to limited semantic alignment and the modality gap between point clouds and satellite images. This paper introduces the large-scale LiDAR-to-image geo-localization pipeline called GeoISF. GeoISF introduces an instance semantic forest constructed using WordNet, which enhances temporal semantic representation and discriminative power by integrating semantic trees from multiple frames. By leveraging environmental semantic representation as a shared medium, GeoISF effectively bridges the modality gap and improves semantic matching accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of GeoISF in large-scale cross-view localization, 13.22 times better than the parallel LiDAR-to-image method in the R@10 metric on the KITTI dataset. The proposed method addresses the existing gap in large-scale LiDAR-to-image cross-view localization, offering a robust solution to the computational and accuracy challenges inherent in such scenarios. We will release the code as an open-source resource available online for the broader research community.

中文摘要翻译: 给定一帧查询地面视角点云在大规模卫星图像上进行定位的问题仍然具有挑战性。现有的LiDAR到图像的跨视角定位方法由于语义对齐有限以及点云与卫星图像之间的模态差距，难以在大规模场景中有效工作。本文提出了大规模LiDAR到图像的地理定位流程，称为GeoISF。GeoISF引入了一种基于WordNet构建的实例语义森林，通过整合多帧的语义树来增强时序语义表示和判别能力。通过利用环境语义表示作为共享媒介，GeoISF有效弥合了模态差距并提升了语义匹配精度。大量实验表明，GeoISF在大规模跨视角定位中表现优越，在KITTI数据集上R@10指标相比并行LiDAR-to-image方法提升13.22倍。所提出的方法填补了大规模LiDAR到图像跨视角定位的现有空白，为此类场景中固有的计算和精度挑战提供了鲁棒解决方案。我们将把代码作为开源资源发布在网上，供更广泛的研究社区使用。

</details>


### [2] [Meta-learning as a principle for human-like visual representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28399)
*Can Demircan,Marcel Binz,Alireza Modirshanechi,Eric Schulz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出并验证了人类视觉表征的灵活性源于元学习（学会学习）压力，使得表征能够支持开放任务。通过在数千个语义任务上训练序列模型，元学习表征在人类相似性判断、语义规则学习和高级视觉皮层预测方面优于预训练编码器。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 预训练神经网络在建模人类视觉表征方面取得了前所未有的成功，但与人类表征之间仍存在较大差距。作者认为原因在于：这些网络优化的是单一固定目标，而人类表征必须支持开放式的、多样化的任务。因此，作者假设人类表征的灵活性源于元学习（学会学习）的压力。

Method: 训练一个序列模型，在数千个语义丰富的任务（将图像映射到高层概念）上进行元学习，无需任何人类数据的监督。

Result: 与预训练基础编码器相比，元学习表征在预测人类相似性判断、语义规则学习以及高级视觉皮层的脑活动方面表现更好。行为层面的提升依赖于解缠的、高层任务分布，而脑对齐主要由学会学习的压力驱动。

Conclusion: 人类视觉表征的灵活性反映了实时学习新语义关系的功能需求。

Original Abstract: The structure of human visual representations underpins our capacity for adaptive behaviour. While pretrained neural networks model human visual representations with unprecedented success, a large discrepancy remains. We propose one reason: these networks optimise a single fixed objective, whereas human representations must support open-ended tasks. We hypothesise this flexibility arises from meta-learning (learning to learn), a pressure shaping representations to acquire new tasks from few observations. To test this, we train a sequence model, without any supervision from human data, across thousands of semantically rich tasks mapping images to high-level concepts. Compared to their pretrained base encoders, meta-learned representations better predict human similarity judgements, semantic rule learning, and high-level visual cortex. Behavioural gains depend on disentangled, high-level task distributions, while brain alignment is driven primarily by the learning-to-learn pressure. Our results suggest the flexibility of human visual representations reflects the functional demand to learn new semantic relationships on the fly.

中文摘要翻译: 人类视觉表征的结构支撑着我们适应性行为的能力。尽管预训练神经网络以前所未有的成功建模了人类视觉表征，但两者之间仍存在较大差距。我们提出一个原因：这些网络优化的是单一固定目标，而人类表征必须支持开放式的任务。我们假设这种灵活性源于元学习（学会学习），这是一种迫使表征从少量观测中获取新任务的压力。为了验证这一假设，我们在数千个将图像映射到高层概念的语义丰富任务上训练了一个序列模型，全程无需任何人类数据的监督。与预训练的基础编码器相比，元学习表征能更好地预测人类相似性判断、语义规则学习以及高级视觉皮层的活动。行为层面的提升依赖于解缠的、高层的任务分布，而脑对齐主要由学会学习的压力驱动。我们的结果表明，人类视觉表征的灵活性反映了实时学习新语义关系的功能需求。

</details>


### [3] [Memory-Augmented LSTM Autoencoder for Unsupervised Activity Recognition with IMU Sensor Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28377)
*Saeid Arabzadeh,Farshad Almasganj,Mohammad Mahdi Ahmadi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于记忆增强自编码器的全无监督时空特征融合框架，用于多传感器IMU人体活动识别，在DaLiAc和PAMAP2数据集上分别达到96.6%和98.4%的准确率，超越有监督和无监督基线方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有深度学习方法在IMU人体活动识别中面临三大挑战：依赖标注数据、多传感器融合复杂、无监督方法捕获时空依赖能力有限，尤其在真实场景中存在噪声数据、活动重叠和标签缺失问题。

Method: 提出全无监督时空特征融合框架，包括：(1) 堆叠自编码器提取层次化静态特征并进行传感器内和跨传感器融合；(2) 序列到序列LSTM自编码器对特征进行时序精炼，融入历史运动模式；(3) 记忆增强机制提升特征表示能力，无需标签即可实现时空特征学习。

Result: 在DaLiAc和PAMAP2数据集上分别达到96.6%和98.4%准确率，超越有监督基线和无监督方法；特征可分性提升最高达9%；采用真实类间窗口分割虽导致准确率下降约7%，但更贴合实际场景。

Conclusion: 提出的全无监督框架通过记忆增强自编码器有效融合多传感器IMU数据的时空特征，在短时间窗口下仍能实现优异的识别性能和特征可分性，具有实时应用潜力。

Original Abstract: HAR using Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensors is vital for healthcare monitoring and rehabilitation. Despite deep learning advancements, major challenges remain: reliance on labeled data, multi-sensor fusion complexity, and the limited ability of unsupervised methods to capture spatiotemporal dependencies. These issues are pronounced in real-world scenarios with noisy data, overlapping activities, and missing labels. We propose a fully unsupervised spatiotemporal feature fusion framework using a memory-augmented autoencoder. It enhances activity representations via short temporal windows of multi-sensor IMU data, enabling real-time applications. Our framework extracts hierarchical static features via a Stacked Autoencoder, fusing them within and across sensors. A sequence-to-sequence LSTM Autoencoder then temporally refines these features, incorporating historical motion patterns without labels. We analyze key hyperparameters to identify configurations that maximize feature separability under short-window constraints. Evaluated on DaLiAc and PAMAP2 using realistic inter-class window segmentation, our method achieves 96.6% and 98.4% accuracy, respectively, surpassing supervised baselines and unsupervised approaches. Our method improves feature separability by up to 9% despite shorter temporal windows. While our realistic inter-class segmentation reduces accuracy by ~7%, it was intentionally adopted to better reflect real-world activity transitions and practical relevance.

中文摘要翻译: 基于惯性测量单元传感器的人体活动识别对于医疗健康监测和康复至关重要。尽管深度学习取得了进展，但仍面临主要挑战：依赖标注数据、多传感器融合复杂、以及无监督方法捕获时空依赖关系的能力有限。这些问题在存在噪声数据、活动重叠和标签缺失的真实场景中尤为突出。我们提出了一种基于记忆增强自编码器的全无监督时空特征融合框架。该框架通过多传感器IMU数据的短时间窗口增强活动表示，支持实时应用。我们的框架通过堆叠自编码器提取层次化静态特征，并在传感器内部和跨传感器层面进行融合。随后，序列到序列的LSTM自编码器对这些特征进行时序精炼，无需标签即可融入历史运动模式。我们分析了关键超参数，以确定在短窗口约束下最大化特征可分性的配置。在DaLiAc和PAMAP2数据集上，采用真实的类间窗口分割评估，我们的方法分别达到96.6%和98.4%的准确率，超越了有监督基线和无监督方法。尽管使用更短的时间窗口，我们的方法将特征可分性提升了最高9%。虽然我们采用的真实类间分割导致准确率下降约7%，但这是为了更准确地反映真实世界的活动过渡和实际应用相关性而有意为之。

</details>


### [4] [Zero-Label Driving Scenario Complexity Detection via Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28383)
*Santosh Jaiswal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出利用自监督联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在无标签数据上通过时序预测误差作为零样本复杂度分数，自动识别复杂驾驶场景，在nuPlan数据集上验证了该方法对非保护转弯、人行横道交互等复杂场景的有效性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有识别复杂驾驶场景的方法依赖于人工标注、有监督分类器或精心设计的规则集，这些方法都需要大量先验知识，成本高昂。本文探索是否可以在没有任何标签的情况下，让模型自主发现场景复杂度。

Method: 在nuPlan mini数据集的结构化智能体状态数据上训练一个最小化的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），利用时序预测误差作为零样本复杂度分数，无需任何真实标签参与训练或评估。

Result: 模型对非保护转弯、人行横道交互和行人靠近场景分配显著更高的分数，对车道保持和静止交通场景分配显著更低的分数；四项消融实验验证了信号来源；下游异常检测任务上平均精度（AP）达到0.512，高于基线0.436。

Conclusion: 自监督潜在世界模型中的时序预测误差可以作为驾驶场景复杂度的实用代理指标，无需人工标注即可有效区分复杂与简单驾驶场景。

Original Abstract: Identifying complex and safety-critical driving scenarios in large unlabelled datasets is an important but expensive problem. Existing approaches rely on human annotators, supervised classifiers, or carefully engineered rule sets, all of which require substantial prior knowledge about what constitutes a difficult scenario. We ask whether a model can discover scenario complexity on its own, with no labels at any stage. We train a minimal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) on structured agent state data from the nuPlan mini dataset and use the temporal prediction error as a zero-shot complexity score. Without access to any ground-truth labels during training or evaluation setup, the model assigns significantly higher scores to scenarios involving unprotected turns, crosswalk interactions, and pedestrian proximity, and significantly lower scores to lane-following and stationary-traffic scenarios. We validate this finding through four ablation experiments that isolate the source of the signal, and through a downstream anomaly detection evaluation that achieves Average Precision of 0.512 against a 0.436 chance baseline. The results show that temporal prediction error in a self-supervised latent world model is a practical proxy for driving scenario complexity.

中文摘要翻译: 在大规模无标签数据集中识别复杂且安全关键的驾驶场景是一个重要但昂贵的问题。现有方法依赖人工标注、有监督分类器或精心设计的规则集，这些都需要大量关于何为困难场景的先验知识。我们探究模型是否可以在没有任何标签的情况下自主发现场景复杂度。我们在nuPlan mini数据集的结构化智能体状态数据上训练了一个最小化的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），并将其时序预测误差用作零样本复杂度分数。在训练和评估过程中均未使用任何真实标签的情况下，该模型对涉及非保护转弯、人行横道交互和行人靠近的场景分配了显著更高的分数，而对车道保持和静止交通场景分配了显著更低的分数。我们通过四项消融实验隔离信号来源，以及一项下游异常检测评估（平均精度0.512，对比随机基线0.436）验证了这一发现。结果表明，自监督潜在世界模型中的时序预测误差是驾驶场景复杂度的实用代理指标。

</details>


### [5] [Data Provenance for Image Auto-Regressive Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28386)
*Bihe Zhao,Louis Kerner,Michel Meintz,Tameem Bakr,Franziska Boenisch,Adam Dziedzic*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种事后溯源框架，无需修改生成过程或输出，通过检测图像自回归模型(IAR)生成的图像中固有特征模式，实现对IAR生成图像的可靠溯源。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 随着图像自回归模型(IAR)在视觉内容生成中广泛应用，需要可靠的溯源方法追踪生成图像的来源模型，以防止虚假信息传播、检测欺诈和归属有害内容。现有水印方法需要修改生成过程或输出，不适用于已发布的无附加标记内容。

Method: 提出一种事后(post-hoc)溯源框架，通过检测IAR生成过程中引入的特征模式来识别图像来源，无需修改生成过程或输出。

Result: 在多种图像自回归模型上验证了方法的有效性，展示了其在自回归图像生成中实现稳健数据溯源的高潜力。

Conclusion: IAR生成图像虽在视觉上与真实图像难以区分，但其生成过程引入了可作为可靠溯源信号的特征模式；所提事后框架可在不依赖水印的情况下有效实现数据溯源。

Original Abstract: Image autoregressive models (IARs) have recently demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual content generation, achieving photorealistic quality and rapid synthesis through the next-token prediction paradigm adapted from large language models. As these models become widely accessible, robust data provenance is required to reliably trace IAR-generated images to the source model that synthesized them. This is critical to prevent the spread of misinformation, detect fraud, and attribute harmful content. We find that although IAR-generated images often appear visually identical to real images, their generation process introduces characteristic patterns in their outputs, which serves as a reliable provenance signal for the generated images. Leveraging this, we present a post-hoc framework that enables the robust detection of such patterns for provenance tracing. Notably, our framework does not require modifications of the generative process or outputs. Thereby, it is applicable in contexts where prior watermarking methods cannot be used, such as for generated content that is already published without additional marks and for models that do not integrate watermarking. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach across a wide range of IARs, highlighting its high potential for robust data provenance tracing in autoregressive image generation.

中文摘要翻译: 图像自回归模型（IARs）近期在视觉内容生成方面展现出卓越能力，通过借鉴大语言模型的下一个标记预测范式，实现了照片级真实感质量与快速合成。随着这些模型被广泛使用，需要稳健的数据溯源方法将IAR生成的图像可靠地追溯至合成它们的源模型，这对于防止虚假信息传播、检测欺诈以及归属有害内容至关重要。我们发现，尽管IAR生成的图像通常在视觉上与真实图像难以区分，但其生成过程会在输出中引入特征模式，这为生成图像提供了可靠的溯源信号。基于此，我们提出了一种事后（post-hoc）框架，能够稳健地检测此类模式以进行溯源追踪。值得注意的是，我们的框架无需修改生成过程或输出，因此在先验水印方法无法使用的场景中同样适用，例如针对已发布且未附加额外标记的生成内容，以及未集成水印功能的模型。我们在多种IAR模型上验证了该方法的有效性，突显了其在自回归图像生成中实现稳健数据溯源的高潜力。

</details>


### [6] [SoccerNet 2026 Player-Centric Ball Action Spotting: Per-Player Attention with Agreement-Based Ensembling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28389)
*Faisal Altawijri,Ismail Mathkour*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个两阶段流水线用于SoccerNet 2026球员中心球类动作定位挑战：先通过跟踪感知动作检测器（TAAD）生成球员动作logits，再通过去噪序列转导（DST）变换器将游戏状态特征和TAAD logits转换为结构化事件序列。通过空间优先注意力排序、加权事件融合集成等改进，将挑战Macro-F1从基线48.6提升至58.94。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 针对足球视频中球员级别的球类动作定位任务，现有方法难以有效利用跨帧上下文和游戏状态信息，且单一模型存在误检问题，需要更精确的动作检测和事件序列结构化方法。

Method: 两阶段流水线：1）TAAD阶段：使用时间变换器增加跨帧上下文，并配合若干训练修复；2）DST阶段：引入两阶段逐球员注意力机制，采用空间优先的注意力排序（先跨球员注意力再时间注意力），同时训练四类模型变体，通过加权事件融合集成（含一致性过滤抑制单模型误检，并为稀有tackle类设置例外）进行组合。

Result: 空间优先的注意力排序使验证集Macro-F1提升1.87%；最终系统将挑战Macro-F1从基线48.6提升至58.94。

Conclusion: 本文提出的两阶段流水线结合空间优先注意力排序和加权事件融合集成，显著提升了球员中心球类动作定位的性能，验证了架构多样性集成和注意力机制优化的有效性。

Original Abstract: We present our submission to the SoccerNet 2026 Player-Centric Ball Action Spotting challenge, which uses a two-stage pipeline: a Track-Aware Action Detector (TAAD) produces per-player action logits from broadcast video, and a Denoising Sequence Transduction (DST) transformer converts game-state features and TAAD logits into structured event sequences. We improve the TAAD with a temporal transformer that adds cross-frame context, alongside several training fixes. For the DST stage, we introduce a two-stage per-player attention mechanism operating on game-state features, and show that a spatial-first attention ordering (cross-player attention before temporal attention) improves validation Macro-F1 by 1.87%. To exploit architectural diversity, we train four model variants and combine them with a Weighted Event Fusion ensemble that applies agreement filtering to suppress single-model false positives while preserving recall, plus a dedicated exception for the rare tackle class. Our final system improves the challenge Macro-F1 from a baseline of 48.6 to 58.94.

*Hao Li,Chen Chu,Filip Biljecki,Cyrus Shahabi,Wenwen Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Topo4Vec是一个基于GeoAI和空间表示学习的自动化矢量数据质量评估框架，通过拓扑错误模拟和有监督学习，在三个城市数据集上实现了对建筑物重叠和街道网络连接错误的有效检测。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 经典基于规则的质量评估算法难以应对多样的城市形态和海量数据，而GeoAI在原生矢量数据上的应用尚不充分，因此需要一种可扩展、自动化的矢量数据质量评估方法。

Conclusion: Topo4Vec展示了一种可扩展、自主的GeoAI方法，适用于大规模矢量数据一致性和质量监测，为快速增长的地理空间数据生态系统提供了有前景的技术路径。

Original Abstract: Geospatial vector data quality is a foundational research topic in GIS, yet classic rule-based quality assessment algorithms often struggle with diverse urban morphologies and massive data volumes. Recently, Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI) shows promising potential for automating geospatial analysis, while its application to native vector data remains largely underexplored. To fill this research gap, we proposed Topo4Vec, an automated GeoAI framework, designed for scalable vector data quality assessment via advanced Spatial Representation Learning (SRL). Specifically, Topo4Vec relax the labor-intensive manual annotation process via topological error simulation, such as overlapping polygons and street network connectivity errors e.g., overshoots and undershoots. Then, it leverages state-of-the-art SRL approaches to encode complex, native vector geometries (e.g., polylines and polygons) into a latent space where topological errors are isolated from valid ones. A systematic performance evaluation across three study areas (Los Angeles, Munich, and Singapore) demonstrates the effectiveness and robustness of Topo4Vec, achieving a peak accuracy of 0.99 for detecting overlapping building footprints and 0.60 for overshoots and undershoots in street networks. Moreover, lessons learned from Topo4Vec shed a promising light into a scalable and autonomous GeoAI approach for large-scale vector data consistency and quality monitoring within the fast-growing geospatial data ecosystems. The code and data used in the paper are made openly available in https://figshare.com/s/612148eeb4bccadbd715.

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种面向低类别数真实场景的基于保真度的XAI评估指标变体，通过生成分布内不确定性扰动来衡量XAI方法的忠实度，并在医学和自然图像上展示了与人类中心指标的相关性。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 提出一种基于保真度的XAI度量变体，核心是生成分布内且能引发不确定性的扰动，从而准确衡量XAI方法的忠实度；并与基于人类中心的物体定位和分割指标进行对比。

Result: 在医学图像和自然图像两类应用上验证了该评估框架的有效性，揭示了领域特性、数据整理策略与XAI方案选择之间复杂的关联性。

Conclusion: 该评估框架能够为CNN模型训练验证提供指导，帮助在不同领域中选择合适的XAI方法，强调了领域、数据整理与XAI选择之间的相互影响。

Original Abstract: The wide use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) in numerous domains and real-world classification applications is justified by their high precision and automation speed, helping users concentrate on higher-expertise tasks. To better understand the models and avoid bias during deployment, eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques can be used after training. But as the list of XAI solutions expand, comparisons between them diverge, and consensus over their evaluation cannot be reached. This paper proposes a variation of Fidelity-based XAI metrics, with a focus on real-conditions applications, where the number of classes is often low. The approach generates in-distribution, uncertainty-provoking perturbations, to ensure proper measurement of the XAI methods faithfulness. As demonstration of the evaluation framework usefulness, it is compared with human-centric object localization and segmentation metrics. Once applied to both medical and natural imaging applications, it highlights the intricate correlation between domain, data curation, and XAI solution choices in order to validate training of a new CNN model.

</details>


### [9] [RADIANT-PET: Reasoning-Augmented PET/CT Lesion Segmentation with Large Language Models and Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28392)
*Jiasheng Wang,Tanun Jitwatcharakomol,Piyawadee Jongpradubgiat,Simeng Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RADIANT-PET框架，将高灵敏度体素级分割模型与基于强化学习优化的局部大语言模型（LLM）相结合，通过病灶级LLM裁决抑制生理性假阳性，显著提升PET/CT病变分割性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: PET/CT中准确的病灶分割对肿瘤学至关重要，但生理性示踪剂摄取和伪影会模拟恶性信号，导致现有纯图像分割模型产生大量假阳性。

Method: 1) 使用高灵敏度但宽松的分割阶段生成候选摄取区域；2) 将候选区域转换为结构化文本描述（含摄取强度、形态、区域及全局解剖背景）；3) 利用大语言模型（LLM）将每个候选分类为真实病灶或假阳性，并可选地利用放射学报告作为临床上下文；4) 通过Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）强化学习优化局部LLM，奖励正确的病灶分类和解剖部位分配。

Result: 在AutoPET和OSU测试集上，RADIANT-PET持续优于强图像基线模型，在提供放射学报告时改进最为显著。

Conclusion: 基于LLM的病灶级推理为传统分割增加了新的推理层，能够抑制生理性假阳性，使体素级预测与临床解读对齐。

Original Abstract: Accurate lesion segmentation in PET/CT is critical for oncology, yet remains challenging because physiologic tracer uptake and artifacts can mimic malignant signal. We present RADIANT-PET, a reasoning-augmented framework that couples a high-sensitivity voxel-level segmentation model with lesion-level large language model (LLM) adjudication. Candidate uptake regions are generated with a deliberately permissive segmentation stage, then converted into structured textual descriptions that summarize uptake intensity, morphology, and regional and global anatomical context. An LLM classifies each candidate as true lesion vs. false positive, optionally leveraging the radiology report as additional clinical context. To strengthen lesion-level reasoning, we further optimize a local LLM via reinforcement learning using Group Relative Policy Optimization, rewarding correct lesion classification and anatomically concordant site assignment. Across AutoPET and an OSU test cohort, RADIANT-PET consistently outperforms strong image-only baselines, with the largest improvements observed when radiology reports are provided. Overall, these results demonstrate that LLM-based lesion-level reasoning adds a novel reasoning layer beyond conventional segmentation, suppressing physiologic false positives and aligning voxel-level predictions with clinical interpretation. The project repository is available at: https://github.com/jwang-580/RADIANT-PET.

中文摘要翻译: PET/CT中的精确病灶分割对肿瘤学至关重要，但由于生理性示踪剂摄取和伪影可能模拟恶性信号，这一任务仍然具有挑战性。我们提出RADIANT-PET，一个推理增强框架，将高灵敏度体素级分割模型与病灶级大语言模型（LLM）裁决相结合。候选摄取区域通过一个刻意宽松的分割阶段生成，然后转换为结构化文本描述，总结摄取强度、形态以及区域和全局解剖上下文。LLM将每个候选分类为真实病灶或假阳性，并可选择利用放射学报告作为额外的临床上下文。为了强化病灶级推理，我们进一步通过基于Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）的强化学习优化局部LLM，奖励正确的病灶分类和解剖部位一致性分配。在AutoPET和OSU测试队列上，RADIANT-PET consistently优于强纯图像基线模型，当提供放射学报告时改进最为显著。总体而言，这些结果表明基于LLM的病灶级推理为传统分割增加了新的推理层，抑制了生理性假阳性，并使体素级预测与临床解读对齐。项目仓库地址：https://github.com/jwang-580/RADIANT-PET。

### [10] [Transition-Aware best-of-N sampling for Longitudinal Chest X-ray Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28393)
*Halil Ibrahim Gulluk,Max Van Puyvelde,Wim Van Criekinge,Olivier Gevaert*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个无训练的、基于过渡感知的最佳N采样方案，用于胸部X光报告生成，通过编码前后影像的变化来提升报告质量。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在临床实践中，胸部X光报告需基于前后影像的对比变化来生成，但现有报告生成器缺乏对这种纵向信息（前后影像过渡）的显式建模。

Method: 提出过渡感知最佳N采样（transition-aware best-of-N sampling）：将报告拆为句子后嵌入无序集合，通过集合间距离（均值偏移、新颖性残差、有向Hausdorff锚点、代价加权最优传输）将（前次、当前）影像对编码为固定维度的方向向量，再以余弦相似度与训练集真实过渡向量库（取最小或k近邻聚合）进行评分排序。

Result: 在AP-PA多访问队列上，结合三种提示和三种视觉-语言生成器进行评测，过渡感知最佳N采样在所有设置下均优于随机选择，在Impression部分获得最大相对提升。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模前后影像的过渡变化，无需额外训练即可显著提升预训练胸部X光报告生成器的输出质量，尤其在报告结论部分效果突出。

Original Abstract: In longitudinal clinical practice, every chest X-ray is read in the context of the patients prior exam, and much of what the radiologist communicates is the change from one visit to the next. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first training-free best-of-N sampling scheme for pre-trained chest X-ray report generators that is explicitly aware of this longitudinal prior to current transition. We call it transition-aware best-of-N sampling, each report is split into sentences and embedded into an unordered set in Rd; each (prior, current) pair is reduced to a fixed-dim directional vector via a set-to-set distance designed to encode the change between the two sets; and candidates are scored by cosine distance from their candidate transition vector to a cached bank of ground-truth training transition vectors, aggregated as min or kNN. We instantiate the framework with four directional set distances (mean-shift, novelty residual, directed-Hausdorff anchor, and cost-weighted optimal transport) and evaluate on a multi-visit AP-PA cohort, running inference under three prompts on three vision-language generators. Transition-aware best-of-N outperforms random selection across the board, with the largest relative gains on the Impression section.

中文摘要翻译: 在纵向临床实践中，每张胸部X光片都是在患者先前检查的背景下被解读的，放射科医生传达的大部分信息是两次就诊之间的变化。据我们所知，我们提出了首个无需训练的、面向预训练胸部X光报告生成器的最佳N采样方案，该方案显式地感知从纵向历史到当前检查的过渡。我们称之为过渡感知最佳N采样：每份报告被拆分为句子并嵌入到R^d维的无序集合中；每个（前次、当前）影像对通过一种集合间距离被简化为固定维度的方向向量，该距离旨在编码两个集合之间的变化；候选报告通过其候选过渡向量与缓存的真实训练过渡向量库之间的余弦距离进行评分，聚合方式采用最小值或k近邻。我们用四种有向集合距离（均值偏移、新颖性残差、有向Hausdorff锚点和代价加权最优传输）实例化了该框架，并在一个多访问AP-PA队列上进行了评估，在三种提示下对三个视觉-语言生成器进行了推理。过渡感知最佳N采样全面优于随机选择，在结论（Impression）部分取得了最大的相对提升。

</details>


### [11] [GPU-Accelerated Inverse Structural Anastylosis from Block Collapse Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28394)
*L. A. Muñoz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出JIP-2，一种GPU加速的深度学习框架，将建筑倒塌构件的结构重组（anastylosis）建模为逆预测任务。该方法结合刚体物理引擎、摩擦分析阈值和双流ResNet-18网络，从倒塌块体图像中重建最可能的原始塔状结构，并生成3D逆向重建视频。在玛雅遗址Uxmal的应用具有潜在价值。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统建筑构件重组严重依赖考古专家的手动逐块对应，过程劳动密集且主观性强。作者受Jenga游戏的组合复杂性启发，旨在将结构重组自动化问题形式化为逆预测任务，以提高效率并减少主观性。

Method: (1) 实现完整刚体物理引擎，含OBB/SAT碰撞检测和PGS接触求解器，并通过Numba JIT和CuPy CUDA加速；(2) 应用Ziglar解析力阈值（F_app = 3*μ_s*m*g（Y轴，无扭矩）和F_app = 4*μ_s*m*g（X轴，扭矩风险）），在三个摩擦等级（μ_s ∈ {0.25, 0.40, 0.60}）下模拟450个场景；(3) 训练双流ResNet-18，注入摩擦独热向量，联合预测块体移除数量、逐位置移除概率、质心不平衡度和Ziglar扭矩风险；(4) 生成平滑的3D逐块逆向重建视频。

Result: 在450个模拟场景上进行了实验，覆盖三个摩擦等级和不同力阈值条件。论文详细描述了完整的管道架构和损失函数设计，但未在摘要中给出具体的量化评估指标。

Conclusion: JIP-2框架展示了将深度学习和物理仿真结合用于计算机辅助结构重组（anastylosis）的可行性，对UNESCO玛雅遗址Uxmal的修复工作具有潜在应用价值。

Original Abstract: The physical anastylosis of collapsed architectural monuments -- the meticulous reassembly of fallen stone elements into their original structural configuration -- represents one of the most intellectually demanding challenges in conservation science. Traditional approaches depend heavily on expert archaeologist judgement and manual block-by-block correspondence, a process that is both labour-intensive and inherently subjective. Inspired by the combinatorial complexity of this problem as manifested in the game of Jenga, we present Jenga Inverse Predictor , a GPU-accelerated deep learning framework that addresses structural anastylosis as an inverse prediction task. Given an image of a collapsed block assembly, JIP-2 reconstructs the most probable prior tower configuration by: (1) implementing a complete rigid-body physics engine with OBB/SAT collision detection and a Projected Gauss-Seidel (PGS) contact solver accelerated with Numba JIT and CuPy CUDA; (2) applying the analytical force thresholds of Ziglar (CMU, 2006) -- F_app = 3*mu_s*m*g (Y-axis, torque-free) and F_app = 4*mu_s*m*g (X-axis, torque risk) -- over three friction levels (mu_s in {0.25, 0.40, 0.60}) across 450 simulated episodes; (3) training a dual-stream ResNet-18 that injects a friction one-hot vector and jointly predicts block removal count, per-position removal probabilities, centre-of-mass imbalance, and Ziglar torque risk; and (4) generating a smooth 3-D video of the block-by-block reverse reconstruction. We discuss implications for computer-assisted anastylosis at the UNESCO Maya site of Uxmal, Yucatan, and provide a detailed technical description of the full pipeline, architecture, and loss formulation.

中文摘要翻译: 倒塌建筑遗迹的结构重组（anastylosis）——将倒塌的石块构件精确地重新组装回其原始结构形态——是保护科学中最具智力挑战性的任务之一。传统方法高度依赖考古专家的判断和手工逐块对应，这一过程既劳动密集又 inherently 主观。受Jenga游戏中展现的组合复杂性启发，我们提出了Jenga Inverse Predictor (JIP-2)，一个GPU加速的深度学习框架，将结构重组问题建模为逆预测任务。给定倒塌块体集合的图像，JIP-2通过以下步骤重建最可能的原始塔状结构：(1) 实现完整的刚体物理引擎，包含基于OBB/SAT的碰撞检测和投影高斯-赛德尔（PGS）接触求解器，并通过Numba JIT和CuPy CUDA加速；(2) 应用Ziglar（CMU, 2006）的解析力阈值——F_app = 3*μ_s*m*g（Y轴，无扭矩）和F_app = 4*μ_s*m*g（X轴，扭矩风险）——在三个摩擦等级（μ_s ∈ {0.25, 0.40, 0.60}）下进行450个模拟场景；(3) 训练一个双流ResNet-18网络，注入摩擦独热向量，联合预测块体移除数量、逐位置移除概率、质心不平衡度以及Ziglar扭矩风险；(4) 生成平滑的3D逐块逆向重建视频。我们讨论了该方法在UNESCO玛雅遗址Uxmal（尤卡坦半岛）计算机辅助结构重组中的应用潜力，并提供了完整管道、架构和损失函数的详细技术描述。

</details>

*Marija Pizurica,Eric Zimmermann,Neil Tenenholtz,James Hall,Olivier Gevaert,Ava P. Amini,Lorin Crawford,Kristen A. Severson*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: JASPR是一个自监督深度学习框架，通过跨模态重建目标整合HE组织病理图像和空间转录组数据，学习联合空间表征，在乳腺癌数据上显著提升了基于HE图像的基因表达预测性能，并具有预后价值。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: JASPR通过自监督跨模态重建学习有效整合了HE图像和空间转录组学数据中的空间上下文信息，能够提升基因表达预测性能，并具有临床预后价值。

Original Abstract: Recent studies have shown that spatial properties of tumors are critical for understanding disease biology and predicting patient outcomes. These spatial properties are increasingly uncovered through complementary modalities: spatial transcriptomics (ST) captures spatially-resolved molecular states, while hematoxylin and eosin-stained whole slide images (HE) reveal tissue morphology. While approaches are emerging to fuse these modalities, effective methods that learn not only joint representations but also incorporate spatial context across modalities are lacking. Here, we present JASPR (Joint Spatial Representation learning), a self-supervised deep learning framework that integrates HE images and ST data through a cross-modal reconstruction objective that incorporates spatial context within HE images and ST profiles. It employs shared modules to capture universal spatial properties across modalities, while modality-specific experts encode features unique to morphological and genomic data. We train and validate JASPR on breast cancer datasets, demonstrating that its learned joint representation substantially improves HE-based prediction of 9,248 genes and provides prognostic value for breast cancer outcomes.

中文摘要翻译: 近期研究表明，肿瘤的空间特性对于理解疾病生物学和预测患者预后至关重要。这些空间特性正通过互补模态被不断揭示：空间转录组学（ST）捕获空间分辨的分子状态，而苏木精-伊红染色的全切片图像（HE）揭示组织形态学。尽管已有融合这些模态的方法出现，但能够既学习联合表征又整合跨模态空间上下文信息的有效方法仍然缺乏。本文提出JASPR（联合空间表征学习），这是一个自监督深度学习框架，通过跨模态重建目标整合HE图像和ST数据，该目标融入了HE图像和ST图谱中的空间上下文信息。它采用共享模块来捕获跨模态的通用空间属性，同时利用模态特定专家编码形态学和基因组数据特有的特征。我们在乳腺癌数据集上训练并验证了JASPR，结果表明其学习的联合表征显著提升了基于HE图像对9,248个基因的预测能力，并为乳腺癌预后提供了评估价值。

### [13] [RadarTwin: Scene-Specific mmWave Radar Simulation and Learning for Mobile Indoor Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28396)
*Emily Bejerano,Federico Tondolo,Devang Gupta,Aaron Mano Cherian,Taeyoo Kim,Ayaan Qayyum,Xiaofan Yu,Xiaofan Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RadarTwin是一个框架，通过结合视觉语言模型推断材料属性与物理光线追踪器，在真实数据采集前为目标空间合成毫米波雷达训练数据。模拟数据训练的模型在12类目标识别任务中，无真实标签时准确率比随机高2.5倍，少量标签可达95.3%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 毫米波雷达感知面临数据稀缺问题：现有数据集训练的模型难以泛化到新物体、新环境和新传感轨迹。

Method: 给定目标空间的3D重建（手机LiDAR、机器人传感或RGB转3D），使用视觉语言模型推断雷达相关的表面材料属性，再通过基于物理的光线追踪器合成多径传播的FMCW雷达测量数据。

Result: 模拟与真实雷达数据共享相同的物体判别性形状和材料特征；建模环境多径对匹配真实测量至关重要。仅用模拟数据训练的模型在真实12类目标识别任务中准确率比随机高2.5倍，加入少量真实标签后准确率达95.3%。

Conclusion: RadarTwin能够在任何真实雷达数据采集之前，为目标空间训练雷达感知模型，显著降低对新环境的部署成本。

Original Abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar perception is limited by data scarcity: models trained on existing radar datasets fail to generalize to new objects, environments, and sensing trajectories. We present RadarTwin, a framework for generating deployment-specific radar training data before real data collection. Given a 3D reconstruction of a target space (phone LiDAR, robot-mounted sensing, or RGB-to-3D), RadarTwin uses a vision-language model to infer radar-relevant surface materials and a physics-based ray tracer to synthesize raw frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar measurements with multi-bounce propagation. To study what transfers from simulation to reality, we collect a paired real-simulated dataset spanning household objects, material classes, distances, rotations, translations, and mobile sensing trajectories. We show that simulated and real radar share the same object-discriminative shape and material features, and that modeling the environment's multipath is essential to matching real measurements. A representation trained on simulation alone recognizes real objects at 2.5 times chance with no real radar labels, and a few labeled examples raise this to 95.3% on a 12-way recognition task. RadarTwin enables training radar perception for a new space before any real radar data is collected there.

中文摘要翻译: 毫米波雷达感知受限于数据稀缺：基于现有雷达数据集训练的模型难以泛化到新目标、新环境和新传感轨迹。本文提出RadarTwin——一个在真实数据采集之前生成部署特定雷达训练数据的框架。给定目标空间的3D重建（手机LiDAR、机器人搭载的传感器或RGB转3D），RadarTwin使用视觉语言模型推断与雷达相关的表面材料属性，并通过基于物理的光线追踪器合成具有多径传播特性的原始调频连续波（FMCW）雷达测量数据。为研究从仿真到现实的迁移效果，我们收集了一个配对真实-仿真数据集，涵盖家居物品、材料类别、距离、旋转、平移以及移动传感轨迹。实验表明，仿真与真实雷达共享相同的物体判别性形状和材料特征，且对环境多径进行建模对于匹配真实测量至关重要。仅用仿真训练的模型在无任何真实雷达标签的情况下对真实目标的识别准确率是随机水平的2.5倍，而加入少量真实标签后，在12类目标识别任务中准确率提升至95.3%。RadarTwin使得在采集任何真实雷达数据之前就能为新空间训练雷达感知模型成为可能。

</details>


### [14] [CLOSER-VLN: Closed-Loop Self-Verified Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28397)
*Shaoxuan Li,Xiangyu Dong,Xiaoguang Ma,Junfeng Chen,Haoran Zhao,Yaoming Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CLOSER方法，在视觉语言导航（VLN）中引入闭环自我验证的检索增强推理，无需训练策略即可在动作执行前进行推理、验证、检索和修正，在CityNav基准上显著提升了空中VLN的性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于大模型的VLN方法大多采用开环决策-执行方式，候选动作缺乏执行前的验证与修正，导致空中VLN中微小误差累积造成大轨迹偏差和目标丢失。

Method: 提出CLOSER，一种无需训练策略的闭环方法，包含三个组件：分层推理器（基于可用信息生成候选动作）、多维动作验证器（评估动作可靠性）、验证触发的多模态检索器（仅在验证失败时从记忆库检索目标示例）。动作在验证通过后才执行，否则进入检索-修正循环。

Result: 在CityNav基准的test-unseen分割上，CLOSER-VLN达到32.01% SR和21.28% SPL，验证了闭环推理的有效性。

Conclusion: 闭环的自我验证与检索增强推理能有效解决空中VLN中开环决策的误差累积问题，无需任务特定的导航策略训练即可取得显著性能提升。

Original Abstract: Vision-language navigation (VLN) has recently advanced with large language and multimodal models, enabling agents to follow natural-language instructions in unseen environments without training a task-specific navigation policy. However, most existing VLN methods relying on large models still adopt an open-loop decision-execution approach, where candidate actions are generated from instructions and observations but are rarely verified or corrected before execution. This causes critical issues in aerial VLN, where minor errors in intermediate actions may quickly accumulate into large trajectory deviations and lead to target loss. To address this issue, we propose Closed-loop Self-verified Retrieval-augmented Reasoning (CLOSER), a training-policy-free method that sequentially performs action reasoning, reliability verification, targeted retrieval, and action correction in a closed-loop manner before executing concrete actions. We instantiate the CLOSER in aerial VLN tasks and develop a CLOSER-VLN framework, which is composed of three components: a hierarchical reasoner for generating candidate actions based on available information, a multidimensional action verifier for assessing the reliability of actions generated by the reasoner, and a verification-triggered multimodal retriever for retrieving targeted exemplars from a memory bank only when verification fails. We conduct experimental evaluations on the CityNav benchmark, where CLOSER-VLN achieves 32.01% SR and 21.28% SPL on the test-unseen split, confirming the effectiveness of closed-loop reasoning.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉语言导航（VLN）近期随着大规模语言和多模态模型的发展取得了进展，使得智能体能够在不训练任务特定导航策略的情况下，依据自然语言指令在未知环境中进行导航。然而，大多数依赖大模型的现有VLN方法仍采用开环决策-执行方式，即从指令和观测中生成候选动作，但在执行前很少进行验证或修正。这在空中VLN中会导致严重问题，因为中间动作的微小误差可能迅速累积成大的轨迹偏差，进而导致目标丢失。为解决此问题，我们提出闭环自我验证检索增强推理（CLOSER），一种无需训练策略的方法，在执行具体动作之前，以闭环方式依次执行动作推理、可靠性验证、针对性检索和动作修正。我们将CLOSER实例化到空中VLN任务中，开发了CLOSER-VLN框架，该框架由三个组件构成：一个基于可用信息生成候选动作的分层推理器、一个评估推理器所生成动作可靠性的多维动作验证器，以及一个仅在验证失败时触发、从记忆库中检索目标示例的验证触发多模态检索器。我们在CityNav基准上进行了实验评估，CLOSER-VLN在test-unseen分割上达到了32.01%的成功率和21.28%的SPL，证实了闭环推理的有效性。

</details>


### [15] [Semantic-Aware Generative Image Transmission for Resource-Constrained Visual IoT Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28398)
*Chenyang Zhang,Changwang Liu,Jinqi Zhu,Jiayi Chang,Yuxuan Wang,Shuqing He,Jia Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种语义感知的生成式图像传输框架，用于资源受限的视觉物联网系统。发送端基于语义重要性和可恢复性选择性地传输离散token，接收端利用MaskGIT恢复被掩码的token，在极低码率下实现了优于传统方法的质量和任务性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有图像通信方法通常压缩或传输完整的全局表示，留给接收端生成式恢复的空间有限。视觉物联网系统需要在低速率无线链路上传输任务相关的视觉证据，亟需一种能结合语义信息来优化传输效率的方法。

Method: （1）VQ编码器将图像编码为离散token网格；（2）在发送端，结合预测熵和局部结构复杂度估计token可恢复性，再融合实例分割和类别感知评分得到的语义重要性；（3）空间分散采样器在码率预算下选择要传输的token；（4）发送端仅传输保留token的量化索引和二进制掩码图；（5）接收端使用Halton序列调度的MaskGIT恢复被掩码的token。

Result: 在Kodak和VisDrone数据集上，AWGN和Rayleigh信道下，所提方法在0.074 bpp时达到29.9 dB PSNR，仅使用0.167 bpp的DeepJSCC/WITT参考方法的44.6%传输比特。下游检测实验表明，语义感知掩码在30%和50%掩码率下均比随机掩码更好地保留了任务相关物体。

Conclusion: 提出的语义感知生成式图像传输框架为窄带视觉物联网链路提供了灵活的比特率-质量权衡，能在极低码率下实现高效的图像传输和下游任务性能。

Original Abstract: Resource-constrained visual Internet of Things (IoT) systems, such as edge cameras, unmanned sensing platforms, industrial inspection nodes, and remote monitoring sensors, often need to transmit task-relevant visual evidence over low-rate wireless links to an edge/cloud service. Existing image communication methods usually compress or transmit complete global representations, leaving limited room to exploit receiver-side generative restoration. This paper proposes a semantic-aware generative image transmission framework for edge-assisted visual IoT. The image captured by an IoT visual sensor is encoded into a discrete token grid by a VQ encoder. At the IoT transmitter or nearby gateway, token recoverability, estimated from prediction entropy and local structure complexity, is fused with semantic importance obtained from instance segmentation and category-aware scoring. A spatial dispersal sampler then selects the tokens to be transmitted under a bitrate budget. The transmitter sends only the quantization indices of kept tokens and a binary mask map, while the edge/cloud receiver recovers masked tokens through MaskGIT with Halton sequence scheduling. Experiments on Kodak and VisDrone scenes under AWGN and Rayleigh channels show that the proposed method provides a flexible bitrate-quality tradeoff for narrowband visual IoT links. At 0.074 bpp, it uses 44.6% of the transmitted bits of the 0.167-bpp DeepJSCC/WITT reference while achieving 29.9 dB PSNR. A pseudo-GT downstream detection study on Kodak further shows that semantic-aware masking preserves task-relevant objects better than random masking at both 30% and 50% mask ratios.

中文摘要翻译: 资源受限的视觉物联网系统，如边缘相机、无人传感平台、工业检测节点和远程监测传感器，通常需要通过低速率无线链路向边缘/云服务传输与任务相关的视觉证据。现有的图像通信方法通常压缩或传输完整的全局表示，留给接收端生成式恢复的空间有限。本文提出了一种面向边缘辅助视觉物联网的语义感知生成式图像传输框架。物联网视觉传感器采集的图像由VQ编码器编码为离散token网格。在物联网发射器或附近网关上，基于预测熵和局部结构复杂度估计的token可恢复性，与通过实例分割和类别感知评分获得的语义重要性相融合。随后，空间分散采样器在比特率预算下选择要传输的token。发射器仅传输保留token的量化索引和二进制掩码图，而边缘/云接收器通过采用Halton序列调度的MaskGIT恢复被掩码的token。在AWGN和Rayleigh信道下对Kodak和VisDrone场景进行的实验表明，所提方法为窄带视觉物联网链路提供了灵活的比特率-质量权衡。在0.074 bpp下，该方法仅使用了0.167 bpp的DeepJSCC/WITT参考方法44.6%的传输比特，同时达到了29.9 dB的PSNR。在Kodak上进行的伪GT下游检测研究进一步表明，在30%和50%的掩码率下，语义感知掩码比随机掩码更好地保留了与任务相关的物体。

</details>


### [16] [Vision-driven Preference Synthesis for Mitigating Hallucinations in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28401)
*Yunhun Nam,Jongheon Jeong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ViPSy框架，通过视觉驱动的偏好数据构建方法，在保持与策略分布一致的同时增强视觉信息利用，显著减少VLM的幻觉问题，达到新的最佳性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有偏好对齐方法存在两个关键局限：(a)基于干预的方法会显著偏离策略分布；(b)基于采样的方法在构建偏好对时未充分利用视觉信息。需要一种既能保持策略对齐又能充分利用视觉信息的偏好数据构建方法。

Method: ViPSy包含两阶段：(1)从语义对齐的图像变体中提取跨图像重复出现的物体级内容作为视觉线索，使偏好构建依赖视觉信息而非语言先验；(2)以该视觉线索为条件，引导策略模型自身的rollout生成候选响应，使候选响应既受视觉内容引导，又保持接近策略的响应分布。

Result: 在AMBER和Object HalBench上幻觉率分别降低35.7%和24.5%，达到新的最优水平；在MMStar、MMVP、CV-Bench等通用视觉理解基准上也有提升，并在语义分割和ImageNet线性探测任务上取得增益。

Conclusion: ViPSy通过视觉驱动的偏好构建有效缓解了VLM的幻觉问题，同时增强了模型的整体视觉能力，证明了该框架的有效性。

Original Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong performance in visual understanding, yet they still suffer from hallucinations, generating content that is not grounded in the image. Preference alignment is a promising approach to improve visual faithfulness, but its success depends heavily on how preference pairs are constructed. Existing methods exhibit two key limitations; (a) intervention-based methods often introduce significant deviation from the policy distribution, and (b) sampling-based methods often underuse visual information during the construction. In this paper, we propose ViPSy (Vision-driven Preference Synthesis), a framework for constructing preference data that are both policy-aligned and visually grounded. Our framework consists of two stages; in the first stage, ViPSy derives a visual cue from recurring object-level content across semantically aligned image variants, so preference construction can rely on visual information rather than language priors. In the second stage, ViPSy conditions the policy's own rollouts on this cue, allowing candidates to be guided by visually grounded content while staying close to the policy's response distribution. The resulting candidates remain close to the policy's response distribution while better leveraging visual information from the image. Experiments show that the resulting VLM, preference-aligned with ViPSy-constructed preference pairs, achieves a new state-of-the-art in hallucination mitigation. Compared with the previous state-of-the-art method, it reduces hallucination rates on AMBER and Object HalBench by 35.7% and 24.5%, respectively. The resulting model further improves on general visual grounding benchmarks, e.g., MMStar, MMVP, and CV-Bench, while also yielding gains in semantic segmentation and ImageNet linear probing, underscoring the effectiveness of our framework in enhancing the model's visual capabilities.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）在视觉理解任务中表现出色，但仍存在幻觉问题，即生成与图像无关的内容。偏好对齐是提升视觉忠实度的有效途径，但其成功高度依赖于偏好对的构建方式。现有方法存在两个关键局限：(a)基于干预的方法往往偏离策略分布较远；(b)基于采样的方法在构建过程中未能充分利用视觉信息。本文提出ViPSy（视觉驱动偏好合成），一种同时实现策略对齐与视觉扎根的偏好数据构建框架。该框架包含两阶段：第一阶段，ViPSy从语义对齐的图像变体中提取跨图像重复出现的物体级内容作为视觉线索，使偏好构建依赖视觉信息而非语言先验；第二阶段，ViPSy以该视觉线索为条件，引导策略模型自身的rollout生成候选响应，使候选响应既受视觉内容引导，又保持接近策略的响应分布。实验表明，使用ViPSy构建的偏好对进行偏好对齐后的VLM，在幻觉缓解方面达到了新的最优水平。与先前最优方法相比，在AMBER和Object HalBench上幻觉率分别降低35.7%和24.5%。该模型在通用视觉理解基准（如MMStar、MMVP和CV-Bench）上也有进一步提升，同时在语义分割和ImageNet线性探测任务上取得增益，充分证明了本框架在增强模型视觉能力方面的有效性。

</details>


### [17] [Learning from Acquisition: Metadata-driven Multimodal Pre-training for Cardiac MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28991)
*Xueyi Fu,Liwei Hu,Zi Wang,Guang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MetaCLIP-CMR框架，利用CMR采集元数据（模态、解剖视图、扫描仪信息等）作为文本监督信号进行对比学习，在少量预训练数据下达到与大规模图像预训练模型相当的CMR表示学习性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的CMR基础模型主要依赖纯图像预训练，忽略了结构化的采集元数据这一天然可获取的弱语义监督信息。

Method: 基于CLIP框架，将成像模态、解剖视图、扫描仪厂商、场强和扫描仪模型等元数据转换为文本监督信号，进行对比语言-图像预训练，获得CMR图像编码器。

Original Abstract: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) routinely records structured acquisition metadata, yet most CMR foundation models rely primarily on image-only pre-training and leave this naturally available source of weak semantic supervision largely underexplored. We propose MetaCLIP-CMR, a metadata-driven framework based on Contrastive Language--Image Pre-training (CLIP), which converts imaging modality, anatomical view, scanner vendor, field strength, and scanner model into textual supervision for CMR representation learning. The pretrained image encoder is evaluated on imaging modality classification, cine view classification, and cardiac segmentation. MetaCLIP-CMR achieves 86.8% modality accuracy and 86.5% cine view accuracy, clearly outperforming ImageNet and masked reconstruction initialisations. For downstream cardiac segmentation, MetaCLIP-CMR consistently obtains the highest Dice score across the evaluated ACDC and M&Ms cine short-axis (SAX) settings under both full-data and 20% fine-tuning regimes. Compared with recent image-focused large-scale CMR pre-training models, MetaCLIP-CMR achieves comparable ACDC segmentation performance, while requiring less than 1% of their pre-training image scale. These results suggest that metadata learning offers a natural and easy-to-use strategy for transforming routinely recorded acquisition information into effective supervision for foundation-level CMR representation learning, highlighting the promise of metadata-driven multimodal pre-training.

中文摘要翻译: 心脏磁共振成像（CMR）常规记录结构化的采集元数据，但大多数CMR基础模型主要依赖仅图像预训练，而未能充分利用这种天然可获取的弱语义监督资源。我们提出MetaCLIP-CMR，一种基于对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）的元数据驱动框架，将成像模态、解剖视图、扫描仪厂商、场强和扫描仪模型转化为用于CMR表示学习的文本监督信号。预训练的图像编码器在成像模态分类、电影视图分类和心脏分割任务上进行了评估。MetaCLIP-CMR在模态分类上达到86.8%的准确率，在电影视图分类上达到86.5%的准确率，明显优于ImageNet初始化与掩码重建初始化。在下游心脏分割任务中，MetaCLIP-CMR在ACDC和M&Ms电影短轴（SAX）设置的全面数据和20%微调协议下均取得最高的Dice分数。与近期以图像为中心的大规模CMR预训练模型相比，MetaCLIP-CMR在ACDC分割性能上表现相当，但其预训练图像规模不足这些模型的1%。这些结果表明，元数据学习提供了一种自然且易于使用的策略，可将常规记录的采集信息转化为有效的监督信号，用于基础级别的CMR表示学习，凸显了元数据驱动的多模态预训练的潜力。

### [18] [DCSNet: Multiscale Feature Aggregation for Small Medical Object Segmentation with Detection-guided Hierarchical Cropping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28402)
*Shanfeng Zhang,Bo Gou,Yue Cao,Lei Zhang,Zhang Yi,Tao He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DCSNet，通过检测引导裁剪分割网络将全局密集预测转化为局部细化过程，结合层级裁剪和多尺度特征聚合，有效解决了医学图像中小目标分割的类别不平衡和边界模糊问题。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 医学图像中小目标分割面临类别不平衡和边界复杂性的挑战，传统全局网络难以检测稀疏目标或存在严重边缘退化问题。

Method: 提出DCSNet，包含两个核心模块：1) 检测引导层级裁剪(DGHC)，通过区域提议动态提取目标中心特征，过滤背景干扰以缓解类别不平衡；2) 多尺度特征聚合(MSFA)，在净化区域内结合Transformer编码器和像素自适应融合策略，动态聚合多尺度特征以捕获语义上下文和细粒度细节。

Result: 在三个不同医学数据集上的大量实验表明，DCSNet显著优于现有最先进方法，在边界精度上取得实质性提升，为临床微病灶分割提供了高度鲁棒的解决方案。

Conclusion: DCSNet通过将全局密集预测转化为局部细化过程，结合检测引导裁剪和多尺度特征聚合，有效克服了类别不平衡和边界退化问题，在医学图像小目标分割中实现了领先性能。

Original Abstract: Small object segmentation in medical imaging is primarily hindered by class imbalance and inherent boundary complexity. Consequently, conventional global networks frequently fail to detect sparse targets or suffer from severe edge degradation. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Detection-guided Cropping Segmentation Network (DCSNet), an end-to-end framework that transforms global dense prediction into a localized refinement process. This framework integrates two core components, namely Detection-guided Hierarchical Cropping (DGHC) and Multiscale Feature Aggregation (MSFA). The DGHC module leverages region proposals to dynamically extract object-centric features, effdataectively filtering out massive background interference to mitigate class imbalance. Subsequently, the MSFA module operates strictly within these purified regions, synergizing a Transformer encoder with a pixel-adaptive fusion strategy. This mechanism dynamically aggregates multiscale features to capture both semantic context and fine-grained details for sharp boundary delineation. Extensive experiments across three diverse medical datasets demonstrate that DCSNet significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, yielding substantial improvements in boundary precision and offering a highly robust solution for clinical micro-lesion segmentation.

中文摘要翻译: 医学影像中的小目标分割主要受限于类别不平衡和固有的边界复杂性。因此，传统的全局网络常常无法检测到稀疏目标，或者遭受严重的边缘退化问题。为克服这些局限，我们提出了检测引导裁剪分割网络（DCSNet），这是一种端到端的框架，将全局密集预测转化为局部细化过程。该框架集成了两个核心组件：检测引导层级裁剪（DGHC）和多尺度特征聚合（MSFA）。DGHC模块利用区域提议动态提取目标中心特征，有效过滤大量背景干扰以缓解类别不平衡。随后，MSFA模块严格在这些净化区域内运行，协同Transformer编码器与像素自适应融合策略。该机制动态聚合多尺度特征，以同时捕获语义上下文和用于清晰边界勾勒的细粒度细节。在三个不同医学数据集上的大量实验表明，DCSNet显著优于现有最先进方法，在边界精度上取得了实质性提升，并为临床微病灶分割提供了一种高度鲁棒的解决方案。

</details>


### [19] [Spatially Localized Image Degradation Embeddings for Image Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29162)
*Krishna Srikar Durbha,Hassene Tmar,Ping-Hao Wu,Ioannis Katsavounidis,Alan C. Bovik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SLIDE-IQA，一种通过注入空间局部退化进行对比预训练的双分支ViT框架，解决了现有SSL在无参考图像质量评估中对空间受限退化不敏感的问题。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有SSL方法在NR-IQA中虽表现优异，但其统一施加全图合成退化的方式导致对真实场景中空间局部且共现的退化不敏感，存在表征盲区。

Method: 提出SLIDE-IQA双分支ViT框架，在对比预训练目标中注入空间受限退化；并引入阈值限定排除机制（Threshold-Bounded Exclusion Mechanism），解决空间局部退化带来的结构冲突，使隐空间同时尊重退化类型和空间尺度。

Result: SLIDE-IQA的纯合成预训练显著提升了对局部退化的敏感性，在NR-IQA基准测试上达到与现有SSL NR-IQA模型竞争的性能。

Conclusion: 通过空间局部退化嵌入的双分支对比学习可以有效弥补SSL在空间受限退化感知上的不足，在保持整体性能的同时增强对局部质量下降的检测能力。

Original Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) currently drives state-of-the-art performance in no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA). However, standard SSL pipelines uniformly apply synthetic distortions across the entire image field, which can limit their sensitivity to spatially localized and co-occurring degradations encountered in real-world content. In this work, we empirically expose this representational blind spot across existing state-of-the-art encoders, demonstrating their reduced sensitivity to spatially bounded image degradations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Spatial Localized Image Degradation Embeddings for Image Quality Assessment (SLIDE-IQA). SLIDE-IQA employs a dual-branch Vision Transformer framework that injects spatially bounded degradations into a contrastive pretraining objective. To handle the spatial complexity of these degradations, we introduce a Threshold-Bounded Exclusion Mechanism, a representational design choice that resolves structural conflicts arising from spatially localized distortions to ensure the latent space respects both degradation type and spatial scale. Finally, we show that SLIDE-IQA's synthetic-only pretraining significantly improves sensitivity to localized distortions, while achieving competitive performance on NR-IQA benchmarks against existing SSL NR-IQA models.

中文摘要翻译: 自监督学习（SSL）目前驱动着无参考图像质量评估（NR-IQA）的最先进性能。然而，标准SSL流程在整幅图像上均匀施加合成退化，这可能限制了其对真实世界内容中空间局部且共现的降质问题的敏感性。在本工作中，我们通过实验揭示了现有最先进编码器中的这一表征盲区，证明了它们对空间受限图像退化的敏感性降低。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了用于图像质量评估的空间局部退化嵌入方法（SLIDE-IQA）。SLIDE-IQA采用双分支Vision Transformer框架，将空间受限退化注入对比预训练目标中。为处理这些退化的空间复杂性，我们引入了阈值限定排除机制——一种表征设计选择，用于解决由空间局部失真引起的结构冲突，确保隐空间同时尊重退化类型和空间尺度。最后，我们证明SLIDE-IQA的纯合成预训练显著提升了对局部失真的敏感性，同时在NR-IQA基准测试中取得了与现有SSL NR-IQA模型竞争的性能。

</details>


### [20] [Enhancing Layer Interaction Using Key-Correlated Layer Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28405)
*Jianlong Xiong,ChuanBo Xie,Le Yu,Quansong He,Tao He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Key-Correlated Layer Attention (KCLA)，通过利用层注意力中Key表示的高余弦相似性，实现了线性计算复杂度和动态信息更新，同时保持长距离跨层连接，在图像识别、目标检测和医学图像分割任务上表现良好。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 层注意力机制虽然增强了跨层交互，但存在二次计算复杂度问题；现有改进方法（如RLA和线性注意力）存在静态信息更新和长距离跨层依赖建模能力有限的问题。

Method: 观察到层注意力中Key表示具有高余弦相似性，基于此提出Key-Correlated Layer Attention (KCLA)，从层注意力的基础定义出发，直接推导出线性计算复杂度，同时保持动态信息更新和固定空间复杂度。

Result: 在图像识别、目标检测和医学图像分割等多个任务上取得了良好的性能表现。

Conclusion: KCLA成功克服了现有方法的局限性，在保持线性复杂度的同时实现了动态信息更新和长距离跨层依赖建模，是一种有效的层注意力改进方案。

Original Abstract: Recent advances in network architecture design have introduced layer attention to enhance inter-layer interactions. In such frameworks, each layer queries all preceding layers to establish cross-layer connections. However, layer attention results in quadratic computational complexity with respect to network depth. To mitigate this issue, prior works have proposed Recurrent Layer Attention (RLA) and linear attention mechanisms, which suffer from static information updates and limited long-range cross-layer dependency modeling. To overcome these limitations, we propose Key-Correlated Layer Attention (KCLA), inspired by our observation that Key representations in layer attention exhibit high cosine similarity. KCLA achieves linear computational complexity while preserving dynamic information updates, directly derived from the foundational definition of layer attention. Furthermore, KCLA maintains long-range cross-layer connections and features a fixed spatial complexity, independent of network depth. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that KCLA delivers good performance across diverse tasks, including image recognition, object detection, and medical image segmentation. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/bgx666/KCLA.

中文摘要翻译: 近期网络架构设计的进展引入了层注意力机制以增强层间交互。在此类框架中，每一层会查询所有前置层以建立跨层连接。然而，层注意力导致计算复杂度与网络深度成二次方关系。为缓解这一问题，先前工作提出了循环层注意力（RLA）和线性注意力机制，但它们存在静态信息更新和长距离跨层依赖建模能力有限的问题。为克服这些局限，受层注意力中Key表示具有高余弦相似性这一观察的启发，我们提出了Key-Correlated Layer Attention (KCLA)。KCLA在保持动态信息更新的同时实现了线性计算复杂度，该设计直接源于层注意力的基础定义。此外，KCLA保持了长距离跨层连接，并具有固定空间复杂度（与网络深度无关）。实验评估表明，KCLA在图像识别、目标检测和医学图像分割等多样化任务上均展现出良好性能。代码已公开在 https://github.com/bgx666/KCLA。

</details>


### [21] [CylindTrack: Depth-Aware Cylindrical Motion Modeling for Panoramic Multi-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30097)
*Buyin Deng,Kai Luo,Lingxin Huang,Xinqi Liu,Fei Cheng,Hang Zheng,Liming Yin,Kailun Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CylindTrack，一种针对全景视频多目标跟踪的深度感知圆柱跟踪-by-检测框架，通过深度-时间轨迹建模、球面时空一致性学习和拓扑感知圆柱运动模型，解决了全景MOT中周期性水平域、IoU关联失效和深度线索不稳定等核心问题。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 全景相机360°视场可减少盲区并延长目标观测时间，但全景MOT不能简单扩展透视MOT：等距柱状全景视频的水平图像域是周期性的而非欧几里得的，破坏了平面运动假设并使基于IoU的关联在0°/360°接缝处失效；同时大视场场景包含更多目标、更强的尺度变化和更频繁的交互，使得在线关联对不稳定的帧级深度线索特别敏感。

Method: 1) 深度-时间轨迹建模(DTM)：将实例深度从孤立的帧级线索提升为时间滤波后的轨迹级状态；2) 球面时空一致性学习(SSTC)：结合时间混合器和球面几何感知注意力，增强深度感知表示中的时间一致性和全景几何对齐；3) 拓扑感知圆柱运动模型(TCMM)：将水平运动提升到连续角度状态空间，在周期性全景域中执行接缝一致的运动预测与关联。

Result: 通过联合建模轨迹级深度一致性和全景拓扑，CylindTrack在挑战性全景场景中改善了身份保持和轨迹连续性。(具体数值结果未在摘要中提供)

Conclusion: CylindTrack通过深度-时间轨迹建模、球面时空一致性学习和拓扑感知圆柱运动模型，有效解决了全景MOT中周期性域、深度不稳定和接缝一致性等关键挑战，提升了身份保持和轨迹连续性。

Original Abstract: Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) is a core capability for embodied perception, and panoramic cameras are attractive for embodied systems because their 360° field of view reduces blind spots and keeps surrounding targets observable for longer durations. However, panoramic MOT is not a straightforward extension of perspective MOT. In equirectangular panoramic videos, the horizontal image domain is periodic rather than Euclidean, which breaks planar motion assumptions and makes IoU-based association unreliable near the 0°/360° seam. Meanwhile, large-FoV scenes often contain more objects, stronger scale variation, and more frequent interactions, making online association particularly sensitive to unstable frame-wise depth cues. To address these issues, we propose CylindTrack, a depth-aware cylindrical tracking-by-detection framework for panoramic MOT. CylindTrack first introduces Depth-Temporal Trajectory Modeling (DTM), which promotes instance depth from an isolated frame-wise cue to a temporally filtered trajectory-level state. To improve the reliability of depth observations, we further develop Spherical Spatio-Temporal Consistency Learning (SSTC), which combines a Temporal Mixer and Spherical Geometry-aware Attention to enhance temporal coherence and panoramic geometric alignment in depth-aware representations. Finally, we design a Topology-Aware Cylindrical Motion Model (TCMM) that lifts horizontal motion into a continuous angular state space and performs seam-consistent motion prediction and association in the periodic panoramic domain. By jointly modeling trajectory-level depth consistency and panoramic topology, CylindTrack improves identity preservation and trajectory continuity in challenging panoramic scenes. The source code will be released at https://github.com/warriordby/CylindTrack.

中文摘要翻译: 多目标跟踪(MOT)是具身感知的核心能力，全景相机因其360°视场能够减少盲区并让周围目标被观测更长时间，从而对具身系统具有吸引力。然而，全景MOT并非透视MOT的简单扩展。在等距柱状全景视频中，水平图像域是周期性的而非欧几里得的，这破坏了平面运动假设，并使基于IoU的关联在0°/360°接缝附近失效。与此同时，大视场场景通常包含更多目标、更强的尺度变化和更频繁的交互，使得在线关联对不稳定的帧级深度线索特别敏感。为解决这些问题，我们提出CylindTrack——一种用于全景MOT的深度感知圆柱跟踪-by-检测框架。CylindTrack首先引入深度-时间轨迹建模(DTM)，将实例深度从孤立的帧级线索提升为时间滤波后的轨迹级状态。为提升深度观测的可靠性，我们进一步开发了球面时空一致性学习(SSTC)，它结合时间混合器与球面几何感知注意力，以增强深度感知表示中的时间一致性和全景几何对齐。最后，我们设计了一种拓扑感知圆柱运动模型(TCMM)，将水平运动提升到连续角度状态空间，并在周期性全景域中执行接缝一致的运动预测与关联。通过联合建模轨迹级深度一致性和全景拓扑，CylindTrack在挑战性全景场景中改善了身份保持和轨迹连续性。源代码将在https://github.com/warriordby/CylindTrack发布。

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AEGIS是一个面向视觉传感器管道的语义感知且不确定性引导的对抗检测框架，通过SemantiGAN模块过滤视觉不一致的对抗输入，并结合随机增强与证据深度学习分类器实现高精度、高鲁棒性的对抗样本检测。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 深度神经网络在视觉传感器网络中虽表现出色，但仍易受对抗性操纵和不可察觉的扰动影响，导致错误预测。现有检测方法在鲁棒性、可解释性和不确定性校准方面存在不足，亟需更可靠的对抗检测框架。

Conclusion: AEGIS通过语义感知过滤与证据深度学习相结合的方式，有效提升了视觉传感器管道中对抗样本检测的性能与可靠性，为实际部署提供了更具鲁棒性的解决方案。

Original Abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have shown outstanding performance in visual recognition tasks within vision sensor networks; however, they are still vulnerable to adversarial manipulations and imperceptible perturbations that can lead to erroneous predictions. To address that, this paper presents AEGIS, a semantic aware and uncertainty guided adversarial detection framework designed for robust image classification in vision sensors pipelines. At its core, a SemantiGAN module functions as a multi class semantic discriminator, identifying and filtering visually inconsistent adversarial inputs before they propagate further in the pipeline. For inputs that pass this stage, a stochastic augmentation process generates test time variations, from which handcrafted instability metrics FlipScore, Prediction Inconsistency, Layerwise Cosine Similarity (early and mid layers), and Entropy are computed. These features are aggregated into a compact five dimensional vector and processed by an Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) classifier, which models output evidence using a Dirichlet distribution to yield both class predictions and calibrated uncertainty estimates. Evaluations on the Tiny ImageNet dataset across six categories clean, FGSM, PGD, patch based, functional, and geometric attacks demonstrate the effectiveness of AEGIS. The proposed framework achieves an AUROC of 92.1\%, an AUPRC of 90.2\%, and an accuracy of 90.7\%, outperforming conventional softmax-based detectors in terms of detection performance, robustness, interpretability, and uncertainty calibration.

### [25] [PS-MOT: Cultivating Instance Awareness from Point Seeds for Multi-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30476)
*Kai Luo,Fei Teng,Mengfei Duan,Wanjun Jia,Xu Wang,Hao Shi,Kunyu Peng,Zhiyong Li,Kailun Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PS-Track，一种基于点监督的多目标跟踪方法，通过层级流水线（数据、模型、损失三个层面）解决点监督存在的空间模糊和身份漂移问题，在多个数据集上达到最先进水平。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统多目标跟踪依赖边界框标注，成本高昂；点监督作为一种经济高效的替代方案，但由于缺乏显式的几何结构和尺度约束，面临空间模糊和身份漂移等问题。本文旨在解决这些挑战。

Result: 在DanceTrack、EmboTrack、SportsMOT和JRDB四个数据集上的实验表明，PS-Track在各种跟踪场景下提供了可行且有效的点监督替代方案，达到了点监督跟踪领域的最优性能。

Conclusion: PS-Track作为点监督多目标跟踪的有效框架，通过从数据、模型到损失的三层设计，成功弥合了点监督与实例级跟踪之间的差距，建立了点监督跟踪的新技术基准。

Original Abstract: We introduce Point-supervised Multi-Object Tracking (PS-MOT) as a cost-effective alternative to traditional bounding box supervision, shifting the focus from spatial fitting to topological center-driven representation. However, PS-MOT faces challenges, e.g., spatial ambiguity and identity drift due to the lack of explicit geometric structure and scale constraints. To address these, we propose PS-Track, a hierarchical pipeline transitioning from points to instances across data, model, and loss levels. At the data level, we introduce Temporal-Feedback Prompting (TFP) to evolve points into temporally consistent pseudo-labels using negative spatial cues and motion priors. At the model level, we design the Point-Excited Wavelet Attention (PEWA) module, which leverages semantic correlations to activate high-frequency components, ``hallucinating'' object boundaries. At the loss level, Uncertainty-Guided Gaussian Learning (UGL) models pseudo-labels as probabilistic distributions, dynamically calibrating supervision intensity. Experiments on DanceTrack, EmboTrack, SportsMOT, and JRDB demonstrate that PS-Track provides a feasible and effective point-supervised alternative across diverse tracking scenarios, establishing a new state-of-the-art for point-supervised tracking. ### [26] [DiffRGD: An Inference-Time Diffusion Guidance Through Riemannian Gradient Descent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28417)
*Jia-Wei Liao,Li-Xuan Peng,Mei-Heng Yueh,Min Sun,Cheng-Fu Chou,Jun-Cheng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiffRGD提出了一种分布感知的引导框架，通过在潜在高斯分布诱导的球形流形上进行约束优化，并利用黎曼梯度下降高效求解，从而在推理时引导扩散模型生成，同时保持潜在高斯结构不被破坏。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的推理时引导方法在控制扩散模型生成时，会引入分布漂移，破坏原始的潜在高斯分布，导致生成样本质量下降。

Method: 将每个采样步骤建模为潜在高斯分布诱导的球形流形上的约束优化问题，并通过黎曼梯度下降（Riemannian Gradient Descent, RGD）高效求解，显式保持潜在高斯结构。

Result: 在多数图像恢复和条件生成任务中，DiffRGD优于以往方法。

Conclusion: DiffRGD是一种即插即用的分布感知引导框架，能无缝集成到任何预训练扩散模型中，有效提升引导生成质量。

Original Abstract: Recently, diffusion models have been widely adopted in generative modeling and have served as foundational models for many image generation tasks. To control the generation without costly re-training or fine-tuning, many works seek inference-time guidance methods to steer the latent via a differentiable objective at inference time. However, these methods cannot effectively preserve the original Gaussian distribution because they introduce distributional drift, thereby degrading the sample quality. To address this gap, we propose DiffRGD, a distribution-aware guidance framework that explicitly preserves the latent Gaussian structure. DiffRGD formulates each sampling step as a constrained optimization problem on a spherical manifold induced by the latent Gaussian distribution, and solves it efficiently via Riemannian Gradient Descent (RGD). DiffRGD is a plug-and-play method that can be seamlessly integrated into any pre-trained diffusion model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiffRGD outperforms previous methods in most image restoration and conditional generation tasks. 中文摘要翻译: 近年来，扩散模型在生成式建模中被广泛采用，并已成为许多图像生成任务的基础模型。为了在不进行昂贵重新训练或微调的情况下控制生成过程，许多工作寻求推理时引导方法，通过在推理时借助可微目标函数来引导潜在变量。然而，这些方法无法有效保持原始的高斯分布，因为它们引入了分布漂移，从而降低了样本质量。为解决这一问题，我们提出DiffRGD，一种分布感知的引导框架，显式地保持潜在高斯结构。DiffRGD将每个采样步骤建模为潜在高斯分布诱导的球形流形上的约束优化问题，并通过黎曼梯度下降（Riemannian Gradient Descent, RGD）高效求解。DiffRGD是一种即插即用的方法，可以无缝集成到任何预训练扩散模型中。大量实验表明，DiffRGD在多数图像恢复和条件生成任务中优于以往方法。我们的代码库已开源在 https://github.com/jwliao1209/DiffRGD。

Original Abstract: Limited data availability, class imbalance, and domain variability remain major barriers to reliable medical image classification. Adaptive mixing, Gaussian boundary blending, and a saliency-preservation constraint reduce semantic distortion and reject or attenuate samples that shift model attention away from clinically relevant evidence. The framework is evaluated on four public benchmarks: the Radiological Society of North America pneumonia chest radiography dataset, Musculoskeletal Radiographs, PatchCamelyon, and the Breast Cancer Histopathological Image Classification dataset. Experiments with convolutional and transformer-based classifiers show that MedDiffuseMix improves accuracy, F1-score, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve compared with standard augmentation, Mixup, GenMix, SaliencyMix, and diffusion-based augmentation baselines. Ablation studies confirm the importance of saliency guidance, adaptive region mixing, and smooth boundary blending. Original Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models typically require substantial computational resources and cloud infrastructure, posing significant challenges for edge deployment in terms of latency, cost, and user privacy. We present JuZhou 1.0, an ultra-lightweight T2I foundation model designed for fully offline, on-device execution. JuZhou 1.0 achieves its efficiency through four key designs: (1) a compact image-generation backbone consisting of a 0.385B-parameter denoising U-Net and a 1.90M-parameter distilled decoder, totaling approximately 0.387B parameters; (2) Rectified Flow training combined with DMD2 distillation, reducing inference to 4 sampling steps; (3) Chinese semantic alignment trained on 9M curated image-text pairs, enabling direct Chinese prompting without external translation at inference time; and (4) a training and distillation pipeline completed on domestically developed Sugon K100 AI accelerators without relying on NVIDIA GPUs for training or distillation. Despite its compact scale, the 28-step base model of JuZhou 1.0 achieves an overall GenEval score of 0.69, outperforming published baselines including SDXL (2.6B, 0.55), SD3-Medium (2B, 0.62), and IF-XL (4.3B, 0.61). We further validate the full poetry-to-image pipeline on Android and the core CLIP-U-Net-VAE generation branch on iOS. On a smartphone powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Mobile Platform, the 4-step U-Net denoising branch runs in approximately 1.6 seconds, while the full Android poetry-to-image pipeline takes 4.5 seconds with on-device prompt refinement on Xiaomi 17 Pro Max. These results position JuZhou 1.0 as a practical approach to mobile text-to-image generation and provide a concrete reference for Chinese-native generation, domestic-compute training, and fully offline on-device deployment after one-time installation.

中文摘要翻译: 文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型通常需要大量的计算资源和云基础设施，这在延迟、成本和用户隐私方面给边缘部署带来了重大挑战。我们提出了JuZhou 1.0，这是一个为完全离线、设备端执行而设计的超轻量级T2I基础模型。JuZhou 1.0通过四项关键设计实现了其高效性：（1）紧凑的图像生成骨干网络，包含一个0.385B参数的去噪U-Net和一个1.90M参数的蒸馏解码器，总计约0.387B参数；（2）将Rectified Flow训练与DMD2蒸馏相结合，将推理过程减少至4个采样步；（3）基于900万精选图文对的中文语义对齐，使得推理时无需外部翻译即可直接使用中文提示词；（4）训练和蒸馏流程完全在国内自主研发的神威K100 AI加速器上完成，不依赖NVIDIA GPU进行训练或蒸馏。尽管规模紧凑，JuZhou 1.0的28步基础模型在GenEval整体得分上达到0.69，超越了包括SDXL（2.6B，0.55）、SD3-Medium（2B，0.62）和IF-XL（4.3B，0.61）在内的已发表基线模型。我们进一步在Android上验证了完整的诗歌到图像流水线，并在iOS上验证了核心的CLIP-U-Net-VAE生成分支。在搭载骁龙8 Elite Gen 5移动平台的智能手机上，4步U-Net去噪分支的运行时间约为1.6秒，而在小米17 Pro Max上，完整的Android诗歌转图像流水线（含设备端提示词精炼）耗时4.5秒。这些结果使JuZhou 1.0成为移动端文生图的一种实用方案，并为中文原生生成、国产计算训练以及一次性安装后完全离线端侧部署提供了具体参考。

### [29] [CLEAR-MoE: Shared-Basis Expert Extraction from Frozen Vision Transformers via Calibration-Driven Layer Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28516)
*Md Irtiza Hossain,Humaira Ayesha,Junaid Ahmed Sifat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CLEAR-MoE四阶段后训练流水线，将冻结的ViT转换为稀疏MoE模型，在不更新骨干权重的情况下以极小精度损失（0.01%）实现模型稀疏化，并发现共享SVD基是保持精度的关键因素。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在不重新训练或更新骨干网络权重的前提下，将预训练的密集ViT模型高效地转换为稀疏MoE架构，以降低推理计算成本并探索模型稀疏化的可行路径。

Method: 四阶段后训练流水线：(i) 基于稀疏度、可聚类性和输出敏感性对FFN层进行评分；(ii) 使用k-means聚类将选定层分解为共享低秩SVD基和每聚类残差专家；(iii) 利用聚类标签监督训练轻量级路由器；(iv) 通过可插拔的CUDA后端调度token。

Result: 在Imagenette上对DeiT-Small保留99.9%准确率（86.70% vs 86.73%）；消融实验表明共享SVD基是保持精度的核心因素；不同路由策略间精度差异不超过0.06个百分点；在五种ViT骨干上精度差异≤0.10个百分点；但CUDA路由开销使FFN速度慢1.3-1.7倍。

Conclusion: CLEAR-MoE能在不更新骨干权重的情况下将密集ViT转换为稀疏MoE模型并保持精度，路由策略本身对精度影响很小，主要挑战在于路由与调度的计算开销，未来需研发融合调度内核以优化性能。

Original Abstract: We present CLEAR-MoE, a four-phase post-training pipeline that converts a frozen pretrained Vision Transformer (ViT) into a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model without updating backbone weights. The pipeline (i) scores feed-forward network (FFN) layers by sparsity, clusterability, and output sensitivity; (ii) decomposes selected layers into a shared low-rank SVD basis and per-cluster residual experts using k-means clustering; (iii) trains lightweight routers supervised by cluster labels; and (iv) dispatches tokens through pluggable CUDA backends. On Imagenette with DeiT-Small, CLEAR-MoE retains 99.9% of the dense model's accuracy (86.70 +/- 0.02% versus 86.73%). Extensive ablation studies reveal a consistent empirical finding: the shared SVD basis is the primary factor responsible for preserving accuracy. Random routing, learned routing, and three different router architectures produce nearly identical performance, with accuracy varying by at most 0.06 percentage points (86.62%-86.68%). Accuracy also remains stable across different SVD ranks, expert counts (2-8), calibration set sizes (50-500), and random seeds. This behavior generalizes across five ViT backbones (DeiT-Tiny, DeiT-Small, DeiT-Base, ViT-Small, and ViT-Base), covering models from 5.7M to 86.6M parameters, with accuracy differences <= 0.10 percentage points from their dense counterparts. On a GTX 960 GPU, routing and scatter-gather overhead make the CLEAR-MoE FFN 1.3-1.7x slower than the dense implementation. A dispatch microbenchmark further shows that routing is an order of magnitude more memory-bound than expert matrix multiplications, identifying fused dispatch kernels as a promising direction for future optimization.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了CLEAR-MoE，一个四阶段后训练流水线，能够将冻结的预训练视觉Transformer（ViT）转换为稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型，而无需更新骨干网络权重。该流水线包括：(i) 基于稀疏度、可聚类性和输出敏感性对前馈网络（FFN）层进行评分；(ii) 使用k-means聚类将选定层分解为共享低秩SVD基和每聚类的残差专家；(iii) 通过聚类标签监督训练轻量级路由器；(iv) 通过可插拔的CUDA后端调度token。在Imagenette数据集上使用DeiT-Small模型时，CLEAR-MoE保留了密集模型99.9%的准确率（86.70% ± 0.02% 对比 86.73%）。广泛的消融研究揭示了一个一致的实证发现：共享的SVD基是保持准确率的主要因素。随机路由、学习路由以及三种不同的路由架构产生的性能几乎相同，准确率差异最多不超过0.06个百分点（86.62%-86.68%）。在不同的SVD秩、专家数量（2-8）、校准集大小（50-500）和随机种子下，准确率也保持稳定。该行为在五种ViT骨干网络（DeiT-Tiny、DeiT-Small、DeiT-Base、ViT-Small和ViT-Base）上具有泛化性，涵盖5.7M到86.6M参数的模型，准确率与其密集版本相比差异不超过0.10个百分点。在GTX 960 GPU上，路由和散射-收集开销使得CLEAR-MoE的FFN比密集实现的FFN慢1.3-1.7倍。调度微基准测试进一步表明，路由的内存瓶颈比专家矩阵乘法高出一个数量级，这表明融合调度内核是未来优化的一个有前景的方向。

</details>


### [30] [Detecting Clinical Hallucinations in LVLMs via Counterfactual Visual Grounding Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28520)
*Xiao Song,Haonan Qin,Zhaoxu Zhang,Jiong Zhang,Yuqi Fang,Caifeng Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于视觉可追溯的幻觉检测框架（CounterVHD），通过反事实实体扰动和视觉证据不确定性估计，在不修改LVLM内部状态的情况下，检测医学图像理解中的文本幻觉，并在多模态医学影像上取得优于基线方法的性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 大型视觉-语言模型在临床图像理解中容易产生"幻觉"（生成图像中不支持的文本发现或属性），现有检测方法通常需要修改模型或访问其内部隐藏状态，缺乏无需模型内部访问、可跨模型迁移的鲁棒检测方案。

Method: 首先从LVLM响应中提取视觉可验证实体，使用医学领域适配的Qwen-VL基础验证器在输入图像上定位每个实体；然后引入反事实实体扰动方法，通过对比事实与反事实的基础验证结果估计视觉证据不确定性；最后基于正例置信度、反事实置信度及其基础验证重叠度计算实体级不确定性分数，进行二分类幻觉决策。

Result: 在多种医学成像模态和多个LVLM骨干网络上，该方法在幻觉检测性能上一致优于近期基线方法，同时提供可解释的定位证据和强大的跨模型迁移能力。

Conclusion: 本文提出的CounterVHD框架是一种无需修改LVLM内部状态、具有跨模型可迁移性的医学图像幻觉检测方法，通过反事实扰动和视觉证据不确定性估计实现了鲁棒的幻觉识别，并为检测结果提供了可解释的视觉定位证据。

Original Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are increasingly used for clinical image understanding, yet they remain vulnerable to \emph{hallucinations}--producing textual findings or attributes not supported by the image. We present a vision-traceable hallucination detection framework that audits arbitrary LVLM responses via visual evidence grounding, requiring neither modification nor internal access to the hidden states of LVLMs. Given an LVLM response, we extract visually verifiable entities and use a medical-domain-adapted Qwen-VL grounding verifier to localize each entity on the input image. To enhance the robustness of our detection method, we introduce a counterfactual entity perturbation method and estimate visual evidence uncertainty by contrasting factual and counterfactual grounding results. Specifically, we compute an entity-level uncertainty score from the positive confidence, counterfactual confidence, and their grounding overlap for binary hallucination decision-making. Experiments on multiple medical imaging modalities and LVLM backbones demonstrate that our method consistently improves hallucination detection performance over recent baselines, while providing interpretable localization evidence and strong cross-model transferability. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Agentic-CliniAI/CounterVHD.

中文摘要翻译: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在临床图像理解中的应用越来越广泛，但它们仍然容易产生"幻觉"——即生成图像中不支持的文本发现或属性。我们提出了一种视觉可追溯的幻觉检测框架，该框架通过视觉证据基础验证来审计任意LVLM响应，既不需要修改LVLM，也不需要访问其内部隐藏状态。给定一个LVLM响应，我们提取视觉可验证的实体，并使用医学领域适配的Qwen-VL基础验证器在输入图像上定位每个实体。为了增强检测方法的鲁棒性，我们引入了一种反事实实体扰动方法，并通过对比事实与反事实的基础验证结果来估计视觉证据不确定性。具体来说，我们从正例置信度、反事实置信度及其基础验证重叠度计算实体级不确定性分数，用于二分类幻觉决策。在多种医学成像模态和LVLM骨干网络上的实验表明，我们的方法在幻觉检测性能上一致优于近期基线方法，同时提供可解释的定位证据和强大的跨模型迁移能力。代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/Agentic-CliniAI/CounterVHD 获取。

</details>

*Yuexi Du,Leya Barrientos,Laura Sheiman,John Lewin,Hemant D. Tagare,Nicha C. Dvornek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MammoFlow方法，利用CC与MLO视图间的几何关系，通过隐式3D一致性先验和基于推土机距离的自一致性损失，合成多视角乳腺X光图像，提升图像质量和下游分类性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 多视角乳腺X光成像依赖配对的CC和MLO视图提供互补投影，但高质量平衡数据集难以获取，现有深度学习方法缺乏对双视图间隐式几何组织对应关系的显式建模。

Method: 开发对齐模块搜索2D仿射变换子空间建立最优解剖对应；基于推土机距离(EMD)构建像素空间自一致性损失，约束生成图像沿前后(AP)轴的1D组织分布；将上述模块集成到预训练的流匹配模型MammoFlow中。

Result: 图像质量优于现有方法，通过放射科专家评估；生成的物理一致图像对将下游分类AUC提升5%。

Conclusion: 首次利用隐式几何组织对应关系引导多视角乳腺X光图像生成，证明几何先验能有效提升生成质量和下游任务性能。

Original Abstract: Multiview mammography relies on paired craniocaudal (CC) and mediolateral oblique (MLO) views to provide complementary projections of a 3D breast volume, enabling precise anomaly localization. However, acquiring high-quality, balanced datasets remains challenging for deep learning applications. We propose a novel method to synthesize multiview mammograms by leveraging the inherent geometric relationship between CC and MLO views. To enforce an implicit 3D consistency prior during generation, we develop an alignment module that searches a 2D affine transformation subspace to establish optimal anatomical correspondence. Leveraging this alignment, we introduce a pixel-space self-consistency loss based on the Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) between the 1D anteroposterior (AP) axis tissue distributions of the generated images. Integrated into a pretrained flow matching model, MammoFlow forces synthesized pairs to share physically plausible tissue distributions from the chest wall to the nipple. To our knowledge, this is the first work to guide multiview mammogram generation using implicit geometric tissue correspondence. Our method demonstrates superior image quality, passes expert radiologist evaluation, and generates physically consistent pairs that improve downstream classification AUC by 5%. Code is available at https://github.com/XYPB/MammoFlow

中文摘要翻译: 多视角乳腺X光成像依赖于配对的头尾位(CC)和内外斜位(MLO)视图，提供三维乳腺容积的互补投影，从而实现对异常的精确定位。然而，为深度学习应用获取高质量、平衡的数据集仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种新方法，通过利用CC和MLO视图之间固有的几何关系来合成多视角乳腺X光图像。为了在生成过程中施加隐式的三维一致性先验，我们开发了一个对齐模块，该模块在二维仿射变换子空间中搜索以建立最优解剖对应。基于该对齐，我们引入了一种基于推土机距离(EMD)的像素空间自一致性损失，约束生成图像沿前后轴(AP)的一维组织分布。该模块集成到预训练的流匹配模型MammoFlow中，迫使合成图像对共享从胸壁到乳头方向上物理上合理的组织分布。据我们所知，这是首个利用隐式几何组织对应关系引导多视角乳腺X光图像生成的工作。我们的方法展示了优越的图像质量，通过了放射科专家的评估，并且生成的物理一致性图像对将下游分类AUC提升了5%。代码已开源：https://github.com/XYPB/MammoFlow

TL;DR: 本文提出DCVLM基准，用于系统评估视觉语言模型（VLM）的数据策展策略，发现数据混合（而非过滤）是提升训练质量的关键，并构建了DCVLM-Baseline数据集，在8B模型上达到63.6%准确率，比最优开源数据集FineVision提升5.4个百分点。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有VLM训练依赖大规模数据策展，但缺乏系统性的基准来评估不同数据策展策略（如过滤、混合、格式化、采样）的效果，因此需要建立一个可控的、标准化的实验平台。

Method: 收集160个数据集（涵盖图像-文本对、多模态交错文档、纯文本、指令微调四种类型），构建6T多模态token语料库；提出DCVLM基准，支持在1B-8B模型规模和6.25B-200B token预算下测试过滤、混合、格式化、采样等策展策略；在52个下游基准（9个领域）上评估模型性能。

Result: 数据混合比数据过滤对训练质量的影响更大；指令密集型混合策略比标题密集型混合策略扩展性更好，且优势随规模增大而扩大；DCVLM-Baseline在8B模型、200B训练token下，33个核心任务平均准确率达63.6%，比FineVision提升5.4个百分点。

Original Abstract: Building performant Vision-Language Models (VLMs) requires carefully curating large-scale training datasets, yet the community lacks systematic benchmarks for evaluating such curation strategies. We introduce DataComp for VLMs (DCVLM), a benchmark for controlled data-centric experiments to improve VLM training. As part of DCVLM, we collect 160 datasets spanning four data types -- image-caption pairs, multimodal interleaved documents, text-only, and instruction-tuning data -- into a corpus of 6T multimodal tokens. DCVLM allows participants to test curation strategies (filtering, mixing, formatting, sampling) across 1B-8B models and 6.25B-200B token budgets. Models are then evaluated on a carefully selected suite of up to 52 downstream benchmarks across 9 domains. We conduct extensive experiments on DCVLM and find that data mixing, not filtering, is key to a high-quality training dataset: instruction-heavy mixtures scale better than caption-heavy ones, with gains widening at larger scales. 中文摘要翻译: 构建高性能视觉语言模型（VLM）需要精心策展大规模训练数据集，然而社区缺乏系统性的基准来评估此类策展策略。我们提出了面向VLM的DataComp（DCVLM），这是一个用于受控数据中心实验以改进VLM训练的基准。作为DCVLM的一部分，我们收集了160个数据集，涵盖四种数据类型——图像-文本对、多模态交错文档、纯文本和指令微调数据——构建成一个包含6T多模态token的语料库。DCVLM允许参与者在1B-8B模型规模和6.25B-200B token预算下测试策展策略（过滤、混合、格式化、采样）。随后，模型在精心挑选的、涵盖9个领域多达52个下游基准测试集上评估。我们在DCVLM上进行了广泛实验，发现数据混合（而非过滤）是构建高质量训练数据集的关键：指令密集型混合策略比标题密集型混合策略扩展性更好，且优势随规模增大而扩大。由此产生的数据集DCVLM-Baseline，在使用200B训练token训练8B VLM时，在33个核心任务套件上达到63.6%的准确率。与当前最先进的开源VLM训练数据集FineVision相比，这提升了5.4个百分点。DCVLM及其所有配套资源将在https://www.datacomp.ai/dcvlm/公开提供。

*Arthur Josi,Emeline Got,Abdallah Dib,Luiz Gustavo Hafemann,Rafael M. O. Cruz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: KM-Speaker 提出了一种基于关键点条件的流式生成框架，通过解耦音频驱动的唇部运动与关键点驱动的上半脸动态，并结合全局风格上下文保留机制，在数据受限条件下实现了高保真、可灵活控制的3D面部动画，在唇形同步、风格遵循和时序控制方面优于现有方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有可控3D面部动画模型通常依赖大规模低质量的“在野”数据集学习全局风格控制，这损害了动画的真实感；同时，这些框架缺乏细粒度的时间精度，难以满足对话定位（如配音）等任务中表情匹配与唇形同步同等关键的需求。

Method: 提出一种解耦策略，将音频驱动的唇部运动与关键点驱动的上半脸动态分离；设计全局风格上下文保留机制以确保全脸表现力的一致性；采用基于关键点条件的流式生成框架，同时提供全局风格引导和帧级时序控制。

Result: 在数据受限场景下，KM-Speaker 在唇形同步精度、风格遵循度和表达性时序控制方面 consistently 优于现有最先进方法，实现了高保真运动与灵活可控性。

Conclusion: KM-Speaker 推进了基于示例的3D面部动画技术，在数据受限条件下同时实现了高保真运动和灵活可控性，为生产级质量的语音驱动面部动画提供了有效方案。

Original Abstract: Speech-driven 3D facial animation methods face significant challenges in simultaneously achieving high-fidelity motion and precise artistic control at production quality. Existing controllable models typically learn global style control by relying on large-scale, low-quality \emph{in-the-wild} datasets that compromise overall animation realism. Furthermore, these frameworks often lack the fine-grained temporal precision required for demanding tasks such as dialogue localization (e.g., dubbing), where matching specific facial expressions is as critical as lip synchronization. We present KM-Speaker (Keypoint-Matching Speaker), a novel keypoint-conditioned flow-based generative framework that provides both global style guidance and frame-level temporal control from reference performances. We propose a disentanglement strategy that separates audio-driven lip motion from keypoint-driven upper-face dynamics, together with a global style context preservation mechanism to ensure coherent full-face expressiveness. KM-Speaker advances example-based 3D facial animation by achieving high-fidelity motion and flexible controllability in a data-constrained setting, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods in lip-sync accuracy, style adherence, and expressive temporal control.

中文摘要翻译: 语音驱动的3D面部动画方法在同时实现高保真运动和生产质量级别的精确艺术控制方面面临重大挑战。现有的可控模型通常依赖大规模、低质量的“在野”数据集来学习全局风格控制，但这会损害整体动画的真实感。此外，这些框架往往缺乏对话定位（如配音）等苛刻任务所需的细粒度时间精度，在这些任务中，匹配特定面部表情与唇形同步同样关键。我们提出KM-Speaker（关键点匹配说话人），一种新颖的基于关键点条件的流式生成框架，可从参考表演中同时提供全局风格引导和帧级时序控制。我们提出一种解耦策略，将音频驱动的唇部运动与关键点驱动的上半脸动态分离，并配合全局风格上下文保留机制以确保全脸表现力的连贯性。KM-Speaker在数据受限场景下推进了基于示例的3D面部动画，实现了高保真运动和灵活可控性，在唇形同步精度、风格遵循度和表达性时序控制方面 consistently 优于现有最先进方法。
