We introduce FiRe (Frequency Reparameterization), that accelerates optimization by reparameterizing per-neuron frequency of periodic INRs without changing their underlying activation function. FiRe gives each neuron a bounded, input-dependent frequency via a separate low-rank gating path and is applicable to any periodic activation function. The gate acts as an implicit preconditioner that improves optimization conditioning at initialization via the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK). This better-conditioned initialization makes optimization converge faster, and the high-frequency content of the reconstruction tracks the target more closely at a fixed computational budget. On 2D image fitting, FiRe increases PSNR over a parameter-matched baseline (up to +1 dB at short training budgets), with gains that vary with resolution and diminish at full convergence. We characterize how performance depends on resolution, rank, and training budget, and give an NTK account that predicts these trends.

中文摘要翻译: 周期性隐式神经表示（INR），如SIREN和FINER，为每个神经元分配相同的全局频率，当局部信号内容变化时，表示预算的利用效率低下。本文提出FiRe（频率重参数化），通过重新参数化周期性INR的每个神经元频率来加速优化，同时不改变其底层激活函数。FiRe通过一个独立的低秩门控路径为每个神经元提供有界的、输入依赖的频率，适用于任何周期激活函数。该门控作为一个隐式预条件子，通过神经正切核（NTK）改善初始化时的优化条件。这种更好条件的初始化使优化收敛更快，且在固定计算预算下，重建的高频内容更紧密地跟踪目标。在2D图像拟合任务中，FiRe相比参数匹配的基线提高了PSNR（在短训练预算下最高提升+1 dB），增益随分辨率和训练预算变化，完全收敛时增益减弱。我们刻画了性能如何依赖于分辨率、秩和训练预算，并给出了预测这些趋势的NTK解释。

</details>


### [116] [Can Machines Really See Objects in Images? A Study Based on Syntactic Distance and Visual Self-Referential Instances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29416)
*Xingyu Peng,Junran Wu,Yue Hou,Zhongliang Qiao,Jiaheng Liu,Shangzhe Li,Jichang Zhao,Wenjun Wu,Xianglong Liu,Yongxin Tong,Li Dong,Ke Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过构造一种最大方差二值噪声中的视觉自指任务（正样本含闭合方形，负样本边界像素翻转），提出“句法距离”概念来衡量类别可分性，发现ResNet和Vision Transformer在该任务上存在相变现象：当图像尺度超过临界点时，分类准确率骤降至随机猜测，且无法恢复。更大的训练集和模型仅能推迟这种崩溃，而全局注意力机制反而加速崩溃。这表明当前视觉架构在全局概念任务上存在结构性能力边界。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 探究视觉模型是否真正理解物体本身，抑或只是拟合表面的局部统计线索。作者受维特根斯坦“语言的界限即世界的界限”观点启发，认为模型的识别能力受限于其学习的描述系统，因此想检验当局部统计线索无法提供稳定分类依据时，模型是否仍能正确分类。

Method: 提出“句法距离”概念，通过衡量操作对称性来度量类别可分性：正距离表示存在可利用的局部特征，零距离则需要全局语义。构造最大方差二值噪声中的视觉自指任务：正样本包含闭合方形，负样本包含一个边界像素翻转的方形，两者全局语义不同但句法距离为零。在ResNet和Vision Transformer上进行实验。

Result: 实验发现一致的相变现象：当图像尺度超过临界点时，分类准确率骤降至随机猜测且在测试范围内无法恢复。更大训练集和模型仅推迟崩溃，而全局注意力机制（ViT）反而更早达到崩溃点。

Conclusion: 当前视觉架构在需要全局语义理解的任务上存在结构性能力边界，仅靠扩大数据和模型规模无法突破。通用智能可能需要创造新的语言描述系统，而非复用已有的学习范式。

Original Abstract: Can a vision model truly see an object, or does it only fit surface-level visual cues? Following Wittgenstein's view that the limits of language are the limits of the world, we view a model's recognition ability as bounded by the descriptive system it has learned. In current vision models, this system is often realized through learned feature representations that exploit local statistical cues. We therefore ask whether a model can still classify correctly when such local cues provide no stable basis for distinction. We formalize this question with syntactic distance, which measures class separability through the symmetry of the operations mapping one class to the other: positive distance exposes exploitable local features, whereas zero distance requires global semantics rather than local rules. We construct a visual self-referential task in maximum-variance binary noise: positive samples contain a closed square, while negative samples contain an otherwise identical square with one flipped boundary pixel. The two classes differ in global semantics but have zero syntactic distance, making local statistical shortcuts unreliable. Experiments on ResNets and Vision Transformers reveal a consistent phase-transition phenomenon, with accuracy collapsing to random guessing once the image scale crosses a critical point and does not recover within the tested range. Larger training sets and models only delay this collapse, while globally attentive ViTs reach it earlier. These results reveal a structural capability boundary of current architectures on global-concept tasks, suggesting that general intelligence may require creating new language, not reusing an existing one.

中文摘要翻译: 一个视觉模型是真的看到了物体，还是仅仅拟合了表面的视觉线索？遵循维特根斯坦关于"语言的界限即世界的界限"的观点，我们将模型的识别能力视作受限于其习得的描述系统。在当前视觉模型中，这一描述系统通常通过学习利用局部统计线索的特征表示来实现。因此，我们提出疑问：当局部线索无法提供稳定的区分依据时，模型是否仍能正确分类？我们通过"句法距离"来形式化这一问题，该指标通过衡量将一个类别映射到另一个类别的操作的对称性来度量类别可分性：正距离表示存在可利用的局部特征，而零距离则需要依赖全局语义而非局部规则。我们在最大方差二值噪声中构建了一个视觉自指任务：正样本包含一个闭合方形，而负样本包含一个与之相同但边界像素有一处翻转的方形。这两个类别在全局语义上不同，但句法距离为零，使得局部统计捷径不可靠。在ResNet和Vision Transformer上的实验揭示出一致的相变现象：一旦图像尺度超过临界点，准确率骤降至随机猜测水平，且在测试范围内无法恢复。更大的训练集和模型规模仅能推迟这一崩溃，而具备全局注意力的ViT反而更早达到该临界点。这些结果表明当前架构在全局概念任务上存在结构性能力边界，暗示通用智能可能需要创造新的语言，而非复用现有的语言。

</details>


### [117] [Bit-ViP: Leveraging Bit-planes to Preserve Visual Privacy in Images through Obfuscation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29417)
*Vishesh Kumar Tanwar,Ashish Gupta,Sanjay Madria,Sajal K. Das*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于位平面的图像混淆方案Bit-ViP，通过结合Lorenz混沌系统和差分隐私生成不可逆噪声，在保护视觉隐私的同时保持图像可用于识别任务，并在UCF101和HMDB51数据集上验证了其安全性优于现有方案。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有图像混淆方案要么易受恶意攻击（如模型反演可重构原始图像），要么生成不可训练的混淆图像导致识别精度不足，亟需一种既安全又可用的混淆方法。

Method: 提出Bit-ViP方案，采用基于位平面的端到端混淆函数，利用Lorenz混沌系统与差分隐私生成不可逆噪声嵌入混淆图像，使得攻击者难以从混淆图像中重构原始图像。

Result: 在UCF101和HMDB51两个行为识别数据集上进行了大量实验，针对重构攻击、像素频率、信息熵和像素互相关性进行了严格的安全性分析，证明了Bit-ViP相较于现有方案的显著改进。

Conclusion: Bit-ViP能够在保护视觉隐私的同时生成安全且可用于训练的图像，有效抵御多种攻击方式，为基于图像的识别任务提供了可行的隐私保护方案。

Original Abstract: The unprecedented growth of computer vision applications, such as surveillance systems and social media, raises security and visual privacy concerns, especially when data is stored on cloud servers. Image obfuscation offers a way to preserve visual privacy while maintaining an adequate level of usability; thus, it has been a topic of great interest in recent years. However, prior obfuscation schemes are either vulnerable to malicious attacks, such as model inversion to reconstruct original images from obfuscated images, or generate non-trainable obfuscated images, making them unusable for achieving reasonable accuracy. This paper proposes a novel bit-plane-based image obfuscation scheme, {\em Bit-ViP}, to preserve visual privacy for image-based recognition tasks. The Bit-ViP scheme produces secure, usable images by incorporating an innovative end-to-end obfuscation function. While doing so, the obfuscated image would contain non-invertible noise (generated by Lorenz's chaotic system and differential privacy), making it hard for an adversary to reconstruct the original image. We conduct extensive experiments on two popular activity recognition datasets, namely UCF101 and HMDB51, to validate the effectiveness of Bit-ViP. In the face of attacks on reconstruction, pixel frequency, information entropy, and pixel inter-correlation, we present a rigorous security analysis demonstrating tangible improvements over existing schemes.

中文摘要翻译: 监控系统和社交媒体等计算机视觉应用的空前增长引发了安全和视觉隐私方面的担忧，尤其当数据存储在云服务器上时。图像混淆提供了一种在保持足够可用性的同时保护视觉隐私的方法，因此近年来备受关注。然而，先前的混淆方案要么易受恶意攻击（例如通过模型反演从混淆图像重构原始图像），要么生成不可训练的混淆图像，使其无法用于实现合理的识别精度。本文提出了一种新颖的基于位平面的图像混淆方案Bit-ViP，用于保护基于图像识别任务的视觉隐私。Bit-ViP方案通过融合一种创新的端到端混淆函数，生成安全且可用的图像。同时，混淆图像包含由Lorenz混沌系统和差分隐私生成的不可逆噪声，使得攻击者难以重构原始图像。我们在两个流行的行为识别数据集UCF101和HMDB51上进行了大量实验，验证了Bit-ViP的有效性。针对重构攻击、像素频率、信息熵和像素互相关性，我们进行了严格的安全性分析，证明了其相较现有方案的显著改进。

</details>


### [118] [Robust Zero-shot Anomaly Detection under Limited Auxiliary Anomaly Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29428)
*Guanyu Lu,Fang Zhou,Cheqing Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DIVE 提出了首个在有限辅助异常先验下的零样本异常检测方法，通过浅层-深层文本嵌入注入策略和解耦机制，显著提升了在目标域中的异常检测性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有零样本异常检测方法假设辅助数据包含丰富的异常多样性，但实际目标域中的异常变化更复杂且不可预测，当辅助异常先验有限时性能严重下降，因此需要解决该场景下的性能退化问题。

Method: 提出 DIVE 方法：(1) 在视觉编码过程中采用浅层-深层文本嵌入注入策略，学习跨辅助训练域和多样目标域的通用异常概念；(2) 提出解耦机制，解决视觉嵌入中对象语义与对象无关文本提示之间的次优对齐问题。

Result: 在有限异常模式设定下，DIVE 在12个数据集上的平均性能：两个分类指标上分别超越 SOTA 基线16.2%和28.5%；三个分割指标上分别超越23.4%、24.1%和47.0%。在辅助数据异常多样性充足时仍保持高度竞争性能。

Conclusion: DIVE 有效解决了有限异常先验下的零样本异常检测性能退化问题，在异常模式有限和充足两种场景下均表现优异。

Original Abstract: Zero-shot anomaly detection aims to identify defects in arbitrary novel domains; however, existing models assume that the auxiliary data contains a rich diversity of anomalies, neglecting the far more complex and unpredictable variations in real-world target domains. This study introduces DIVE, the first approach to investigate the scenario of limited auxiliary anomaly priors and resolve the resulting substantial performance degradation. Through a shallow-and-deep text embedding injection strategy during visual encoding, DIVE learns to abstract generic anomaly concepts shared across the auxiliary training domain and diverse target domains. Moreover, we propose a disentanglement mechanism to tackle the suboptimal alignment between visual embeddings entangled with object semantics and object-agnostic textual prompts. Experiments demonstrate that, under the setting of limited anomaly patterns in auxiliary data, DIVE outperforms SOTA baselines by up to 16.2% and 28.5% on two classification metrics, and 23.4%, 24.1%, and 47.0% on three segmentation metrics, in terms of average performance across twelve datasets. Furthermore, it maintains highly competitive performance when auxiliary data exhibits sufficient anomaly diversity.

中文摘要翻译: 零样本异常检测旨在识别任意新领域中的缺陷；然而，现有模型假设辅助数据包含丰富的异常多样性，忽略了真实目标域中远更复杂且不可预测的变化。本研究提出了DIVE，这是首个探索有限辅助异常先验场景并解决由此导致的严重性能退化问题的方法。通过在视觉编码过程中采用浅层-深层文本嵌入注入策略，DIVE学习提取跨辅助训练域和多样化目标域共享的通用异常概念。此外，我们提出了一种解耦机制，以解决视觉嵌入中对象语义与对象无关文本提示之间的次优对齐问题。实验表明，在辅助数据异常模式有限的设定下，DIVE在12个数据集上的平均性能在两个分类指标上分别超越SOTA基线16.2%和28.5%，在三个分割指标上分别超越23.4%、24.1%和47.0%。此外，当辅助数据具有充足的异常多样性时，它仍然保持高度竞争性的性能。

</details>


### [119] [EvLIR: Learning Illumination Residuals from Ordered Events for Low-Light Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29430)
*Haoxian Zhou,Chuanzhi Xu,Langyi Chen,Pengfei Ye,Haodong Chen,Qiang Qu,Ali Anaissi,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EvLIR框架，利用有序事件流的时间残差信息进行低光图像增强，通过时序事件残差模块（TERM）和ConvGRU建模短窗口事件动态，在Retinex风格框架下实现光照估计和图像恢复，在四个基准上取得SOTA结果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 低光图像增强在输入帧存在结构缺失、饱和噪声和弱局部对比度时严重病态。事件相机提供高时间分辨率的异步亮度变化观测，但现有工作常将体素通道视为无序或静态特征堆叠，而非显式建模其窗口内的时间演化，削弱了事件的有用时间证据。

Method: 提出EvLIR框架，包含：1) 保留事件流的有序时间bin；2) 时序事件残差模块（TERM）用轻量级ConvGRU编码短窗口事件动态；3) 将时序状态转换为有界光照校正，为Retinex风格的光照估计提供空间自适应光度引导；4) 可靠性感知的图像-事件联合恢复。

Result: 在SDE和SDSD室内/室外四个基准上，EvLIR在12项数据集-度量对中取得11项最优，平均PSNR 25.63 dB、PSNR* 28.30 dB、SSIM 0.827。

Conclusion: 显式建模事件流中时间bin的有序演化能够有效提升低光图像增强性能，EvLIR框架通过时序残差学习和Retinex风格光照估计取得了优越结果。

Original Abstract: Low-light image enhancement is severely ill-posed when the input frame contains missing structure, saturated noise, and weak local contrast. Event cameras provide asynchronous brightness-change observations with high temporal resolution, but prior works often treat voxel channels as an unordered or static feature stack before fusion, rather than explicitly modeling their within-window temporal evolution, weakening the temporal evidence that makes events useful. We propose EvLIR, a temporal-residual enhancement framework that learns illumination residuals from ordered events for low-light image enhancement. Given a low-light frame and its aligned event voxel, EvLIR preserves the ordered temporal bins of the event stream and introduces a Temporal Event Residual Module (TERM) to encode short-window event dynamics with a lightweight ConvGRU. The resulting temporal state is converted into a bounded illumination correction, which provides spatially adaptive photometric guidance for Retinex-style illumination estimation and subsequent reliability-aware image-event restoration. On SDE and SDSD indoor/outdoor benchmarks, EvLIR achieves the best result on eleven of twelve dataset-metric pairs, with average scores of 25.63~dB PSNR, 28.30~dB PSNR*, and 0.827 SSIM across the four benchmarks.

中文摘要翻译: 低光图像增强在输入帧存在结构缺失、饱和噪声和弱局部对比度时严重病态。事件相机提供具有高时间分辨率的异步亮度变化观测，但现有工作常将体素通道视为无序或静态特征堆叠后再融合，而非显式建模其窗口内的时间演化，从而削弱了事件中有用的时间证据。本文提出EvLIR——一种从有序事件中学习光照残差的时序残差增强框架，用于低光图像增强。给定低光帧及其对齐的事件体素，EvLIR保留事件流中有序的时间bin，并引入时序事件残差模块（TERM），通过轻量级ConvGRU编码短窗口事件动态。得到的时序状态被转换为有界光照校正，为Retinex风格的光照估计及后续的可靠性感知图像-事件恢复提供空间自适应光度引导。在SDE和SDSD室内/室外基准上，EvLIR在12项数据集-度量对中取得11项最优结果，四个基准上的平均得分为PSNR 25.63 dB、PSNR* 28.30 dB、SSIM 0.827。

</details>


### [120] [Bridging VideoQA and Video-Guided Agentic Tasks via Generalized Keyframe Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29445)
*Sunqi Fan,Qingle Liu,Runqi Yin,Meng-Hao Guo,Shuojin Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了VG-GUIBench基准，用于评估MLLM-based GUI代理根据视频教程完成交互任务的能力，并提出了TASKER关键帧提取算法，该算法联合考虑任务相关性和场景动态来选择信息帧，在VideoQA和视频引导智能体任务上均取得了显著性能提升。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有VideoQA基准主要评估模型感知浅层视觉线索的能力，很少检验MLLM是否能从视频教程中学习深层知识或程序性技能并泛化到下游长程智能体任务，因此需要新的基准来填补这一评估空白。

Method: 提出了TASKER（Task-driven And Scene-aware Keyframe searchER）关键帧提取算法，该算法联合考虑任务相关性（task relevance）和场景动态（scene dynamics）两个维度来识别信息丰富的关键帧，用于提升视频理解与下游智能体任务的性能。

Result: TASKER在EgoSchema完整集上超越最佳基线2.0%，在NExT-QA数据集上超越1.8%，同时在视频引导的智能体任务基准上也取得了显著性能提升。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，通用化的关键帧提取方法在视频理解任务中具有巨大潜力，TASKER算法有效弥合了视频理解与下游智能体任务之间的差距。

Original Abstract: Video understanding is a fundamental capability for multimodal intelligence, and recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on Video Question Answering (VideoQA) benchmarks. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate whether models can perceive shallow visual cues, while rarely examining whether MLLMs can learn deeper knowledge or procedural skills from video tutorials and generalize them to downstream long-horizon agentic tasks. To address this gap, we introduce VG-GUIBench (Video-Guided GUI Benchmark), a new benchmark designed to evaluate whether MLLM-based GUI agents can follow video tutorials to complete corresponding GUI interactive tasks. Furthermore, we observe that the performance of models on both VideoQA and video-guided agentic tasks critically depends on effective keyframe extraction. Based on this observation, we propose TASKER (Task-driven And Scene-aware Keyframe searchER), a keyframe extraction algorithm that jointly considers task relevance and scene dynamics to identify informative frames. Experimental results demonstrate that TASKER achieves significant performance improvements on both VideoQA and video-guided agentic task benchmarks, outperforming the best baseline by 2.0% on the EgoSchema fullset and 1.8% on the NExT-QA dataset, respectively. These results further highlight the potential of generalized keyframe extraction methods for video understanding tasks. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/VG-GUI-TASKER/VG-GUI-TASKER.

中文摘要翻译: 视频理解是多模态智能的基础能力，近年来多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视频问答（VideoQA）基准上取得了显著性能。然而，现有基准主要评估模型是否能够感知浅层视觉线索，很少检验MLLM是否能从视频教程中学习更深层的知识或程序性技能，并将其泛化到下游长程智能体任务中。为填补这一空白，我们提出了VG-GUIBench（Video-Guided GUI Benchmark），这是一个新的基准，旨在评估基于MLLM的GUI代理是否能跟随视频教程完成相应的GUI交互任务。此外，我们观察到模型在VideoQA和视频引导智能体任务上的性能关键依赖于有效的关键帧提取。基于这一发现，我们提出了TASKER（Task-driven And Scene-aware Keyframe searchER），一种联合考虑任务相关性和场景动态来识别信息帧的关键帧提取算法。实验结果表明，TASKER在VideoQA和视频引导智能体任务基准上均取得了显著的性能提升，在EgoSchema完整集上超越最佳基线2.0%，在NExT-QA数据集上超越1.8%。这些结果进一步凸显了通用化关键帧提取方法在视频理解任务中的潜力。我们的代码和数据已在https://github.com/VG-GUI-TASKER/VG-GUI-TASKER公开。

</details>


### [121] [Miti360: A Comprehensive Dataset for Improved Reforestation Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29447)
*Cedric Kiplimo,Samuel Mbatia,Ciira wa Maina,Arthur Sichangi,Dennis Gitundu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Miti360 是一个面向肯尼亚Kieni森林的高分辨率遥感与地面实测数据集，旨在弥补非洲森林监测数据的缺失。通过微调，DeepForest模型的框精度提升12%，召回率提升69%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有森林监测训练数据主要来自北美、欧洲、亚洲和澳大利亚，非洲林业数据存在严重空白，缺乏地理多样性。

Method: 在肯尼亚Kieni森林770公顷区域采集2023年3月至2025年2月的数据，包括无人机正射影像、地面图像、树木生物物理参数、物种、GPS坐标及历史气象数据；使用DJI Mavic 2 Pro航拍，Agisoft Metashape拼接，ArcGIS Pro切片，智能手机和定制立体相机采集地面图像。

Result: 通过微调，DeepForest模型的框精度提升12%，框召回率提升69%，并成功实现了三年间树冠的追踪。

Conclusion: Miti360能够支持机器学习系统加速树木普查、物种与地理区域匹配、基于气象条件的生长建模以及数字孪生框架开发，有效推进撒哈拉以南非洲地区的再造林监测和可持续林业实践。

Original Abstract: Over the past decade, interest in applying machine learning (ML) to automate forest monitoring has grown significantly. However, existing training datasets are predominantly drawn from North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia, leaving a critical gap in African forestry data. To address this limited geographic diversity, we present Miti360, a comprehensive dataset for reforestation monitoring that comprises high-resolution imagery, ground truth data, and longitudinal weather data. Data collection occurred within a 770-ha reforested section of the Kieni Forest in Kenya between March 2023 and February 2025. Miti360 comprises aerial photos (orthophotos and tiles) with tree bounding box annotations, terrestrial images (single and stereo), and detailed data records including tree biophysical parameters, species, and GPS coordinates, alongside historical weather data. Aerial surveys utilized a DJI Mavic 2 Pro, with imagery stitched via Agisoft Metashape and tiled using ArcGIS Pro, while terrestrial captures used smartphones and custom stereo cameras. Miti360 enables the training of ML systems for tasks such as accelerating tree censuses, matching species to geographical areas, modelling growth based on weather conditions, and developing digital twin frameworks. Models can be trained on Miti360 to address challenges specific to Sub-Saharan Africa, ultimately advancing reforestation monitoring and fostering sustainable forestry practices in underrepresented regions. We demonstrate the utility of this dataset by successfully tracking tree crowns across three years and improving the DeepForest model's box precision and box recall by 12% and 69% respectively through fine-tuning on Miti360.

中文摘要翻译: 过去十年间，利用机器学习自动化森林监测的兴趣显著增长。然而，现有的训练数据集主要来自北美、欧洲、亚洲和澳大利亚，非洲林业数据存在严重空白。为解决这一地理多样性不足的问题，我们提出了Miti360——一个面向再造林监测的综合数据集，包含高分辨率影像、地面真值数据和长期气象数据。数据采集于2023年3月至2025年2月期间，在肯尼亚Kieni森林一块770公顷的再造林区域内进行。Miti360包括带有树木边界框标注的航拍照片（正射影像和切片）、地面图像（单目和立体）以及详细的记录数据，涵盖树木生物物理参数、树种和GPS坐标，同时附有历史气象数据。航测采用DJI Mavic 2 Pro无人机，图像通过Agisoft Metashape拼接并使用ArcGIS Pro切片，地面图像使用智能手机和定制立体相机采集。Miti360能够支持机器学习系统的训练，用于加速树木普查、将树种与地理区域匹配、基于气象条件建模生长以及开发数字孪生框架。通过Miti360训练的模型可应对撒哈拉以南非洲特有的挑战，最终推进再造林监测并促进代表性不足地区的可持续林业实践。我们通过在三年间成功追踪树冠，以及通过Miti360微调使DeepForest模型的框精度和框召回率分别提升12%和69%，验证了该数据集的实用性。

</details>


### [122] [The Platonic Defense: Backdoor Defense for Self-Supervised Encoders in the Era of Large Scale Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29451)
*Tuo Chen,Minjing Dong,Benlei Cui,Jian Liu,Jie Gui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为"柏拉图表示防御"的黑盒测试时防御范式，通过能量函数对自监督学习模型中的后门攻击进行检测和表示净化，无需攻击先验知识、标签或训练数据。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 自监督学习预训练模型易受后门攻击，而现有防御方法在全黑盒场景下往往需要访问标签、攻击模式或训练数据，难以有效防御。

Method: 受柏拉图表示假说启发，将防御形式化为一个条件能量函数，该函数定义在源表示和一组参考表示之上。能量函数通过噪声对比估计进行检测训练，通过去噪得分匹配进行表示净化训练。理论保证上，匹配与不匹配样本之间的能量间隙由源表示与参考表示之间的互信息下界约束。

Result: 在多个自监督编码器和超过10种攻击上验证了有效性，该方法能同时进行表示检测和表示净化，在多种攻击下均取得显著性能提升。

Conclusion: 提出了一种攻击无关、模型无关、模态无关的黑盒测试时防御方法，理论上通过互信息保证了能量间隙的下界，实验上在多种攻击和编码器上表现优异。

Original Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) pretrained models have become a dominant paradigm for visual representation learning, but they are vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Existing defenses struggle to defend against such attacks in a fully black-box setting because they often require access to labels, attack patterns, or training data. To tackle this issue, we propose a new attack-agnostic, model-agnostic, and modality-agnostic black-box test-time defense paradigm, called \emph{Platonic Representation Defense}. It is inspired by the Platonic Representation Hypothesis, which suggests that large-scale independently trained encoders converge toward compatible projections of the same underlying reality. We formalize this idea as a conditional energy function defined over source representations and a set of reference representations. The energy function is trained for detection through noise-contrastive estimation and for representation purification through denoising score matching. Theoretically, the energy gap between matched and mismatched samples is lower bounded by the mutual information between source and reference representations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on multiple self-supervised encoders and more than 10 attacks. The method can perform both representation detection and purification, and achieves substantial performance gains across multiple attacks. Code is available \href{https://github.com/jsrdcht/Platonic-Representation-Defense}{here}.

中文摘要翻译: 自监督学习（SSL）预训练模型已成为视觉表示学习的主导范式，但它们容易受到后门攻击。现有防御方法在全黑盒场景下难以有效防御这类攻击，因为它们通常需要访问标签、攻击模式或训练数据。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的攻击无关、模型无关且模态无关的黑盒测试时防御范式，称为"柏拉图表示防御"。该方法的灵感来源于柏拉图表示假说，该假说认为大规模独立训练的编码器会收敛到对同一潜在现实的兼容投影。我们将这一思想形式化为一个定义在源表示和一组参考表示上的条件能量函数。该能量函数通过噪声对比估计训练用于检测，通过去噪得分匹配训练用于表示净化。理论上，匹配样本与不匹配样本之间的能量间隙由源表示与参考表示之间的互信息下界约束。我们在多个自监督编码器和超过10种攻击上验证了该方法的有效性。该方法能同时执行表示检测和表示净化，在多种攻击下均取得了显著的性能提升。代码已公开。

</details>


### [123] [Resonant Brane Splatting for Arbitrary-Scale Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29453)
*Giulio Federico,Giuseppe Amato,Claudio Gennaro,Fabio Carrara,Marco Di Benedetto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RBS是一种前馈式任意尺度超分框架，用Brane基元替代平面高斯，通过高斯-厄米特模式编码局部对比和纹理，结合基于量子转折点的精确剔除策略，在加速渲染的同时提升重建质量。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于2D高斯溅射的ASR方法中，标准高斯是平滑低通基元，建模边缘和精细纹理需要大量重叠且对齐良好的高斯，造成光栅化瓶颈。

Method: 提出Brane基元，在标准高斯包络上增加内部高斯-厄米特模式，每个模式分配独立颜色系数；零阶模式对应标准GS，高阶模式捕获高频信息。同时引入基于经典量子转折点的精确剔除策略的可微分光栅化器，跳过非贡献区域。

Result: 在标准ASR基准上，RBS在重建质量上优于隐式解码器和GS基线，且实现了比先前GS方法更优的速度-质量权衡。

Conclusion: Brane基元能以更少的重叠基元实现高质量重建，结合高效剔除策略，有效解决GS在ASR中的计算瓶颈。

Original Abstract: Arbitrary-Scale Super-Resolution (ASR) reconstructs images at continuous magnification factors. Recent methods accelerate inference by replacing computationally heavy implicit neural decoders with explicit 2D Gaussian Splatting (GS). However, since standard Gaussians are smooth low-pass primitives, modeling edges and fine textures requires multiple overlapping, well-aligned splats, which creates severe bottlenecks during rasterization. To address this, we introduce Resonant Brane Splatting (RBS), a feed-forward ASR framework. RBS replaces flat Gaussians with Branes: expressive primitives that emit spatially varying colors to natively model local contrast and complex textures within a single footprint. We achieve this by augmenting the standard Gaussian envelope with internal Gaussian-Hermite modes, assigning a distinct color coefficient to each. The zero-order mode recovers standard GS, while higher-order modes capture high frequencies. We predict Brane parameters directly from low-resolution features. Because Branes provide a mathematically richer formulation than simple Gaussians, far fewer primitives need to overlap to reconstruct a given target pixel. To exploit this, we introduce an efficient fully differentiable rasterizer with a precise culling strategy based on the classical quantum turning point. This allows us to safely skip negligible regions, drastically reducing the rendering overhead. Experiments on standard ASR benchmarks show that RBS improves reconstruction quality over implicit and GS baselines, while achieving superior speed-quality trade-off than prior GS methods.

中文摘要翻译: 任意尺度超分辨率(ASR)旨在以连续放大因子重建图像。近期方法通过将计算密集的隐式神经解码器替换为显式2D高斯溅射(GS)来加速推理。然而，由于标准高斯是平滑的低通基元，建模边缘和精细纹理需要多个重叠且对齐良好的高斯，这给光栅化过程带来了严重瓶颈。为解决这一问题，我们提出了共振膜溅射(RBS)，一种前馈式ASR框架。RBS将平面高斯替换为Brane：一种表达力丰富的基元，能够在单一足迹内发射空间变化的颜色，从而原生地建模局部对比度和复杂纹理。我们通过在标准高斯包络上增加内部高斯-厄米特模式来实现这一点，为每个模式分配独立的颜色系数。零阶模式恢复标准GS，而高阶模式捕获高频信息。我们直接从低分辨率特征预测Brane参数。由于Brane在数学上比简单高斯提供更丰富的表达形式，重建给定目标像素所需的基元重叠数量大大减少。为利用这一特性，我们引入了一个高效的、完全可微的光栅化器，并基于经典量子转折点设计了精确的剔除策略。这使我们能够安全地跳过可忽略区域，显著降低渲染开销。在标准ASR基准上的实验表明，RBS在重建质量上优于隐式方法和GS基线，同时相比先前GS方法实现了更优的速度-质量权衡。

</details>


### [124] [From Phase to Phenomenon: Self-Supervised Learning of Subsurface Scattering with Minimal Phase-shift Inputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29461)
*Arjun Majumdar,Raphael Braun,Andreas Engelhardt,Hendrik PA. Lensch*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种自监督预训练框架，仅需8张高频相位偏折图像即可学习次表面散射光传输表征，通过定制化数据增强和专用损失函数，在复杂几何材质物体上实现高质量重建，所需图像数量比之前方法少几个数量级。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有次表面散射光传输重建方法需要大量输入图像，采集成本高、效率低，亟需一种能从极少输入中学习通用SSS表征的自监督方法。

Method: 利用立体投影-相机系统，每视角仅采集8张高频相位偏折图像；设计针对PSP-SSS数据的定制化增强策略；采用编码器-解码器架构，预训练编码器后迁移至下游任务；提出专用损失函数提升各向异性足迹重建精度。

Result: 定制化增强策略显著优于标准ImageNet式增强；预训练编码器学到的SSS表征可泛化至未见复杂几何材质物体；相比先前方法，所需图像数量减少几个数量级，同时实现高保真重建。

Conclusion: 提出的自监督框架能从极少量PSP图像中学习通用且可迁移的SSS表征，大幅降低了采集成本，为实际应用中的次表面散射重建提供了高效可行的方案。

Original Abstract: We propose a self-supervised pretraining framework for learning sub-surface scattering (SSS) light transport representations from minimal input. Our method leverages a stereo projector-camera setup that captures only eight high-frequency phase-shift profilometry (PSP) images per view to pretrain an encoder in a multi-view, multi-object setting. We introduce a tailored augmentation strategy for PSP-based SSS data, and show that it significantly outperforms standard ImageNet-style augmentations for SSL pretraining. The pretrained encoder learns generalizable SSS representations that transfer effectively to downstream tasks, including spatially varying relighting and representation evaluation using a kNN classifier. Combined with a decoder, the model reconstructs dense scattering footprint responses, trained using a dedicated cost function that improves accuracy, particularly for anisotropic footprints. Despite using only eight input images per view, our approach generalizes to unseen objects with complex geometry and material properties, achieving high-fidelity reconstructions while requiring orders of magnitude fewer images than prior methods.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了一种自监督预训练框架，用于从极少量输入中学习次表面散射光传输表征。该方法利用立体投影-相机设置，每视角仅采集八张高频相位偏折图像，即可在多视角多物体场景中预训练编码器。我们引入了一种针对基于PSP的SSS数据的定制化增强策略，并证明该策略在自监督预训练中显著优于标准的ImageNet风格增强。预训练编码器学习了可泛化的SSS表征，并有效迁移至下游任务，包括空间可变重光照以及使用kNN分类器的表征评估。结合解码器后，模型可重建密集的散射足迹响应，使用专用损失函数进行训练，尤其提高了各向异性足迹的精度。尽管每视角仅使用八张输入图像，我们的方法仍能泛化至具有复杂几何和材质属性的未见物体，实现高保真重建，同时所需图像量比先前方法少几个数量级。

</details>


### [125] [MIRROR: Aligning Semantic Relations from Language to Image via Gromov--Wasserstein](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29462)
*Hong-Han Wang,Yuntao Wang,Hu Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MIRROR框架，通过最优传输理论中的Semi-Inverse Gromov-Wasserstein (SI-GW) 问题，将语言模型中的关系先验几何地迁移到视觉表示中，解决多模态大模型在视觉上下文中无法正确应用概念间关系的问题。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 多模态大模型虽然从语言骨干中继承了丰富的关系先验，但在视觉上下文中却经常无法正确应用这些关系。现有基于投影的对齐方法只关注单个视觉token的语义正确性，从未检查概念间的关系是否在从语言到视觉的跨模态迁移中得以保留，存在结构盲点。

Method: 提出MIRROR框架，核心是Semi-Inverse Gromov-Wasserstein (SI-GW) 问题，这是一个将视觉表示与语言导出的关系先验对齐的逆几何问题。该方法具有唯一闭式解，可高效计算并适用于长token序列。在decoder-only Transformer中，设计了层、注意力头和token级别的策略，无需额外参数或增加推理成本即可稳定提取关系结构。

Result: MIRROR在提升关系一致性的同时，保持了通用视觉-语言任务的性能。

Conclusion: 通过几何正则化框架将语言中的关系先验迁移到视觉表示，可以有效解决多模态大模型在视觉上下文中关系推理失败的问题，且不带来额外参数或推理成本。

Original Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) inherit rich relational priors from their language backbones, yet often fail when asked to apply these relationships in visual contexts. We trace this failure to a structural blind spot: projection-based alignment trains each visual token to carry the right semantics, but never asks whether the relationships between concepts survive the crossing from language to vision. To address this, we propose MIRROR (Mapping Inter-concept Relations from language to visual Representation via Optimal-transport-based Regularization), a geometric regularization framework that transfers relational priors from language to vision by exploiting the rich relational structure encoded in language representations. Specifically, we derive a surrogate loss from the proposed Semi-Inverse Gromov-Wasserstein (SI-GW) problem, an inverse geometric problem that aligns visual representations with language-derived relational priors. We show that this formulation admits a unique closed-form solution that prescribes the ideal visual relational structure implied by language geometry and cross-modal coupling. The structure of the formulation also enables efficient computation, making it applicable to long token sequences. Applying SI-GW inside decoder-only Transformers requires careful design. We introduce targeted strategies at the layer, head, and token levels to ensure stable extraction without additional parameters or inference cost. MIRROR improves relational consistency while preserving performance on general vision-language tasks.

中文摘要翻译: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）从其语言骨干中继承了丰富的关系先验，但在被要求在视觉上下文中应用这些关系时却经常失败。我们将这一失败追溯到一个结构盲点：基于投影的对齐方法训练每个视觉token携带正确的语义，但从未检查概念间的关系是否在从语言到视觉的跨模态迁移中得以保留。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了MIRROR（通过基于最优传输的正则化将概念间关系从语言映射到视觉表示），这是一种几何正则化框架，通过利用语言表示中编码的丰富关系结构，将关系先验从语言迁移到视觉。具体来说，我们从提出的半逆Gromov-Wasserstein（SI-GW）问题中推导出一个代理损失，这是一个将视觉表示与语言导出的关系先验对齐的逆几何问题。我们证明了该公式具有唯一的闭式解，该解规定了由语言几何和跨模态耦合所隐含的理想视觉关系结构。该公式的结构还支持高效计算，使其适用于长token序列。在仅decoder的Transformer中应用SI-GW需要仔细设计。我们引入了层、注意力头和token级别的针对性策略，以确保在无需额外参数或推理成本的情况下稳定提取。MIRROR在保持通用视觉-语言任务性能的同时，提升了关系一致性。

</details>


### [126] [CellDETR: A Detection-Guided Framework for Scalable Cell Representation Learning from Histopathology Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29463)
*Shikang Zhang,Guojun Li,Yicong Mao,Chulin Sha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CellDETR是一个基于Deformable DETR的检测引导框架，通过位置特征解耦和框约束注意力机制，实现从全切片图像中可扩展的细胞级表示学习，在细胞分类任务上超越现有方法，并展示了良好的跨数据集迁移能力。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的病理基础模型在补丁级和切片级表示学习上取得了显著进展，但细胞级表示学习仍未得到充分探索，这限制了细胞层面可解释性、生物学发现和临床转化。因此需要一种可扩展的细胞级表示学习框架。

Method: 提出了CellDETR框架，基于Deformable DETR，引入位置特征解耦（location feature decoupling）和框约束注意力机制（box-constrained attention mechanism），实现从WSI中自动化提取细胞级嵌入。同时结合对比学习设计，构建了基于CellDETR的预训练模型，可从无标签WSI中进行可扩展的细胞表示学习。

Result: 1) 在PanNuke数据集上的有监督细胞分类任务中优于现有最优方法；2) 基于对比学习的预训练模型提升了下游细胞分类性能；3) 使用Xenium空间转录组学衍生的细胞注释进行预训练后，实现了准确的跨数据集细胞分类，证明了细胞嵌入的可迁移性和生物学相关性。

Conclusion: CellDETR为可解释计算病理学提供了一种可扩展的通用细胞级表示学习框架。

Original Abstract: Recent advances in pathology foundation models have substantially improved patch and slide level representation learning from whole-slide images (WSIs).However, cell-level representations learning remain underexplored, limiting cell resolved interpretability, biological discovery, and clinical translation. We propose CellDETR, a detection-guided framework built on Deformable DETR for scalable cell representation learning from WSIs. By introducing location feature decoupling and box-constrained attention mechanism, CellDETR enables automated extraction of cell-level embeddings, and outperform existing state-of-the-art methods in supervised cell classification on PanNuke data. In addition, by incorporating contrastive learning design, we build a CellDETR-based pretraining model for scalable cell representation learning from unlabeled WSIs, which improves downstream cell classification performance. Furthermore, we show that after pretraining with Xenium spatial transcriptomics-derived cell annotations, CellDETR achieves accurate cross-dataset cell classification, demonstrating the transferability and biological relevance of the learned cell embeddings. Together, CellDETR provides a scalable route toward general cell-level representation learning framework for interpretable computational patholog

中文摘要翻译: 病理基础模型的最新进展已经显著改善了从全切片图像（WSI）中进行补丁级和切片级表示学习的能力。然而，细胞级表示学习仍未得到充分探索，这限制了细胞层面的可解释性、生物学发现和临床转化。我们提出了CellDETR，一种基于Deformable DETR构建的检测引导框架，用于从WSI中进行可扩展的细胞表示学习。通过引入位置特征解耦和框约束注意力机制，CellDETR能够自动提取细胞级嵌入，并在PanNuke数据集上的有监督细胞分类任务中优于现有最先进方法。此外，通过结合对比学习设计，我们构建了基于CellDETR的预训练模型，可以从无标签WSI中进行可扩展的细胞表示学习，从而提升下游细胞分类性能。进一步地，我们展示了在使用Xenium空间转录组学衍生的细胞注释进行预训练后，CellDETR能够实现准确的跨数据集细胞分类，证明了所学细胞嵌入的可迁移性和生物学相关性。综上所述，CellDETR为可解释计算病理学提供了一种迈向通用细胞级表示学习框架的可扩展路径。

</details>


### [127] [Rank-Aware Hyperbolic Alignment for Vision-Language Dataset Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29464)
*Jongoh Jeong,Sun-Kyung Lee,Kuk-Jin Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种秩感知双曲对齐方法（RAHA），用于视觉-语言数据集蒸馏，通过在双曲空间中分层对齐共享语义并正则化残差子空间，提升跨模态检索与迁移鲁棒性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有VLDD方法在全维欧氏空间中强制对齐，但由于图像-文本相关性存在秩亏问题（共享语义集中在低维范围，残差子空间弱相关），导致对齐过于严格；而LoRS虽引入低秩分解放松对齐，但未显式控制表示空间中的主导对齐容量与结构。

Method: 提出秩感知双曲对齐（RAHA），将多模态表示提升到双曲空间，采用非对称目标优化蒸馏对：在共享范围内强制测地线对齐，同时正则化残差子空间以保留模态私有多样性并提升迁移鲁棒性。

Result: 在基准测试上，RAHA在固定预算下展示了具有竞争力的跨模态检索性能和改进的迁移指标。

Conclusion: RAHA通过结合层次几何与显式的对齐容量控制，有效缓解了欧氏空间中全维对齐的过度约束问题，在数据集压缩任务中实现了更优的跨模态对齐与迁移能力。

Original Abstract: Vision-language dataset distillation (VLDD) compresses a large image-text paired dataset into a small set of synthetic pairs that can efficiently train contrastive vision-language models under strict data and compute budgets. Most existing methods match expert trajectories or cross-modal statistics, yet still enforce full-dimensional alignment in a Euclidean embedding space. This is often overly restrictive due to rank-deficient image--text correlation, with shared semantics concentrated in a low-dimensional range and remaining variation spread across a weakly correlated residual subspace. LoRS relaxes alignment at the similarity level by low-rank factorization, but does not explicitly control dominant alignment capacity and structure in the representation space. We thus propose a rank-aware hyperbolic alignment (RAHA) that combines hierarchical geometry with explicit alignment-capacity control. RAHA lifts multimodal representations to hyperbolic space and optimizes distilled pairs with asymmetric objectives that enforce geodesic alignment in the shared range while regularizing the residual subspace to preserve modality-private diversity and improve transfer robustness. Experiments on benchmarks show that RAHA demonstrates competitive cross-modal retrieval and improved transfer indicators under fixed budgets.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉-语言数据集压缩（VLDD）将大规模图像-文本配对数据集压缩为少量合成配对，可在严格的数据和计算预算下高效训练对比式视觉-语言模型。现有方法大多匹配专家轨迹或跨模态统计量，但仍强制在欧氏嵌入空间中实现全维度对齐。由于图像-文本相关性存在秩亏问题——共享语义集中在低维范围，而剩余变化分布在弱相关的残差子空间上——这种对齐往往过于严格。LoRS通过低秩分解在相似性层面放松对齐，但未显式控制表示空间中的主导对齐容量与结构。为此，我们提出一种秩感知双曲对齐（RAHA）方法，结合层次几何与显式的对齐容量控制。RAHA将多模态表示提升到双曲空间，并采用非对称目标优化蒸馏配对：在共享范围内强制测地线对齐，同时正则化残差子空间以保留模态私有多样性并提升迁移鲁棒性。基准实验表明，在固定预算下，RAHA展示了具有竞争力的跨模态检索性能和改善的迁移指标。

</details>


### [128] [MAVIN: Multi-Shot Audio-Visual Generation with Narrative Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29473)
*Kaiqi Liu,Yunyao Mao,Ziqi Cai,Zheng Geng,Jing Wang,Qiulin Wang,Xintao Wang,Pengfei Wan,Kun Gai,Shuchen Weng,Boxin Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MAVIN提出了一种边界感知注意力机制、身份感知传播机制和多智能体脚本生成流水线，首次实现了多镜头音视频生成的自定义叙事控制，在解决时间错位、多主体可控性和完整脚本化方面达到最优性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有生成模型虽能生成高保真视频，但在需要复杂叙事控制的多镜头音视频生成中，存在时间错位、可控性有限以及脚本不完整等问题。

Method: 1）边界感知注意力机制：利用分层标题和边界感知token路由，在各自时间边界内渲染音视频元素；2）身份感知传播机制：利用身份嵌入和身份感知掩码，将特定身份绑定到一致的视觉外观和声音音色；3）多智能体脚本生成流水线：将用户自由形式输入转换为分层标题。

Result: 在构建的MAVINSet数据集上的大量实验表明，MAVIN达到了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: MAVIN为将生成模型整合到专业电影制作工作流中开辟了新途径。

Original Abstract: While recent generative models produce high-fidelity videos, they struggle with the complex narrative control required for coherent multi-shot audio-visual generation. Existing methods suffer from temporal misalignment, limited controllability, and incomplete scripting. In this paper, we propose MAVIN, the first framework for multi-shot audio-visual generation with customized narrative control. To resolve temporal misalignment, we propose boundary-aware attention, which leverages hierarchical captions and boundary-aware token routing to render audio-visual elements within their respective temporal boundaries. To improve the controllability for multi-subject scenarios, we propose ID-aware propagation, utilizing identity embeddings and an identity-aware mask to bind specific identities to consistent visual appearances and vocal timbres. To provide comprehensive audio-visual narratives, we present a multi-agent scripting pipeline to transform free-form user inputs into hierarchical captions. Furthermore, we construct MAVINSet, a multi-shot audio-visual dataset for robust training and evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MAVIN achieves state-of-the-art performance, opening up a new avenue for integrating generative models into professional filmmaking workflows.

中文摘要翻译: 虽然当前的生成模型能够生成高保真视频，但在多镜头音视频生成所需的复杂叙事控制方面仍存在不足。现有方法存在时间错位、可控性有限以及脚本不完整等问题。在本文中，我们提出了MAVIN，这是首个支持自定义叙事控制的多镜头音视频生成框架。为解决时间错位问题，我们提出了边界感知注意力机制，该机制利用分层标题和边界感知token路由，在各自的时间边界内渲染音视频元素。为提升多主体场景下的可控性，我们提出了身份感知传播机制，利用身份嵌入和身份感知掩码将特定身份绑定到一致的视觉外观和声音音色上。为提供全面的音视频叙事，我们提出了一种多智能体脚本生成流水线，将用户自由形式的输入转化为分层标题。此外，我们构建了MAVINSet——一个用于鲁棒训练和评估的多镜头音视频数据集。大量实验表明，MAVIN达到了最先进的性能，为将生成模型整合到专业电影制作工作流中开辟了新途径。

</details>


### [129] [VCS-SLAM: Geometry-Validated Semantic Evidence Fusion for 3D Gaussian SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29494)
*Raman Jha,Shuaihang Yuan,Yi Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VCS-SLAM提出了一种基于几何验证的语义证据融合框架，通过在3D高斯SLAM中评估语义观测的几何可靠性（可见一致性、表面支撑边界证据、射线级冲突不确定性），抑制遮挡、语义边界模糊和射线几何歧义带来的伪影，提升了语义建图的精度和重建质量。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的语义3D高斯SLAM方法对2D语义先验采用统一的优化权重进行融合，但遮挡、不支持的语义边界和歧义的射线几何会导致全局高斯地图中出现持久的语义伪影。

Method: 提出VCS-SLAM框架，通过可见一致性、表面支撑边界证据和射线级冲突不确定性来评估每个语义观测的几何可靠性，构建可靠性感知的目标函数，抑制遮挡区域的语义更新、减少无支撑的语义渗漏、延迟模糊区域的早期标签分配。

Result: 在Replica数据集上展示了改进的语义一致性、边界保持和重建质量；在ScanNet数据集上证明了在真实RGB-D输入下保持竞争力的跟踪性能。

Conclusion: 通过几何验证的可靠性评估能有效提升语义3D高斯SLAM的语义一致性和地图重建质量。

Original Abstract: Visual SLAM performance often deteriorates in complex real-world applications. Semantic 3D Gaussian SLAM commonly fuses 2D semantic priors into a persistent 3D map using uniform optimization weights. However, such priors are not equally reliable in online mapping: occlusions, unsupported semantic boundaries, and ambiguous ray geometry can introduce persistent semantic artifacts into the global Gaussian map. We propose VCS-SLAM, a geometry-validated semantic evidence fusion framework for RGB-D 3D Gaussian SLAM. Instead of treating all semantic observations as uniformly valid supervision, VCS-SLAM evaluates their geometric reliability through visibility consistency, surface-supported boundary evidence, and ray-level conflict uncertainty. The resulting reliability-aware objective suppresses occluded semantic updates, reduces unsupported semantic bleeding, and delays premature label assignment in ambiguous regions. Experiments on Replica demonstrate improved semantic consistency, boundary preservation, and reconstruction quality. Results on ScanNet further show that VCS-SLAM maintains competitive tracking performance under real RGB-D inputs

中文摘要翻译: 视觉SLAM在复杂的真实世界应用中性能往往会下降。语义3D高斯SLAM通常使用统一的优化权重将2D语义先验融合到持久的3D地图中。然而，这些先验在线建图中并非同样可靠：遮挡、不支持的语义边界以及歧义的射线几何可能会将持久的语义伪影引入全局高斯地图。我们提出了VCS-SLAM，一个面向RGB-D 3D高斯SLAM的几何验证语义证据融合框架。VCS-SLAM并非将所有语义观测视为统一有效的监督，而是通过可见一致性、表面支撑边界证据和射线级冲突不确定性来评估其几何可靠性。由此产生的可靠性感知目标函数抑制了遮挡区域的语义更新，减少了无支撑的语义渗漏，并延迟了模糊区域的过早标签分配。在Replica上的实验证明了改进的语义一致性、边界保持和重建质量。在ScanNet上的结果进一步表明，VCS-SLAM在真实RGB-D输入下保持了具有竞争力的跟踪性能。

</details>


### [130] [Rectifying Mask via Entropy for Distractor-Free 3DGS in Ambiguous Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29496)
*Wongi Park,Jiyeon Lim,Minjae Lee,Myeongseok Nam,Seongjun Choi,Jungwoo Kim,Soomok Lee,William J. Beksi,SangHyun Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RefineSplat提出了一种基于熵感知的自适应掩码方法，通过结合熵和实例掩码捕获模糊干扰物，并引入熵感知密度控制来对齐高斯体，在多个数据集上实现了无干扰物的新视角合成，达到SOTA性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有方法难以区分瞬态干扰物与静态场景，因为干扰物与背景存在颜色或语义上的模糊性（ambiguity），导致新视角合成质量下降。

Method: 1) 提出熵感知自适应掩码方法（entropy-aware adaptive masking），结合熵和实例掩码捕获模糊干扰物；2) 提出熵感知密度控制（entropy-aware density control），利用熵感知的位置梯度在模糊场景中对齐高斯体；3) 构建并公开了Ambiguous wild数据集，包含18个干扰物与场景难以区分的场景。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，RefineSplat在无干扰物新视角合成任务上达到了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: RefineSplat通过熵感知的自适应掩码和密度控制，有效解决了干扰物与静态场景之间的模糊性问题，实现了高质量的无干扰物新视角合成。

Original Abstract: We present RefineSplat, a systematic framework that effectively constructs transient masks to identify diverse ambiguous distractors. To do this, we qualitatively and quantitatively analyze issues and propose a novel entropy-aware adaptive masking method. Unlike existing approaches that struggle to distinguish transient elements from static scenes due to color or semantic ambiguity, RefineSplat captures ambiguous distractors leveraging entropy and instance masks. Furthermore, we propose a simple yet effective entropy-aware density control to align Gaussians in ambiguous scenarios considering Entropy-aware positional gradients. Additionally, to rigorously validate our method, we first create and release the Ambiguous wild dataset, including 18 scenes where distractors and static scenes are hard to distinguish due to color or semantic resemblances. Experimental results on various datasets demonstrate that RefineSplat shows state-of-the-art performance, showing distractor-free novel view synthesis.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了RefineSplat，一个系统性框架，能够有效构建瞬态掩码以识别多样化的模糊干扰物。为此，我们定性和定量地分析了相关问题，并提出了一种新颖的熵感知自适应掩码方法。与现有因颜色或语义模糊性而难以区分瞬态元素与静态场景的方法不同，RefineSplat利用熵和实例掩码捕获模糊干扰物。此外，我们提出了一种简单而有效的熵感知密度控制方法，在考虑熵感知位置梯度的模糊场景中对齐高斯体。为严格验证我们的方法，我们首先构建并公开了Ambiguous wild数据集，包含18个因颜色或语义相似性而难以区分干扰物与静态场景的场景。多个数据集上的实验结果表明，RefineSplat展现出最先进的性能，实现了无干扰物的新视角合成。

</details>


### [131] [Learning Where and When: Patch-Based Spatiotemporal Localization in Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29498)
*Hamza Karim,Nghia Nguyen,Lokman Bekit,Yasin Yilmaz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于块(patch)的时空弱监督异常定位框架，能够同时定位异常的时间和空间位置，无需边界框监督即可生成细粒度空间异常图，在多个基准上超越现有方法，并发布了新的空间标注资源。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有弱监督视频异常检测(WSVAD)主要关注时间定位，忽略了异常在帧内的空间范围，而空间定位对于实际部署中的可解释性和实用性至关重要。

Method: 基于网格级块特征，在多实例学习范式下学习区域级异常分数；提出邻近感知Top-k时空选择策略，在无需边界框监督的情况下生成细粒度空间异常图。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上超越现有最先进方法，在时空定位精度上取得显著提升。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法有效解决了弱监督视频异常检测中空间定位缺失的问题，并通过发布测试集的帧级边界框标注等资源，为未来研究提供了新基础。

Original Abstract: Weakly supervised video anomaly detection (WSVAD) has predominantly focused on temporal localization, identifying when anomalies occur while largely neglecting their spatial extent within frames. Yet, spatial localization is essential for interpretability and practical deployment in real-world settings. We introduce a patch-based spatiotemporal framework for weakly supervised anomaly localization that jointly models where and when anomalies occur. Our approach operates on grid-level patch features and learns region-level anomaly scores under a multiple instance learning paradigm. We further propose a Proximity-Aware Top-k spatiotemporal selection strategy that enables the model to generate fine-grained spatial anomaly maps without requiring bounding-box supervision during training. Our method surpasses existing state-of-the-art approaches across multiple benchmarks, yielding substantial gains in spatiotemporal localization accuracy. In addition, we release frame-level bounding-box annotations for the test sets of two widely used datasets, along with our code and pretrained models, providing new resources to facilitate future research in spatially grounded WSVAD.

中文摘要翻译: 弱监督视频异常检测(WSVAD)主要关注时间定位，即识别异常发生的时间，而很大程度上忽略了它们在帧内的空间范围。然而，空间定位对于实际部署中的可解释性和实用性至关重要。我们提出了一种基于块的时空弱监督异常定位框架，能够联合建模异常发生的位置和时间。我们的方法基于网格级块特征，在多实例学习范式下学习区域级异常分数。我们进一步提出了一种邻近感知Top-k时空选择策略，使模型能够在训练过程中无需边界框监督即可生成细粒度空间异常图。我们的方法在多个基准数据集上超越了现有最先进方法，在时空定位精度上取得了显著提升。此外，我们发布了两个广泛使用数据集的测试集的帧级边界框标注，以及我们的代码和预训练模型，为促进空间定位弱监督视频异常检测的未来研究提供了新的资源。

</details>


### [132] [Empirical Evaluation of Multi-Modal Touch Detection in Over-the-Shoulder Video Surveillance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29504)
*Mohammadreza Rashidi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了一个基于物理手指交互的触摸检测框架（BEHINT），用于从肩窥视频中重建移动键盘击键事件。在受控场景下F1-score仅约18%，在多模态融合下序列相似度仅3%；在真实非受控视频中，系统因皮肤过滤器响应整个手部而非指尖接触，每帧产生中位数57个触摸点，完全无法实现可靠的击键重建。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 探索是否可以通过拍摄用户肩部的视频（即肩窥视频）来监控人机交互模式，从而在不直接获取屏幕录制权限的情况下重建移动设备上的击键序列。

Method: 系统集成四种并行检测模态：（1）MediaPipe解剖手部关键点；（2）HSV肤色滤波；（3）时序帧差分运动检测；（4）形状引导的Canny边缘分析。将检测到的相对触摸坐标映射到参考屏幕布局以重建击键序列。

Result: 在120帧受控场景视频中：Motion-Only F1=18.5%，Edge-Only F1=18.2%，多模态融合F1=16.7%，序列相似度仅3.0%。在真实第三视角视频中，每帧产生中位数57个触摸点（峰值205），远超实际点击速率。系统在非受控场景下完全失效。

Conclusion: 该击键重建系统在受控实验环境下表现非常有限，且在真实非受控视频中完全不可靠。受控场景的结果无法泛化到非受控镜头，系统无法实现除校准后的受控设置之外的可靠击键重建。

Original Abstract: Video Intelligence Surveillance (VIDINT) on over-the-shoulder footage is a proposed vector for monitoring human-computer interaction patterns without direct screen recording access. In this paper, we evaluate a Behavioral Intelligence (BEHINT) touch-detection framework designed to reconstruct keystroke events on mobile keypad interfaces from physical finger interactions. Our system integrates four parallel detection modalities: (1) anatomical hand landmarks via MediaPipe, (2) HSV skin color filtering, (3) temporal frame differencing for motion detection, and (4) shape-guided Canny edge analysis. We map relative touch coordinates to a reference screen layout to reconstruct typing sequences. Evaluation on a 120-frame first-person staged video of passcode entry reveals that while MediaPipe and Skin Detection fail to run autonomously due to partial hand occlusion and ambient noise, Motion-Only and Edge-Only configurations achieve F1-scores of 18.5% and 18.2%, respectively. The combined multi-modal configuration achieves an F1-score of 16.7% and a sequence similarity of 3.0% when mapped to the iOS passcode layout. We conduct ablation, resolution decay, noise sensitivity, and proximity threshold tuning to characterize the system's operational envelope. We then audit generalization on 5 real, publicly licensed third-person phone videos and find that the detector emits a median of 57 touch points per frame (peaking at 205), one to three orders of magnitude more than the rate of real taps, because the skin filter responds to the whole hand rather than to fingertip contact. The staged keystroke result does not survive contact with uncontrolled footage; the system does not achieve reliable keystroke reconstruction outside the calibrated staged setting.

中文摘要翻译: 视频智能监控（VIDINT）通过肩窥视角的录像，被提出作为一种在没有直接屏幕录制权限的情况下监测人机交互模式的途径。本文评估了一个旨在从物理手指交互中重建移动键盘界面击键事件的行为智能（BEHINT）触摸检测框架。我们的系统集成了四种并行检测模态：（1）通过MediaPipe提取解剖学手部关键点，（2）HSV肤色滤波，（3）用于运动检测的时序帧差分，（4）形状引导的Canny边缘分析。我们将相对触摸坐标映射到参考屏幕布局以重建击键序列。在120帧第一人称受控密码输入视频上的评估表明，由于部分手部遮挡和环境噪声，MediaPipe和皮肤检测无法自主运行，而仅运动检测和仅边缘检测的配置分别达到了18.5%和18.2%的F1分数。多模态融合配置的F1分数为16.7%，映射到iOS密码布局后的序列相似度为3.0%。我们进行了消融实验、分辨率衰减测试、噪声敏感性分析和邻近阈值调优，以刻画系统的运行边界。随后，我们在5段真实、公开许可的第三人称手机视频上进行了泛化审计，发现检测器每帧产生的中位数触摸点为57个（峰值可达205个），比实际点击速率高出1到3个数量级，原因是皮肤滤波器响应的是整个手部而非指尖接触。受控场景下的击键结果在非受控镜头中无法成立；该系统在校准后的受控设置之外无法实现可靠的击键重建。

</details>


### [133] [Benchmark AUC Is Not Deployable Reliability: A Cross-Dataset Audit of Off-the-Shelf Features for Surveillance Video Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29506)
*Mohammadreza Rashidi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文揭露了AI监控中“可疑行为”检测的基准测试存在严重泛化缺陷：在同一场景训练和测试时AUC尚可，但跨数据集测试时AUC降至随机水平（约0.5），且更强的骨干网络反而加剧了这一下降。作者认为当前基准成绩夸大了部署可靠性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 当前视频异常检测领域宣称在高帧级ROC-AUC指标上表现优异，但这些指标是在同一摄像头、同一场景下训练和测试得到的。作者质疑这种实验室设定无法反映真实部署场景，因此审计了跨数据集场景下的模型表现。

Method: 使用无监督正态性模型：从单个数据集的全部正常训练帧中提取冻结的现成嵌入（CLIP、DINOv2、ResNet-50、EfficientNet-B0），通过最近邻距离计算异常得分，分别在相同数据集和跨数据集上测试。同时使用PaDiM风格的马氏距离检测器进行对比验证。

Result: 在4个真实数据集（UCSD Ped1/2、CUHK Avenue、ShanghaiTech）和4种骨干网络上，同数据集AUC平均0.704，但跨数据集AUC平均仅0.499，相当于随机猜测；多个配对实验低于随机水平。最强骨干DINOv2在同数据集上AUC最高（Ped2上0.901），但跨数据集下降幅度最大。在有利操作点下，误报率高达每小时31,931次。

Conclusion: 当前监控异常检测的基准数字描述的是经过校准的实验室环境，严重高估了可部署的可靠性；模型在不同场景下完全不具备泛化能力。

Original Abstract: Automated "suspicious behavior" flagging is a headline promise of AI surveillance, and the field reports high frame-level ROC-AUC on standard video anomaly detection benchmarks. Those numbers are measured by training and testing on the same camera and scene. We audit what happens when that assumption is dropped. We build an unsupervised normality model from the all-normal training frames of one dataset, using frozen off-the-shelf embeddings (CLIP, DINOv2, ResNet-50, EfficientNet-B0) and a nearest-neighbour distance, and score the test frames of the same and of other datasets. Across 4 real datasets (UCSD Ped1, UCSD Ped2, CUHK Avenue, ShanghaiTech) and 4 backbones, same-dataset AUC averages 0.704 but cross-dataset AUC averages 0.499, which is chance: a detector calibrated on one scene is no better than a coin flip on another, and in several pairs it is below chance. The strongest backbone makes this worse, not better: DINOv2 has the best same-dataset AUC (up to 0.901 on Ped2) and the largest cross-dataset drop. The collapse is not an artefact of the scoring rule: replacing the nearest-neighbour detector with a PaDiM-style Mahalanobis detector reproduces it almost exactly (cross-dataset gap 0.202 versus 0.208). Even at a favourable operating point the false-alarm rate is on the order of 31,931 per hour. We conclude that the benchmark numbers quoted for surveillance anomaly detection describe a calibrated laboratory setting and overstate deployable reliability by a wide margin, and we release the code that reproduces every number.

中文摘要翻译: 自动化“可疑行为”标记是AI监控的核心承诺，该领域在标准视频异常检测基准上报告了高帧级ROC-AUC指标。这些数字是在同一摄像头、同一场景下训练和测试得到的。我们审计了放弃这一假设后会发生什么。我们从一个数据集的全部正常训练帧中构建无监督正态性模型，使用冻结的现成嵌入（CLIP、DINOv2、ResNet-50、EfficientNet-B0）和最近邻距离，在相同数据集和其他数据集上对测试帧进行评分。在4个真实数据集（UCSD Ped1、UCSD Ped2、CUHK Avenue、ShanghaiTech）和4种骨干网络下，同数据集AUC平均为0.704，但跨数据集AUC平均为0.499，这相当于随机猜测：在一个场景上校准的检测器在另一个场景上不比抛硬币更好，并且在若干配对中甚至低于随机水平。最强的骨干网络非但没有改善这一情况，反而使其更糟：DINOv2具有最佳的同数据集AUC（Ped2上高达0.901），但跨数据集下降幅度最大。这种崩溃并非评分规则的伪影：用PaDiM风格的马氏距离检测器替换最近邻检测器几乎完全复现了这一现象（跨数据集差距0.202 vs 0.208）。即使在有利的操作点下，误报率也高达每小时约31,931次。我们得出结论，引用的监控异常检测基准数字描述的是经过校准的实验室环境，严重高估了可部署的可靠性，并开源了可复现所有数字的代码。

</details>


### [134] [Scenes as Objects, Not Primitives: Instance-Structured 3D Tokenization from Unposed Views](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29513)
*Mijin Yoo,In Cho,Subin Jeon,Jiwoo Lee,Eunbyung Park,Seon Joo Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种前馈式3D场景分解框架，将场景分解为实例结构的3D token组（实例token+锚点token），实现从多视图图像直接生成以对象实例为原生接口的表示，无需3D标注即可完成重建、分割和编辑。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有前馈式3D重建方法输出的是稠密无结构的点集或高斯体，缺乏实例级结构信息，对象级理解需要在重建后额外处理。本文旨在让对象实例成为表示的原生接口，而非衍生产物。

Method: 提出两层分解的token组表示：每个组包含一个实例token（捕获实体级身份）和多个锚点token（编码局部几何与外观），解码为3D高斯体集合。通过可微渲染联合优化重建损失和分割监督，无需3D标注。

Result: 在类别无关实例分割任务上超越了每场景优化的基线方法，在新视图合成上保持竞争力。直接支持实例级场景编辑（删除、平移、插入对象）和高效开放词汇3D实例检索（检索复杂度随实例数而非基元数扩展）。

Conclusion: 证明了两层分解的token组表示能够将对象实例作为3D表示的原生接口，同时兼顾重建质量、分割精度和下游任务效率。

Original Abstract: A 3D scene is understood through its objects, not the primitives that compose them. Yet feed-forward reconstruction methods output dense, unstructured sets of points or Gaussians, leaving object-level structure to be recovered after the fact. We propose a feed-forward framework that decomposes a scene into instance-structured 3D token groups directly from unposed multi-view images -- compact object-centric units from which reconstruction, segmentation, and manipulation all follow. Each token group pairs an instance token capturing entity-level identity with anchor tokens that encode local geometry and appearance, which are decoded into a set of 3D Gaussians. This two-level factorization decouples object identity from local appearance, making object instances a native interface of the representation rather than a derived product. The token groups are learned through differentiable rendering with joint reconstruction and segmentation supervision, requiring no 3D annotations. Our feed-forward model surpasses per-scene optimization baselines in class-agnostic instance segmentation while remaining competitive in novel view synthesis. Beyond these metrics, the same token groups directly unlock instance-level scene editing -- removing, translating, or inserting objects by operating on their groups -- as well as efficient open-vocabulary 3D instance retrieval, where retrieval complexity scales with the number of instances rather than primitives.

中文摘要翻译: 一个3D场景是通过其中的物体来理解的，而非构成这些物体的基元。然而，前馈式重建方法输出的是稠密、无结构的点集或高斯体，将实例级结构的恢复留待事后处理。本文提出一个前馈式框架，直接从无位姿的多视图图像中将场景分解为实例结构的3D token组——紧凑的以对象为中心的单元，重建、分割和操作均由此衍生而来。每个token组将一个捕获实体级身份的实例token与编码局部几何和外观的锚点token配对，并被解码为一组3D高斯体。这种两层分解将对象身份与局部外观解耦，使得对象实例成为表示的原生接口而非衍生产物。这些token组通过可微渲染和联合重建与分割监督来学习，无需3D标注。我们的前馈模型在类别无关的实例分割上超越了每场景优化的基线方法，同时在新视图合成上保持竞争力。除指标外，这些token组直接解锁了实例级场景编辑——通过对组进行操作来删除、平移或插入对象——以及高效的开放词汇3D实例检索，其检索复杂度随实例数量而非基元数量扩展。

</details>


### [135] [MotionAtlas: Detailed Region Captioning for Motion-Centric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29531)
*Weisong Liu,Haochen Wang,Kuan Gao,Yuhao Wang,Yikang Zhou,Zhongwei Ren,Jacky Mai,Anna Wang,Yanwei Li,Jason Li,Zhaoxiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MotionAtlas 是一个面向运动中心视频的细粒度描述系统，包含人工标注基准、可扩展数据管道和强大的视频多模态大模型，通过区域感知的运动描述缓解视觉杂乱与运动纠缠问题，在多项基准上超越基线模型。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的运动描述数据集和方法通常进行全局运动描述，难以处理视频中多个物体同时运动时的视觉杂乱和运动纠缠问题，缺乏对特定区域细粒度运动的理解与可靠、可量化的评估。

Method: (1) 构建 MotionAtlas-Bench 基准，包含 2,073 道选择题，用于评估细粒度运动理解；(2) 设计可扩展数据管道，采用自引导精炼（self-bootstrap refinement）抑制细粒度幻觉，生成 15.9 万条高质量运动描述数据；(3) 设计定制训练数据组合策略，在多种基线视频多模态大模型（如 Molmo2、Qwen3-VL）上实现一致且显著的性能提升。

Result: MotionAtlas-4B 在通用运动基准上平均超越 Qwen3-VL-4B 5.2 个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过区域感知的运动描述范式、高质量数据管道和定制化训练策略，MotionAtlas 有效提升了视频多模态大模型对细粒度运动的理解能力，相关基准、数据集和代码已开源。

Original Abstract: We propose MotionAtlas, a system for detailed captioning of motion-centric videos, comprising (1) a dedicated human-annotated benchmark, (2) a scalable, high-quality pipeline to construct training samples, and (3) a family of powerful Video-MLLMs. Unlike conventional global motion captioning datasets, we focus on region-aware motion captioning: given a video and a spatiotemporal mask, the model generates precise descriptions of motion within the target region, thereby alleviating visual clutter and motion entanglement and enabling reliable, quantifiable evaluation. Concretely, we first build MotionAtlas-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 2,073 multiple-choice questions, meticulously annotated for a curated set of high-quality, motion-centric videos, to evaluate fine-grained motion understanding of the objects in question. Second, we design a rigorous and scalable data pipeline that leverages self-bootstrap refinement to suppress fine-grained hallucinations, yielding 159k high-quality motion captioning data. Third, we design a tailored training data composition strategy, which achieves consistent and substantial performance gains across diverse baseline Video-MLLMs, including Molmo2 and Qwen3-VL. For instance, MotionAtlas-4B surpasses Qwen3-VL-4B by an average of 5.2 percentage points across general motion benchmarks. The benchmark, dataset, and code have been released.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出 MotionAtlas，一个用于运动中心视频的详细描述系统，包含 (1) 一个专用的人工标注基准，(2) 一个可扩展、高质量的训练样本构建管道，以及 (3) 一系列强大的视频多模态大语言模型。与传统的全局运动描述数据集不同，我们聚焦于区域感知的运动描述：给定一段视频和一个时空掩码，模型生成目标区域内运动的精确描述，从而缓解视觉杂乱和运动纠缠问题，并实现可靠、可量化的评估。具体而言，我们首先构建了 MotionAtlas-Bench，一个包含 2,073 道选择题的综合性基准，针对一组精心挑选的高质量运动中心视频进行了细致标注，以评估目标物体的细粒度运动理解能力。其次，我们设计了一个严格且可扩展的数据管道，利用自引导精炼来抑制细粒度幻觉，生成了 15.9 万条高质量运动描述数据。第三，我们设计了定制的训练数据组合策略，在多种基线视频多模态大语言模型（包括 Molmo2 和 Qwen3-VL）上实现了一致且显著的性能提升。例如，MotionAtlas-4B 在通用运动基准上平均超越 Qwen3-VL-4B 5.2 个百分点。基准、数据集和代码已开源发布。

</details>


### [136] [GarmentZoom: Generating Zoomable Images from Garment Listings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29535)
*Renjie Zhao,Jingwei Ma,Huy Huynh Cao,Brian Curless,Steven M. Seitz,Ira Kemelmacher-Shlizerman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GarmentZoom系统，通过单模型支持连续缩放倍率（3-20×），无需空间对齐即可将服装全视图增强为与特写图匹配的高保真图像，实现无缝缩放浏览。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 电商服装展示中，全景图和特写图分别侧重整体视野和细节，用户需频繁切换视角，破坏了浏览连续性。现有超分辨率方法要么依赖空间对齐，要么需要逐实例微调，难以处理全视图与特写图之间空间不对齐且缩放倍率差异大的问题。

Method: 训练一个统一的生成模型，无需空间对齐即可合成细节，支持3-20×连续缩放倍率，覆盖多种服装类型。通过单模型替代逐实例微调，大幅降低训练成本。

Result: 该方法无需空间对齐即可合成高质量细节，在质量上达到与逐实例微调方法相当的水平，但训练成本仅为后者的极小部分。

Conclusion: GarmentZoom通过单模型实现了跨服装类型和连续缩放倍率的高保真图像增强，解决了空间不对齐和尺度变化大的难题，为电商交互式浏览提供了高效且高质量的解决方案。

Original Abstract: Online product listings for garments often include an overview photo and a close-up to show garment details. However, each photo focuses on either field of view or garment detail, forcing users to alternate between views and breaking browsing continuity. We present GarmentZoom, a system that enhances the full-view photo to match the fidelity of its accompanying close-up, enabling seamless zoom-and-pan exploration. Unlike standard reference-based super-resolution, our setting involves close-up references that are spatially unaligned with the full view, and scale factors that vary substantially across garments 3-20$\times$. Prior work typically relies on alignment to transfer details or requires per-instance fine-tuning to memorize them. Instead, we train a single model that supports a continuous range of scales across diverse garments. Our approach synthesizes details without requiring spatial alignment and matches the quality of per-instance methods with a fraction of the training cost.

中文摘要翻译: 电商平台上服装类商品详情页通常同时展示一张概述全景图（展示整体效果）和一张特写图（展示面料细节）。然而，每张图片只能聚焦于视野或细节其中之一，迫使用户在两种视图之间来回切换，破坏了浏览的连续性。本文提出GarmentZoom系统，能够将全景照增强至与伴随的特写图同等的保真度，实现无缝的缩放和平移浏览。与标准的基于参考的超分辨率不同，本文场景中的特写参考图与全景图在空间上不对齐，且缩放倍率在不同服装上差异显著（3-20倍）。先前的工作通常依赖空间对齐来传递细节，或需要逐实例微调来记忆细节。相比之下，本文训练了一个单一的模型，即可支持多种服装类型下的连续缩放倍率范围。本文方法无需空间对齐即可合成细节，在质量上与逐实例方法相当，而训练成本仅为后者的极小部分。

</details>


### [137] [Reliability-Prioritized Fine-Grained Generation in Multimodal Large](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29573)
*Xiaomeng Fan,Wu Wei,Yuwei Wu,Zhi Gao,Shiyu Luo,Mingyang Gao,Haoyu Zhao,Zhenxin Diao,Yuxuan Ba,Lijia Feng,Yunde Jia,Mehrtash Harandi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现多模态大模型在细粒度描述时更易出错，为此构建了粒度感知基准GranFact，提出层次感知评估算法和可靠性优先的偏好优化方法，在提升细粒度生成能力的同时保持可靠性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 观察到并理论证明多模态大模型生成细粒度描述比粗粒度描述更容易出错，因此需要让模型在保持可靠的前提下生成尽可能具体的描述，而不是一味追求更细粒度的输出。

Method: 1）构建GranFact基准，包含专家验证的多目标图像及其粗到细类别标注；2）提出层次感知评估算法，同时评估预测的视觉正确性和正确预测的具体程度；3）提出基于直接偏好优化的可靠性优先偏好优化方法，惩罚不可靠的细粒度声称，奖励可靠的细粒度描述。

Result: 在GranFact基准上的实验表明，该方法在提升细粒度生成能力的同时保持了描述的可信性。

Conclusion: 所提出的可靠性优先的偏好优化方法能够有效平衡细粒度生成与可靠性之间的矛盾，使模型生成可信任的细粒度描述。

Original Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly expected to generate fine-grained descriptions of visual content. However, we observe and theoretically show that generating fine-grained responses poses a reliability challenge, \textit{i.e.}, fine-grained generation is more error-prone than coarse-grained generation. This phenomenon suggests that models should generate the finest description that remains reliable rather than simply produce more specific outputs. To investigate this problem, we develop \textsc{GranFact}, a granularity-aware benchmark consisting of expert-verified multi-object images with coarse-to-fine category annotations. Then, we design a hierarchy-aware evaluation algorithm, which assesses both whether model predictions are visually correct and how specific the correct predictions are. We also propose a reliability-prioritized preference optimization method based on Direct Preference Optimization, which penalizes unreliable fine-grained claims while rewarding reliable specificity. Experiments on \textsc{GranFact} show that our method improves fine-grained generation while preserving reliability. Code and data are available \href{https://github.com/WeiWu2025/GranFact}{here}.

中文摘要翻译: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）越来越多地被期望生成关于视觉内容的细粒度描述。然而，我们观察到并从理论上证明，生成细粒度响应会带来可靠性挑战，即细粒度生成比粗粒度生成更容易出错。这一现象表明，模型应生成最精细但仍可靠的描述，而非简单地产生更具体的输出。为研究该问题，我们开发了GranFact，一个粒度感知的基准，包含经专家验证的多目标图像及其从粗到细的类别标注。随后，我们设计了一种层次感知评估算法，同时评估模型预测在视觉上是否正确以及正确预测的具体程度。我们还提出了一种基于直接偏好优化的可靠性优先偏好优化方法，该方法惩罚不可靠的细粒度声称，同时奖励可靠的细粒度描述。在GranFact上的实验表明，我们的方法在保持可靠性的同时提升了细粒度生成能力。代码和数据已开源。

</details>


### [138] [ReMAP-PET: Beyond Visual Understanding -- Learning Region-Guided Metabolic Alignment Semantics from Brain PET](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29577)
*Dasen Dai,Yanteng Zhang,Shuoqi Li,Yuxiang Wei,Hongjie Yu,Qingxin Zhang,Qizhen Lan,Jagath C. Rajapakse,Vince D. Calhoun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReMAP-PET提出了一种将PET编码器与脑区区域代谢语义（SUVR）进行联合回归与对比学习对齐的方法，取代将PET视为通用体积数据的做法，在SUVR预测、诊断分类和认知回归任务上显著优于冻结预训练基线，并实现了代谢嵌入与临床文本的对齐及端到端报告生成。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有3D脑基础模型将PET视为通用体积数据，忽略了PET区别于结构性神经影像的**结构化区域代谢信息**，导致模型无法捕捉PET特有的代谢语义。

Method: 基于部分微调的MedicalNet 3D ResNet-50，通过**联合回归目标**（预测脑区标准化摄取值比SUVR）和**对比学习目标**，使编码器学习PET模态背后的代谢语义；再通过对比对齐将代谢嵌入与冻结的BioClinicalBERT临床语言嵌入对齐，实现PET到文本报告的生成。

Result: 在1015对PET-SUVR样本上，SUVR MAE达0.070，SUVR Recall@1达77.8%，显著优于五种冻结预训练基线；线性探测在诊断分类和认知回归任务上表明嵌入保留了临床相关信息，无需任务特定微调。

Conclusion: 将PET编码器锚定于区域代谢语义（而非通用体积数据）能够产生结构化、可解释且与语言兼容的表征，为代谢感知的PET理解开辟了新方向。

Original Abstract: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) reveals brain metabolism and is clinically central to neurodegenerative disease assessment, yet existing 3D brain foundation models treat PET as generic volumetric data, missing the structured regional metabolic information that distinguishes it from structural neuroimaging. To address these limitations, we propose ReMAP-PET, a framework that moves beyond visual encoding by supervising a partially-tuned MedicalNet 3D ResNet-50 with brain regional standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR) profiles through joint regression and contrastive objectives, enabling the encoder to learn the metabolic semantics underlying PET modality. On 1015 paired PET--SUVR samples, ReMAP-PET achieves 0.070 SUVR MAE and 77.8% PET SUVR Recall@1, substantially outperforming five frozen pretrained baselines. We further connect the metabolic embedding to clinical language via contrastive alignment with frozen BioClinicalBERT and demonstrate end-to-end PET-to-report generation through SUVR-constrained verbalization. Linear probing on diagnostic classification and cognitive regression tasks confirms that the embeddings retain clinically relevant information without task-specific fine-tuning. Our results show that grounding PET encoders in regional metabolic semantics -- rather than treating PET as generic volumetric data -- yields representations that are structured, interpretable, and language-compatible, pointing to a new direction for metabolic-aware PET understanding.

中文摘要翻译: 正电子发射断层扫描（PET）能够揭示脑代谢活动，在神经退行性疾病评估中具有核心临床价值。然而，现有的3D脑基础模型将PET视为通用体积数据，忽略了其区别于结构性神经影像的结构化区域代谢信息。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了ReMAP-PET框架，该框架超越了纯视觉编码：通过联合回归与对比学习目标，对部分微调的MedicalNet 3D ResNet-50施加脑区标准化摄取值比（SUVR）特征的监督，使编码器能够学习PET模态背后的代谢语义。在1015对PET-SUVR样本上，ReMAP-PET取得了0.070的SUVR平均绝对误差和77.8%的PET SUVR Recall@1，显著优于五种冻结预训练基线。我们进一步通过对比对齐，将代谢嵌入与冻结的BioClinicalBERT进行对齐，并展示了基于SUVR约束的文本化实现的端到端PET到报告生成。在诊断分类和认知回归任务上的线性探测结果表明，嵌入在无需任务特定微调的情况下保留了临床相关信息。我们的研究结果表明：将PET编码器锚定于区域代谢语义（而非将其视为通用体积数据）能够产生结构化、可解释且与语言兼容的表征，这为代谢感知的PET理解指明了新方向。

</details>


### [139] [ScAle: Attention Head Scaling as a Minimal Adapter for Spatial Reasoning in Vision Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29579)
*Rahul Chowdhury,Timothy A Rupprecht,Xuan Shen,Pu Zhao,Yanzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种超轻量级方法ScAle，通过学习少量标量系数重新缩放选定Transformer层的激活值，在不修改预训练权重的情况下显著提升VLM的空间推理能力，仅需1K可训练参数即可达到甚至接近标准PEFT方法的性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有VLM在空间推理方面表现不佳，而提升该能力通常需要微调大量额外参数。初步分析发现，仅重新缩放选定Transformer层的激活值（不修改预训练权重）就能显著影响下游性能，由此启发提出更高效的适配方法。

Method: 提出ScAle方法，在完全冻结的骨干网络上，学习一小部分标量系数来调制最后token的注意力（attention）和MLP激活值，实现超轻量级的模型适配。

Result: 在SpatialEval空间推理基准上取得最高134.1%的相对准确率提升；仅使用1K可训练参数，远少于LoRA等标准PEFT方法所需的百万级参数；在保持强非空间VQA准确率的同时，恢复了标准PEFT的大部分性能。

Conclusion: 有界的激活重新加权提供了一种简单、架构无关且高度参数高效的预训练VLM适配替代方案。

Original Abstract: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent challenge for many vision language models (VLMs), and improving it typically requires fine-tuning with substantial additional parameters. Our preliminary analysis reveals that rescaling activations in selected transformer layers-without modifying pretrained weights-can significantly influence downstream performance. Motivated by this observation, we propose ScAle, an ultra-lightweight adaptation method that learns a small set of scalar coefficients to modulate last-token attention and MLP activations in a fully frozen backbone. We evaluate our method on the synthetic spatial reasoning benchmark SpatialEval and on real-world VQA datasets (COCOQA and VGQA) across multiple model families. Our method, ScAle, achieves up to 134.1% relative accuracy gains using only 1K trainable parameters without requiring millions of trainable parameters as in standard PEFT methods such as LoRA. Despite its extreme compactness, our approach recovers a substantial fraction of standard PEFT performance while preserving strong non-spatial VQA accuracy. These results demonstrate that bounded activation reweighting provides a simple, architecture-agnostic, and highly parameter-efficient alternative for adapting pretrained VLMs.

中文摘要翻译: 空间推理对许多视觉语言模型（VLM）来说仍然是一个持续的挑战，而提升该能力通常需要使用大量额外参数进行微调。我们的初步分析表明，在选定的Transformer层中重新缩放激活值——无需修改预训练权重——可以显著影响下游性能。受此观察启发，我们提出了ScAle，一种超轻量级的适配方法，它在完全冻结的骨干网络上学习一小部分标量系数，用于调制最后token的注意力和MLP激活值。我们在合成空间推理基准SpatialEval以及真实世界VQA数据集（COCOQA和VGQA）上，跨多个模型族评估了我们的方法。我们的方法ScAle仅使用1K可训练参数即可实现最高134.1%的相对准确率提升，无需像LoRA等标准PEFT方法那样需要数百万可训练参数。尽管其极度紧凑，我们的方法恢复了标准PEFT的大部分性能，同时保持了强大的非空间VQA准确率。这些结果表明，有界的激活重新加权提供了一种简单、架构无关且高度参数高效的预训练VLM适配替代方案。

</details>


### [140] [SonoCLIP: Mask-Guided Region-Aware Vision-Language Pretraining for Fetal Ultrasound Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29586)
*Hang Su,Chao Sun,Zhaofan Li,Wei Hu,Juhua Liu,Bo Du*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SonoCLIP 是一个百万级、区域可控的胎儿超声视觉-语言基础模型，通过掩码通道视觉提示实现全局-局部对比学习，在零样本迁移上表现优越。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有超声基础模型受限于严重的散斑噪声、采集变异性及模糊的解剖边界，且CLIP模型仅依赖全局图文对齐，对临床关键的局部结构不敏感。

Method: 提出SonoCLIP，在视觉编码器中引入分割掩码作为掩码通道视觉提示（mask-channel visual prompts），实现全局-局部联合对比表示学习；提出基于Sigmoid的成对对比损失（sigmoid-based pairwise contrastive loss）以提升大规模监督下的训练稳定性；构建包含144万张图像、覆盖24个标准切面的多模态胎儿超声数据集。

Result: 跨中心评估表明，SonoCLIP在全局和掩码引导推理下均取得优越的零样本迁移性能。

Conclusion: SonoCLIP建立了一个可控且面向临床的胎儿超声分析基础模型。

Original Abstract: Vision-language foundation models have shown strong potential in medical image analysis. Although foundation models for ultrasound imaging have recently emerged, the domain remains particularly challenging due to severe speckle noise, acquisition variability, and subtle anatomical boundaries, leading to high inter-observer variability. Existing CLIP-based models rely primarily on global image-text alignment, limiting their sensitivity to clinically decisive local structures. We propose SonoCLIP, the first million-scale region-controllable fetal ultrasound vision-language foundation model that integrates segmentation masks as mask-channel visual prompts within the vision encoder, enabling joint global-local contrastive representation learning. To support scalable region-text alignment, we introduce a sigmoid-based pairwise contrastive loss that improves stability under large-scale supervision. We further curate a 1.44M-image multimodal fetal ultrasound dataset spanning 24 standard planes for large-scale pretraining. Extensive cross-center evaluations demonstrate that SonoCLIP achieves superior zero-shot transfer performance under both global and mask-guided inference, establishing a controllable and clinically oriented foundation model for fetal ultrasound analysis. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/Harrison-one/SonoCLIP.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉-语言基础模型在医学图像分析中展现出巨大潜力。尽管近年来出现了面向超声成像的基础模型，但由于严重的散斑噪声、采集变异性以及模糊的解剖边界，该领域仍然极具挑战性，导致观察者间差异较大。现有基于CLIP的模型主要依赖全局图像-文本对齐，限制了其对临床关键局部结构的敏感性。我们提出SonoCLIP——首个百万级、区域可控的胎儿超声视觉-语言基础模型，该模型在视觉编码器中集成分割掩码作为掩码通道视觉提示，实现了全局-局部联合对比表示学习。为支持可扩展的区域-文本对齐，我们引入了一种基于Sigmoid的成对对比损失，提升了大规模监督下的训练稳定性。此外，我们构建了一个包含144万张图像、覆盖24个标准切面的多模态胎儿超声数据集用于大规模预训练。跨中心评估表明，SonoCLIP在全局和掩码引导推理下均实现了优越的零样本迁移性能，为胎儿超声分析建立了一个可控且面向临床的基础模型。我们的代码和数据已在 https://github.com/Harrison-one/SonoCLIP 公开。

</details>


### [141] [One Scene, Two Depths: Probing Geometric Ambiguity in Monocular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29600)
*Xiaohao Xu,Feng Xue,Xiang Li,Haowei Li,Shusheng Yang,Tianyi Zhang,Matthew Johnson-Roberson,Xiaonan Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出单目深度估计将三维世界的分层几何结构简化为单标量深度，存在歧义性。为此，作者提出MD-3k双层稀疏基准和ML-SRA指标来测量深度模型的层偏好，并发现Laplacian Visual Prompting (LVP)这种无需训练的频谱变换能显著改变冻结模型的深度层选择，表明深度基础模型可能表达了互补的几何假设。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的单目深度估计将三维世界中的多层几何结构（如透明场景中的前景玻璃和背景）简化为每像素单一标量深度，忽略了场景内在的层次性。这种简化使得监督目标成为标注约定而非场景固有真理，导致不同模型对同一场景可能存在不同的深度层偏好。亟需一个基准来度量和揭示这种歧义性。

Method: 1) 构建MD-3k (MultiDepth-3k) 基准数据集，包含稀疏的双层有序标注，用于测量深度模型的层偏好和多层空间关系准确性 (ML-SRA)。2) 提出Laplacian Visual Prompting (LVP)，一种无需训练的频谱输入变换方法，通过修改输入图像的频谱特征来改变冻结模型的深度层输出。

Result: 在MD-3k基准上，主流深度基础模型在标准RGB输入下展现出不同的层偏好，表明同一分层几何结构在不同模型中可被不同方式解析。LVP能显著改变某些冻结模型的报告层，最强的RGB/LVP组合 (DAv2-L) 达到75.5%的ML-SRA。

Conclusion: 深度基础模型可能表达了互补的几何假设，这些假设在标准RGB推理中未被充分体现。呼吁学界以歧义感知的视角重新思考深度监督与评估，将多种有效的3D解释视为需要测量、保留和表达的几何结构。

Original Abstract: A faithful 3D world representation should account for layered geometry, where a single camera ray may contain multiple visible and geometrically valid surfaces. Monocular depth estimation, however, reduces this structure to one scalar depth per pixel. Transparent scenes make this ambiguity measurable: the same ray can pass through foreground glass and observe the background, turning the supervised target into a convention of annotation, data, and training rather than a scene-intrinsic truth. A learned predictor exposes this convention as its depth-layer preference. We introduce MultiDepth-3k (MD-3k), a sparse two-layer ordinal benchmark for measuring depth-layer preference and multi-layer spatial relationship accuracy (ML-SRA). On MD-3k, leading depth foundation models exhibit diverse layer preferences under standard RGB input, showing that the same layered geometry can be resolved differently across models. We further find that Laplacian Visual Prompting (LVP), a training-free spectral input transformation, can substantially change the reported layer for certain frozen models. The strongest RGB/LVP pair, DAv2-L, reaches 75.5% ML-SRA. These results suggest that depth foundation models may express complementary geometric hypotheses that standard RGB inference leaves unexpressed. We invite the community to rethink depth supervision and evaluation through an ambiguity-aware lens, where multiple valid 3D interpretations are treated as geometric structure to be measured, preserved, and expressed.

中文摘要翻译: 一个忠实的三维世界表征应当考虑分层几何结构，其中单条相机射线可能包含多个可见且几何上有效的表面。然而，单目深度估计将此结构简化为每像素一个标量深度。透明场景使得这种歧义性变得可测：同一条射线可以穿过前景玻璃并观测到背景，使得监督目标成为标注、数据和训练的一种约定，而非场景固有的真实。学习到的预测器暴露了这种约定，表现为其深度层偏好。我们引入了MultiDepth-3k (MD-3k)，一个稀疏的双层有序基准，用于测量深度层偏好和多层空间关系准确性（ML-SRA）。在MD-3k上，主流的深度基础模型在标准RGB输入下展现出不同的层偏好，表明同一分层几何结构在不同模型中可以不同方式被解析。我们进一步发现，Laplacian Visual Prompting (LVP)——一种无需训练的频谱输入变换——可以显著改变某些冻结模型的报告层。最强的RGB/LVP组合DAv2-L达到了75.5%的ML-SRA。这些结果表明，深度基础模型可能表达了互补的几何假设，而标准RGB推理未能充分表达这些假设。我们邀请学界以歧义感知的视角重新思考深度监督与评估，将多种有效的3D解释视为需要被测量、保留和表达的几何结构。

</details>


### [142] [Benchmarking Geospatial Foundation Models for Agriculture Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29664)
*Zhuocheng Shang,Sanmay Das,Ahmed Eldawy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对地理空间基础模型在农业应用中的地理可迁移性进行了系统评估，发现三个主流模型（Prithvi、SpectralGPT、SatMAE）在跨区域多时相作物分割和变化检测任务中性能显著下降，仅能预测常见作物而遗漏稀有作物，揭示了当前模型的关键局限性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 地理空间基础模型在遥感任务中展现出广泛泛化能力，但其地理可迁移性，特别是在农业应用场景中，尚未得到系统性的测试和验证。

Method: 构建了一个受控基准测试，选取Prithvi、SpectralGPT和SatMAE三个模型，在美国四个州（爱荷华、北卡罗来纳、加利福尼亚、明尼苏达）上进行多时相作物分割和变化检测任务。通过将训练集、验证集和测试集分配到不同地理区域，测量模型对未见过的土地数据进行迁移时的表现。

Result: 所有三个模型在区域分布偏移下性能均严重下降，仅能预测最常见的作物而遗漏稀有作物；将模型适配到统一的输入格式对每个模型的影响不同，这增加了直接进行架构比较的复杂性。

Conclusion: 当前地理空间基础模型在农业应用中存在关键局限性，应建立区域感知评估作为必要标准。

Original Abstract: Geospatial foundation models pretrained on satellite imagery promise broad generalization across remote sensing tasks and regions, but their geographic transferability has not been systematically tested, especially in agriculture applications. This paper presents a controlled benchmark that evaluates three models, Prithvi, SpectralGPT, and SatMAE, on multi-temporal crop segmentation and change detection across four U.S. states, Iowa, North Carolina, California, and Minnesota. By assigning each train, validation, and test split to a separate region, we measure how well each model transfers to land it has not seen. All three degrade sharply under regional distribution shift, predicting only the most common crops while missing rare ones. We further find that fitting these models to a shared input format affects each one differently, which complicates direct architectural comparison. These results expose key limitations of current geospatial foundation models for agriculture and point to region aware evaluation as a necessary standard.

中文摘要翻译: 基于卫星影像预训练的地理空间基础模型有望在遥感任务和跨区域中展现广泛的泛化能力，但其地理可迁移性尚未得到系统测试，尤其是在农业应用场景中。本文提出了一个受控基准测试，评估了三个模型——Prithvi、SpectralGPT和SatMAE——在美国四个州（爱荷华、北卡罗来纳、加利福尼亚和明尼苏达）的多时相作物分割和变化检测任务上的表现。通过将训练集、验证集和测试集分配到不同的地理区域，我们衡量了每个模型在未见过的土地数据上的迁移能力。结果显示，所有三个模型在区域分布偏移下性能均严重下降，仅能预测最常见的作物，而遗漏了稀有作物。我们进一步发现，将这些模型适配到统一的输入格式对每个模型的影响不同，这增加了直接进行架构比较的复杂性。这些结果揭示了当前地理空间基础模型在农业应用中的关键局限性，并指出区域感知评估应成为必要标准。

</details>


### [143] [Unlocking the Visual Record of Materials Science: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset from Scientific Literature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29667)
*Subham Ghosh,Shubham Tiwari,Mohammad Ibrahim,Abhishek Tewari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MatMMExtract管道，将材料科学文献中的复合图表分解为子面板，并利用大语言模型生成结构化的图文对数据集MatSciFig（391,606对），同时引入MaterialScope检测数据集优化面板定位，显著提升了材料科学领域视觉-语言学习的基准性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 材料科学文献中的图表蕴含大量实验知识，但大多为复合图（多子面板共享单一标题），导致直接图文配对不可靠，阻碍了AI大规模利用这些视觉数据。

Method: 端到端开源管道MatMMExtract：1）将复合图分解为子面板；2）利用大语言模型（基于材料科学分类体系）为每个子面板生成结构化标注（子标题、两级可视化类别、科学摘要）；3）引入MaterialScope数据集（2,811张人工标注图）微调YOLO12-m检测器实现精准面板定位。

Result: 从14,810篇开放获取文章中提取180,571张图，生成391,606对图文对；YOLO12-m检测器在MaterialScope上mAP_50达0.9227；Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite取得最佳成本-质量权衡（82%输出评级良好，幻觉率4.8%）；双编码器检索基线在MatSciFig上R@1相比零样本CLIP提升4.4倍。

Conclusion: MatMMExtract有效解决了材料科学领域复合图表的结构化提取难题，所生成的MatSciFig数据集对视觉-语言学习具有直接可用性，且所有资源均已开源。

Original Abstract: The materials science literature encodes decades of experimental knowledge in figures, yet this visual record remains locked away and inaccessible to AI at scale. The core difficulty is structural: most scientific figures are compound, with a single caption describing multiple sub-panels simultaneously, making direct image-text pairing unreliable. We present MatMMExtract, an end-to-end open-source pipeline that resolves this by decomposing compound figures into individual sub-panels and generating structured, grounded annotations using a large language model guided by a curated materials science taxonomy. Applied to 14,810 open-access articles, MatMMExtract produces MatSciFig; 391,606 panel-level image-text pairs from 180,571 figures, each annotated with a sub-caption, a two-level visualisation category spanning 19 classes and over 100 subtypes, and a scientific summary. To enable accurate panel localisation, we introduce MaterialScope, a domain-specific detection dataset of 2,811 manually annotated materials science figures, on which a fine-tuned YOLO12-m detector achieves mAP_50 of 0.9227. Among six benchmarked language models, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite delivers the best cost-quality trade-off for annotation generation, with 82% of outputs rated good and a hallucination rate of 4.8%. A dual-encoder retrieval baseline on MatSciFig achieves a 4.4 times improvement in R@1 over zero-shot CLIP, demonstrating the dataset's immediate utility for vision-language learning. All resources are released openly to the community.

中文摘要翻译: 材料科学文献中，图表编码了数十年的实验知识，然而这些视觉记录仍然被封锁，无法被AI大规模获取。其核心困难在于结构性问题：大多数科学图表是复合图，单个标题同时描述多个子面板，导致直接的图文配对不可靠。我们提出MatMMExtract，这是一个端到端的开源管道，通过将复合图分解为独立的子面板，并利用由精心策划的材料科学分类体系引导的大语言模型生成结构化、基于内容的标注，来解决这一问题。将该管道应用于14,810篇开放获取文章后，MatMMExtract生成了MatSciFig数据集：来自180,571张图的391,606对面板级图文对，每个面板标注有子标题、跨19个大类和100多个子类型的两级可视化类别，以及一份科学摘要。为了实现精准的面板定位，我们引入了MaterialScope，一个包含2,811张人工标注材料科学图像的领域专用检测数据集，在该数据集上微调的YOLO12-m检测器达到了0.9227的mAP_50。在六个经过基准测试的语言模型中，Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite在标注生成方面取得了最佳成本-质量权衡，82%的输出被评为良好，幻觉率为4.8%。在MatSciFig上建立的双编码器检索基线相比零样本CLIP在R@1上提升了4.4倍，证明了该数据集对视觉-语言学习的即时可用性。所有资源均已向社区开放发布。

</details>


### [144] [PoseShield: Neural Collision Fields for Human Self-Collision Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29686)
*Zhengyuan Li,Zeyun Deng,Yifan Shen,Liangyan Gui,Miaolan Xie,Joseph Campbell,Xifeng Gao,Kui Wu,Zherong Pan,Aniket Bera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PoseShield 是一种在 SMPL 姿态空间中直接定义的神经碰撞约束，通过将碰撞校正形式化为带 Eikonal 正则化的约束优化问题，实现了高成功率的姿态级碰撞避免，无需重新训练底层运动模型。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 基于 SMPL 的人体姿态估计和运动生成中，极端姿态或随机运动合成常导致网格自穿透，产生物理上不合理的输出。现有方法多在网格空间操作或依赖启发式惩罚项，缺乏低维姿态空间中的理论化碰撞约束。

Method: 提出 PoseShield，在 SMPL 姿态空间中定义神经碰撞约束，将碰撞校正建模为约束优化问题，并引入 Eikonal 方程的正则化以保证碰撞边界附近梯度的非消失性，提升数值稳定性。该方法可直接应用于运动序列，作为与生成器无关的事后碰撞校正器。

Result: 在新构建的 SMPL 姿态基准上，方法达到 95.8% 的成功率，优于现有最先进的基线方法。

Conclusion: PoseShield 在低维姿态空间中实现了理论上严谨、无需重新训练的碰撞校正，显著提升了物理合理性，具有较好的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

Original Abstract: Self-collision remains a persistent challenge in SMPL-based human pose estimation and motion generation. Under extreme articulations or stochastic motion synthesis, generated meshes frequently exhibit self-penetrations, leading to physically implausible results. We propose PoseShield, a neural collision constraint defined directly in SMPL pose space. We formulate collision correction as a constrained optimization problem and connect the learned constraint with the Eikonal equation. Enforcing Eikonal regularization ensures non-vanishing gradients near the collision boundary, improving numerical stability and robustness of the optimization process. Unlike prior methods that operate in the mesh space or rely on heuristic penalties, our approach operates directly in the low-dimensional space of human poses and is theoretically grounded. The same learned constraint extends to human motion sequences, providing a generator-agnostic post-hoc collision corrector without retraining the underlying motion model. Experiments on a newly constructed SMPL pose benchmark show that our method achieves a 95.8% success rate and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

中文摘要翻译: 自碰撞问题在基于 SMPL 的人体姿态估计和运动生成中仍然是一个持续的挑战。在极端关节姿态或随机运动合成条件下，生成的网格经常出现自穿透现象，导致物理上不合理的结果。我们提出 PoseShield，一种直接在 SMPL 姿态空间中定义的神经碰撞约束。我们将碰撞校正形式化为一个约束优化问题，并将学习到的约束与 Eikonal 方程联系起来。施加 Eikonal 正则化确保了碰撞边界附近的梯度非消失，提升了优化过程的数值稳定性和鲁棒性。与先前在网格空间操作或依赖启发式惩罚项的方法不同，我们的方法直接在低维人体姿态空间中运行，且具有理论依据。相同的学习约束可扩展到人体运动序列，作为与生成器无关的事后碰撞校正器，无需重新训练底层运动模型。在新构建的 SMPL 姿态基准上的实验表明，我们的方法达到了 95.8% 的成功率，并超越了现有最先进的基线方法。

</details>


### [145] [Progressive Self-Supervised Learning with Individualized Community Assignment for Brain Network Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29695)
*Hairui Chen,Yanwu Yang,Jianfeng Cao,Hanyang Peng,Chenfei Ye,Ting Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BrainPICM提出了一种通过渐进式个性化社区感知掩码的自监督框架，利用最优传输实现软社区分配和置信度引导的课程学习，在三个fMRI数据集上提升了诊断精度和表示可解释性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有自监督学习方法在脑网络分析中忽视了大脑模块化社区结构的个体间异质性，采用通用掩码策略无法捕捉受试者特定的功能组织，导致模型难以同时学习稳定的模块结构和个体变异。

Method: 1) 将ROI到社区的映射建模为渐进式不平衡最优传输过程，输出软分配矩阵和每个ROI的置信度分数；2) 基于置信度分数设计课程式掩码策略，逐步将低置信度（可能病理）区域纳入训练；3) 构建偏差感知聚合模块，通过相对于群体模板的质量重分布量化功能重组。

Result: 在ABIDE-I、ADHD-200和ADNI三个fMRI数据集上，BrainPICM在诊断准确率上持续优于现有最先进的监督学习和自监督学习方法。

Conclusion: 显式地将模块化社区结构注入掩码建模能够生成功能更一致且泛化性更强的脑网络表示，验证了个体化社区感知策略在脑疾病诊断中的有效性。

Original Abstract: Brain networks exhibit a modular community structure that varies across individuals and neurological conditions. However, existing self-supervised learning (SSL) methods often overlook this heterogeneity, relying on generic masking strategies that fail to capture subject-specific functional organization. We propose BrainPICM, a self-supervised framework for brain network analysis via progressive individualized community aware masking. BrainPICM formulates ROI-to-community mapping as a progressive unbalanced optimal transport process, yielding soft assignments and per-ROI confidence scores. Guided by these confidence estimates, a curriculum-style masking strategy gradually incorporates low-confidence, potentially pathological regions into training, enabling the model to learn both stable modular structures and individual variations. Additionally, a deviation-aware aggregation module quantifies functional reorganization by measuring mass redistribution relative to a population template, enhancing interpretability and downstream prediction.
