Experiments on three fMRI datasets (ABIDE-I, ADHD-200, ADNI) show that BrainPICM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art supervised and SSL methods in diagnostic accuracy, indicating that explicitly injecting modular community structure into masked modeling yields more functionally consistent and generalizable representations. The source code for this approach will be released at https://github.com/Hrychen7/BrainPICM.

中文摘要翻译: 大脑网络呈现出模块化的社区结构，该结构在不同个体和神经系统疾病之间存在差异。然而，现有的自监督学习方法常常忽视这种异质性，依赖于无法捕捉受试者特定功能组织的通用掩码策略。我们提出了BrainPICM，一种通过渐进式个性化社区感知掩码进行脑网络分析的自监督框架。BrainPICM将ROI到社区的映射建模为一个渐进式不平衡最优传输过程，输出软分配矩阵和每个ROI的置信度分数。在这些置信度估计的引导下，一种课程式掩码策略逐步将低置信度的、可能具有病理特征的区域纳入训练，使模型能够同时学习稳定的模块结构和个体变异。此外，一个偏差感知聚合模块通过量化相对于群体模板的质量重分布来度量功能重组，增强了可解释性和下游预测能力。在三个fMRI数据集（ABIDE-I、ADHD-200、ADNI）上的实验表明，BrainPICM在诊断准确率上持续优于最先进的监督学习和自监督学习方法，这表明将模块化社区结构显式注入掩码建模能够生成功能更一致且泛化性更强的表征。该方法的源代码将在https://github.com/Hrychen7/BrainPICM发布。

</details>


### [146] [MF-UAVPose6D: A Model-Free Monocular 6-DoF Pose Estimation Framework for Fixed-Wing UAVs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29697)
*Juanqin Liu,Leonardo Plotegher,Eloy Roura,Shaoming He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需CAD模型和关键点先验的单目6-DoF姿态估计框架MF-UAVPose6D，用于固定翼无人机非合作目标，通过热图引导中心定位、视角感知模块、动态拓扑采样和解耦平移-旋转解码实现鲁棒估计。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于模型或关键点匹配的方法难以可靠应用于非合作无人机目标，因为这类目标通常缺少CAD模型和关键点先验信息，亟需一种无需模型先验的单目6-DoF姿态估计方法。

Method: 提出MF-UAVPose6D框架：1) 热图引导的中心定位获取稳定目标锚点；2) 视角感知模块(PAM)建模观测射线先验；3) 动态拓扑采样(DTS)补充机翼、机身和尾翼的弱结构线索；4) 解耦平移-旋转姿态解码机制估计6-DoF姿态。同时构建了FW-UAV6DPose合成数据集。

Result: 实验结果表明，MF-UAVPose6D无需CAD模型即可实现准确高效的单目6-DoF姿态估计，在远距离旋转估计、深度恢复和联合姿态评估方面表现出强鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 提出了一种适用于固定翼无人机的无模型单目6-DoF姿态估计方法，有效解决了非合作目标缺乏CAD模型和关键点先验的难题，在多种评估指标上表现优异。

Original Abstract: For uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs), estimating six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) poses is essential for airspace situational awareness, target tracking, and counter-UAV operations. However, non-cooperative targets usually lack computer-aided design (CAD) models and keypoint priors, making existing model-based or keypoint-matching methods difficult to apply reliably. To address these challenges, this paper proposes MF-UAVPose6D, a model-free monocular 6-DoF pose estimation framework for fixed-wing UAVs. During inference, the method takes only a single red-green-blue (RGB) image and camera intrinsics as input. It first obtains a stable target anchor through heatmap-guided center localization, introduces a Perspective-Aware Module (PAM) to model observation-ray priors, exploits Dynamic Topological Sampling (DTS) to complement weak structural cues from the wings, fuselage, and tail, and adopts a decoupled translation-rotation pose decoding mechanism to estimate the 6-DoF pose. In addition, we construct the FW-UAV6DPose synthetic dataset, which covers fixed-wing UAV observations across diverse distances, viewpoints, and poses. Experimental results show that MF-UAVPose6D achieves accurate and efficient monocular 6-DoF pose estimation without requiring CAD models, and demonstrates strong robustness in long-range rotation estimation, depth recovery, and joint pose evaluation.

中文摘要翻译: 对于无人驾驶飞行器（UAV）而言，估计六自由度（6-DoF）姿态对于空域态势感知、目标跟踪以及反无人机操作至关重要。然而，非合作目标通常缺乏计算机辅助设计（CAD）模型和关键点先验，这使得现有的基于模型或关键点匹配的方法难以可靠应用。为解决这些挑战，本文提出MF-UAVPose6D，一种面向固定翼无人机的无模型单目6-DoF姿态估计框架。在推理阶段，该方法仅以单张红绿蓝（RGB）图像和相机内参作为输入。它首先通过热图引导的中心定位获取稳定的目标锚点，引入视角感知模块（PAM）建模观测射线先验，利用动态拓扑采样（DTS）补充来自机翼、机身和尾翼的弱结构线索，并采用解耦的平移-旋转姿态解码机制来估计6-DoF姿态。此外，我们构建了FW-UAV6DPose合成数据集，涵盖不同距离、视角和姿态下的固定翼无人机观测样本。实验结果表明，MF-UAVPose6D无需CAD模型即可实现准确高效的单目6-DoF姿态估计，并在远距离旋转估计、深度恢复和联合姿态评估方面展现出强大的鲁棒性。

</details>


### [147] [Early Warning Signals for OpenVLA Failure under Visual Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29699)
*Dipesh Tharu Mahato,Rachel Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究了OpenVLA（视觉-语言-动作模型）在感知条件变化下，其内部激活是否包含可线性解码的失败预测信息。在LIBERO操作任务中，通过遮挡、颜色偏移和相机抖动等测试，发现第16层的逻辑探针在预测15步内的失败时AUROC达0.972，但该结果存在局限性，未建立因果机制或任务泛化能力。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: VLA模型将感知、语言理解和控制整合为单一策略，但视觉条件变化时难以诊断其失败原因。现有方法缺乏对模型内部状态与任务失败之间关系的理解，因此动机是探究OpenVLA的内部激活中是否包含可线性解码的近期任务失败信息。

Method: 在LIBERO操作环境中固定OpenVLA策略，记录执行过程中的内部激活值。在rollout完成后，拟合轻量级逻辑回归探针（logistic probe）作为监控器。主要压力测试为遮挡（occlusion），同时评估颜色偏移和相机抖动。通过AUROC和AUPRC指标比较逻辑探针、均值差异方向（mean difference direction）和动作不一致基线（action disagreement baseline）的性能。进行跨层稀疏扫描比较不同层的可解码性。

Result: 遮挡使OpenVLA成功率从57%降至17%。在第16层，逻辑探针预测15步内失败的AUROC达0.972，AUPRC为0.352，优于两个基线。层扫描显示层16最强，层8仍有信息，层10较弱。颜色偏移未导致失败（良性对照），相机抖动导致失败且遮挡训练的监控器仍优于随机水平。

Conclusion: OpenVLA内部状态在受控感知变化下包含与失败相关的可解码结构，但实验未建立因果机制、任务泛化或可部署的恢复系统。结果具有明确局限性。

Original Abstract: Vision Language Action models combine perception, language grounding, and control in a single policy, but their failures are hard to diagnose once visual conditions shift. We test whether OpenVLA feedforward activations contain linearly decodable information about near term task failure in LIBERO manipulation rollouts. The policy is fixed throughout. We log internal activations during execution and fit lightweight monitors after the rollouts are collected. Occlusion is the main controlled stress test. It reduces OpenVLA success from $57\%$ to $17\%$ over $100$ episodes per condition. Under this shift, a logistic probe at layer 16 reaches AUROC $0.972$ and AUPRC $0.352$ for predicting failure within a $15$ step horizon. It outperforms both a mean difference direction and an action disagreement baseline. A sparse layer sweep finds uneven decodability across depth: layer 16 is strongest among the tested layers, layer 8 remains informative, and layer 10 is weaker. To check whether the monitor is just an occlusion detector, we also evaluate color shift and camera jitter without refitting. Color shift produces no failures in this setting, so it is a benign control rather than a failure benchmark. Camera jitter does induce failures, and the occlusion trained monitor remains above random. The result is deliberately limited: OpenVLA internal states contain failure relevant structure under controlled perceptual shift, but these experiments do not establish a causal mechanism, task held out generalization, or a deployable recovery system.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉-语言-动作模型将感知、语言基础和控制整合为单一策略，但一旦视觉条件发生变化，其失败原因难以诊断。我们测试了OpenVLA的前馈激活是否包含关于LIBERO操作任务rollout中近期任务失败的线性可解码信息。策略在整个过程中保持固定。我们在执行过程中记录内部激活，并在rollout收集完成后拟合轻量级监控器。遮挡是主要的受控压力测试。它使OpenVLA的成功率从每个条件下100个episode的57%降至17%。在这种变化下，第16层的逻辑探针在预测15步时间范围内的失败时达到AUROC 0.972和AUPRC 0.352。其性能优于均值差异方向和动作不一致基线。跨层稀疏扫描发现不同深度上的可解码性不均匀：在测试层中第16层最强，第8层仍具有信息性，第10层较弱。为验证监控器是否仅是遮挡检测器，我们还评估了颜色偏移和相机抖动而不重新拟合。颜色偏移在此设置下未产生失败，因此它是良性对照而非失败基准。相机抖动确实导致失败，且未经重新拟合的遮挡训练监控器仍优于随机水平。该结果具有明确局限性：OpenVLA内部状态在受控感知变化下包含与失败相关的结构，但这些实验并未建立因果机制、任务外泛化或可部署的恢复系统。

</details>


### [148] [UniVAD v2: Unified Visual Anomaly Detection via Support-Conditioned Boundary Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29714)
*Zhaopeng Gu,Bingke Zhu,Zhaowen Li,Guibo Zhu,Yingying Chen,Ming Tang,Peng Su,Jinqiao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出UniVAD v2，一种双侧支持条件边界构建框架，用于统一视觉异常检测。在正常侧通过最优传输关系建模（OTRM）和自适应协调机制（ACRRM）增强局部对应与全局关系捕捉，在异常侧通过少样本异常参考模块（FAR）利用可选的异常参考调整决策边界。在六个跨领域数据集上，UniVAD v2在1N-shot设置下将图像级AUC从83.0%提升至84.5%，在1N+1A-shot设置下达到85.7%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有少样本统一异常检测方法主要从正常侧证据推断类别特定的决策边界，缺乏异常侧证据的支持；同时在正常侧难以联合捕捉局部对应关系与全局支持-查询关系，导致对未见异常的边界不可靠。

Method: 基于UniVAD的组件-分块分治框架，UniVAD v2在正常侧引入最优传输关系建模模块（OTRM），通过传输式分配补充检索与支持-查询匹配；引入自适应协调机制（ACRRM），估计情节条件化的可靠性以融合两种证据来源。在异常侧引入少样本异常参考模块（FAR），将可选的异常参考转化为拒绝侧证据用于边界调整。

Result: 在六个跨领域数据集（工业、逻辑、医学）上，1N-shot设置下图像级AUC从UniVAD的83.0%提升至84.5%，1N+1A-shot设置下达85.7%。在MVTec-AD Severity Split上达96.2%图像级AUC和96.9%像素级AUC，证明异常参考可实现可控边界定制而无需重新训练。

Conclusion: UniVAD v2通过双侧证据（正常侧与异常侧）构造边界，显著提升了统一异常检测在少样本场景下的跨域泛化能力，且异常参考提供了无需重训的边界定制能力。

Original Abstract: Unified visual anomaly detection seeks to train a single detector that can be deployed across categories, domains, and application scenarios. In the few-shot transfer regime, the key challenge is to estimate an episode-specific boundary for an unseen target category from a small support set. Existing approaches mainly infer this boundary from normal-side evidence and provide limited abnormal-side evidence for deployment-specific tolerance. Within the normal side, they often struggle to jointly capture local correspondences and global support-query relations, making their boundaries less reliable for unseen anomalies. To address these issues, we propose UniVAD v2, a two-sided support-conditioned boundary construction framework for unified visual anomaly detection. Built on the component-patch divide-and-conquer framework of UniVAD, UniVAD v2 strengthens the normal side with an Optimal Transport-based Relational Modeling module (OTRM), which complements retrieval with support-query matching through transport-style allocation, and an Adaptive Coordination mechanism for Retrieval and Relational Modeling (ACRRM), which estimates episode-conditioned reliabilities to fuse the two sources of evidence. On the abnormal side, a Few-Shot Abnormal Reference module (FAR) converts optional abnormal references into rejection-side evidence for boundary adjustment. Experiments on six datasets spanning industrial, logical, and medical anomaly detection demonstrate strong cross-domain generalization. Under the 1N-shot protocol, UniVAD v2 improves the mean image-level AUC over UniVAD from 83.0\% to 84.5\%, and further reaches 85.7\% in the 1N+1A-shot setting. On the MVTec-AD Severity Split (MVTec-AD-SS), UniVAD v2 achieves 96.2\% image-level AUC and 96.9\% pixel-level AUC, showing that abnormal references enable controllable boundary customization without retraining.

中文摘要翻译: 统一视觉异常检测旨在训练一个能够跨类别、跨领域、跨应用场景部署的单一检测器。在少样本迁移场景下，关键挑战是从少量支持集中估计一个未见目标类别的情节特定边界。现有方法主要从正常侧证据推断该边界，且对部署特定容忍度仅提供有限的异常侧证据。在正常侧，它们通常难以联合捕捉局部对应关系和全局支持-查询关系，使得其边界对未见异常不够可靠。为解决这些问题，我们提出了UniVAD v2，一种用于统一视觉异常检测的双侧支持条件边界构建框架。基于UniVAD的组件-分块分治框架，UniVAD v2在正常侧引入了一个基于最优传输的关系建模模块（OTRM），通过传输式分配来补充检索与支持-查询匹配，以及一个检索与关系建模的自适应协调机制（ACRRM），该机制估计情节条件化的可靠性以融合两种证据来源。在异常侧，少样本异常参考模块（FAR）将可选的异常参考转化为拒绝侧证据用于边界调整。在涵盖工业、逻辑和医学异常检测的六个数据集上的实验证明了强大的跨域泛化能力。在1N-shot协议下，UniVAD v2将平均图像级AUC从UniVAD的83.0%提升至84.5%，并在1N+1A-shot设置下进一步达到85.7%。在MVTec-AD Severity Split（MVTec-AD-SS）上，UniVAD v2实现了96.2%的图像级AUC和96.9%的像素级AUC，表明异常参考无需重新训练即可实现可控的边界定制。

</details>


### [149] [Accurate Recognition of Pneumonia and COVID-19 by Geometric Shape Normalization of Lung Region using Automatic Landmark Detection and Piecewise Affine Warping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29715)
*Salvador E. Ayala-Raggi,Rafael Alejandro Cruz-Ovando,Lauro Reyes-Cocoletzi,Aldrin Barreto-Flores*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于肺区几何归一化的胸片疾病识别系统，通过地标检测、普氏分析和仿射扭曲实现解剖对齐，在COVID-19和病毒性肺炎分类中取得高准确率且有效抵抗采集伪影。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 胸片中的采集伪影（如扫描仪差异、患者定位不一致）会影响疾病识别模型的性能，现有方法缺乏对解剖结构对齐的系统性处理，因此需要一种几何归一化方法来去除这些混杂因素。

Method: 提出三模块系统：①带坐标注意力的ResNet-18地标检测器（集成4个模型+TTA）预测15个肺轮廓点；②广义普氏分析+德劳内三角剖分+分段仿射扭曲的几何归一化；③迁移学习+SAHS对比增强的ResNet-18分类器（COVID-19/病毒性肺炎/正常）。

Result: 地标检测平均误差3.61像素；COVID-19数据库上归一化分类器五折交叉验证准确率98.60±0.26%、F1-Macro 98.00%；在COVID-19数据库（98.60% vs 96.24%）和混合数据集（94.67% vs 94.17%）上均优于伪影掩码/裁剪的未对齐图像。

Conclusion: 解剖对齐（几何归一化）能够提供比原始图像更可控且抗采集伪影的表示，在肺部疾病识别中具有更好的泛化能力和鲁棒性。

Original Abstract: This paper presents an automatic system for recognizing pulmonary diseases in chest X-rays using geometric normalization of the lung region. The method combines three modules: (1) a ResNet-18 landmark detector with coordinate attention that predicts 15 lung-contour landmarks, achieving a mean localization error of 3.61 pixels through an ensemble of four models with test-time augmentation; (2) a geometric normalizer based on Generalized Procrustes Analysis, Delaunay triangulation, and piecewise affine warping to map each lung region to a standardized shape; and (3) a ResNet-18 classifier with transfer learning and SAHS contrast enhancement to classify images as COVID-19, Viral Pneumonia, or Normal. On the COVID-19 Radiography Database, the normalized-image classifier achieved 98.60+/-0.26% accuracy and 98.00% F1-Macro using five-fold cross-validation. Although original images produced slightly higher raw accuracy, Grad-CAM and cropping experiments suggest that this advantage is partly influenced by acquisition artifacts. In contrast, geometrically normalized images outperformed artifact-masked/cropped unaligned images on both the COVID-19 Radiography Database (98.60% vs. 96.24%) and a balanced adult-pediatric mixed dataset including pediatric cases from the Kermany dataset (94.67% vs. 94.17%). These results suggest that anatomical alignment can provide a more controlled and artifact-resistant representation for pulmonary disease recognition.

中文摘要翻译: 本文提出了一种基于肺区几何归一化的胸片肺部疾病自动识别系统。该方法结合三个模块：（1）一个带有坐标注意力的ResNet-18地标检测器，通过四个模型的集成和测试时增强预测15个肺轮廓地标，平均定位误差为3.61像素；（2）基于广义普氏分析、德劳内三角剖分和分段仿射扭曲的几何归一化器，将每个肺区映射到标准化形状；（3）一个结合迁移学习和SAHS对比增强的ResNet-18分类器，对图像进行COVID-19、病毒性肺炎或正常分类。在COVID-19放射学数据库上，归一化图像分类器通过五折交叉验证达到98.60±0.26%的准确率和98.00%的F1-Macro。尽管原始图像在原始准确率上略高，但Grad-CAM和裁剪实验表明这一优势部分受采集伪影影响。相比之下，几何归一化图像在COVID-19放射学数据库（98.60% vs. 96.24%）和包含Kermany数据集儿童病例的平衡成人-儿童混合数据集（94.67% vs. 94.17%）上均优于伪影掩码/裁剪的未对齐图像。这些结果表明，解剖对齐可以为肺部疾病识别提供更可控且抗伪影的表征。

</details>


### [150] [AerialMetric: Benchmarking and Adapting UAV Monocular Metric Depth Estimation in the Real World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29716)
*Zhongqiang Song,Guanying Chen,Yuqi Zhang,Yin Zou,Chuanyu Fu,Zhiyuan Yuan,Chuan Huang,Shuguang Cui,Xiaochun Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对无人机航拍图像中的单目度量深度估计问题，提出了AerialMetric基准数据集，包含5.2万真实和1.6万合成图像-深度对，并基于该数据集对现有方法进行了系统评估与微调，实现了航拍场景下的最优性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有单目深度估计模型主要在街景和室内数据集上训练，在无人机航拍视角下存在显著的域差距（domain gap），缺乏专门针对航拍场景的度量深度估计基准数据集和系统评估。

Method: 构建AerialMetric基准数据集，包含四个互补子集：真实摄影测量数据、受控航拍采集数据、逼真合成场景数据、以及互联网在野图像数据；基于该数据集系统评估现有SOTA模型，并通过对代表性度量深度模型进行微调建立航拍基准。

Result: 数据集提供了5.2万真实和1.6万合成图像-深度对；系统评估揭示了视角、高度和相机参数对度量深度预测的影响；微调后的模型在多样化航拍图像上实现了最优性能。

Conclusion: AerialMetric数据集有效弥补了航拍场景下度量深度估计的基准缺失，通过微调现有模型可显著提升航拍视角下的深度预测性能，数据集与代码已开源。

Original Abstract: This paper addresses the problem of monocular metric depth estimation in aerial UAV imagery. Although recent data-driven methods have achieved remarkable progress in ground-level scenarios, models trained primarily on street-view and indoor datasets exhibit significant domain gaps when applied to aerial viewpoints. To tackle these challenges, we introduce AerialMetric, a benchmark dataset designed to evaluate and facilitate the adaptation of monocular metric depth estimation under UAV aerial viewpoints. The dataset consists of four complementary subsets collected from different sources, jointly covering real-world photogrammetry data, controlled aerial acquisition settings, photorealistic synthetic scenes, and in-the-wild Internet imagery. Totally, AerialMetric provides 52K real-world and 16K synthetic image-depth pairs with reliable metric ground truth. Based on this dataset, we conduct systematic evaluations of existing state-of-the-art models under aerial settings and investigate the impact of viewpoint, altitude, and camera parameters on metric depth prediction. In addition, by fine-tuning representative metric depth model on our dataset, we establish a comprehensive aerial benchmark and achieve state-of-the-art performance across diverse aerial imagery. Our dataset, code, and model weight are publicly available at https://kuieless.github.io/AerialMetric-ECCV2026-page/.

中文摘要翻译: 本文针对无人机航拍图像中的单目度量深度估计问题展开研究。尽管近期基于数据驱动的方法在地面场景中取得了显著进展，但主要在街景和室内数据集上训练的模型在应用于航拍视角时存在显著的域差距。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了AerialMetric——一个旨在评估和促进无人机航拍视角下单目度量深度估计适应的基准数据集。该数据集包含来自不同来源的四个互补子集，共同覆盖真实摄影测量数据、受控航拍采集场景、逼真合成场景以及互联网在野图像。总计，AerialMetric提供了5.2万对真实图像-深度对和1.6万对合成图像-深度对，并配有可靠的度量地面真值。基于该数据集，我们对现有最先进模型在航拍场景下进行了系统评估，并研究了视角、高度和相机参数对度量深度预测的影响。此外，通过在数据集上对代表性度量深度模型进行微调，我们建立了一个全面的航拍基准，并在多样化的航拍图像上实现了最先进的性能。我们的数据集、代码和模型权重已在 https://kuieless.github.io/AerialMetric-ECCV2026-page/ 公开提供。

</details>


### [151] [HTC-SGA Former: A Hybrid Transformer-CNN Network with Self-Guided Attention and a New Boundary-Weighted Adaptive Loss for Coronary DSA Vessel Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29744)
*Rayan Merghani Ahmed,Marwa Omer Mohammed Omer,Mohamed Elmanna,Shijie Li,Bin Li,Shoujun Zhoua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种轻量级混合Transformer-CNN框架HTC-SGA Former，用于冠状动脉DSA血管分割，通过多尺度全局-局部窗口注意力、自引导特征注意力和边界加权自适应复合损失函数，在仅0.81M参数下超越14种现有方法，有效改善了弱血管恢复、血管连续性和边界定位。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有冠状动脉DSA血管分割方法难以同时处理全局上下文推理与弱血管、血管连续性和精细边界的保留，且存在血管-背景类别严重不平衡问题，因此需要一种轻量级且能兼顾全局局部上下文建模与弱血管增强的框架。

Method: 提出HTC-SGA Former轻量级混合框架：采用CNN编码器提取局部血管形态，Transformer解码器进行上下文特征建模；设计多尺度全局-局部窗口注意力（MS-GLWA）模块实现高效全局-局部上下文建模；自引导特征注意力（SGFA）模块增强弱血管响应；边界加权自适应复合损失（BWACL）强调薄血管边界并自适应平衡血管恢复与边界细化。

Result: 在私有左右冠状动脉DSA子集上，HTC-SGA Former以仅0.81M参数超越14种现有最优方法；BWACL损失在四种编码器-解码器架构上均优于二值交叉熵和Dice损失，展现出强跨骨干适用性。

Conclusion: HTC-SGA Former通过互补的全局-局部上下文建模、血管聚焦细化和自适应优化，有效提高了弱血管恢复、血管连续性和边界定位能力，为未来计算机辅助心血管介入提供了可靠且计算高效的冠脉血管分析方案。

Original Abstract: Accurate coronary Digital Subtraction Angiography (DSA) vessel segmentation is essential for computer-aided diagnosis and treatment planning of coronary artery disease (CAD). However, thin low-contrast vessels, background interference, and severe vessel-background class imbalance make reliable segmentation of weak distal branches and vessel boundaries challenging. Existing methods struggle to balance global contextual reasoning with preservation of weak vessels, vessel continuity, and fine boundaries. To address these limitations, we propose HTC-SGA Former, a lightweight hybrid Transformer-CNN framework for coronary DSA vessel segmentation. It employs a CNN encoder for local vessel morphology extraction and a Transformer decoder for contextual feature modeling. A Multi-Scale Global-Local Window Attention (MS-GLWA) block performs efficient global-local contextual modeling, while a Self-Guided Feature Attention (SGFA) module enhances weak-vessel responses. In addition, a Boundary-Weighted Adaptive Compound Loss (BWACL) emphasizes thin-vessel boundaries and adaptively balances vessel recovery and boundary refinement. Experiments on private right and left coronary artery DSA subsets show that HTC-SGA Former outperforms 14 state-of-the-art segmentation methods while maintaining a compact architecture with only 0.81M parameters. BWACL also improves performance over binary cross-entropy and Dice losses across four encoder-decoder architectures, demonstrating strong cross-backbone applicability. HTC-SGA Former improves thin-vessel recovery, vessel continuity, and boundary localization through complementary global-local contextual modeling, vessel-focused refinement, and adaptive optimization, supporting reliable and computationally efficient coronary vessel analysis for future computer-assisted cardiovascular interventions.

中文摘要翻译: 准确的冠状动脉数字减影血管造影（DSA）血管分割对于冠状动脉疾病（CAD）的计算机辅助诊断和治疗规划至关重要。然而，薄而低对比度的血管、背景干扰以及严重的血管-背景类别不平衡，使得对微弱远端分支和血管边界的可靠分割具有挑战性。现有方法难以平衡全局上下文推理与弱血管、血管连续性和精细边界的保留。为解决这些局限，我们提出HTC-SGA Former，一种用于冠状动脉DSA血管分割的轻量级混合Transformer-CNN框架。该框架采用CNN编码器提取局部血管形态，Transformer解码器进行上下文特征建模。多尺度全局-局部窗口注意力（MS-GLWA）模块执行高效的全局-局部上下文建模，自引导特征注意力（SGFA）模块增强弱血管响应。此外，边界加权自适应复合损失（BWACL）强调薄血管边界并自适应平衡血管恢复与边界细化。在私有左右冠状动脉DSA子集上的实验表明，HTC-SGA Former在保持仅0.81M参数的紧凑架构下，超越了14种现有最优分割方法。BWACL在四种编码器-解码器架构上均优于二值交叉熵和Dice损失，展现出强跨骨干适用性。HTC-SGA Former通过互补的全局-局部上下文建模、血管聚焦细化和自适应优化，改善了弱血管恢复、血管连续性和边界定位，为未来计算机辅助心血管介入提供了可靠且计算高效的冠脉血管分析方案。

</details>


### [152] [LEIQ-Assessor: Multi-dimensional Quality Assessment of Low-light Enhanced Images via Multi-task Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29752)
*Wei Sun,Yanwei Jiang,Dandan Zhu,Jinqiu Sang,Jikai Xu,Weixia Zhang,Guangtao Zhai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LEIQ-Assessor，一种基于多任务学习的低光照图像增强质量评估模型，通过SigLIP2视觉Transformer同时预测整体MOS和六个感知子属性，在MLE基准上显著优于现有无参考IQA模型，并在QoMEX 2026挑战赛中获第二名。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 低光照图像增强算法在提升可见度的同时常引入噪声放大、颜色偏移、结构损伤和过曝等伪影，降低了增强图像的感知质量，因此需要一套可靠的图像质量评估指标来评价增强效果，以支持算法研发和实际应用。

Method: 以预训练的SigLIP2视觉Transformer为骨干网络，采用多任务学习框架同时预测整体平均意见得分(MOS)以及六个感知子属性（亮度、色彩保真度、噪声水平、曝光质量、自然度、内容恢复），通过PLCC损失联合优化相关目标，使共享表征学习到更丰富的质量感知特征。

Result: 在MLE基准上，LEIQ-Assessor显著优于现有无参考IQA模型和手工设计的质量描述符；在QoMEX 2026低光照增强图像质量评估大挑战赛中取得第二名。

Conclusion: 多任务学习框架能够有效提取低光照增强图像的多维质量特征，联合优化相关感知子属性比单任务方法更有效，验证了该方法在低光照图像质量评估任务中的优越性。

Original Abstract: Low-light image enhancement algorithms (LIEAs) aim to improve the visibility of images captured under poor illumination. However, the enhancement process often introduces artifacts such as noise amplification, color shift, structural damage, and over-exposure, which degrade the perceptual quality of the enhanced images. Therefore, a reliable image quality assessment (IQA) metric for evaluating enhancement effects is of great importance for both the development of LIEAs and their practical applications. In this paper, we present \textbf{LEIQ-Assessor}, a multi-dimensional quality assessment model for low-light image enhancement based on multi-task learning, developed for the QoMEX 2026 Grand Challenge on Low-light Enhanced Image Quality Assessment. Specifically, our method leverages a pre-trained SigLIP2 Vision Transformer as the backbone and simultaneously predicts the overall Mean Opinion Score (MOS) together with six perceptual sub-attributes: lightness, color fidelity, noise level, exposure quality, naturalness, and content recovery. By jointly optimizing these correlated objectives via the PLCC loss, the shared representation captures richer quality-aware features than its single-task counterpart. Experiments on the MLE benchmark demonstrate that LEIQ-Assessor significantly outperforms existing no-reference IQA models and hand-crafted quality descriptors. Our method achieved second place in the QoMEX 2026 Grand Challenge on Low-light Enhanced Image Quality Assessment. The code is available at https://github.com/sunwei925/LEIQ-Assessor.

中文摘要翻译: 低光照图像增强算法旨在提升在弱光照条件下拍摄图像的可见性。然而，增强过程常常引入噪声放大、颜色偏移、结构损伤和过度曝光等伪影，从而降低增强图像的感知质量。因此，一套可靠的用于评估增强效果的图像质量评估指标，对于低光照图像增强算法的发展及其实际应用都具有重要意义。在本文中，我们提出了LEIQ-Assessor，一种基于多任务学习的低光照图像增强多维度质量评估模型，针对QoMEX 2026低光照增强图像质量评估大挑战赛而开发。具体而言，我们的方法采用预训练的SigLIP2视觉Transformer作为骨干网络，同时预测整体平均意见得分以及六个感知子属性：亮度、色彩保真度、噪声水平、曝光质量、自然度和内容恢复。通过PLCC损失联合优化这些相关目标，共享表征相比其单任务对应方法能够学习到更丰富的质量感知特征。在MLE基准上的实验表明，LEIQ-Assessor显著优于现有无参考图像质量评估模型和手工设计的质量描述符。我们的方法在QoMEX 2026低光照增强图像质量评估大挑战赛中获得了第二名。代码已开源在https://github.com/sunwei925/LEIQ-Assessor。

</details>


### [153] [MR-IQA: A Unified Margin View of Regression and Ranking for Blind Image Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29760)
*Yuan Li,Youyuan Lin,Zitang Sun,Yung-Hao Yang,Kiyofumi Miyoshi,Chenhui Chu,Shin'ya Nishida*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示了无参考图像质量评估（BIQA）中回归与排序两种范式的内在联系——质量间隔（quality margin），并提出基于强化学习的直接质量间隔优化框架MR-IQA，在六个BIQA基准上取得竞争性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 尽管联合回归-排序监督常能提升BIQA性能，但二者之间的关系主要停留在经验层面，缺乏理论上的深入探索。

Method: 提出MR-IQA框架，将回归和排序统一为质量间隔优化问题，采用强化学习采样质量分数并将成对间隔误差作为策略奖励进行优化，从而更显式地建模质量结构。

Result: 在六个BIQA基准上取得竞争性通用性能，受控对比实验表明MR-IQA在平均PLCC/SRCC指标上优于基于回归或排序的强化学习方法。

Conclusion: 为回归与排序的统一提供了新的理论视角，为BIQA乃至更广领域的质量结构建模奠定了理论基础。

Original Abstract: Blind image quality assessment (BIQA) is commonly built on two basic learning paradigms: regression and ranking. Regression calibrates absolute scores, whereas ranking recovers quality structure from ordinal relations. Although joint regression-ranking supervision often improves BIQA, the relation between the two paradigms remains largely empirical and underexplored. In this work, we revisit what underlies regression and ranking and identify pairwise relational distance, termed quality margin, as their common bridge. Our derivation shows that, at the objective-optimization level, both paradigms fit quality margins: regression fits margins induced by score endpoints, while ranking fits transformed or sign-level margins through preference probabilities. Motivated by this insight, we propose MR-IQA, a direct quality-margin optimization framework for reinforcement learning (RL)-based BIQA. MR-IQA samples quality scores and optimizes pairwise margin errors as policy rewards, thereby modeling quality structure more explicitly. Experiments on six BIQA benchmarks show competitive general performance, and controlled comparisons demonstrate that MR-IQA achieves the strongest average PLCC/SRCC over regression- or ranking-based RL methods. Our findings provide a new insight into unifying regression and ranking, offering a theoretical basis for understanding quality-structure modeling in BIQA and beyond.

中文摘要翻译: 无参考图像质量评估（BIQA）通常建立在两种基本学习范式之上：回归和排序。回归校准绝对分数，而排序从序数关系中恢复质量结构。尽管联合回归-排序监督常能提升BIQA性能，但这两种范式之间的关系仍主要停留在经验层面，缺乏深入探索。本文重新审视回归与排序的底层机制，识别出成对关系距离——即质量间隔（quality margin）——作为二者的共通桥梁。我们的推导表明，在目标优化层面，两种范式都在拟合质量间隔：回归拟合由分数端点导出的间隔，而排序通过偏好概率拟合变换后的或符号级的间隔。受此启发，我们提出MR-IQA，一个针对基于强化学习（RL）的BIQA的直接质量间隔优化框架。MR-IQA采样质量分数，并将成对间隔误差作为策略奖励进行优化，从而更显式地建模质量结构。在六个BIQA基准上的实验显示了竞争性的通用性能，受控对比表明MR-IQA在平均PLCC/SRCC上优于基于回归或排序的强化学习方法。我们的发现为统一回归与排序提供了新见解，为理解BIQA及更广领域的质量结构建模提供了理论基础。

</details>


### [154] [TopoAgent: An Agentic Framework for Automated Topology Learning in Medical Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29763)
*Guangyu Meng,Pengfei Gu,Xueyang Li,Yiyu Shi,Erin Wolf Chambers,Danny Z. Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TopoAgent，一种基于大语言模型的智能体框架，用于自动化医学图像分析中的拓扑描述符选择和特征提取，无需任务特定训练。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有拓扑数据分析方法大多默认使用单一固定的拓扑描述符（如持久性图像），忽视了拓扑表示的多样性，且缺乏能够自动为给定图像数据集选择最合适拓扑描述符的自动化框架。

Method: TopoAgent基于LLM，通过感知-推理-行动-反思循环运行，配备21个领域专用工具和双记忆机制，其技能从15种拓扑描述符在26个数据集上的系统评估中蒸馏而来。

Result: 在26个数据集上系统评估了15种拓扑描述符与6种分类器的组合，并将评估知识蒸馏为TopoAgent的技能集。

Conclusion: TopoAgent能够自动分析输入图像的拓扑特征，推理并确定最优拓扑描述符及其配置，无需任务特定训练即可完成拓扑特征向量的提取。

Original Abstract: Topological data analysis (TDA), particularly persistent homology (PH), captures geometric structural properties in medical images (e.g., connected components, loops, shape characteristics), which conventional pixel-level deep learning approaches often neglect. While many topological descriptors are known for converting persistence diagrams (PDs) or raw images into topological feature vectors, existing methods mostly default to a single fixed descriptor (e.g., persistence images), leaving the diversity of topological representations largely unexplored. To the best of our knowledge, there is no known large language model (LLM)-based agentic framework that can automatically determine the most suitable topological descriptors for a given image dataset and produce the corresponding topological feature vectors for downstream tasks. To fill this gap, we propose \textbf{TopoAgent}, an LLM-based agentic framework that automates topology learning for medical image analysis.TopoAgent operates through a Perception--Reasoning--Action--Reflection loop supported by 21 domain-specific tools and dual memory that accumulates experience across runs. Its skill set is distilled from systematic evaluation of 15 topological descriptors across 26 datasets with six classifiers. TopoAgent analyzes input images and their topological characteristics, reasons about which topological descriptors best suit the input, and determines the optimal descriptor and its configuration, all without task-specific training.

中文摘要翻译: 拓扑数据分析（TDA），特别是持久同调（PH），能够捕捉医学图像中的几何结构特征（如连通分量、环、形状特征），而这些特征常被传统的像素级深度学习方法忽略。尽管已知有许多拓扑描述符可以将持久性图（PD）或原始图像转换为拓扑特征向量，但现有方法大多默认使用单一固定的描述符（例如持久性图像），拓扑表示的多样性在很大程度上未被探索。据我们所知，目前尚不存在基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体框架能够自动为给定图像数据集确定最合适的拓扑描述符，并生成相应的拓扑特征向量用于下游任务。为填补这一空白，我们提出了\textbf{TopoAgent}，一种基于LLM的智能体框架，能够自动化医学图像分析中的拓扑学习。TopoAgent通过一个感知-推理-行动-反思循环运行，该循环由21个领域专用工具和双记忆机制支持，能够在多次运行中积累经验。其技能集来源于对15种拓扑描述符在26个数据集上结合6种分类器的系统评估。TopoAgent能够分析输入图像及其拓扑特征，推理最适合输入的拓扑描述符，并确定最优描述符及其配置，整个过程无需任务特定训练。

</details>


### [155] [UrbanCDNet: Appearance-Robust and Boundary-Aware Bitemporal Change Detection for Korean Urban Building Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29781)
*Abdirashid Omar,Jonghyuk Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出UrbanCDNet，一种针对韩国城市建筑变化检测任务设计的Siamese CNN网络，通过结合多线索比较、对齐感知差异、轻量级上下文精炼、场景校准和边界监督，在稀疏变化、高光度差异和边界准确性等挑战性场景下显著优于强基线模型。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 韩国城市场景中，双时相航空影像的建筑变化检测面临三大挑战：变化区域稀疏、不同采集时间之间外观差异大、输出需要精确的建筑足迹而非粗粒度区域。现有通用模型难以有效应对这些特定问题。

Method: 提出UrbanCDNet，一种任务特定的Siamese CNN，包含：外观鲁棒的多线索比较模块、对齐感知的中尺度差异模块、轻量级上下文精炼、场景校准以及辅助边界监督。

Result: 在AIHub韩国基准数据集上（3998训练/503验证/499测试对），UrbanCDNet达到0.7335精确率、0.7696召回率、0.7511 F1和0.6014 IoU。在稀疏变化子集（变化<5%）上F1从0.4765提升至0.6175，高光度差异子集上F1从0.6349提升至0.7285，边界F1（3像素容差）从0.3445提升至0.4447，目标F1（IoU@0.3）从0.0690提升至0.2258。

Conclusion: 在该韩国基准数据集上，任务导向的时间对比和边界感知监督比通用的模型规模扩展更为重要，UrbanCDNet的设计能有效解决稀疏变化、光度差异和边界精度等核心挑战。

Original Abstract: Urban building change detection from bi-temporal aerial imagery is important for redevelopment monitoring, infrastructure management, and unauthorized-construction screening, but Korean urban scenes remain difficult because changed regions are often sparse, appearance varies strongly between acquisition dates, and useful outputs must follow building footprints rather than coarse blobs. This paper presents UrbanCDNet, a task specific Siamese CNN that combines appearance-robust multi-cue comparison, alignment-aware middle-scale differencing, lightweight context refinement, scene calibration, and auxiliary boundary supervision. Experiments use a corrected AIHub-based Korean benchmark with 3,998 training, 503 validation, and 499 test pairs, and report changed-class precision, recall, F1, and IoU. On the locked test split, UrbanCDNet achieves 0.7335 precision, 0.7696 recall, 0.7511 F1, and 0.6014 IoU, outperforming a strong Siamese U-Net baseline (0.7108 F1, 0.5514 IoU) and the strongest external competitor, ChangeFormer-MIT-B0 (0.7107 F1, 0.5512 IoU). Additional diagnostic slicing shows that the gain is concentrated in the operating regimes that motivated the design: on the sparse-change subset with less than 5% changed area, F1 improves from 0.4765 to 0.6175, and on the high photometric-gap subset it improves from 0.6349 to 0.7285. Boundary F1 at 3-pixel tolerance rises from 0.3445 to 0.4447, while object F1 at IoU 0.3 rises from 0.0690 to 0.2258. These results indicate that, on this Korean benchmark, task-shaped temporal comparison and boundary-aware supervision matter more than generic model scale alone

中文摘要翻译: 基于双时相航空影像的城市建筑变化检测对于再开发监测、基础设施管理和违章建筑筛查具有重要意义，但韩国城市场景仍然具有挑战性，因为变化区域通常稀疏、不同采集时间之间的外观差异较大，且有用的输出必须遵循建筑足迹而非粗粒度区域。本文提出了UrbanCDNet，一种任务特定的Siamese CNN，结合了外观鲁棒的多线索比较、对齐感知的中尺度差分、轻量级上下文精炼、场景校准以及辅助边界监督。实验基于修正后的AIHub韩国基准数据集，包含3,998个训练对、503个验证对和499个测试对，报告了变化类的精确率、召回率、F1和IoU。在封闭测试集上，UrbanCDNet达到了0.7335精确率、0.7696召回率、0.7511 F1和0.6014 IoU，优于强基线Siamese U-Net（0.7108 F1，0.5514 IoU）和最强劲的外部竞争者ChangeFormer-MIT-B0（0.7107 F1，0.5512 IoU）。额外的诊断性切片分析表明，性能提升集中在促使该方法设计的操作场景中：在变化面积小于5%的稀疏变化子集上，F1从0.4765提升至0.6175；在高光度差异子集上，F1从0.6349提升至0.7285。3像素容差下的边界F1从0.3445提升至0.4447，IoU 0.3下的目标F1从0.0690提升至0.2258。这些结果表明，在该韩国基准数据集上，任务导向的时间比较和边界感知监督比单纯的通用模型规模更为重要。

</details>


### [156] [Graph-GSReg: Leveraging 3D Scene Graphs for Gaussian Splatting Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29782)
*Jaewon Lee,Mangyu Kong,Euntai Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将多个3D高斯泼溅场景合并为统一高斯表示的方法，通过构建3D场景图将配准问题转化为图配准问题，并采用自监督测试时优化来消除合并伪影。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 大规模3D地图构建和长期地图管理需要将多个3DGS场景合并为统一的高斯表示，但现有方法存在局限性：基于学习的方法需要大量训练数据且建立高斯基元直接对应困难；基于图像的优化方法严重依赖通用基础模型的粗糙初始化且优化成本高。

Method: 提出3D场景图构建方法，将3DGS及其渲染图像抽象为更高层级的图表示，从而将3DGS配准重新表述为图配准问题；并引入自监督测试时优化，通过保持原始场景与合并场景之间的视觉一致性来消除空洞和漂浮物等遮挡伪影。

Result: 在真实和合成基准上评估，该方法在配准精度和合并场景渲染质量上均具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 所提出的3D场景图表示能够实现语义信息和结构上下文的全局一致性理解，自监督测试时优化有效消除了合并过程中的遮挡伪影，为大规模3DGS场景合并提供了有效方案。

Original Abstract: Merging multiple 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes into a single unified Gaussian representation is essential for large-scale 3D mapping and long-term map management. Despite its importance, this area remains underexplored, and existing solutions exhibit several limitations. Learning-based methods attempt direct correspondence between Gaussian primitives and require training on large 3DGS datasets. Image-based optimization methods depend heavily on coarse initialization from generic foundation models and often incur expensive refinement. We present \ourmodel. Our method constructs a 3D scene graph from a 3DGS and its rendered images, \textit{reformulating 3DGS registration as a graph registration problem}. The proposed 3D scene graph represents each 3DGS at a higher-level representation, enabling a globally consistent understanding of semantic information and structural context for accurate registration. To further construct a seamless unified scene, we introduce a Self-Supervised Test-Time Optimization. Naively merging two 3D Gaussian scenes often suffers from occlusion artifacts such as hollows and floaters. To alleviate this issue, we refine the merged Gaussians to preserve visual consistency between the original scenes and the merged scene. We evaluate our method on real and synthetic benchmarks, demonstrating competitive registration accuracy and merged scene rendering quality.

中文摘要翻译: 将多个3D高斯泼溅场景合并为统一的高斯表示对于大规模3D地图构建和长期地图管理至关重要。尽管具有重要性，该领域仍未得到充分探索，现有解决方案存在若干局限性。基于学习的方法试图建立高斯基元之间的直接对应关系，但需要在大型3DGS数据集上进行训练。基于图像的优化方法严重依赖通用基础模型的粗糙初始化，且通常需要昂贵的精细优化。我们提出了OurModel。该方法从3DGS及其渲染图像构建3D场景图，将3DGS配准重新表述为图配准问题。所提出的3D场景图以更高层级的表示表征每个3DGS，能够实现语义信息和结构上下文的全局一致性理解，从而进行精确配准。为构建无缝统一场景，我们引入了自监督测试时优化。直接合并两个3D高斯场景常会出现空洞和漂浮物等遮挡伪影。为缓解该问题，我们对合并后的高斯进行优化，以保持原始场景与合并场景之间的视觉一致性。我们在真实和合成基准上进行了评估，结果表明该方法在配准精度和合并场景渲染质量方面均具有竞争力。

</details>


### [157] [OP3DSG: Open-Vocabulary Part-Aware 3D Scene Graph Generation for Real-World Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29786)
*Yirum Kim,Ue-Hwan Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出OP3DSG，一种开放词汇的、部件感知的3D场景图生成框架，能够联合建模物体、交互部件、空间关系、功能关系和可供性，在UniGraph3D基准上达到SOTA性能，并在真实机器人任务中验证了有效性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有3D场景图生成方法以物体为中心，编码的关系信息有限，无法支持需要细粒度理解的真实场景应用。

Method: 集成物体-部件知识引导检测与部件感知3D融合以保留小且交互相关的部件；采用几何初始化的先验图结合LLM精炼以减少虚假关系预测并实现高效图构建。

Result: 在提出的UniGraph3D基准上达到SOTA性能，并在多种真实机器人任务中验证了其作为感知主干的有效性。

Conclusion: OP3DSG能够有效生成包含部件级粒度和多层级关系的3D场景图，在开放场景下优于现有方法，并适用于真实机器人应用。

Original Abstract: 3D scene graphs (3DSGs) provide a compact and structured abstraction of 3D environments. Although advances in foundation models have enabled open-vocabulary 3DSG generation, existing approaches remain object-centric and encode limited relational information -- restricting their applicability in real-world scenarios that require fine-grained understanding. We propose OP3DSG, an open-vocabulary part-aware 3DSG generation framework that constructs unified graphs that jointly model objects, interactive parts, spatial relations, functional relations, and affordances. OP3DSG integrates object-part knowledge-guided detection with part-aware 3D fusion to preserve small and interaction-relevant components, and employs a geometry-initialized prior graph with LLM-based refinement to reduce spurious relational predictions while enabling efficient graph construction. To systematically evaluate unified 3D scene graph construction, we introduce UniGraph3D, a benchmark designed for part-aware perception and multi-level relational reasoning. Experimental results show that OP3DSG achieves state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates its effectiveness as a perception backbone in diverse real-world robotics tasks.

中文摘要翻译: 3D场景图（3DSG）提供了3D环境的紧凑且结构化的抽象表示。尽管基础模型的进步使得开放词汇的3DSG生成成为可能，但现有方法仍以物体为中心，编码的关系信息有限——这限制了它们在需要细粒度理解的真实场景中的适用性。我们提出OP3DSG，一种开放词汇的、部件感知的3DSG生成框架，该框架构建统一图，联合建模物体、交互部件、空间关系、功能关系和可供性。OP3DSG集成了物体-部件知识引导检测与部件感知3D融合，以保留小尺寸且与交互相关的部件；并采用几何初始化的先验图结合基于大语言模型（LLM）的精炼，以减少虚假关系预测，同时实现高效的图构建。为了系统性地评估统一3D场景图构建，我们引入了UniGraph3D，一个专为部件感知感知和多层级关系推理设计的基准。实验结果表明，OP3DSG达到了最先进的性能，并在多种真实机器人任务中展示了其作为感知主干的有效性。

</details>


### [158] [UniTriSplat: A Unified 3D Gaussian Splatting Framework with Uniform Spherical Rasterization for Universal Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29794)
*Yipeng Zhu,Huajian Huang,Tristan Braud,Sai-Kit Yeung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniTriSplat提出了一种基于HEALPix球面离散化的统一3DGS框架，解决了现有方法在不同相机模型（透视、鱼眼、全景）下因依赖相机专用光栅化而导致的性能退化问题，在球面弧度域内统一完成高斯溅射的前向渲染与梯度传播，实现了从窄视场到全景的一致优化行为。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有3DGS框架依赖相机专用的光栅化方法，在不同相机模型（如透视、鱼眼、全景相机）下存在立体角采样不一致的问题，导致跨相机模型的性能退化。亟需一种统一框架来消除这种相机异构性带来的优化不一致。

Method: 1) 利用HEALPix等面积球面离散化构造球面采样网格，使其与输入图像的角分辨率对齐；2) 在球面弧度域内直接推导高斯溅射的前向渲染和梯度传播公式；3) 引入HEALPix感知的SSIM损失，以尊重球面邻域结构，提升感知重建质量。

Result: 在多种相机模型（透视、鱼眼、全景）上的大量实验表明，UniTriSplat在保持几何保真度和渲染质量的同时，一致地提升了跨相机泛化能力。

Conclusion: UniTriSplat通过球面统一重投影框架，有效消除了不同相机模型间的采样不一致性，为3DGS在异构相机系统下的通用部署提供了可行方案。

Original Abstract: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) frameworks rely on camera-specific rasterization, suffering from inconsistent solid-angle sampling and degraded performance across heterogeneous camera models (e.g., perspective, fisheye, omnidirectional). To address this limitation, we propose UniTriSplat, a unified 3DGS framework for universal cameras that reformulates Gaussian splatting on the unit sphere via HEALPix discretization. Leveraging the equal-area property of HEALPix, we construct a spherical sampling grid aligned with the angular resolution of input images. We derive the forward rendering and gradient propagation of Gaussians directly in the spherical radian domain, yielding uniform optimization behavior from narrow-FoV images to full 360-degree panoramas. To enhance perceptual reconstruction quality, we additionally introduce a HEALPix-aware SSIM loss that respects spherical neighborhood structure. Extensive experiments across diverse camera models demonstrate that UniTriSplat consistently improves cross-camera generalization while preserving geometric fidelity and rendering quality.

中文摘要翻译: 现有3D高斯溅射（3DGS）框架依赖于相机专用的光栅化方法，存在立体角采样不一致的问题，导致在不同相机模型（如透视、鱼眼、全景相机）下性能退化。为了解决这一局限，我们提出UniTriSplat，一个面向通用相机的统一3DGS框架，通过HEALPix离散化在高斯球面上重新构建高斯溅射。利用HEALPix的等面积特性，我们构造了一个与输入图像角分辨率对齐的球面采样网格。我们在球面弧度域内直接导出高斯的前向渲染和梯度传播公式，从而在从窄视场图像到全360度全景图像上实现统一的优化行为。为了增强感知重建质量，我们还引入了一种HEALPix感知的SSIM损失，该损失尊重球面邻域结构。跨多种相机模型的大量实验表明，UniTriSplat在保持几何保真度和渲染质量的同时，一致地提升了跨相机泛化能力。

</details>


### [159] [Concept Removal Guidance: Evidence-Calibrated Negative Guidance for Safe Diffusion Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29801)
*Yoonseok Choi,Chaeyoung Oh,Hyunjun Choi,Seokin Seo,Kee-Eung Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出概念移除引导（CRG），一种无需训练的方法，通过从扩散模型的噪声预测中估计不需要概念的存在，并自适应地校准负向引导，在保持生成质量的同时有效抑制不安全内容。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有推理时控制方法（如固定权重负向引导、动态后验赔率重加权、轻量级相似度方法）存在安全-保真度权衡、对开放词汇组合提示脆弱、忽略去噪轨迹中图像证据变化等问题，亟需一种自适应且鲁棒的解决方案。

Method: CRG方法在每个扩散步骤从模型的噪声预测中估计不需要概念的存在程度，然后通过闭合形式的约束更新来自适应地校准负向引导，强制执行目标存在阈值，同时最小程度地扰动条件轨迹。

Result: 在红队基准测试中，CRG降低了攻击成功率，同时保持了良性样本的保真度；此外，无需微调或外部分类器即可扩展到艺术家风格和暴力内容等额外抑制目标。

Conclusion: CRG作为一种无需训练、自适应校准的负向引导方法，在安全性与保真度之间取得了更好的平衡，且具有良好的泛化能力。

Original Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models remain vulnerable to adversarial prompts that elicit disallowed content, motivating reliable inference-time controls. A popular approach is negative guidance, which subtracts a negative prompt direction with a fixed weight. However, it often forces a safety-fidelity trade-off, causing artifacts or prompt drift when over-applied and failing under attacks when under-applied. Dynamic variants reweight guidance using posterior-odds signals, which can be brittle for open-vocabulary compositional prompts, while lightweight similarity-based methods ignore the evolving image evidence along the denoising trajectory. We introduce Concept Removal Guidance (CRG), a training-free method that estimates unwanted-concept presence at each diffusion step from the model's noise predictions, and adaptively calibrates negative guidance via a closed-form constrained update enforcing a target presence threshold while minimally perturbing the conditional trajectory. Across red-teaming benchmarks, CRG reduces attack success rates while preserving benign fidelity, and extends to additional suppression targets such as artist style and violence without fine-tuning or external classifiers.

中文摘要翻译: 文本到图像扩散模型仍然容易受到对抗性提示的攻击，这些提示会引发被禁止的内容，这推动了可靠的推理时控制需求。一种流行的方法是负向引导，它使用固定权重减去负向提示方向。然而，这种方法常常迫使安全性与保真度之间进行权衡：过度应用时会导致伪影或提示漂移，而应用不足时则会在攻击下失败。动态变体使用后验赔率信号重新加权，但这对于开放词汇的组合提示可能较为脆弱，而轻量级的基于相似度的方法忽略了沿去噪轨迹演变的图像证据。我们引入了概念移除引导（CRG），一种无需训练的方法，该方法从每个扩散步骤的模型噪声预测中估计不需要概念的存在，并通过闭合形式的约束更新自适应地校准负向引导，强制执行目标存在阈值，同时最小程度地扰动条件轨迹。在红队基准测试中，CRG降低了攻击成功率，同时保持了良性样本的保真度，并且无需微调或外部分类器即可扩展到额外的抑制目标，如艺术家风格和暴力内容。

</details>


### [160] [Clearer Sight, Fewer Lies: Oriented Pickup Preference Optimization for Multimodal Hallucination Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29805)
*Xin Zou,Haolin Deng,Yibo Yan,Shuliang Liu,Zhiwei Jin,Chen Chen,Haonan Lu,Xuming Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OPPO方法，通过证据感知的对齐目标学习视觉证据强度的偏好，而非仅关注回复质量，从而缓解多模态大模型的幻觉问题。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 多模态大模型容易产生幻觉，因为其生成偏好未充分校准到视觉证据上，倾向于依赖语言先验而非忠实于视觉信息。实验发现，当用模型自身的注意力显式增强查询相关的视觉证据时，生成变得更准确，表明许多错误并非源于感知缺失，而是模型对已注意到的证据信任不足。

Method: 提出Oriented Pickup Preference Optimization (OPPO)，一种证据感知的对齐目标。该方法在同一忠实回复下对比强证据、锚定证据、弱证据三种视图，将朴素视觉偏好转化为有序的视觉证据对齐。同时结合细粒度的span级和token级正则化来稳定训练，并提供理论分析证明有序证据间隔能诱导局部视觉敏感性的正下界。

Result: 在幻觉评估和通用基准测试上的广泛评估表明，OPPO一致优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过显式学习视觉证据强度的偏好排序，而非仅优化回复质量，可以有效缓解多模态大模型的幻觉问题，使模型更忠实地依据视觉证据进行生成。

Original Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are prone to hallucination as their generation preferences are insufficiently calibrated to visual evidence, causing them to fall back on linguistic priors, rather than faithful grounding. In this work, we start from an empirical observation: when query-relevant visual evidence is explicitly strengthened using the model's own attention, generation becomes more accurate, suggesting that many failures do not arise solely from missing perception, but from an insufficient tendency to trust the evidence the model has already attended to. Motivated by this finding, we propose Oriented Pickup Preference Optimization (\texttt{OPPO}), an evidence-aware alignment objective that learns preferences over the strength of visual evidence, rather than only response quality. Concretely, \texttt{OPPO} contrasts the same faithful response under stronger, anchored, weaker-evidence views, turning naive visual preference into ordered visual-evidence alignment. We further combine this objective with fine-grained span-level and token-level regularization to stabilize the training. Besides, we provide a theoretical analysis showing that ordered evidence margins induce a positive lower bound on local visual sensitivity. Extensive evaluations across hallucination and general-purpose benchmarks demonstrate that \texttt{OPPO} consistently outperforms baseline methods.

中文摘要翻译: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）容易出现幻觉，因为其生成偏好未能充分校准到视觉证据上，导致模型退而依赖语言先验，而非忠实于视觉信息。在本工作中，我们从一个经验性观察出发：当使用模型自身的注意力显式增强查询相关的视觉证据时，生成变得更加准确，这表明许多失败并非仅仅源于感知缺失，而是模型对已注意到的证据缺乏足够的信任倾向。受此发现启发，我们提出了定向拾取偏好优化（OPPO），一种证据感知的对齐目标，它学习关于视觉证据强度的偏好，而不仅仅是回复质量。具体来说，OPPO在同一忠实回复下对比强证据、锚定证据和弱证据三种视图，将朴素的视觉偏好转化为有序的视觉证据对齐。我们进一步将该目标与细粒度的span级和token级正则化相结合，以稳定训练。此外，我们提供了理论分析，证明有序证据间隔能够诱导局部视觉敏感性的正下界。在幻觉评估和通用基准测试上的广泛评估表明，OPPO一致优于基线方法。

</details>


### [161] [Consistency as Inductive Bias: Learning Cross-View Invariance for Robust Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29812)
*Xin Zou,Haolin Deng,Yibo Yan,Shuliang Liu,Kening Zheng,Zhiwei Jin,Chen Chen,Haonan Lu,Xuming Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ConsistRoll方法，通过在GRPO中引入跨视角一致性约束来改进多模态大语言模型的强化学习训练，在不增加额外生成开销和标注的情况下，显著提升多模态推理能力。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有MLLM在强化学习中缺乏跨视角一致性这一重要归纳偏置，标准RLVR目标仅对每个视觉输入分配点态奖励，即使使用数据增强，变换后的视角也通常独立获得奖励，一旦单视角奖励饱和就无法提供有效信号。

Method: ConsistRoll复用GRPO的组采样机制，将原始视图与语义不变的变换视图放在同一生成组中，仅当配对完成结果既正确又一致时分配联合奖励，从而将一致性转化为在线信用分配信号，无需额外生成开销和标注。

Result: 在数学、通用任务、幻觉等多个领域基准上，ConsistRoll在多模态推理中实现了稳健的性能提升。

Conclusion: 跨视角一致性是有效的归纳偏置，ConsistRoll引入的跨视角修正项能够惩罚视角依赖性并缓解优势崩塌问题，优于传统数据增强方法。

Original Abstract: Inductive biases steer learning toward generalizable solutions by encoding task structure. In this work, we identify a crucial missing bias in MLLMs: cross-view consistency, \textit{i.e.}, semantically invariant views of the same instance should lead to the same answer. Standard reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) objectives do not impose this constraint, but instead assign pointwise rewards to each visual input. Even with data augmentation (DA), transformed views are typically rewarded independently, providing little signal once within-view rewards saturate. We propose \textbf{ConsistRoll}, a simple but effective method that injects cross-view consistency into RLVR training by reusing the group-sampling mechanism of GRPO. Specifically, ConsistRoll places original and semantically invariant transformed views in the same generation group, and assigns a joint reward only when paired completions are both correct and consistent. In this way, ConsistRoll turns consistency into an online credit-assignment signal, \textbf{without extra generation overhead and annotations}. Theoretically, we show that cross-view consistency is a valid inductive bias, and ConsistRoll introduces a cross-view correction term absent from DA, penalizing view dependence and alleviating advantage collapse. Comprehensive benchmarks across math, general-purpose, hallucination domains confirm that ConsistRoll achieves robust improvements in multimodal reasoning.

中文摘要翻译: 归纳偏置通过编码任务结构引导学习走向可泛化的解。在这项工作中，我们识别出多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中一个关键缺失的偏置：跨视角一致性，即同一实例的语义不变视角应得出相同的答案。标准可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）目标并未施加这一约束，而是为每个视觉输入分配点态奖励。即使使用数据增强（DA），变换后的视角通常独立获得奖励，一旦单视角奖励饱和就几乎无法提供信号。我们提出ConsistRoll，一种简单但有效的方法，通过复用GRPO的组采样机制将跨视角一致性注入RLVR训练。具体而言，ConsistRoll将原始视图和语义不变的变换视图放在同一生成组中，仅当配对完成结果既正确又一致时分配联合奖励。通过这种方式，ConsistRoll将一致性转化为在线信用分配信号，无需额外生成开销和标注。理论上，我们证明了跨视角一致性是一个有效的归纳偏置，并且ConsistRoll引入了数据增强所缺乏的跨视角修正项，惩罚视角依赖性并缓解优势崩塌。在数学、通用任务、幻觉等多个领域基准上的全面评估证实，ConsistRoll在多模态推理中实现了稳健的性能提升。

</details>


### [162] [Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Image: Advancing Masked Discrete Diffusion for High-Resolution Image Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29814)
*Shufan Li,Greg Heinrich,Hanrong Ye,Yonggan Fu,Aditya Grover,Jan Kautz,Pavlo Molchanov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Image的掩码离散扩散模型（MDM），通过令牌编辑机制和分组交叉熵（GCE）损失函数，解决了标准MDM缺乏自校正能力和大词汇量下训练信号稀疏两个关键问题，在GenEval、DPG和HPSv3上取得了领先性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有掩码离散扩散模型存在两个关键挑战：一是标准MDM缺乏自校正能力，离散令牌一旦被解掩码就无法修改；二是增大离散图像分词器词汇量虽能提升重建保真度，但会导致生成建模的优化困难，因为每个令牌的训练信号变得稀疏。

Method: 提出了两种创新：1）令牌编辑机制，允许模型在推理过程中动态修正已解掩码的令牌；2）分组交叉熵（GCE）目标函数，为嵌入空间中邻近真实令牌的令牌分配正学习信号，缓解信号稀疏问题；同时实现了GCE的自定义融合算子以降低大词汇量下的显存占用。

Result: 在GenEval上达到0.90，DPG上达到86.9，HPSv3上达到10.76，显著提升了掩码离散图像生成器的训练效率和图像保真度。

Conclusion: 所提出的令牌编辑机制和GCE损失函数有效克服了掩码离散扩散模型的两大核心瓶颈，在提升训练效率的同时大幅改善了图像生成质量，达到了最先进的水平。

Original Abstract: We propose Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Image, a state-of-the-art masked discrete diffusion model (MDM) for high-resolution text-to-image synthesis. Compared with prior work on masked image generation, Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Image addresses two key challenges. First, unlike continuous diffusion models which progressively refine latent representations across the entire image, standard MDMs lack self-correcting capability because discrete tokens cannot be modified once they are unmasked. Second, although increasing the vocabulary size of discrete image tokenizers improves reconstruction fidelity, it introduces optimization difficulties for generative modeling as the per-token training signal becomes increasingly sparse. To address the first challenge, Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Image incorporates a token-editing mechanism that enables the model to dynamically revise already-unmasked tokens during inference, similar to how a sculptor iteratively refines their work. To tackle the second challenge, we propose a Grouped Cross-Entropy (GCE) objective that assigns positive learning signals to tokens neighboring the ground truth in embedding space, thereby alleviating signal sparsity. To further improve training efficiency, we implement a custom fused operator for GCE that significantly reduces VRAM usage in large-vocabulary settings. Experimental results demonstrate that these innovations substantially improve both training efficiency and image fidelity of masked discrete image generators, achieving a score of 0.90 on GenEval, 86.9 on DPG and 10.76 of HPSv3.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Image，一种用于高分辨率文本到图像合成的最先进掩码离散扩散模型（Masked Discrete Diffusion Model, MDM）。与先前在掩码图像生成方面的工作相比，Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Image解决了两个关键挑战。首先，与在整个图像上逐步细化潜在表征的连续扩散模型不同，标准的MDM缺乏自校正能力，因为离散令牌一旦被解掩码就无法修改。其次，尽管增大离散图像分词器的词汇量可以提升重建保真度，但它会给生成建模带来优化困难，因为每个令牌的训练信号变得愈发稀疏。为了解决第一个挑战，Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Image引入了一种令牌编辑机制，使模型能够在推理过程中动态修正已解掩码的令牌，类似于雕塑家反复雕琢其作品的过程。为解决第二个挑战，我们提出了一种分组交叉熵（Grouped Cross-Entropy, GCE）目标函数，该函数为嵌入空间中邻近真实令牌的令牌分配正学习信号，从而缓解信号稀疏问题。为了进一步提升训练效率，我们为GCE实现了一个自定义融合算子，显著减少了在大词汇量设置下的显存占用。实验结果表明，这些创新显著提升了掩码离散图像生成器的训练效率和图像保真度，在GenEval上达到0.90，DPG上达到86.9，HPSv3上达到10.76。

</details>


### [163] [Learning Cross-view Correspondences for Geo-localization on Planetary Surfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29821)
*Hong Minh Nguyen,Marcus Märtens,Tat-Jun Chin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向行星表面探索的跨视角地理定位基准数据集，该数据集基于高分辨率月球地形模型，包含10438个360°地表全景图与对应的天顶图像，并研究了基于Transformer的定位方法在行星表面场景中的应用效果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 行星表面探测中，卫星定位系统不可用且车载里程计随时间漂移，而轨道测绘产品（如天顶图像和地形图）与地面观测图像之间存在视角差异大、纹理稀少、地形重复以及光照变化剧烈等挑战，亟需一种基于视觉的跨视角地理定位方法作为GNSS的替代方案。

Method: 构建了一个基于物理渲染的跨视角地理定位基准数据集，包含从高分辨率月球地形模型中渲染的10438个360°地表全景图以及精确对应的天顶图像；同时提供重叠瓦片以研究非中心定位。使用基于Transformer的先进地理定位方法从头训练并评估检索准确率。

Result: 实验表明基于学习的跨视角定位方法能够成功应用于行星表面领域，在月球地形数据集上取得了良好的检索准确率。

Conclusion: 基于学习的跨视角地理定位方法可以作为全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）的视觉替代方案，有效应用于行星表面探测中的全局位置感知任务。

Original Abstract: Maintaining global position awareness is a fundamental challenge for planetary surface exploration, since satellite-based positioning systems are unavailable and onboard odometry drifts over time. Although orbital mapping products, such as overhead imagery and terrain-derived maps, provide global context, aligning them with surface observations is challenging due to large viewpoint differences, low texture, repetitive terrain, and drastic changes in appearance caused by varying illumination and topography. We introduce a new cross-view geo-localization benchmark built from physically rendered surface panoramas and overhead tiles derived from a high-resolution lunar terrain model. Our dataset contains 10438 ground views rendered as 360$^\circ$ surface panoramas with matching overhead images precisely centered at the same location. Additionally, a set of overlapping tiles is provided to study off-center localization with multiple plausible candidates per panorama. We study the performance of a state-of-the-art transformer-based geo-localization method on our data, by training it from scratch and reporting retrieval accuracy. Our results demonstrate that learning-based cross-view localization methods can be successfully applied to the domain of planetary surfaces, providing a vision-based alternative to global navigation satellite systems.

中文摘要翻译: 维持全局位置感知是行星表面探测的一个基本挑战，因为基于卫星的定位系统不可用且车载里程计随时间漂移。尽管轨道测绘产品（如天顶图像和地形派生地图）提供了全局上下文，但由于巨大的视角差异、纹理稀少、地形重复以及由变化的光照和地形引起的剧烈外观变化，将它们与地面观测对齐仍具挑战性。我们引入了一个新的跨视角地理定位基准数据集，该数据集基于物理渲染的地表全景图和源自高分辨率月球地形模型的天顶瓦片构建。我们的数据集包含10438个地面视图，渲染为360°地表全景图，并配有精确位于同一位置的匹配天顶图像。此外，还提供了一组重叠瓦片，用于研究每个全景图存在多个合理候选位置的非中心定位。我们在数据上研究了一种基于Transformer的最先进地理定位方法的性能，通过从头训练并报告检索准确率。我们的结果表明，基于学习的跨视角定位方法可以成功应用于行星表面领域，为全球导航卫星系统提供了一种基于视觉的替代方案。

</details>


### [164] [HomeDiffusion: Zero-Shot Object Customization with Multi-View Representation Learning for Indoor Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29828)
*Guoqiu Li,Jin Song,Yiyun Fei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出HomeDiffusion，一种基于扩散模型的零样本物体定制生成方法，通过利用参考物体的多视角图像，在背景场景的指定区域生成视觉和谐且细节保真的物体。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有零样本物体定制生成方法存在两个主要问题：1）生成物体在图案、曲线等细节上与参考物体存在显著偏差；2）对于非对称参考物体，缺乏全面的多视角信息导致无法生成与背景场景协调的物体姿态。

Method: 1）构建了包含家具多角度图像和室内场景的新数据集；2）基于扩散模型提出HomeDiffusion，利用参考物体的多视角图像在背景场景指定区域生成视觉和谐的物体姿态；3）在扩散过程中提取参考物体的高保真细节，并在潜在空间与噪声潜变量进行交叉注意力计算，确保定制物体生成的细节保持。

Result: 大量定性和定量实验表明，该方法在性能上优于其他现有的零样本和少样本物体定制方法。

Conclusion: HomeDiffusion通过引入多视角信息和高保真细节提取与交叉注意力机制，有效解决了现有零样本物体定制生成中细节偏差和姿态不协调的问题。

Original Abstract: Recently, zero-shot object customization generation methods have rapidly developed and shown tremendous potential for applications. For instance, in the e-commerce domain, consumers can observe the visual effect of furniture placed within their personal living spaces or clothes worn on their own bodies. Many existing approaches perform object customization generation based on diffusion models and extracted reference object features. However, the generated object significantly diverges from the original reference object in details such as patterns and curves. Particularly for asymmetrical reference objects, the absence of comprehensive multi-viewpoint information prevents the generation of object poses that harmonize with the background scene. To address these shortcomings, we have constructed a novel dataset comprising multi-angle images of furniture and indoor scenes. Based on diffusion models, we introduce HomeDiffusion, which can leverage multi-viewpoint images of the same reference object to accurately generate visually harmonious object poses within specified areas of the background scene. During the diffusion process, we further extract high-fidelity details of the reference object and perform cross-attention with the noise latents in the latent space, thereby ensuring the preservation of details in the customized object generation. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance over other existing zero-shot as well as few-shot object customization approaches.

中文摘要翻译: 近年来，零样本物体定制生成方法迅速发展并展现出巨大的应用潜力。例如，在电子商务领域，消费者可以观察到家具放置在其个人生活空间或衣服穿在自己身上的视觉效果。现有许多方法基于扩散模型和提取的参考物体特征进行物体定制生成。然而，生成的物体在图案、曲线等细节上与原始参考物体存在显著偏差。特别是对于非对称参考物体，缺乏全面的多视角信息导致无法生成与背景场景协调的物体姿态。为解决这些不足，我们构建了一个包含家具多角度图像和室内场景的新数据集。基于扩散模型，我们提出了HomeDiffusion，该方法能够利用同一参考物体的多视角图像，在背景场景的指定区域内准确生成视觉和谐的物体姿态。在扩散过程中，我们进一步提取参考物体的高保真细节，并在潜在空间中与噪声潜变量进行交叉注意力计算，从而确保定制物体生成中的细节保持。大量定性和定量实验表明，我们的方法在性能上优于其他现有的零样本和少样本物体定制方法。

</details>


### [165] [Robust Trajectory Distillation: Hybrid Reweighting Meets Teacher-Inspired Targets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29837)
*Kaifeng Chen,Lechao Cheng,Jiyang Li,Shengeng Tang,Fan Zhang,Yantao Pan,Yaxiong Wang,Tuanrui Hui,Zhun Zhong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于轨迹的数据集蒸馏框架，通过选择性引导重加权（SGR）和教师启发辅助目标（TIAT）两个组件，在噪声监督下同时抑制噪声并保留可迁移知识，无需重新标注或干净子集，显著提升了蒸馏数据集的鲁棒性和表示质量。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统数据集蒸馏在噪声标注下会将错误关联与有用信号一同压缩，导致鲁棒性下降；而现有噪声标签处理方法（如样本选择、损失加权、标签校正）紧密耦合噪声估计与模型优化，依赖干净锚点，且可能放大确认偏差，与数据集蒸馏追求紧凑、即插即用监督的目标不匹配。

Method: 提出轨迹驱动的数据集蒸馏框架，包含两个互补组件：(1) 选择性引导重加权（SGR），融合全局遗忘模式（二次分裂遗忘）和局部邻域一致性，沿教师轨迹逐步优先选择干净监督；(2) 教师启发辅助目标（TIAT），从教师中间动态中蒸馏辅助残差信号，增强信息性信号同时保持内部一致性。

Result: 在对称噪声、非对称噪声和真实世界噪声场景下，该方法相较于现有最先进的数据集蒸馏基线均取得了一致的性能提升，且框架具有鲁棒性、标签保持性、计算轻量化和广泛适用性。

Conclusion: SGR和TIAT共同在噪声监督下生成更干净、更丰富的蒸馏数据集表示，且无需重新标注或干净子集，是一种有效的噪声鲁棒数据集蒸馏方案。

Original Abstract: Dataset distillation (DD) condenses large corpora into compact, information-rich subsets for efficient training and reuse. However, under noisy supervision, DD risks condensing corrupted associations together with useful signals, degrading robustness. Conventional noisy-label remedies (sample selection, loss weighting, label correction) tightly couple noise estimation with model optimization, often require clean anchors, and can amplify confirmation bias-assumptions that are misaligned with DD's goal of compact, plug-and-play supervision. We therefore propose a trajectory-based DD framework that jointly suppresses noise and preserves transferable knowledge without relabeling or clean subsets. It comprises two complementary components: Selective Guidance Reweighting (SGR), which fuses global forgetting patterns (second-split forgetting) with local neighborhood consistency into a progressive reweighting scheme that prioritizes clean supervision along the teacher trajectory; and Teacher-Inspired Auxiliary Targets (TIAT), which inject auxiliary residual guidance distilled from intermediate teacher dynamics to reinforce informative signals while remaining internally consistent. Together, SGR and TIAT produce distilled datasets with cleaner and richer representations under noisy supervision. The framework is robust, label-preserving, computationally lightweight, and broadly applicable, yielding consistent gains over state-of-the-art DD baselines across symmetric, asymmetric, and real-world noise.

中文摘要翻译: 数据集蒸馏（DD）将大规模语料库压缩为紧凑且信息丰富的子集，以实现高效训练和复用。然而，在噪声监督下，数据集蒸馏存在将错误关联与有用信号一同压缩的风险，从而降低鲁棒性。传统的噪声标签处理方法（如样本选择、损失加权、标签校正）将噪声估计与模型优化紧密耦合，通常需要干净锚点，并可能放大确认偏差——这些假设与数据集蒸馏追求紧凑、即插即用监督的目标不一致。为此，我们提出了一种基于轨迹的数据集蒸馏框架，该框架在无需重新标注或干净子集的情况下，同时抑制噪声并保留可迁移知识。该框架包含两个互补组件：选择性引导重加权（SGR），它将全局遗忘模式（二次分裂遗忘）与局部邻域一致性融合为渐进重加权方案，沿教师轨迹优先选择干净监督；以及教师启发辅助目标（TIAT），它从教师中间动态中蒸馏出辅助残差指导，增强信息性信号同时保持内部一致性。SGR和TIAT共同在噪声监督下生成更干净、更丰富的蒸馏数据集表示。该框架具有鲁棒性、标签保持性、计算轻量化和广泛适用性，在对称噪声、非对称噪声和真实世界噪声场景下均比现有最先进的数据集蒸馏基线取得了一致的性能提升。

</details>


### [166] [Bricker to BRACE: A Bracket Exposure RAW Dataset and Restoration Model for Flicker-Banding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29845)
*Zihan Zhou,Libo Zhu,Jue Gong,Zhiyi Zhou,Jiezhang Cao,Yong Guo,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对卷帘快门与显示亮度调制之间的时间混叠导致的闪烁条纹（FB）问题，通过系统分析其复杂形态，提出了一种多帧包围式RAW图像恢复范式。构建了合成-真实包围式RAW数据集Bricker，并提出了BRACE模型，利用频率感知带状先验和多尺度空间交叉注意力调制器（MSCAM）实现跨曝光空间融合，同时引入条纹频率一致性（SFC）指标评估去条纹效果，在合成和真实基准上均达到SOTA性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有单帧方法使用简化的参数化条纹模型，无法可靠区分闪烁条纹伪影与真实纹理。本文通过系统分析发现闪烁条纹形态随曝光设置变化显著，因此需要多帧包围式RAW恢复方案来解决问题。

Method: 构建Bricker数据集（基于光线追踪物理模拟和自动多曝光采集工具）；提出BRACE模型，包含频率感知带状先验和多尺度空间交叉注意力调制器（MSCAM）用于跨曝光空间融合；引入条纹频率一致性（SFC）指标评估去条纹效果。

Result: 在合成和真实基准上均取得了最先进的性能（SOTA）。

Conclusion: 多帧包围式RAW恢复范式能有效解决闪烁条纹伪影问题，BRACE模型和Bricker数据集为相关研究提供了新的基准和方法。

Original Abstract: Flicker-banding (FB), arises from temporal aliasing between a camera's rolling shutter and a display's brightness modulation, degrading screen-captured image readability with color shifts and jagged patterns. Existing single-frame methods with simplified parametric stripe models cannot reliably distinguish these artifacts from genuine texture. To address this, we conduct a systematic analysis of complex FB morphologies and reveal their significant variation across exposure settings, motivating a multi-frame bracketed RAW restoration paradigm. We construct Bricker, a synthetic-real bracketed RAW dataset built via ray-tracing-based physical simulation and automated multi-exposure capture tool. We further propose BRACE: Bracketed RAW Flicker-Banding Removal, a multi-frame restoration model that utilizes frequency-aware banding prior and a multi-scale spatial cross-attention modulator (MSCAM) for cross-exposure spatial fusion. We also introduce the Stripe Frequency Consistency (SFC) metric to evaluate banding removal. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real benchmarks. Our dataset and code are available at: https://github.com/ZZH-qwq/BRACE.

中文摘要翻译: 闪烁条纹（Flicker-banding, FB）源于卷帘快门与显示亮度调制之间的时间混叠，会导致屏幕拍摄图像出现色彩偏移和锯齿状图案，降低可读性。现有的基于简化参数化条纹模型的单帧方法无法可靠地区分这些伪影与真实纹理。为解决此问题，我们对复杂的FB形态进行了系统分析，揭示了其在曝光设置下的显著变化，从而提出了一种多帧包围式RAW恢复范式。我们构建了Bricker，一个通过基于光线追踪的物理模拟和自动化多曝光采集工具构建的合成-真实包围式RAW数据集。进一步提出了BRACE（Bracketed RAW Flicker-Banding Removal），一个多帧恢复模型，利用频率感知带状先验和多尺度空间交叉注意力调制器（MSCAM）进行跨曝光空间融合。我们还引入了条纹频率一致性（SFC）指标来评估去条纹效果。实验表明，该方法在合成和真实基准上均取得了最先进的性能。我们的数据集和代码已开源：https://github.com/ZZH-qwq/BRACE。

</details>


### [167] [See Only When Needed: Context-Aware Attention Intervention for Mitigating Hallucinations in LVLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29847)
*Yuqing Lei,Wenbo Lyu,Yingjun Du,Xiantong Zhen,Cees G. M. Snoek,Ling Shao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种训练无关的推理时注意力干预方法CAI，通过两轴选择性（看哪里、何时干预）在解码中仅对不确定令牌进行细粒度视觉注意力调整，在不损失流畅性的前提下有效缓解LVLM的物体幻觉问题，达到SOTA效果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有训练无关的缓解幻觉方法通常均匀增强视觉信号，这会放大无关区域并引入虚假证据，损害生成流畅性。需要一种更精细的、上下文感知的干预策略，在需要时才增强视觉信息。

Method: CAI采用两轴选择性机制：(1) 从早期层表示中提取令牌特定的视觉相关性，定位语义对齐区域；(2) 仅在深层解码中不确定性突增的令牌上，应用基于熵和深度的门控注意力倾斜，对置信令牌和无关区域保持不变。对比解码作为可选的辅助偏差抑制模块。

Result: 在多个LVLM主干和基准上达到最先进的幻觉缓解效果。分析表明CAI是一种KL散度最小化的注意力重加权方法，在门控未激活或倾斜较小时干预有界。

Conclusion: CAI通过上下文感知的细粒度注意力干预，在有效缓解物体幻觉的同时保持了语言流畅性，且无需训练即可推广到不同LVLM模型。

Original Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) excel at multimodal tasks but remain prone to object hallucinations. Prior training-free remedies often uniformly strengthen visual signals, which may also amplify irrelevant regions and introduce spurious evidence, harming fluency. We propose Context-aware Attention Intervention (CAI), a training-free inference-time mechanism that enforces a see only when needed principle via two-axis selectivity: where to look and when to intervene. At each decoding step, CAI derives token-specific visual relevance from early-layer representations to localize semantically aligned regions, and applies a conservative, entropy- and depth-gated attention tilt only for uncertainty-spiking tokens in deeper layers where visual grounding degrades, leaving confident tokens and irrelevant regions largely unchanged. This targeted intervention strengthens visual grounding while preserving linguistic fluency, and it yields consistent improvements even without contrastive decoding, which remains optional as an auxiliary bias-suppression module. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLM backbones and benchmarks show that CAI achieves state-of-the-art hallucination mitigation, and our analysis characterizes CAI as a KL-minimal attention reweighting with bounded interference under inactive gates or small tilts. Code is available at https://github.com/Iris1946/CAI.

中文摘要翻译: 大型视觉-语言模型在多模态任务中表现出色，但仍容易出现物体幻觉。先前的训练无关缓解方法通常均匀增强视觉信号，这也会放大无关区域并引入虚假证据，损害流畅性。我们提出上下文感知的注意力干预（CAI），一种训练无关的推理时机制，通过两轴选择性——看哪里和何时干预——来强制执行"仅在需要时观看"的原则。在每个解码步骤中，CAI从早期层表示中提取令牌特定的视觉相关性以定位语义对齐的区域，并对仅在深层（视觉基础退化）中不确定性突增的令牌应用保守的、基于熵和深度门控的注意力倾斜，而对置信令牌和无关区域基本保持不变。这种针对性的干预在保留语言流畅性的同时增强了视觉基础，并且即使没有对比解码（作为可选的辅助偏差抑制模块）也能产生一致的改进。在多个LVLM主干和基准上的大量实验表明，CAI达到了最先进的幻觉缓解效果，我们的分析将CAI刻画为一种在门控未激活或倾斜较小时具有有界干扰的KL最小化注意力重加权。代码已开源：https://github.com/Iris1946/CAI。

</details>


### [168] [Efficient Visual Pointing for Embodied AI:Agent-Driven Data Synthesis, Cross-Block Attention, and Iterative Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29850)
*Zijian Hong,Qi Lv,Yuxiang Xie,Jianming Xing,Xiang Deng,Weili Guan,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了PointArena 2026的解决方案，通过三类改进（智能体驱动合成、确定性数据管道、模型端模块）实现77.2%准确率，在基准测试中排名第二。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 针对视觉指代定位（visual pointing）中存在的三个主要失效模式，提出系统性解决方案以提升模型在语义锚点生成、数据质量控制和坐标定位等方面的性能。

Method: 1) 智能体驱动合成构建大规模语义和锚点相对候选池（涵盖55,372个处理输出）；2) 确定性可引导数据管道通过掩码、模板和路径验证生成10,000样本主集；3) 两个模型端模块：AttnRes添加门控跨块注意力提升可引导性，ABC校正将扰动坐标与视觉特征编码用于通用坐标定位；类别感知路由组合互补专家模型。

Result: 整体准确率77.2%，基准排名第二。各类别准确率：可执行性93.9%，空间关系82.6%，推理78.2%，计数70.4%，可引导性63.0%。

Conclusion: 通过智能体驱动数据合成、确定性数据管道和模型端注意力校正模块的组合策略，有效解决了视觉指代定位中的多种失效模式，验证了该方法在复杂指令理解与坐标映射任务中的有效性。

Original Abstract: Visual pointing maps a language instruction to pixel co ordinates, a core skill for embodied AI. We describe our PointArena 2026 solution, which achieves 77.2% overall accuracy and ranks second on the benchmark. The ap proach targets three failure modes. First, agent-driven syn thesis builds large semantic and anchor-relative candidate pools; the server inventory contains 55,372 processed out puts, 53,772 de-duplicated sample IDs, and 37,574 train able completed or accepted rows. Second, a determinis tic steerable-data pipeline creates a verified 10,000-sample main set, plus reserve samples, using masks, templates, and path verification. Third, two model-side modules address complementary errors: AttnRes adds gated cross-block at tention for steerability, while ABC correction encodes per turbed coordinates with visual features for general coordi nate grounding. Category-aware routing combines comple mentary specialists; local validation used to select experts records 93.9% Affordance, 82.6% Spatial Relation, 78.2% Reasoning, 70.4% Counting, and 63.0% Steerability.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉指代定位将语言指令映射到像素坐标，是具身智能的核心技能。本文介绍了PointArena 2026的解决方案，实现了77.2%的整体准确率并在基准测试中排名第二。该方法针对三种失效模式：首先，智能体驱动合成构建了大规模语义和锚点相对候选池；服务器库存包含55,372个处理输出、53,772个去重样本ID以及37,574个可训练已完成或已接受行。其次，确定性可引导数据管道通过掩码、模板和路径验证，创建了包含10,000个样本的已验证主集及备用样本。第三，两个模型端模块处理互补错误：AttnRes添加门控跨块注意力以实现可引导性，而ABC校正将扰动坐标与视觉特征编码用于通用坐标定位。类别感知路由组合互补专家模型；通过局部验证选择专家，记录了可执行性93.9%、空间关系82.6%、推理78.2%、计数70.4%和可引导性63.0%的准确率。

</details>


### [169] [RainODE: Continuous-Time Precipitation Forecasting with Latent Neural ODEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29855)
*Yeeun Seong,Doyi Kim,Minseok Seo,Changick Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RainODE将降水预报重新建模为连续时间动力系统，利用神经ODE在潜空间中建模演化，结合布朗桥随机源模块处理非平流变化，实现任意时间分辨率的高精度降水预测。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统降水预报在提高时间分辨率时受限于观测条件和密集离散建模的计算成本，亟需一种能实现连续时间推断且保持预测清晰度的新方法。

Method: 提出RainODE框架，将降水预报建模为连续时间动力系统，使用神经ODE在潜空间中建模导数一致的时间动力学以捕获大尺度平流运动；同时引入基于布朗桥的随机源建模模块，细化残余强度变化并恢复精细结构，实现确定性连续动力学与随机细化的结合。

Result: 在SEVIR和新提出的RAPID数据集上，RainODE在多个时间间隔和降水类型上均取得一致提升。

Conclusion: RainODE通过确定性连续动力学与随机细化的结合，实现了任意时间推断并保持预测清晰度，有效克服了传统方法在时间分辨率上的局限性。

Original Abstract: In precipitation forecasting, not only accuracy but also temporal resolution is critical. However, increasing temporal resolution is constrained by observational limitations and the computational cost of dense discrete modeling. To overcome this limitation, we reformulate precipitation forecasting as a continuous-time dynamical system and propose RainODE, a framework that models precipitation evolution in latent space using a Neural ODE. This formulation enables derivative-consistent temporal dynamics and captures the dominant large-scale advective motion of precipitation systems. Nevertheless, a purely deterministic ODE struggles to represent non-advective intensity changes such as localized growth, decay, and sub-grid variability, often leading to over-smoothed predictions. To address this issue, we introduce a stochastic source modeling module based on a Brownian Bridge formulation, which refines residual intensity variations and restores fine-grained structures while preserving advective consistency. By combining deterministic continuous dynamics with stochastic refinement, RainODE enables arbitrary-time inference while maintaining sharp predictions. Experiments on SEVIR and the newly introduced Radar-based Precipitation Integrated Dataset (RAPID) demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple temporal intervals and precipitation regimes. The code is available at https://github.com/SeongYE/RainODE.

中文摘要翻译: 在降水预报中，不仅准确性至关重要，时间分辨率同样关键。然而，提高时间分辨率受到观测限制和稠密离散建模计算成本的制约。为解决这一局限性，我们将降水预报重新建模为连续时间动力系统，并提出RainODE框架，该框架利用神经ODE在潜空间中建模降水演化。这一公式能够实现导数一致的时间动力学，并捕获降水系统的主要大尺度平流运动。然而，纯粹的确定性ODE难以表示非平流强度变化（如局地增长、衰减和次网格变异性），常常导致预测过于平滑。为解决这一问题，我们引入了一个基于布朗桥公式的随机源建模模块，该模块在保持平流一致性的同时，细化残余强度变化并恢复精细结构。通过将确定性连续动力学与随机细化相结合，RainODE能够在保持预测清晰度的同时实现任意时间推断。在SEVIR和新引入的基于雷达的降水集成数据集（RAPID）上的实验表明，RainODE在多个时间间隔和降水类型上均取得了一致的改进。代码已在https://github.com/SeongYE/RainODE 开源。

</details>


### [170] [SUMO: Segment and Track Any Motion with Nonlinear State Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29861)
*Kexin Tian,Sixu Li,Keshu Wu,Yang Zhou,Zhengzhong Tu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SUMO，一个零样本、无需训练的视觉跟踪与运动分割统一框架，通过非线性状态空间模型和选择性无迹卡尔曼滤波实现高精度目标状态估计。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有视觉目标跟踪（VOT）和运动目标分割（MOS）方法过度依赖视觉线索，在复杂非线性运动场景下表现不佳，缺乏融合非线性动力学与视觉分割的统一方案。

Method: 1) 提出非线性状态空间模型（SSM）捕获复杂目标动力学；2) 设计选择性无迹卡尔曼滤波（SUF）进行状态估计，包含联合评分机制和动态融合多源预测；3) 采用记忆选择机制评估记忆帧的可靠性。

Result: 在VOT和MOS两项任务上均达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: SUMO通过融合非线性动力学与视觉分割，实现了零样本、无需训练的跨任务统一框架，有效解决了复杂运动场景下的跟踪与分割难题。

Original Abstract: Visual Object Tracking (VOT) and Moving Object Segmentation (MOS) are two fundamental tasks in computer vision that involve both spatial and temporal object dynamics. Existing methods rely predominantly on visual cues and thus often falter in real-world scenarios where object motions are inherently complex and nonlinear. To address this limitation, we propose SUMO, a zero-shot, training-free, unified framework integrating nonlinear dynamics with vision-based segmentation for accurate and consistent VOT and MOS. Specifically, we develop a nonlinear State Space Model (SSM) inspired by robotics principles to capture the complex object dynamics. Building on this model, we propose a Selective Unscented Filter (SUF) for accurate state estimation, which features a joint scoring mechanism and dynamically fuses multi-source predictions to identify the most plausible object state over time. Furthermore, we apply a memory selection mechanism to evaluate the reliability of memory frames. Our extensive experimental results show that SUMO achieves state-of-the-art performance on both VOT and MOS tasks.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉目标跟踪（VOT）和运动目标分割（MOS）是计算机视觉中涉及空间与时间目标动态的两个基本任务。现有方法主要依赖视觉线索，因此在目标运动本质上复杂且非线性现实场景中常常表现不佳。为解决这一局限性，我们提出SUMO——一个零样本、无需训练的统一框架，将非线性动力学与基于视觉的分割相结合，以实现准确且一致的VOT和MOS。具体而言，我们受机器人学原理启发，开发了一个非线性状态空间模型（SSM）来捕获复杂的目标动态。在此模型基础上，我们提出了一种选择性无迹卡尔曼滤波（SUF）用于精确状态估计，该滤波具有联合评分机制，并能够动态融合多源预测以识别随时间变化最可能的目标状态。此外，我们应用了记忆选择机制来评估记忆帧的可靠性。我们的大量实验结果表明，SUMO在VOT和MOS两项任务上均达到了最先进的性能。

</details>


### [171] [LWDrive: Layer-Wise World-Model-Guided Vision-Language Model Planning for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29879)
*Chen Yang,Yuhao Wei,Ze Xu,Ziheng Zou,Shuang Liang,Delin Ouyang,Lingfeng Qi,Jie Li,Guofa Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LWDrive是一个端到端自动驾驶规划框架，通过层级世界模型引导，将VLM生成的粗略轨迹逐步细化为几何精确、多视图感知的未来轨迹，在NAVSIM基准上达到92.0分。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: VLM直接生成的轨迹仅编码粗略的驾驶意图，缺乏几何精确性、未来感知能力和多视图接地规划能力，不足以支持端到端自动驾驶规划。

Method: 提出LWDrive框架：1) 将VLM输出作为意图感知的粗略轨迹，扩展候选空间；2) 引入未来帧生成监督，使VLM学习前向场景表征；3) 设计Foresight Cascade Planner (FCP)，利用多层VLM特征、历史时序状态、Action-Query表示和当前帧多视图BEV特征，从粗到细逐步精炼候选轨迹；4) 评分头评估精炼后的候选轨迹，选出最优轨迹。

Result: 在NAVSIM基准上达到92.0分，在NAVSIM-v2上达到89.6分。

Conclusion: LWDrive通过层级世界模型引导和从粗到细的精炼策略，有效弥合了VLM粗略意图与精确轨迹规划之间的鸿沟，显著提升了端到端自动驾驶规划性能。

Original Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide powerful semantic understanding and commonsense reasoning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving (E2E-AD) planning. However, trajectories directly generated by VLMs often encode only coarse driving intentions and remain insufficient for geometrically accurate, future-aware, and multi-view-grounded planning. To address these limitations, we develop the Layer-Wise World-Model-Guided Driving framework (LWDrive). LWDrive is a VLM planning framework that refines coarse trajectories through layer-wise world-model guidance. Instead of treating the VLM output as the final trajectory, LWDrive uses it as an intent-aware coarse plan, expands a diverse candidate space around it, and progressively refines the candidates through a Foresight Cascade Planner (FCP). Specifically, we introduce future-frame generation supervision to encourage the VLM to learn forward-looking scene representations, thereby injecting planning-relevant predictive dynamics into its internal hidden states. Built upon these world-model-supervised representations, FCP exploits VLM features across multiple layers and integrates historical temporal states, Action-Query representations, and current-frame multi-view Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) features to refine candidate trajectories in a coarse-to-fine manner. This design enables progressive correction of spatial positions and motion trends while grounding trajectory refinement with multi-view scene cues and preserving the high-level driving intention produced by the large model. Finally, a score head evaluates the refined candidates and selects the best trajectory as the final planning output. Experiments show that LWDrive achieves a score of 92.0 on the NAVSIM benchmark and 89.6 on NAVSIM-v2. Code and models will be made publicly available.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）为端到端自动驾驶（E2E-AD）规划提供了强大的语义理解和常识推理能力。然而，由VLM直接生成的轨迹通常仅编码了粗略的驾驶意图，不足以实现几何精确、具备未来感知且多视图接地的规划。为解决这些局限，我们提出了层级世界模型引导的驾驶框架（LWDrive）。LWDrive是一个VLM规划框架，通过层级世界模型引导来精炼粗略轨迹。LWDrive不将VLM输出视为最终轨迹，而是将其作为意图感知的粗略规划，围绕其扩展多样化的候选空间，并通过前瞻级联规划器（FCP）逐步精炼候选轨迹。具体而言，我们引入未来帧生成监督，促使VLM学习前向的场景表征，从而将规划相关的预测动态注入其内部隐藏状态。基于这些世界模型监督的表征，FCP利用多层VLM特征，并融合历史时序状态、动作查询表示以及当前帧多视图鸟瞰视角（BEV）特征，以从粗到细的方式精炼候选轨迹。该设计在保持大模型产生的高层驾驶意图的同时，能够逐步修正空间位置和运动趋势，并将轨迹精炼与多视角场景线索相接地。最后，评分头评估精炼后的候选轨迹，并选择最优轨迹作为最终的规划输出。实验表明，LWDrive在NAVSIM基准上达到92.0分，在NAVSIM-v2上达到89.6分。代码和模型将公开发布。

</details>


### [172] [IREU: Identity-Related Encoder-Only Unlearning for Customized Portrait Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29880)
*Chaoyi Shi,Shanshan Zhang,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对定制化肖像生成（CPG）技术带来的隐私风险，首次研究身份遗忘（identity unlearning）问题，提出一种名为IREU的方法，通过离线定位身份相关特征并仅对其进行扰动，在遗忘目标身份的同时保持其他身份生成 fidelity，且学到的遗忘编码器可跨不同生成器泛化。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有CPG技术可根据输入身份图像生成高质量人物图像，但存在传播虚假视觉信息的隐私风险。为应对这一风险，每个公开生成器在接到请求时应能抑制对特定人物的生成能力，因此需要研究身份遗忘问题。

Method: 提出IREU方法：首先离线定位与身份相关的特征区域，然后仅对这些特征进行扰动。具体而言，更新图像编码器时，最小化目标遗忘身份在生成图像与输入图像之间的身份相似度，同时最大化保留身份的身份相似度，从而避免全局扰动损害其他身份的生成 fidelity。

Result: 实验结果表明，IREU在对目标遗忘身份实现更好遗忘效果的同时，对保留身份保持了高 fidelity；且遗忘后的图像编码器无需微调即可在不同生成器上泛化，便于实际部署。

Conclusion: 本文首次提出CPG领域的身份遗忘方法IREU，通过精准定位并扰动身份相关特征，在遗忘与保留之间取得良好平衡，且具有良好的跨生成器泛化能力，为隐私保护提供了有效方案。

Original Abstract: Customized Portrait Generation (CPG) technologies have been widely used to generate high-fidelity person images given an input image indicating the identity and a text prompt indicating the required edits. Yet these methods pose significant privacy risks by spreading fake visual information. Against such risks, each public generator should be able to suppress its generation ability for a particular person when requested. Therefore, in this work we investigate the identity unlearning problem for CPG. Since there are no previous methods in this field, we propose a simple baseline that updates the image encoder by minimizing identity similarity between generated and input images for target identities to be unlearned, while maximizing it for identities to be retained. However, we find such a global perturbation in the feature space harms the fidelity of generated images for other identities to be retained. To solve this problem, we propose a novel method IREU, which first locates identity-related features in an offline manner and then only performs feature perturbations on them. The experimental results show that our proposed method IREU achieves better identity unlearning performance for target identities to be unlearned, and also keeps high fidelity for other identities to be retained. In addition, our unlearned image encoder is generalizable across different generators with the same encoder without fine-tuning, which is friendly for deployment in practice.

中文摘要翻译: 定制化肖像生成（CPG）技术已被广泛应用于根据指示身份信息的输入图像和指示所需编辑的文本提示来生成高保真人物图像。然而，这些方法通过传播虚假视觉信息带来了显著的隐私风险。为应对此类风险，每个公开生成器在被请求时应能抑制对特定人物的生成能力。因此，本文研究CPG中的身份遗忘问题。由于该领域尚无先前方法，我们提出了一个简单基线：通过最小化目标遗忘身份在生成图像与输入图像之间的身份相似度，同时最大化保留身份的身份相似度，来更新图像编码器。然而，我们发现这种在特征空间中的全局扰动会损害其他需要保留身份的生成图像保真度。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的方法IREU，该方法首先以离线方式定位身份相关特征，然后仅对这些特征执行扰动。实验结果表明，我们提出的IREU方法对目标遗忘身份实现了更好的身份遗忘效果，同时为其他需保留的身份保持了高保真度。此外，我们遗忘后的图像编码器无需微调即可在不同生成器之间泛化，便于实际部署。

</details>


### [173] [Building artificial intelligence virtual tissue (AIVT) for tissue state representation, feature prediction, and dynamic simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29883)
*Qiqi Lu,Qianjin Feng,Shaoqun Zeng,Shenghua Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了AI虚拟组织（AIVT）概念，一个基于空间多模态数据的人工智能框架，用于建模健康和疾病状态下的组织。该框架能够学习统一、空间可分辨且可动态操控的组织状态表征，实现组织状态分析、分子和形态特征预测以及时空组织动力学模拟。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 理解组织状态及其转变对研究健康组织稳态和疾病病理重塑至关重要，但传统计算方法无法充分捕捉组织作为空间组织的多尺度生物系统的复杂性。AI在表征复杂系统方面表现出色，为描述组织状态及其转变创造了新机遇。

Method: 提出AI虚拟组织（AIVT）概念框架，该框架基于空间多模态数据，通过学习统一、空间可分辨且可动态操控的组织状态表征，实现组织状态的分析、分子和形态特征预测以及时空动力学模拟。

Result: 论文概述了AIVT的基本假设、核心能力、架构组件以及数据和算法基础，为AI驱动的组织建模提供了一个系统性框架，但未提供具体实验结果。

Conclusion: AIVT作为一个AI驱动的组织建模框架，能够有效弥合传统计算方法与组织复杂性之间的差距，为理解健康和疾病中的组织状态及其转变提供了新的范式。

Original Abstract: Modeling tissue states and their transitions is essential for understanding tissue homeostasis in health and pathological remodeling in disease. However, conventional computational modeling approaches are inadequate to capture the complexity of tissues as spatially organized, multiscale biological systems. Artificial intelligence (AI) has shown a remarkable ability for representing intricate systems, creating new opportunities to characterize tissue states and their transitions. Here, we propose the concept of AI virtual tissue (AIVT), an AI framework grounded in spatial multimodal data for modeling tissues in health and disease. AIVT is designed to learn unified, spatially resolved, and dynamically manipulatable representations of tissue state, enabling tissue state representation and analysis, molecular and morphological feature prediction, and simulation of spatiotemporal tissue dynamics. We outline the fundamental assumptions, core capabilities, architectural components, as well as data and algorithm foundations of AIVT as a framework for AI-driven tissue modeling.

中文摘要翻译: 建模组织状态及其转变对于理解健康状态下的组织稳态和疾病状态下的病理重塑至关重要。然而，传统的计算建模方法不足以捕捉组织作为空间组织的多尺度生物系统的复杂性。人工智能在表征复杂系统方面展现出了卓越的能力，为描述组织状态及其转变创造了新机遇。在此，我们提出AI虚拟组织（AIVT）的概念，这是一个基于空间多模态数据的人工智能框架，用于建模健康和疾病状态下的组织。AIVT被设计为能够学习统一、空间可分辨且可动态操控的组织状态表征，从而实现组织状态表征与分析、分子和形态特征预测，以及时空组织动力学模拟。我们概述了AIVT作为AI驱动组织建模框架的基本假设、核心能力、架构组件，以及数据和算法基础。

</details>


### [174] [LLM-based Multimodal Personality Recognition via Facial Action Unit-Text Semantic Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29900)
*Tianyi Zhang,Wei Shan,Yuan Zong,Tianhua Qi,Wenming Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于LLM的面部动作单元（AU）与文本回答语义融合的框架，用于异步视频面试中的人格识别，在AVI-6基准上优于多数基线方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有方法要么仅依赖文本导致信息丢失（忽略面部线索），要么使用全脸图像或稀疏采样帧丢弃了精细时间动态，缺乏有效融合非语言线索与文本语义的手段。

Method: 将AU序列转换为可解释文本描述，通过LLM与参与者的文本回答进行语义融合，再使用轻量回归头将嵌入映射为连续人格评分，不破坏底层语义空间。

Result: 在AVI-6基准上，该方法在多数基线中取得一致性改进，预测误差更低，与人工评分的相关性更强；AU衍生的语义表示提供了互补的非语言线索；语义理解与回归预测的解耦提升了训练稳定性和可解释性。

Conclusion: AU-文本融合为异步视频面试中的人格识别提供了一种基于心理学原理且计算高效的框架。

Original Abstract: Personality recognition in asynchronous video interviews (AVIs) has become increasingly important due to their widespread adoption in modern recruitment. Existing approaches often rely on large language models (LLMs) to analyze textual responses of interviewees in AVI. However, unimodel methods often suffer from information loss (e.g., ignore facial cues). In contrast, multimodal methods that employ full-face images or sparsely sampled frames can discard fine-grained temporal dynamics critical for accurate personality assessment. To overcome these limitations, we propose an LLM-based framework that semantically fuse facial action units (AUs) with textual responses of AVI. AU sequences are first converted into interpretable textual descriptions, which are then fused with participants' textual responses through an LLM. A lightweight regression head transforms the resulting embeddings into continuous personality scores without disrupting the underlying semantic space. Experiments on the AVI-6 benchmark demonstrate consistent improvements over most baselines, with lower prediction errors and stronger correlations with human-rated scores across multiple traits. Further analysis reveals that AU-derived semantic representations offer complementary non-verbal cues to textual responses. Decoupling semantic understanding from regression prediction within the LLM also leads to greater training stability and clearer interpretability. Overall, these findings demonstrate that AU-text fusion provides a psychologically grounded and computationally efficient framework for personality recognition in AVIs.

中文摘要翻译: 异步视频面试中的人格识别因其在现代招聘中的广泛应用而日益重要。现有方法通常依赖大语言模型分析面试者的文本回答。然而，单模态方法常遭受信息损失（例如忽略面部线索）。相比之下，采用全脸图像或稀疏采样帧的多模态方法可能丢弃对准确人格评估至关重要的精细时间动态。为克服这些局限，我们提出一种基于LLM的框架，将面部动作单元与AVI中的文本回答进行语义融合。AU序列首先被转换为可解释的文本描述，然后通过LLM与参与者的文本回答融合。一个轻量回归头将所得嵌入转换为连续人格评分，而不破坏底层语义空间。在AVI-6基准上的实验表明，该方法在多数基线中取得一致性改进，预测误差更低，且与多个特质的人工评分具有更强的相关性。进一步分析揭示，AU衍生的语义表示为文本回答提供了互补的非语言线索。在LLM内部将语义理解与回归预测解耦，也带来了更高的训练稳定性和更清晰的可解释性。总体而言，这些发现表明AU-文本融合为AVI中的人格识别提供了一种基于心理学原理且计算高效的框架。

</details>


### [175] [StrucTab: A Structured Optimization Framework for Table Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29905)
*Gengluo Li,Shangpin Peng,Chengquan Zhang,Binghong Wu,Hao Feng,Weinong Wang,Pengyuan Lyu,Huawen Shen,Xingyu Wan,Zhuotao Tian,Han Hu,Can Ma,Yu Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV
