TL;DR: StrucTab是一种通过中间结构监督和奖励分解学习表格解析的模型，结合Uni-TabRL统一强化学习框架和TableVerse-5K基准数据集，在多个公开基准上达到最优性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有VLM端到端表格解析方法缺乏显式中间推理，而基于强化学习的优化常因不稳定的奖励设计受阻，亟需结构化的建模与优化方法。

Method: (1) 建模层面：将解析过程分解为行-列计数和合并单元格分析等人为启发的子任务，通过顺序推理策略逐步统一；(2) 优化层面：提出Uni-TabRL统一强化学习框架，利用分解奖励（有效性、结构、内容）提供稳定优化的信号；(3) 评估层面：构建TableVerse-5K大规模挑战性基准。

Result: StrucTab在所有公开基准上达到SOTA，并在TableVerse-5K上取得显著提升，验证了显式结构建模和分解奖励优化的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过中间结构监督和分解奖励优化，StrucTab有效提升了表格解析的性能和泛化能力，代码和基准已开源。

Original Abstract: Table parsing aims to convert table images into structured, machine-readable representations, a task requiring the joint perception of complex spatial layouts and textual content. While recent vision-language models (VLMs) enable end-to-end parsing, they typically rely on direct supervision of the final output, thereby bypassing the explicit intermediate reasoning that is crucial for understanding complex table structures. Furthermore, attempts to optimize these models using reinforcement learning (RL) are often hindered by unstable or ambiguous reward designs, limiting potential performance gains. To address these limitations, we propose StrucTab, a table parsing model learned through intermediate structural supervision and reward decomposition. At the modeling level, by decomposing the parsing process into human-inspired subtasks, such as row-column counting and merged-cell analysis, StrucTab progressively unifies them through a sequential reasoning strategy. At the optimization level, we introduce Uni-TabRL, a unified RL framework that leverages decomposed rewards (validity, structure, and content) to provide stable and informative optimization signals. Finally, at the evaluation level, we present TableVerse-5K, a large-scale, challenging benchmark encompassing diverse, real-world table scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of StrucTab across all evaluated public benchmarks and significant improvements on TableVerse-5K, validating the effectiveness of explicit structural modeling and decomposed reward optimization. Code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/VirtualLUOUCAS/StrucTab.

中文摘要翻译: 表格解析旨在将表格图像转换为结构化的、机器可读的表示，这一任务需要联合感知复杂的空间布局和文本内容。虽然近期视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够实现端到端解析，但它们通常依赖于对最终输出的直接监督，从而绕过了对理解复杂表格结构至关重要的显式中间推理。此外，尝试使用强化学习（RL）优化这些模型时，常常受到不稳定或模糊的奖励设计阻碍，限制了潜在的性能提升。为解决这些局限，我们提出StrucTab，一种通过中间结构监督和奖励分解学习的表格解析模型。在建模层面，通过将解析过程分解为类似人工的子任务，如行-列计数和合并单元格分析，StrucTab通过顺序推理策略逐步统一这些子任务。在优化层面，我们提出Uni-TabRL，一种统一的RL框架，利用分解奖励（有效性、结构性和内容性）提供稳定且信息丰富的优化信号。最后，在评估层面，我们提出TableVerse-5K，一个大规模的、具有挑战性的基准，涵盖多样化的真实世界表格场景。大量实验表明，StrucTab在所有评估的公开基准上达到最先进的性能，并在TableVerse-5K上取得显著提升，验证了显式结构建模和分解奖励优化的有效性。代码和基准已公开于 https://github.com/VirtualLUOUCAS/StrucTab。

</details>


### [176] [Traffic-CBM: A Structurally Interpretable Multimodal Framework for Encrypted Traffic Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29909)
*Honglei Jin,Wenshuo Chen,Shaofeng Liang,Haozhe Jia,Menshuo Zhao,Shuxu Jin,Songning Lai,Yutao Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Traffic-CBM，一种结构可解释的加密流量分类多模态框架，通过将异构流量信号组织为统一的分层概念空间（统计概念、时序概念、数据包级和跨数据包概念），在保持竞争力分类性能的同时提供清晰的结构化解释能力。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有加密流量分类方法虽然性能强大，但决策过程难以解释，因为方法将流统计、数据包序列和字节级表示融合成不透明的潜在特征，使得不清楚哪种证据实际驱动了预测。

Method: 提出Traffic-CBM框架，核心思路是将异构流量信号组织成统一的分层概念空间，而非直接融合成黑盒表示。具体包括：（1）分组的流统计信息映射为统计概念；（2）专用时序编码器从不相交特征子空间学习时序概念；（3）字节级证据组织成数据包级和跨数据包概念。这些概念是受预定义流量证据组约束的标量证据摘要。

Result: 在多个加密流量基准上，Traffic-CBM实现了有竞争力和平衡的分类性能，同时提供了比传统端到端融合模型更清晰的结构化解释接口。进一步分析表明，学习到的概念空间在预测过程中被积极使用，为多模态流量证据提供了更清晰的结构化解释。

Conclusion: 论文提出了一种结构可解释的多模态框架Traffic-CBM，通过构建统一的分层概念空间而非直接融合异构特征，实现了加密流量分类的透明决策，在保持竞争力分类性能的同时提供了清晰的结构化解释能力。

Original Abstract: Encrypted traffic classification has achieved strong performance, but its decision process remains difficult to interpret. Existing methods usually combine flow statistics, packet sequences, and byte-level representations into opaque latent features, making it unclear which type of evidence actually drives the prediction. In this paper, we propose Traffic-CBM, a structurally interpretable multimodal framework for encrypted traffic classification. Instead of directly fusing heterogeneous traffic signals into a black-box representation, Traffic-CBM organizes them into a unified hierarchical concept space. These concepts are not manually annotated semantic attributes; rather, they are scalar evidence summaries constrained by predefined traffic evidence groups. More specifically, grouped flow statistics are mapped to statistical concepts, dedicated temporal encoders learn temporal concepts from disjoint feature subspaces, and byte-level evidence is further organized into packet-level and cross-packet concepts. This design turns heterogeneous traffic evidence into an explicit concept representation and makes different levels of traffic evidence easier to analyze. We evaluate Traffic-CBM on multiple encrypted traffic benchmarks. Results show that it achieves competitive and balanced classification performance while providing a clearer structural interpretation interface than conventional end-to-end fusion models. Further analyses suggest that the learned concept space is actively used in the prediction process and provides a clearer structural explanation of multimodal traffic evidence.

中文摘要翻译: 加密流量分类已经取得了强大的性能，但其决策过程仍然难以解释。现有方法通常将流统计信息、数据包序列和字节级表示组合成不透明的潜在特征，使得实际驱动预测的证据类型变得不清楚。在本文中，我们提出了Traffic-CBM，一种面向加密流量分类的结构可解释多模态框架。Traffic-CBM没有将异构流量信号直接融合成黑盒表示，而是将它们组织成一个统一的分层概念空间。这些概念并非手动标注的语义属性，而是由预定义的流量证据组约束的标量证据摘要。更具体地说，分组的流统计信息映射到统计概念，专用的时序编码器从不相交的特征子空间中学习时序概念，字节级证据进一步组织成数据包级和跨数据包概念。这种设计将异构流量证据转化为显式的概念表示，并使不同层次的流量证据更易于分析。我们在多个加密流量基准上评估了Traffic-CBM。结果表明，它实现了有竞争力和平衡的分类性能，同时提供了比传统端到端融合模型更清晰的结构化解释接口。进一步的分析表明，学习到的概念空间在预测过程中被积极使用，并为多模态流量证据提供了更清晰的结构化解释。

</details>


### [177] [H-GRPO: Permutation-Invariant Reinforcement Learning for Grounded Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29915)
*Eric Peh,Debaditya Roy,Basura Fernando*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于分解式证据 grounding 的框架，通过将全局查询分解为原子子问题并为每个子问题提供显式子答案和局部证据边界框，构建结构化的推理路径，从而提升 VLM 的性能和可解释性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型（VLM）在基准测试中表现优异，但仍然是"黑箱"，容易产生幻觉或依赖表层捷径，缺乏可解释性。

Method: 提出分解式证据 grounding 框架：将全局查询分解为一系列原子子问题，每个子问题要求显式的子答案以及关键的局部证据边界框，从而在特定视觉区域上 grounding 中间逻辑步骤，构建类似人类推理的结构化推理路径。

Result: 最终答案基于已验证的视觉事实通过逻辑推导得出，而非统计猜测，从而提升准确性和可解释性。

Conclusion: 该方法通过结构化、可分解的推理路径，使 VLM 的最终回答成为可验证视觉事实的逻辑结果，有效缓解幻觉和表层捷径问题。

Original Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often achieve high performance on benchmarks while remaining "black boxes", yet they remain prone to hallucination or rely on superficial shortcuts. In this work, we propose a framework designed to enhance both performance and interpretability through De-compositional Evidence Grounding. Unlike monolithic inference approaches, our approach forces the model to decompose a global query into a sequence of atomic sub-questions, each requiring an explicit sub-answer and critically a localized evidence bounding box. By grounding intermediate logical steps (e.g. identifying a container, analyzing liquid properties, and assessing environmental context) in specific visual regions, we construct a structured reasoning path that mirrors human-like deduction. This allows the final answer to emerge as a logical consequence of verified visual facts rather than a statistical guess.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）在基准测试中通常表现优异，但仍然是"黑箱"，且容易产生幻觉或依赖表层捷径。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个旨在通过分解式证据 grounding 来增强性能和可解释性的框架。与整体推理方法不同，我们的方法迫使模型将全局查询分解为一系列原子子问题，每个子问题都需要一个显式的子答案，以及关键的局部证据边界框。通过在特定视觉区域上 grounding 中间逻辑步骤（例如，识别容器、分析液体性质、评估环境上下文），我们构建了一条类似人类推理的结构化推理路径。这使得最终答案能够成为已验证视觉事实的逻辑结果，而非统计猜测。

</details>


### [178] [DCGrasp: Distance-aware Controllable Grasp Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29924)
*Hiroyasu Akada,Jesús Pérez,Emre Aksan,Vasileios Choutas,Cristian Romero,Alberto Garcia-Garcia,Vladislav Golyanik,Christian Theobalt,Thabo Beeler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DCGrasp是一个基于距离感知的可控抓取生成系统，利用新颖的抓取能量项（距离轮廓）和扩散Transformer生成高质量、物理合理的手-物体交互，支持灵活的用户控制并泛化到多样化的物体几何形状。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有3D手-物体交互生成方法缺乏灵活的可控性和对多样化物体几何的泛化能力，限制了在机器人、XR和合成数据生成等实际应用中的可用性。

Method: 提出距离轮廓（Distance Profile）作为手部顶点到最近物体点的有符号距离，结合距离感知权重，捕获近接触区域中语义相似的手-物体交互。基于扩散Transformer生成距离轮廓和候选手部姿态，再通过优化精炼候选姿态，确保优化后的手部姿态与生成的距离轮廓在近接触区域保持一致。

Result: 实验表明DCGrasp能生成高质量、物理合理的抓取，支持灵活的用户控制，并泛化到多样化的物体和手部形状及尺度。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了一个鲁棒且通用的可控3D手-物体交互合成流程。

Original Abstract: Generating 3D hand-object interactions is essential for applications in robotics, XR, and synthetic data generation, where flexible controllability and strong generalization to diverse object geometries are required. However, existing methods rarely satisfy these requirements, limiting their practical applicability. We present DCGrasp, a distance-aware controllable grasp generation system built on a novel grasp energy term. This term computes Distance Profile, a signed distance from each hand vertex to the nearest object point, coupled with distance-aware weighting, effectively capturing the semantically similar hand-object interaction in near-contact regions while remaining invariant to object and hand identity. Given various controllable signals, DCGrasp first generates a Distance Profile based on a Diffusion Transformer, together with a corresponding candidate hand pose. We then refine the candidate pose through optimization, enforcing consistency between the optimized hand pose and the generated Distance Profile in near-contact regions. Our experiments show that DCGrasp produces high-quality, physically plausible grasps with flexible user control, generalizing to diverse object and hand shapes and scales. Our work establishes a robust and versatile pipeline for the synthesis of controllable 3D hand-object interactions.

中文摘要翻译: 生成3D手-物体交互对于机器人、扩展现实（XR）和合成数据生成等应用至关重要，这些应用要求灵活的可控性和对多样化物体几何形状的强泛化能力。然而，现有方法很少满足这些要求，限制了其实际适用性。我们提出了DCGrasp，一个基于新颖抓取能量项的距离感知可控抓取生成系统。该能量项计算距离轮廓（Distance Profile），即从每个手部顶点到最近物体点的有符号距离，并结合距离感知权重，有效捕获近接触区域中语义相似的手-物体交互，同时对物体和手部身份保持不变性。在给定各种可控信号的情况下，DCGrasp首先基于扩散Transformer生成距离轮廓及对应的候选手部姿态。然后通过优化精炼候选姿态，确保优化后的手部姿态与生成的距离轮廓在近接触区域保持一致。实验表明，DCGrasp能生成高质量、物理合理的抓取，支持灵活的用户控制，并泛化到多样化的物体和手部形状及尺度。我们的工作为可控3D手-物体交互的合成建立了一个鲁棒且通用的流程。

</details>


### [179] [Latent-CURE for Breast Cancer Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29928)
*Weiyi Zhao,Xiaoyu Tan,Lu Gan,Liang Liu,Xihe Qiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Latent-CURE框架，利用不对称加权链式思维在潜在空间中进行临床推理，解决多模态大模型在自动乳腺超声诊断中因流行病学不平衡导致的捷径学习问题，提升罕见恶性特征的识别能力。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于多模态大模型的自动乳腺超声诊断框架采用不透明的端到端范式，优先学习全局统计相关性而非结构化临床推理，在极端不平衡的真实世界流行病学数据中容易发生捷径学习，忽略罕见但关键的恶性指标，而偏向常见的良性模式。

Method: 提出Latent-CURE框架，核心包括：(1) 基于潜在空间推理的不对称加权链式思维方法，构建隐式推理轨迹，迫使模型依次推断标准化的BI-RADS形态学描述符，最终得出诊断结论；(2) 双不对称优化策略，通过动态调整边界和权重，保护高特异性恶性描述符不被常见的良性先验所掩盖。

Result: 综合评估表明，所提出的知识注入方法能够提供透明的临床证据，并在不平衡的医疗队列中实现稳健、准确的诊断性能。

Conclusion: Latent-CURE通过将结构化临床推理注入多模态大模型，有效克服了端到端范式在数据不平衡场景下的局限，兼顾了诊断的可解释性与准确性。

Original Abstract: Multimodal Large Models have significantly advanced automated breast ultrasound diagnosis. However, most existing frameworks utilize opaque, end-to-end paradigms prioritizing global statistical correlations over structured clinical reasoning. Consequently, these models remain susceptible to shortcut learning amid extreme real-world epidemiological imbalances, often bypassing rare but decisive malignant indicators for dominant benign patterns. To address this disconnect, we propose Latent-CURE, a novel diagnostic framework driven by asymmetric weighted chain-of-thought methodology grounded in latent space reasoning. Unlike traditional approaches, our framework constructs an implicit reasoning trajectory forcing the model to sequentially infer standardized BI-RADS morphological descriptors before converging on a final diagnosis. Furthermore, to combat the extreme scarcity of critical malignant features, we couple this architecture with a dual-asymmetric optimization strategy. By dynamically adjusting margins and weights, this strategy safeguards high-specificity malignant descriptors from being overshadowed by common benign priors. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that our knowledge-injected approach provides transparent clinical evidence while achieving robust, accurate diagnostic performance in imbalanced medical cohorts.

中文摘要翻译: 多模态大模型显著推进了自动乳腺超声诊断的发展。然而，现有大多数框架采用不透明的端到端范式，优先学习全局统计相关性而非结构化临床推理。因此，这些模型在面对真实世界极端流行病学不平衡时仍容易发生捷径学习，常常跳过罕见但决定性的恶性指标，而偏向占主导地位的良性模式。为解决这一脱节问题，我们提出Latent-CURE——一种基于潜在空间推理的不对称加权链式思维方法驱动的新型诊断框架。与传统方法不同，我们的框架构建了一条隐式推理轨迹，迫使模型在收敛到最终诊断之前依次推断标准化的BI-RADS形态学描述符。此外，为应对关键恶性特征的极端稀缺性，我们将该架构与双不对称优化策略相结合。该策略通过动态调整边界和权重，保护高特异性恶性描述符不被常见良性先验所掩盖。综合评估表明，我们的知识注入方法能够提供透明的临床证据，并在不平衡的医疗队列中实现稳健、准确的诊断性能。

</details>


### [180] [Scene-aware Prediction of Diverse Human Movement Goals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29942)
*Qiaoyue Yang,Amadeus Weber,Magnus Jung,Ayoub AI-Hamadi,Sven Wachsmuth*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于条件变分自编码器的多目标预测方法，通过RGB场景和人体姿态生成多样化的人类运动目标，以应对人类行为随机性，并在GTA-IM和PROX数据集上验证了泛化能力。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的人类目标预测方法要么需要场景语义知识，要么仅处理与物体的交互，无法有效处理人类运动的多目标随机性。因此需要一种无需语义标注、能预测多样化潜在目标的方法。

Method: 基于条件变分自编码器（CVAE）的生成模型，以当前RGB场景和人体姿态作为输入，通过在CVAE的潜空间中采样，生成多个多样化的人类运动目标。

Result: 该方法能够在场景中生成多个运动目标，在GTA-IM和PROX数据集上展现出跨场景的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 基于CVAE的生成模型能有效预测多样化的人类运动目标，为自主系统在主动规划中提供支持，且无需场景语义知识。

Original Abstract: Anticipation of human behaviours facilitates autonomous systems in proactive planning. Human behaviour could be stochastic due to varying goals. Human goals typically guide their own movement and could therefore help to predict the human trajectory and human motion in the long-term. To infer the human movement intentions, the environmental context plays a significant role, in addition to the social cues expressed by the individual. Previous works on human goals prediction either require semantic knowledge of the scene, or only tackle interactions with objects. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-goal prediction method using the generative model to address the stochasticity of human movement. It leverages the current RGB scene and the human pose to predict diverse potential future goals of human movement based on the Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE). Our results demonstrate that our approach is capable of generating multiple movement goals in the scene via samplings in latent space of the CVAE and exhibits generalization capability across scenarios in GTA-IM dataset and PROX dataset. Code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/Q-Y-Yang/DiverseGoalsPrediction.git}{\texttt{https://github.com/Q-Y-Yang/DiverseGoalsPrediction}}.

中文摘要翻译: 对人类行为的预见有助于自主系统进行主动规划。由于目标各异，人类行为可能是随机的。人类目标通常会引导其自身的运动，因此有助于长期预测人类轨迹和人体运动。要推断人类运动意图，除了个体表达的社会线索外，环境上下文也起着重要作用。以往关于人类目标预测的工作要么需要场景的语义知识，要么仅处理与物体的交互。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于生成模型的新型多目标预测方法，以应对人类运动的随机性。该方法利用当前RGB场景和人体姿态，基于条件变分自编码器（CVAE）预测人类运动多样化的潜在未来目标。我们的结果表明，我们的方法能够通过在CVAE潜空间中进行采样，在场景中生成多个运动目标，并在GTA-IM数据集和PROX数据集上展现出跨场景的泛化能力。代码已公开在\href{https://github.com/Q-Y-Yang/DiverseGoalsPrediction.git}{\texttt{https://github.com/Q-Y-Yang/DiverseGoalsPrediction}}。

</details>


### [181] [Explainability-Aware Frustum Attack: Exposing Structural Vulnerabilities in LiDAR-Based 3D Object Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29963)
*Chengzeng You,Binbin Xu,Soteris Demetriou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可解释性引导的对抗分析方法，通过SALL方法生成通用显著性图，并设计EFA攻击高效扰动点云中关键空间区域，揭示了LiDAR三维目标检测器在空间证据依赖上的结构性脆弱性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有对点云三维目标检测器的对抗鲁棒性研究主要集中于孤立物体模型或物理可实现性，缺乏对检测器在复杂场景中如何依赖空间证据以及能否被高效利用的理解。

Method: 提出SALL（Saliency-LiDAR）方法，跨场景聚合积分梯度（Integrated Gradients）归因，生成通用显著性图；基于此设计EFA（Explainability-aware Frustum Attack），选择性扰动最具影响力的视锥区域，而非均匀攻击整个物体区域。

Result: 在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，针对PointPillars和SECOND等检测器，EFA在减少25-50%扰动视锥数量的情况下，使检测召回率下降超过15个百分点，优于非显著性感知的基线方法。

Conclusion: 现代三维检测器将判别性证据集中在少数空间区域，暴露出当前LiDAR感知系统存在结构性鲁棒性漏洞。

Original Abstract: The structural vulnerabilities of point cloud-based 3D object detectors remain poorly understood. Prior work has studied adversarial robustness primarily on isolated 3D object models, while recent LiDAR spoofing attacks target richer and more realistic driving scenes but focus mainly on physical realizability rather than understanding detector behavior or attack efficiency. In this work, we investigate how LiDAR-based detectors rely on spatial evidence in complex scenes and whether these reliance patterns can be exploited to induce failures more efficiently. To this end, we propose an explainability-guided adversarial analysis methodology. We introduce the Saliency-LiDAR (SALL) method, which aggregates Integrated Gradient attributions across scenes to produce universal saliency maps for LiDAR-based 3D object detectors. Guided by these maps, we design the Explainability-aware Frustum Attack (EFA), which selectively perturbs only the most influential frustums rather than uniformly attacking entire object regions. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes, across detectors such as PointPillars and SECOND, show that EFA reduces detection recall by more than 15 percentage points while requiring 25-50% fewer perturbed frustums than the state-of-the-art non-saliency-aware baseline. These findings reveal that modern 3D detectors concentrate discriminative evidence in a small subset of spatial regions, exposing a structural robustness vulnerability in current LiDAR perception systems. Our code is released at https://github.com/SecMindLab/Saliency_LiDAR.

中文摘要翻译: 基于点云的三维目标检测器的结构脆弱性仍未被充分理解。以往工作主要针对孤立的三维物体模型研究对抗鲁棒性，而最近的LiDAR欺骗攻击针对更丰富、更真实的驾驶场景，但主要关注物理可实现性而非理解检测器行为或攻击效率。本文研究LiDAR检测器在复杂场景中如何依赖空间证据，以及这些依赖模式能否被利用以更高效地诱发故障。为此，我们提出了一种可解释性引导的对抗分析方法。我们引入Saliency-LiDAR（SALL）方法，跨场景聚合积分梯度（Integrated Gradient）归因，为基于LiDAR的三维目标检测器生成通用显著性图。在这些图的引导下，我们设计了可解释性感知的视锥攻击（Explainability-aware Frustum Attack, EFA），该方法选择性地仅扰动最具影响力的视锥区域，而非均匀攻击整个物体区域。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，针对PointPillars和SECOND等检测器的实验表明，EFA在减少25-50%扰动视锥数量的情况下，使检测召回率下降超过15个百分点，优于当前非显著性感知的基线方法。这些发现揭示了现代三维检测器将判别性证据集中在少数空间区域，从而暴露了当前LiDAR感知系统中的结构性鲁棒性漏洞。我们的代码已在https://github.com/SecMindLab/Saliency_LiDAR发布。

</details>


### [182] [Variance Reduction on the Camera Axis: Multi-View Score Distillation for 3D](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29964)
*Marian Lupascu,Mihai Sorin Stupariu,Ionut Mironica*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MV-SDI方法，通过在每步中聚合多个视图（K=2或4）的梯度来降低分数蒸馏的方差，无需重新训练或多视图数据，在固定UNet预算下显著提升3D生成质量，优化步数减半。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的分数蒸馏方法每步梯度仅从单个随机视图估计，方差高且忽略全局形状一致性。先前工作通过在多视图数据上重新训练扩散先验来改进，但这使得采样贡献与先验质量不可分离。本文的目标是仅从采样轴入手，在不修改先验的前提下降低梯度方差。

Method: 提出多视图聚合分数蒸馏（MV-SDI），每步从K个视图聚合梯度（通过梯度累积实现，峰值内存不变），并采用对映反码对（antithetic antipodal pairs）作为视图采样策略，实现平衡的角度覆盖。2D先验保持冻结，无需重新训练或多视图数据。

Result: 在固定10,000次UNet调用预算下：K=2时CLIP R-Precision从74.8%提升至83.8%，CLIP得分从0.297提升至0.312，HPSv2和ImageReward指标一致提升，43个提示基准上发散率为0.0%，优化步数减半；K=4时R-Precision达86.9%，CLIP得分0.307，步数减少四倍，所有对齐指标均显著优于单视图基线。

Conclusion: MV-SDI是一种无需重新训练、无需多视图数据即可显著提升分数蒸馏3D生成质量的方法，兼容现有基于梯度的分数蒸馏管线（包括SDI），通过多视图梯度聚合实现更低的方差和更好的3D一致性。

Original Abstract: Score distillation turns a pretrained 2D diffusion model into a 3D generator, but the per-step gradient is estimated from a single randomly chosen view: it is high-variance and blind to global shape consistency. Prior work addresses this by retraining the diffusion prior on multi-view data; this improves consistency but makes the sampling contribution inseparable from prior quality. We instead isolate the sampling axis. The per-step gradient is one noisy sample of an expectation over views; aggregating K samples per step at a fixed total UNet budget reduces variance without touching the prior. We introduce Multi-View Aggregated Score Distillation (MV-SDI), which aggregates gradients from K views per step via gradient accumulation, keeping peak memory unchanged and the 2D prior frozen, and draws views as antithetic antipodal pairs, a prior-independent geometric property, for balanced angular coverage. At a fixed 10,000-UNet-call budget, K=2 raises CLIP R-Precision from 74.8% to 83.8% and CLIP score from 0.297 to 0.312, with consistent gains on HPSv2 and ImageReward and a 0.0% divergence rate on the 43-prompt benchmark; optimization steps halve as a consequence. K=4 gives a fourfold step reduction at R-Precision 86.9% and CLIP 0.307, still well above the single-view baseline on every alignment metric. MV-SDI is compatible with gradient-based score-distillation pipelines, including Score Distillation via Inversion, and requires no retraining and no multi-view data.

中文摘要翻译: 分数蒸馏将预训练的2D扩散模型转化为3D生成器，但每步梯度仅从单个随机视图估计，导致方差高且忽略全局形状一致性。先前工作通过在多视图数据上重新训练扩散先验来解决此问题；这提升了一致性，但使采样贡献与先验质量无法分离。我们转而孤立采样轴。每步梯度是视图期望的一个噪声样本；在固定的总UNet预算下，每步聚合K个样本可降低方差，而不触及先验。我们提出多视图聚合分数蒸馏（MV-SDI），通过梯度累积每步聚合K个视图的梯度，保持峰值内存不变且2D先验冻结，并采用对映反码对（一种与先验无关的几何属性）采样视图，以实现平衡的角度覆盖。在固定的10,000次UNet调用预算下，K=2将CLIP R-Precision从74.8%提升至83.8%，CLIP得分从0.297提升至0.312，在HPSv2和ImageReward上均有一致提升，在43个提示基准上发散率为0.0%；优化步数因此减半。K=4在R-Precision达86.9%、CLIP得分为0.307时实现四倍步数缩减，每个对齐指标仍远高于单视图基线。MV-SDI与基于梯度的分数蒸馏管线（包括通过反演的分数蒸馏）兼容，无需重新训练，也无需多视图数据。

</details>


### [183] [Learning Efficient 4D Gaussian Representations from Monocular Videos with Flow Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29976)
*Shengjun Zhang,Jinzhao Li,Xin Fei,Yueqi Duan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Flow Splatting通过构建速度场并扩展传统的3D高斯溅射技术到4D领域，从单目视频中高效重建动态3D场景，实现更快的训练和渲染速度以及更好的图像质量。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的基于3D高斯溅射的动态场景重建方法（如变形场、轨迹或时空4D体积）存在训练时间长、渲染速度慢或内存消耗高的问题，未能充分利用密集动态信息。

Method: 提出Flow Splatting方法：1) 扩展4D体积，使用时变均值和协方差表示复杂动态；2) 基于该表示构建并近似速度场；3) 扩展体渲染策略，通过考虑相机运动的影响将速度场进行溅射，从而渲染光流以监督动力学学习过程。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，与现有最先进方法相比，Flow Splatting实现了更好的图像质量、更少的训练时间和更高的渲染速度。

Conclusion: Flow Splatting通过速度场构建和溅射技术有效解决了现有4D高斯方法在效率和性能上的不足，为单目视频动态场景重建提供了一种高效且高质量的解决方案。

Original Abstract: Reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes from monocular videos is challenging due to scene complexity and temporal dynamics. With the advancement of 3D Gaussian Splatting in novel view synthesis, existing methods extend 3D Gaussians to 4D domain with deformation fields, trajectories or spatiotemporal 4D volumes to model scene element deformation. However, these methods suffer from long training time, low rendering speed or high memory consumption for per-frame reconstruction of 4D volumes, without fully exploiting dense dynamic information. To address this issue, we propose Flow Splatting, which constructs the velocity field and enables the conventional splatting technique to render optical flow from the velocity field to supervise dynamics learning process from monocular videos. Specifically, we extend 4D volumes with time varying means and covariance to represent complex dynamics. Then, we construct and approximate the velocity field naturally based on this representations. While conventional volume rendering techniques support to render color fields, we extend the volume rendering strategy to splat the velocity field by considering the influence of camera motions. We conduct experiments on various benchmarks to demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of our method. Compared to the state-of-the-art methods, our model achieves better image quality with less time consumption and higher rendering speed.

中文摘要翻译: 从单目视频中重建动态3D场景因场景复杂性和时间动态性而具有挑战性。随着3D高斯溅射在新视角合成中的发展，现有方法将3D高斯扩展到4D领域，利用变形场、轨迹或时空4D体积来建模场景元素的变形。然而，这些方法在逐帧重建4D体积时需要较长的训练时间、较低的渲染速度或较高的内存消耗，未能充分利用密集动态信息。为解决这一问题，我们提出Flow Splatting，该方法构建速度场并使传统溅射技术能够从速度场渲染光流，从而从单目视频中监督动力学学习过程。具体而言，我们扩展了具有时变均值和协方差的4D体积来表示复杂动态。然后，基于该表示自然地构建并近似速度场。传统体渲染技术支持渲染颜色场，我们通过考虑相机运动的影响，将体渲染策略扩展为对速度场进行溅射。我们在多个基准数据集上进行了实验，证明了我们方法的效率和有效性。与最先进的方法相比，我们的模型在更少的时间和更高的渲染速度下实现了更好的图像质量。

</details>


### [184] [Rigel: Self-Distilled Score Adaptation for Image and Video Captioning Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29997)
*Shuitsu Koyama,Kazuki Matsuda,Yuiga Wada,Shinnosuke Hirano,Daichi Yashima,Komei Sugiura*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Rigel是一种基于自蒸馏分数自适应的图像/视频描述自动评估指标，通过从冻结的LLM中蒸馏出评估专用评分头，并在Vid-Lepus数据集上微调，在参考无关设置下于ActivityNet-Fact上取得超10分的提升。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有LLM-as-a-Judge方法虽提升了与人类判断的契合度，但仍存在大词汇语言建模与小标签集评估之间的不匹配问题。

Method: 提出Rigel指标，采用自蒸馏分数自适应方法：从冻结的LLM中蒸馏出一个评估专用的评分头，在任务对齐空间中捕捉判断信号，避免依赖大词汇token集；再用人工判断数据微调LLM骨干网络。同时构建了Vid-Lepus数据集用于训练。

Result: 在多个基准测试上，Rigel优于现有最佳指标，在参考无关设置下于ActivityNet-Fact数据集上取得超过10分的提升。

Conclusion: 通过自蒸馏分数自适应策略，Rigel有效解决了LLM评估中词汇空间与标签空间不匹配的问题，显著提升了图像/视频描述自动评估与人类判断的对齐度。

Original Abstract: Automatic evaluation of image and video captioning is essential for benchmarking multimodal systems, although standard evaluation metrics show limited alignment with human judgments. Recent approaches using large language models (LLMs), commonly referred to as LLM-as-a-Judge, have improved alignment with human judgments but still suffer from a mismatch between large-vocabulary language modeling and evaluation over a small label set. To address this, we propose Rigel, an automatic evaluation metric for image and video captioning, based on self-distilled score adaptation. The metric employs an evaluation-specific scoring head distilled from a frozen LLM, which captures judgment signals in a task-aligned space without relying on large-vocabulary token sets. We then refine the LLM backbone with human judgment data. To train Rigel, we constructed the Vid-Lepus dataset, which contains 3,338 video clips, 33,380 reference captions, and 5,637 candidate captions. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that Rigel outperforms state-of-the-art metrics, achieving over 10-point improvements on ActivityNet-Fact in the reference-free setting.

中文摘要翻译: 图像与视频描述的自动评估对于多模态系统的基准测试至关重要，尽管标准评估指标与人类判断的对齐程度有限。近期使用大语言模型（LLM）的方法（通常称为LLM-as-a-Judge）虽然改善了与人类判断的对齐，但仍存在大词汇语言建模与小标签集评估之间的不匹配问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Rigel——一种基于自蒸馏分数自适应的图像与视频描述自动评估指标。该指标采用从冻结的LLM中蒸馏出的评估专用评分头，在任务对齐空间中捕捉判断信号，而不依赖大词汇token集。随后，我们使用人工判断数据对LLM骨干网络进行微调。为训练Rigel，我们构建了Vid-Lepus数据集，包含3,338个视频片段、33,380条参考描述和5,637条候选描述。在多个基准测试上的实验表明，Rigel优于现有最佳指标，在参考无关设置下于ActivityNet-Fact数据集上取得超过10分的提升。

</details>


### [185] [SICAGE: Speaker-Independent Culture-Aware Gesture Generation using TED4C-L Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30001)
*Ariel Gjaci,Antonio Sgorbissa,Vittorio Murino*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SICAGE框架，通过域泛化学习与说话者无关的文化表征来指导共语手势生成，并构建了TED4C-L数据集，实验表明该方法在运动真实感、多样性、节拍同步、语义相关性和文化一致性上均有提升。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有共语手势生成方法常忽视文化差异，且文化条件模型在说话者不重叠的数据划分下评估不足，导致看似“文化”的行为可能混杂了说话者个人风格。

Method: 提出SICAGE模块化框架：将每位说话者视为独立域并通过域泛化（对抗学习或Fishr正则化）学习说话者无关的文化表征，再以此条件化多模态生成器（如ALaDiT实时扩散手势生成器）产生符合文化习惯的手势。

Result: 构建了含764位说话者、4个文化群体、106小时的TED4C-L数据集。实验表明SICAGE在运动真实感、多样性、节拍同步、语义相关性和文化一致性方面均优于基线。

Conclusion: 通过说话者无关的文化表征学习，能有效解耦文化与说话者身份，提升跨文化手势生成的文化一致性和整体质量。

Original Abstract: Recent co-speech gesture generation methods often overlook cultural differences, limiting their effectiveness in human-agent interaction. Moreover, culture-conditioned models are rarely evaluated under speaker-disjoint splits, so apparent "cultural" behavior may be confounded with speaker-specific gesturing style. We introduce SICAGE, a modular framework for culture-aware co-speech gesture generation that conditions motion synthesis models on speaker-independent cultural representations. SICAGE learns these representations from audio and text by treating each speaker as a separate domain while imposing invariance across speakers. This encourages representations to remain culture-discriminative while reducing dependence on speaker identity. The resulting cultural embeddings condition a multimodal generator to produce culturally appropriate gestures. We instantiate this idea with two domain generalization approaches: adversarial learning and Fishr regularization. We further introduce ALaDiT, a real-time diffusion-based gesture generator designed to efficiently incorporate the learned cultural embeddings. To validate our method, we built TED4C-L, a 106-hour multimodal dataset of 764 TED speakers from four cultural groups. Experiments show that SICAGE improves motion realism, diversity, beat synchronization, semantic relevance, and cultural consistency.

中文摘要翻译: 最近的共语手势生成方法常常忽略文化差异，限制了它们在人与智能体交互中的有效性。此外，文化条件模型很少在说话者不重叠的数据划分下进行评估，因此看似“文化”的行为可能与说话者个人手势风格相混淆。我们提出了SICAGE，一个面向文化感知共语手势生成的模块化框架，该框架将运动合成模型以说话者无关的文化表征为条件。SICAGE通过将每位说话者视为独立域并在不同说话者间施加不变性约束，从音频和文本中学习这些表征。这鼓励表征保持文化判别性，同时降低对说话者身份的依赖。由此产生的文化嵌入作为条件输入多模态生成器，以生成符合文化习惯的手势。我们通过两种域泛化方法实例化该思想：对抗学习和Fishr正则化。我们还提出了ALaDiT，一个实时扩散手势生成器，旨在高效地融合学习到的文化嵌入。为验证我们的方法，我们构建了TED4C-L数据集，这是一个包含来自四个文化群体的764位TED演讲者、共计106小时的多模态数据集。实验表明，SICAGE在运动真实感、多样性、节拍同步、语义相关性和文化一致性方面均有提升。

</details>


### [186] [GeoEdit: Geometry-Aware Object Editing via Dual-Branch Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30003)
*Yi He,Jiangming Wang,Xinyu Wang,Mark Fong,Songchun Zhang,Yuxuan Xue,Hai-Tao Zheng,Yue Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoEdit是一种无需额外训练的Lift-Manipulate-Render-Denoise管线，通过3D解耦、深度对齐代理和方差同质注入，在单张照片中实现符合3D物理约束的物体精确操作（平移、旋转、缩放），同时保持背景自然和身份保真度。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的图像编辑器在单张照片中操作物体时缺乏3D空间感知，导致透视违背、重影和背景模糊。核心难点在于：重定位物体需遵循刚性几何约束，而暴露的背景区域需自由合成合理内容。现有方法要么是2D方法缺乏空间意识，要么是强制注入结构代理破坏潜在空间的方差同质性，引发自注意力泄漏问题。

Method: GeoEdit包含两个阶段：（1）Lift-Manipulate-Render阶段：将场景和物体在3D中解耦，通过点对应关系对齐，渲染带有结构深度图的几何对齐代理。（2）Dual-Branch Denoising阶段：使用视频扩散主干保持物体身份，同时在前景区域通过窄去噪窗口以匹配的噪声方差注入3D约束（方差同质注入），背景则自由去噪。

Result: 在GeoEditBench基准（涵盖物体平移、旋转和相机运动）上的实验表明，该方法在几何精度、身份保真度和背景质量方面均取得一致提升。

Conclusion: GeoEdit通过解耦3D几何与外观、利用方差同质注入避免自注意力泄漏，成功实现了单张照片中符合物理约束的物体操作，且无需额外训练。

Original Abstract: Precisely manipulating objects in a single photograph (translation, rotation, scaling) while obeying 3D physical constraints remains unsolved for diffusion-based editors. Current 2D methods lack spatial awareness and produce perspective violations. Forcing structural proxies into the latent space also disrupts variance homogeneity, and the resulting self-attention leakage leads to ghosting and background blur. The core difficulty is asymmetric: the relocated object must follow a rigid geometry, yet the uncovered background needs freedom to synthesize plausible content. We present GeoEdit, a training-free Lift-Manipulate-Render-Denoise pipeline that satisfies both constraints. We decouple scene and object in 3D, align them through point correspondence, and render a geometry-aligned proxy with a structural depth map. A Dual-Branch Denoising stage then refines this proxy: a video diffusion backbone preserves object identity, while 3D constraints are injected into the foreground within a narrow denoising window at matching noise variance (variance-homogeneous injection). The background denoises freely. Because the injected signal matches the native latent statistics, self-attention stays undisturbed. We also introduce GeoEditBench, a pose-aware benchmark covering object translation, object rotation, and camera movement with pose-aware evaluation metrics. Experiments confirm consistent gains in geometric accuracy, identity fidelity, and background quality. Our codes are available at https://github.com/Heey731/GeoEdit.

中文摘要翻译: 在单张照片中精确操控物体（平移、旋转、缩放）同时遵循3D物理约束，对于基于扩散的编辑工具而言仍是一个未解决的问题。当前的2D方法缺乏空间感知能力，会产生透视违和。将结构代理强行注入潜在空间也会破坏方差同质性，由此导致的自注意力泄漏会引起重影和背景模糊。核心困难在于非对称性：被重定位的物体必须遵循刚性几何，而暴露的背景区域需要自由地合成合理的内容。我们提出了GeoEdit，一种无需训练的Lift-Manipulate-Render-Denoise（提升-操控-渲染-去噪）管线，可同时满足这两个约束。我们在3D空间中将场景和物体解耦，通过点对应关系将它们对齐，并渲染带有结构深度图的几何对齐代理。随后，一个双分支去噪阶段对该代理进行精炼：视频扩散主干保持物体身份，而3D约束通过匹配的噪声方差在窄去噪窗口内注入到前景区域（方差同质注入）。背景则自由地去噪。由于注入的信号与原始的潜在统计特性相匹配，自注意力机制保持不受干扰。我们还引入了GeoEditBench，一个包含物体平移、物体旋转和相机运动且带有姿态感知评估指标的基准测试集。实验证实了在几何精度、身份保真度和背景质量方面的一致提升。我们的代码可从 https://github.com/Heey731/GeoEdit 获取。

</details>


### [187] [SkelEM: Training-Signal Decoupling of Skeleton and Diffusion for Self-supervised Axial Super-Resolution in Volume Microscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30012)
*Bohao Chen,Yanchao Zhang,Yanan Lv,Chenxun Deng,Hua Han,Xi Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SkelEM，一种自监督轴向超分辨率框架，通过将低频拓扑与高频细节解耦训练，利用循环一致性机制从稀疏切片中提取真实域残差先验，仅需≤5步扩散即可实现高保真细节恢复，并在新基准BRAVE-ASR上验证了跨仪器泛化能力。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有自监督轴向超分辨率方法面临三重困境：回归模型导致纹理过度平滑、纯扩散模型产生结构性幻觉、推理延迟过高。亟需一种能兼顾保真度与感知质量且推理高效的方案。

Method: SkelEM采用解耦训练信号策略：一个冻结的拓扑网络负责低频结构建模，一个扩散精炼器负责高频细节增强，两者由不相交的目标函数优化。在此基础上，利用统一循环一致性机制从输入稀疏切片中提取真实域残差先验，双向对齐扩散精炼器以消除跨平面伪影，并通过该物理先验截断逆扩散过程，仅需≤5步即可完成高保真细节恢复。

Result: 在公开基准上，SkelEM在自监督方法中实现了保真度-感知质量权衡的最佳平衡，在下游膜分割任务上达到最先进性能，并在不同模态间展现出鲁棒的零样本泛化能力。此外，本文还构建了BRAVE-ASR基准用于跨仪器泛化评估。

Conclusion: SkelEM通过训练信号层面的解耦设计，有效突破了自监督轴向超分辨率的三重困境，在保证结构真实性的同时实现了高效的高频细节恢复，并具备良好的跨模态零样本泛化能力。

Original Abstract: Volume microscopy, including electron and light microscopy, suffers from severe anisotropic resolution due to physical axial sectioning. Existing self-supervised axial super-resolution (ASR) methods face a trilemma bounded by overly smoothed regression textures, structural hallucinations of pure diffusion models, and prohibitive inference latency. In this paper, we propose Skeleton-refinE Microscopy (SkelEM), a self-supervised framework that decouples ASR at the training-signal level: a frozen topological network and a diffusion refiner are optimized by disjoint objectives, separating low-frequency topology formulation from high-frequency detail enhancement. Building on this deterministic skeleton, we exploit a unified cycle-consistent mechanism on input sparse slices to simultaneously extract a real-domain residual prior and bidirectionally align the diffusion refiner, washing away cross-plane artifacts without synthetic bias. By truncating the reverse diffusion process with this physical prior, SkelEM achieves high-fidelity detail restoration in merely $\le 5$ steps. To rigorously assess cross-instrument generalization, we further introduce BRAVE-ASR, a new benchmark of co-aligned anisotropic and isotropic volumes acquired on a Plasma-FIB instrument. Across public benchmarks, SkelEM achieves the most favorable balance across the fidelity-perception trade-off among self-supervised methods, with state-of-the-art downstream membrane segmentation performance and robust zero-shot generalization across distinct modalities.

中文摘要翻译: 体积显微镜（包括电子显微镜和光学显微镜）由于物理轴向切片而遭受严重的各向异性分辨率问题。现有的自监督轴向超分辨率（ASR）方法面临三重困境：过度平滑的回归纹理、纯扩散模型的结构性幻觉以及 prohibitive 的推理延迟。本文提出SkelEM（Skeleton-refinE Microscopy），一种自监督框架，在训练信号层面解耦ASR：一个冻结的拓扑网络和一个扩散精炼器由不相交的目标函数优化，将低频拓扑建模与高频细节增强分离。在此确定性骨架基础上，我们利用统一的循环一致性机制对输入稀疏切片进行处理，同时提取真实域残差先验并双向对齐扩散精炼器，从而消除跨平面伪影而不引入合成偏差。通过用该物理先验截断逆扩散过程，SkelEM仅需≤5步即可实现高保真细节恢复。为严格评估跨仪器泛化能力，我们进一步引入了BRAVE-ASR，一个基于Plasma-FIB仪器采集的共对齐各向异性与各向同性体积的新基准。在公开基准上，SkelEM在自监督方法中实现了保真度-感知质量权衡的最佳平衡，在下游膜分割任务上达到最先进性能，并在不同模态间展现出鲁棒的零样本泛化能力。

</details>


### [188] [Shell-Supervised Gaussian Splatting for Urban Real-to-Sim Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30014)
*Yuan Yang,Peijun Lu,Fangzhou Lu,Sai Fan,Siqi Yan,Chenyuan Zhang,Haobo Liang,Yichen Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出壳监督高斯泼溅（Shell-Supervised Gaussian Splatting），利用外部立面结构壳作为轻量几何监督，改善近距离城市立面视频到3D重建中玻璃、反射、重复窗户等弱纹理区域的表面几何质量，同时保持逼真的渲染效果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有视频到3D重建方法在近距离城市立面场景中效果不佳，玻璃、反射、重复窗户和弱纹理区域虽然能生成视觉上可信的渲染，但表面几何不稳定，无法满足具身AI中碰撞推理、导航和智能体-环境交互对几何精度的需求。

Method: 提出壳监督高斯泼溅框架：将外部立面结构壳对齐到视频重建帧，渲染每视图深度图、相机空间法线图和有效掩膜图，在3D高斯优化过程中通过掩膜门控损失（mask-gated losses）施加监督，仅对壳支持的可见立面区域进行正则化，保留RGB驱动的外观重建能力。

Result: 在匿名的近距离城市立面场景实验中，相比纯RGB、单目提示和表面导向的高斯泼溅基线方法，该方法在立面朝向一致性和可见表面点云一致性上取得改进，同时保持可比的留出视图渲染质量。

Conclusion: 通过引入外部结构壳作为轻量几何监督，能够在保持渲染质量的同时有效改善弱纹理城市立面区域的几何重建精度，为具身AI提供更可靠的几何表示。

Original Abstract: Real-to-sim reconstruction for embodied AI requires geometry that is useful for collision reasoning, navigation, and agent-environment interaction, not only photorealistic novel-view synthesis. However, close-range urban facades are difficult for video-to-3D reconstruction: glass, reflections, repeated windows, and weak texture can produce visually plausible renderings with unstable surface geometry. We introduce shell-supervised Gaussian Splatting, a reconstruction-stage framework that uses an external facade structural shell as lightweight geometric supervision for video-driven Gaussian reconstruction. The method aligns an exterior shell to the video reconstruction frame, renders per-view depth, camera-space normal, and valid-mask maps, and applies these cues through mask-gated losses during Gaussian optimization. This design preserves RGB-driven appearance while regularizing only visible shell-supported facade regions. Experiments on anonymized close-range urban facade scenes show improved facade orientation and visible-surface point-cloud consistency over photo-only, monocular-cue, and surface-oriented Gaussian baselines, while maintaining comparable held-out rendering quality.

中文摘要翻译: 具身AI的真机到仿真重建不仅需要逼真的新视角合成，更需要能够用于碰撞推理、导航和智能体-环境交互的几何信息。然而，近距离城市立面场景的视频到3D重建存在困难：玻璃、反射、重复窗户和弱纹理区域虽然能产生视觉上可信的渲染，但其表面几何不稳定。本文提出了壳监督高斯泼溅，一种在重建阶段利用外部立面结构壳作为轻量几何监督的视频驱动高斯重建框架。该方法将外部结构壳对齐到视频重建帧，渲染每视图深度图、相机空间法线图和有效掩膜图，并在高斯优化过程中通过掩膜门控损失施加这些监督信号。该设计在保留RGB驱动外观重建的同时，仅对壳支持的可见立面区域进行正则化。在匿名的近距离城市立面场景实验表明，与纯RGB、单目提示和表面导向的高斯泼溅基线方法相比，该方法在立面朝向一致性和可见表面点云一致性上取得改进，同时保持可比的留出视图渲染质量。

</details>


### [189] [Monte Carlo Energy Aggregation for Mobile 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30017)
*Xiaobiao Du,YuAn Wang,Hao Li,Bosheng Wang,Xun Sun,Xin Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Flux-GS提出了一种面向移动平台的高效3D高斯泼溅方法，通过蒙特卡洛能量聚合器、属性条件SH增强模块和多视图Alpha剪枝策略，在显著降低参数量的同时保持高保真渲染质量。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 高阶球谐函数带来的大量推理和存储开销是3D高斯泼溅在移动平台部署的主要瓶颈，现有方法难以在资源受限设备上实现实时高质量渲染。

Method: (1) 蒙特卡洛镜面能量聚合器：采样三阶辐射残差，将镜面能量压缩到紧凑潜空间；(2) 属性条件SH增强模块：基于高斯内在属性预测偏移量，增强一阶SH表示；(3) 多视图Alpha剪枝与稠化策略：利用多视图指导确保结构一致性并精确移除冗余高斯体。

Result: 大幅减少参数量，同时保持具有竞争力的视觉质量，为移动端实时渲染提供了鲁棒且可扩展的解决方案。

Conclusion: Flux-GS通过三种创新设计有效解决了高阶SH带来的开销问题，在移动平台上实现了高保真实时渲染，代码已开源。

Original Abstract: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting have demonstrated unprecedented success in novel view synthesis. However, the substantial inference and storage overhead driven by high-order Spherical Harmonics (SH) are primary bottlenecks for mobile platforms. In this paper, we present Flux-GS, a real-time Gaussian Splatting method designed to achieve high-fidelity rendering with significantly reduced overhead for resource-constrained mobile platforms. We first propose a Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator, sampling third-order radiance residuals and aggregating specular energy into a compact latent space. In this way, our method effectively preserves visually salient lighting features in lower-order bands without expensive distillation or pre-training. To mitigate the high-frequency details lost during compression, we introduce an Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement module. This module predicts Gaussian-aware offsets based on intrinsic Gaussian attributes, which enhance the first-order SH representation prior to inference, without extra inference costs. Furthermore, the original single-view gradient-based densification is prone to producing excessive Gaussians and overfitting to a certain view. We address these limitations by proposing a Multi-view Alpha-based Densification and Pruning strategy. By leveraging multi-view guidance, we ensure multi-view structure consistency and the precise removal of redundant primitives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Flux-GS achieves substantial parameter reduction while maintaining competitive visual quality, offering a robust and scalable solution for real-time mobile rendering. Code: \textcolor{magenta}{\href{https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/flux-gs-project/}{https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/flux-gs-project/}}.

中文摘要翻译: 近期3D高斯泼溅技术的进展在新视角合成中取得了前所未有的成功。然而，高阶球谐函数所带来的巨大推理和存储开销是移动平台的主要瓶颈。本文提出Flux-GS，一种专为资源受限移动平台设计的实时高斯泼溅方法，在显著降低开销的同时实现高保真渲染。我们首先提出蒙特卡洛镜面能量聚合器，通过采样三阶辐射残差并将镜面能量聚合到紧凑潜空间中。该方法无需昂贵的蒸馏或预训练，即可有效保留低阶频带中的视觉显著光照特征。为缓解压缩过程中丢失的高频细节，我们引入了属性条件SH增强模块。该模块基于高斯内在属性预测高斯感知偏移量，在推理前增强一阶SH表示，且不引入额外推理成本。此外，原始的单视图梯度稠化容易产生过多高斯体并过拟合特定视角。我们提出多视图Alpha剪枝与稠化策略来克服这些局限。通过多视图引导，我们确保了多视图结构一致性并精确移除冗余图元。大量实验表明，Flux-GS在保持具有竞争力的视觉质量的同时实现了显著的参数减少，为移动端实时渲染提供了鲁棒且可扩展的解决方案。代码：\textcolor{magenta}{\href{https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/flux-gs-project/}{https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/flux-gs-project/}}。

</details>


### [190] [OmniDance: Multimodal Driven Dance Video Generation with Large-scale Internet Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30019)
*Kaixing Yang,Jiashu Zhu,Xulong Tang,Ziqiao Peng,Xiangyue Zhang,Chubin Chen,Puwei Wang,Jiahong Wu,Xiangxiang Chu,Hongyan Liu,Jun He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CIPE-Dance大规模舞蹈视频数据集（30万片段/400小时）和OmniDance框架，通过深度感知专业化架构、锚定易到难课程学习策略及模态专有时变CFG策略，将音乐作为互补条件融入文本到视频基础模型，实现文本到视频、音乐到视频及多模态到视频的统一生成，达到SOTA性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有音乐驱动舞蹈视频生成面临两大局限：缺乏大规模高质量舞蹈视频数据集，以及缺乏将音乐作为互补条件信号融入视频生成基础模型的原则性框架。

Method: 1) 构建CIPE-Dance数据集：通过渐进式专家流水线，从互联网收集30万个高质量舞蹈视频片段（超400小时），涵盖多样舞者、环境及舞种，并带有编舞感知的文本标注。2) 提出OmniDance框架：设计深度感知专业化架构、锚定易到难课程学习策略、模态专有时变无分类器引导策略，将音乐作为高频时域动态信号与文本低频语义互补，集成到文本到视频基础模型中。

Result: 在CIPE-Dance数据集上的大量实验表明，OmniDance在文本到视频、音乐到视频及多模态到视频三个任务上均达到SOTA性能，展现出鲁棒的多模态融合能力。

Conclusion: 通过大规模数据集和原则性框架，有效解决了音乐驱动舞蹈视频生成中数据不足和模态融合缺乏理论指导的问题，实现了高质量、多模态可控的舞蹈视频生成。

Original Abstract: Music-driven dance video generation aims to synthesize expressive human motion that is temporally aligned with music while maintaining high visual fidelity. Despite recent progress, existing methods still face two key limitations: the lack of large-scale, high-quality dance video datasets, and the absence of principled frameworks for integrating music as a complementary conditioning signal into Video Generation Foundation Models. To address these limitations, we introduce CIPE-Dance, a large-scale Internet-sourced dance video dataset with choreography-informed text annotations, constructed via a progressive expert pipeline. To the best of our knowledge, CIPE-Dance is the largest dataset for dance video generation to date, comprising 300k high-quality clips over 400 hours and covering diverse dancers, environments, and dance genres. We further propose OmniDance, a framework-level recipe for integrating music into a TI2V foundation model without sacrificing its original controllability or visual fidelity. Motivated by the complementary roles of text as low-frequency semantics and music as high-frequency temporal dynamics, OmniDance co-designs a depth-aware specialization architecture, an anchored easy-to-hard curriculum learning strategy, and a modality-specialized time-dependent CFG strategy, enabling unified TI2V, MI2V, and MTI2V generation. Extensive experiments on CIPE-Dance demonstrate that OmniDance achieves state-of-the-art performance across all three tasks and exhibits robust multimodal integration capability. Project is available at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/OmniDance.

中文摘要翻译: 音乐驱动的舞蹈视频生成旨在合成与音乐在时间上对齐、同时保持高视觉保真度的富有表现力的人体运动。尽管近期取得了进展，现有方法仍面临两个关键局限：缺乏大规模高质量的舞蹈视频数据集，以及缺乏将音乐作为互补条件信号融入视频生成基础模型的原则性框架。为解决这些局限，我们提出了CIPE-Dance——一个大规模互联网来源的舞蹈视频数据集，带有编舞感知的文本标注，通过渐进式专家流水线构建。据我们所知，CIPE-Dance是目前最大的舞蹈视频生成数据集，包含超过400小时的30万高质量片段，覆盖多样的舞者、环境和舞蹈类型。我们进一步提出OmniDance，一个用于将音乐融入文本到视频基础模型的框架级方案，且不牺牲其原有的可控性或视觉保真度。受文本作为低频语义与音乐作为高频时域动态的互补角色启发，OmniDance联合设计了深度感知专业化架构、锚定易到难课程学习策略以及模态专有时变无分类器引导策略，实现了统一文本到视频、音乐到视频以及多模态到视频的生成。在CIPE-Dance上的大量实验表明，OmniDance在所有三个任务上均达到最先进水平，并展现出鲁棒的多模态融合能力。项目链接：https://github.com/AMAP-ML/OmniDance。

</details>


### [191] [Uncertainty Estimation in Pathology Foundation Models via Deep Mutual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30020)
*Gbègninougbo Aurel Davy Tchokponhoue,Sevda Öğüt,Ali Idri,Dorina Thanou,Pascal Frossard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DICE框架，通过集成多个冻结的病理基础模型并建模其分歧作为不确定性估计，实现可靠预测、异常定位，并提升分类与校准性能，推动PFM向临床不确定性感知决策系统转化。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 病理基础模型（PFM）在全切片图像分析中表现优异，但其预测缺乏可靠的置信度估计，且单一PFM无法在所有任务上通用，严重削弱了在医疗场景中的信任度。

Method: 提出DICE框架，集成K个冻结的PFM，通过深度互学习对齐集成成员，理论上证明该目标上界约束模型不确定性，并以集成成员的分歧作为不确定性估计的代理；同时利用集成的共识在无监督下实现斑块级异常定位。

Result: 在三个具有挑战性的WSI基准上，DICE提供了可靠的不确定性估计，能在分布内和分布外设置下准确标记易失败病例，同时在分类、校准和定位任务上达到或超越SOTA基线。

Conclusion: DICE框架是推动病理基础模型向不确定性感知临床决策支持系统转化的关键一步。

Original Abstract: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) offer generalizable representations for whole-slide image (WSI) analysis, yet their clinical adoption remains limited. Specifically, their predictions lack reliable confidence estimates, and no single PFM is universally best across tasks, which severely undermines trust in medical settings. To overcome this, we propose $\mathtt{DICE}$, a plug-and-play framework that ensembles $K$ frozen PFMs and models their disagreement as a proxy for uncertainty estimation. To ensure this proxy yields meaningful estimates, we align the ensemble members via deep mutual learning, and theoretically show that this objective upper-bounds the model uncertainty. Additionally, we demonstrate that the ensemble's consensus localizes abnormalities at the patch level without any explicit supervision. We evaluate $\mathtt{DICE}$ on three challenging WSI benchmarks. Notably, our framework provides reliable uncertainty estimates that accurately flag failure-prone cases under in- and out-of-distribution settings, while matching or outperforming SOTA baselines in classification, calibration, and localization. Overall, $\mathtt{DICE}$ takes a crucial step toward translating PFMs into uncertainty-aware decision-support systems.

中文摘要翻译: 病理基础模型（PFM）为全切片图像（WSI）分析提供了可泛化的表示，但其临床应用仍然有限。具体而言，它们的预测缺乏可靠的置信度估计，且没有单一的PFM能在所有任务上普遍最优，这严重削弱了在医疗环境中的信任度。为解决这一问题，我们提出了$\mathtt{DICE}$，一个即插即用的框架，它集成$K$个冻结的PFM，并以它们之间的分歧作为不确定性估计的代理。为确保该代理能产生有意义的估计，我们通过深度互学习对齐集成成员，并从理论上证明该目标函数对模型不确定性进行了上界约束。此外，我们证明了集成的共识可以在没有任何显式监督的情况下实现斑块级别的异常定位。我们在三个具有挑战性的WSI基准上评估了$\mathtt{DICE}$。值得注意的是，我们的框架提供了可靠的不确定性估计，能够在分布内和分布外设置下准确标记易失败病例，同时在分类、校准和定位任务上达到或超越当前最优基线。总体而言，$\mathtt{DICE}$在将PFM转化为不确定性感知的决策支持系统方面迈出了关键一步。

</details>


### [192] [IBRSteG: Learning a Generalizable Steganography Framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30024)
*Fanye Kong,Hongyu Xia,Yu Zheng,Boyang Gong,Jie Zhou,Jiwen Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出IBRSteG，一种面向3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的通用隐写框架，通过引入GAS网络实现与场景无关的高斯属性嵌入，无需逐场景微调即可将秘密3D场景隐蔽地隐藏于载体场景中，在保证视觉质量的同时实现了高容量和高安全性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有3DGS隐写方法的参数生成与特定场景刚性耦合，缺乏对新场景的泛化能力，且需要在每个场景上进行微调或优化，效率低下。因此，亟需一种可泛化的3DGS隐写方法，能够跨不同场景进行无需微调的隐写嵌入。

Method: 将3D隐写建模为前馈式3D高斯嵌入过程，提出GAS（Gaussian Attributes Steganographer）网络。GAS学习与场景无关的嵌入函数，通过将秘密3D高斯点的属性注入到载体场景中，直接重建隐写场景，无需逐场景微调或优化。该方法将3D高斯转换为结构化属性，使其兼容2D学习范式，从而增强对未见3DGS场景的泛化能力。

Result: 在多个公开数据集上的大量实验表明，IBRSteG能够有效隐藏不同场景，具有高视觉质量、高容量和高安全性。

Conclusion: 提出了一种可泛化的3DGS隐写框架IBRSteG，解决了现有方法缺乏泛化性的问题，在隐写容量和安全性方面均优于现有方法。

Original Abstract: Recent advances in deep learning have notably improved steganographic message hiding. However, designing a generalizable steganographic approach for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) that can embed meaningful 3D scene content remains challenging. In this paper, we propose IBRSteG, a generalizable framework for 3DGS steganography that enables undetectable concealment of secret scenes within a steganographic scene. Unlike existing approaches whose parameter generation is rigidly coupled with the specific scene, we formulate 3D steganography as a feed-forward 3D Gaussian embedding process that generalizes across different 3DGS scenes. To realize this, we introduce GAS (Gaussian Attributes Steganographer), a network that learns a scene-independent embedding function by injecting the attributes of secret 3D Gaussian points into a cover scene, thereby directly reconstructing the steganographic scenes without per-scene finetuning or optimization. By transforming 3D Gaussian into these structured attributes, these attributes are compatible with 2D learning paradigms and benefit from their structured nature, thereby enhancing generalization to unseen 3DGS scenes. Extensive experiments on established datasets demonstrate that IBRSteG can effectively conceal different scenes with high visual quality, and achieves superior capacity and security. Code is available at https://github.com/LingXiang2023/IBRSteG.

中文摘要翻译: 深度学习的最新进展显著改进了隐写信息隐藏技术。然而，设计一种可泛化的、能够嵌入有意义的3D场景内容的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）隐写方法仍然具有挑战性。本文提出IBRSteG，一个面向3DGS隐写的通用框架，能够将秘密场景以不可检测的方式隐藏于隐写场景中。与现有方法参数生成与特定场景刚性耦合不同，我们将3D隐写建模为一个前馈式3D高斯嵌入过程，使其能够泛化到不同的3DGS场景。为此，我们引入了GAS（Gaussian Attributes Steganographer）网络，该网络通过将秘密3D高斯点的属性注入到载体场景中，学习与场景无关的嵌入函数，从而直接重建隐写场景，无需逐场景微调或优化。通过将3D高斯转换为这些结构化属性，这些属性与2D学习范式兼容并受益于其结构化特性，从而增强了对未见3DGS场景的泛化能力。在多个公开数据集上的大量实验表明，IBRSteG能够以高视觉质量有效隐藏不同场景，并实现了更高的容量和安全性。代码已开源：https://github.com/LingXiang2023/IBRSteG。

</details>


### [193] [MuseBench: Benchmarking Intent-Level Audiovisual Arts Understanding in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30026)
*Yuxuan Fan,Gyusik Seo,Jing Hao,Jaemin Cho,Mohit Bansal,Jaehong Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Musebench基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型对视听艺术的理解能力，发现最佳模型准确率仅48.29%，远低于人类专家的87.18%，揭示当前模型在创意领域存在显著差距。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基准主要衡量模型的感知识别能力，忽视了对其创作意图（为什么通过特定的创意选择来表达）的推理，而真正的艺术理解恰恰需要这种推理能力。

Method: 构建Musebench基准，包含4,016个问题，涵盖电影、静态视觉、舞台表演和游戏四大艺术领域。问题从10K+视频论文中提取，经四阶段迭代流程（快捷过滤、对抗性干扰、专家验证）生成和优化，包括单选和变选项多选两种题型。

Result: 对28个最先进多模态大语言模型进行零样本评估，最佳模型准确率仅48.29%，远低于人类专家87.18%的表现。

Conclusion: 当前多模态大语言模型在创意领域的专业理解能力与人类专家存在显著差距，艺术理解中对创作意图的推理能力是现有模型的主要短板。

Original Abstract: Audiovisual arts encompass diverse creative disciplines, including cinema, visual arts, stage performance, and game design, where artistic meaning arises from deliberate combinations of visual, auditory, and narrative elements (e.g., fear amplified through claustrophobic framing, or grief conveyed through silence and lingering close-ups). True artistic understanding extends beyond recognizing what is depicted to reasoning about why it is expressed through particular creative choices. Despite the strong progress of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), this critical aspect of artistic understanding remains underexplored, as existing benchmarks largely measure perceptual recognition while overlooking reasoning about creative intent. To address this gap, we introduce Musebench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate MLLMs on nuanced artistic understanding. It comprises 4,016 questions spanning cinematic arts, static visual arts, stage performing arts, and game arts, distilled from over 10K candidate video essays that pair professional commentary with visual demonstration. To capture the open-ended nature of artistic analysis at scale, the benchmark combines single-select and variable-option multi-select questions. All questions are generated and refined through a four-phase iterative pipeline combining shortcut filtering, adversarial distractors, and expert validation. Comprehensive zero-shot evaluation of 28 state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that even the best-performing model achieves only 48.29% accuracy, substantially below human expert performance of 87.18%, exposing a significant gap in current models' creative domain expertise.

中文摘要翻译: 视听艺术涵盖了多样的创意学科，包括电影、视觉艺术、舞台表演和游戏设计，其艺术意义来源于视觉、听觉和叙事元素的刻意组合（例如，通过幽闭的构图放大恐惧，或通过沉默和特写镜头传达悲伤）。真正的艺术理解不仅在于识别描绘了什么，更在于推理为什么通过特定的创意选择来表达。尽管多模态大语言模型取得了显著进展，但艺术理解的这一关键方面仍未得到充分探索，因为现有基准主要衡量感知识别，而忽略了对创作意图的推理。为填补这一空白，我们引入了Musebench，一个旨在评估多模态大语言模型在细微艺术理解能力上的综合基准。该基准包含4,016个问题，涵盖电影艺术、静态视觉艺术、舞台表演艺术和游戏艺术，从超过10K个候选视频论文中提炼而来，这些视频论文将专业评论与视觉演示相结合。为大规模捕捉艺术分析的开放性，该基准结合了单选题和变选项多选题。所有问题通过一个四阶段迭代流程生成和优化，该流程结合了快捷过滤、对抗性干扰项和专家验证。对28个最先进的多模态大语言模型进行的全面零样本评估显示，即使表现最好的模型也仅达到48.29%的准确率，远低于人类专家87.18%的表现，揭示了当前模型在创意领域专业知识上的显著差距。

</details>


### [194] [Cross-Modal Iteration Distillation for Robust IHD Screening: The IDNet Framework and A New Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30027)
*Yongchang Gao,Junjie Pang,Shuaiyu Yang,Yusheng Yang,Xichao Jia,Shaojie Li,Hongfei Zhang,Jia Mu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出IDNet多模态框架，通过跨模态蒸馏聚合器(CDA)融合双眼眼底图像与临床变量，在UK Biobank基准上超越现有方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 当前基于彩色眼底照相的缺血性心脏病筛查研究受限于缺乏公开基准数据集，且无法有效融合高维视网膜图像特征与低维稀疏临床变量。

Method: 提出IDNet框架，包含跨模态蒸馏聚合器(CDA)，利用可学习查询按序整合左眼、右眼和临床特征，缓解高维视觉特征与低维表格数据之间的不平衡问题；同时构建了可复现的UK Biobank基准数据集。

Result: 在UK Biobank基准上（50,410张图像，25,205名受试者），IDNet在多个基线方法中表现最优，CDA作为即插即用融合模块能持续提升多种视觉编码器的性能。

Conclusion: 提出的多模态融合框架能有效提升IHD筛查性能，CDA模块具有良好的通用性和可迁移性。

Original Abstract: Color Fundus Photography (CFP) offers a low-cost and non-invasive route for ischemic heart disease (IHD) screening, but current studies are limited by scarce public benchmarks and ineffective fusion of retinal images with sparse clinical variables. We propose IDNet, a multimodal framework with a Cross-Modal Distillation Aggregator (CDA) that uses learnable queries to sequentially integrate left-eye, right-eye, and clinical features, mitigating the imbalance between high-dimensional visual features and low-dimensional tabular inputs. We also construct a reproducible UK Biobank benchmark with open-source curation and quality-control pipelines, yielding 50,410 images from 25,205 subjects. On this benchmark, IDNet outperforms image-only, clinical-only, and several multimodal baselines, and CDA consistently improves multiple visual encoders as a plug-in fusion module.

中文摘要翻译: 彩色眼底照相(CFP)为缺血性心脏病(IHD)筛查提供了一种低成本、非侵入性的途径，但当前研究受限于缺乏公开基准数据集，且无法有效融合视网膜图像与稀疏的临床变量。我们提出IDNet，一种多模态框架，其核心是跨模态蒸馏聚合器(CDA)，通过可学习查询按序整合左眼、右眼及临床特征，缓解了高维视觉特征与低维表格输入之间的不平衡问题。我们还构建了可复现的UK Biobank基准，包含开源整理与质控流程，涵盖25,205名受试者的50,410张图像。在该基准上，IDNet优于纯图像、纯临床以及多种多模态基线方法，且CDA作为即插即用融合模块能持续提升多种视觉编码器的性能。

</details>


### [195] [CogSENet: Blind Image Deblurring with Blur-Conditioned Semantic Routing and Explicit Frequency Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30030)
*Pan Wang,Yihao Hu,Xiujin Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CogSENet，一种受鹰视觉系统启发的动态语义对齐重建框架，通过语义驱动状态空间模块、双频融合模块和连续模糊场估计，在盲图像去模糊任务上以更少参数实现最优性能，并泛化至去雾、去雨和去噪任务。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有盲图像去模糊方法难以处理真实世界中空间变化的退化问题，且缺乏区分有效纹理与伪影的语义感知能力。

Method: 方法包含三个核心模块：(1) 语义驱动状态空间模块(SDSSM)，通过可微路由实现语义感知的令牌重组，模拟鹰的主动扫视扫描以建立提示条件的长程依赖；(2) 双频融合模块(BFFB)，利用小波变换将特征分解为高低频，模拟鹰视网膜的功能分化；(3) 连续模糊场(CBF)估计，从模糊图像估计模糊场并与CLIP语义先验融合，模拟焦距适应以实现空间非均匀模糊下的自适应恢复。

Result: 在视觉质量和结构保真度上超越当前最先进去模糊方法，且参数量更少；在去雾、去雨和去噪任务上也表现良好。

Conclusion: 受鹰视觉启发的动态语义对齐框架能有效应对真实世界的空间变化退化，兼具高效性和泛化能力。

Original Abstract: Blind image deblurring demands the recovery of high-fidelity details and coherent structures from complex, unknown degradations. Current blind image deblurring methods struggle with real-world, spatially varying degradations, and lack the semantic awareness necessary to reliably differentiate valid textures from artifacts. To bridge this gap, we propose CogSENet, a dynamic, semantic-aligned reconstruction framework inspired by the eagle's visual system. By mimicking the eagle's active saccadic scanning, we devise a Semantic-Driven State Space Module (SDSSM) with semantic-aware token regrouping via differentiable routing, enabling prompt-conditioned long-range dependency modeling. To ensure physically interpretable recovery of textures and structures, a BiFreqFusionBlock (BFFB) mirrors functional differentiation of the eagle's retina by decomposing features into high and low frequencies using wavelet transforms. Finally, we estimate a continuous Blur Field (CBF) from blur image and fuse it with CLIP semantic priors to modulate the deepest latent features, emulating focal adaptation and enabling adaptive restoration under spatially non-uniform blur. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CogSENetoutperforms state-of-the-art deblurring methods in both visual quality and structural fidelity with fewer parameters, while also performing favorably on dehazing, deraining, and denoising tasks.

中文摘要翻译: 盲图像去模糊要求从复杂、未知的退化中恢复高保真细节和连贯结构。当前的盲图像去模糊方法在处理真实世界中空间变化的退化时仍然存在困难，并且缺乏必要的语义感知能力来可靠地区分有效纹理与伪影。为弥合这一差距，我们提出CogSENet——一种受鹰视觉系统启发的动态、语义对齐重建框架。通过模仿鹰的主动扫视扫描，我们设计了语义驱动状态空间模块(SDSSM)，该模块通过可微路由实现语义感知的令牌重组，从而实现提示条件的长程依赖建模。为确保纹理和结构的物理可解释恢复，双频融合模块(BFFB)通过小波变换将特征分解为高低频，模仿鹰视网膜的功能分化。最后，我们从模糊图像中估计连续模糊场(CBF)，并将其与CLIP语义先验融合，以调制最深层的潜在特征，模拟焦距适应，实现空间非均匀模糊下的自适应恢复。大量实验表明，CogSENet在视觉质量和结构保真度上以更少参数超越当前最先进的去模糊方法，同时在去雾、去雨和去噪任务上也表现良好。

</details>


### [196] [Consensus Clustering of Free-Viewing Gaze Data: New Insights into Human-Information Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30035)
*Beryl Gnanaraj,Jaya Sreevalsan-Nair,Saqib Alam Ansari,Maanasa Rajaraman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为EnsembleGaze的无监督集成学习系统，用于对自由观看眼动数据进行共识聚类，通过统计特征工程和多种聚类策略联合分析用户行为与刺激类型，揭示了注视模式中环境/焦点观看模式的区分以及用户分组的图像上下文依赖性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 自由观看眼动数据虽然丰富，但其人机信息交互（HII）模式尚未得到充分研究，现有方法缺乏对用户与刺激特征联合分析的无监督学习框架。

Method: 提出端到端无监督集成学习系统EnsembleGaze：1）基于注视点分布统计描述子进行特征工程；2）对特征向量实施多种聚类方法的共识投票，构建共关联矩阵；3）提出两种高维聚类策略——共识子空间聚类和谱双聚类，实现用户与图像的联合表征。

Result: 图像刺激分组在不同方法间高度一致，稳健地反映了环境/焦点观看模式区分；用户分组则依赖于图像上下文，只有双聚类和两步条件方法能恢复该结构。不同数据集呈现特定模式，各聚类策略提供互补性洞察。

Conclusion: EnsembleGaze为场景感知研究中注视行为的无监督分析提供了可复现方法，双聚类方法在捕捉用户分组的图像上下文依赖性方面具有独特架构优势。

Original Abstract: Free-viewing gaze data provides a rich, task-free window into human visual attention. Conventional exploratory data analysis of the data provides user attention patterns through fixations and areas of interest. However, despite the richness of this gaze data, its human-information interaction (HII) patterns are understudied. We address this gap using consensus clustering of gaze data with respect to users and stimulus characteristics. We present a novel end-to-end unsupervised ensemble learning system for consensus clustering of free-viewing gaze datasets, EnsembleGaze. With a goal of characterizing the user behavior and stimulus type, we propose a feature engineering step based on statistical descriptors of fixation-based distributions. EnsembleGaze involves consensus voting of selected clustering methods implemented on the feature vector to compute the co-association matrix. Using the separate consensus clustering of users and stimuli as a baseline, we further propose two high-dimensional clustering strategies for determining gaze clusters based on joint user and image characterization. They are consensus subspace clustering and spectral biclustering. Clustering performance is evaluated using selected standard metrics and is further interpreted through image-level properties. Our system provides a replicable method for the unsupervised analysis of fixation behavior in scene perception research. Our results show that image stimuli groupings are highly consistent across methods, reflecting a robust ambient-versus-focal viewing mode distinction, whereas user groupings are image-context-dependent, a structure that only biclustering and the two-step conditional approaches are architecturally capable of recovering. Testing on the publicly available datasets revealed dataset-specific patterns, with each offering complementary insights through distinct clustering strategies.

中文摘要翻译: 自由观看眼动数据为人类视觉注意提供了一个丰富且无需特定任务的窗口。传统探索性数据分析通过注视点和感兴趣区域提供用户注意模式。然而，尽管这类眼动数据丰富，其中的人机信息交互（HII）模式仍未得到充分研究。我们通过基于用户和刺激特征对眼动数据进行共识聚类来填补这一空白。本文提出了一种新颖的端到端无监督集成学习系统——EnsembleGaze，用于自由观看眼动数据集的共识聚类。以表征用户行为和刺激类型为目标，我们提出了一种基于注视点分布统计描述子的特征工程步骤。EnsembleGaze通过对选定的聚类方法在特征向量上实施共识投票，计算共关联矩阵。以用户和刺激的独立共识聚类作为基线，我们进一步提出了两种基于用户与图像联合表征的高维聚类策略，即共识子空间聚类和谱双聚类。聚类性能通过选定的标准指标进行评估，并通过图像级属性进行解释。我们的系统为场景感知研究中注视行为的无监督分析提供了一种可复现的方法。结果表明，图像刺激分组在不同方法间高度一致，稳健地反映了环境/焦点观看模式的区分；而用户分组则依赖于图像上下文，这种结构只有双聚类和两步条件方法在架构上具备恢复能力。在公开数据集上的测试揭示了数据集特定的模式，不同的聚类策略提供了互补性的洞察。

</details>


### [197] [Walking in the Implicit: Interactive World Exploration via Neural Scene Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30045)
*Zhiqi Li,Chengrui Dong,Zhenhua Du,Hangning Zhou,Cong Qiu,Hailong Qin,Mu Yang,Dongxu Wei,Peidong Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种以场景为中心的交互式视频生成范式，将帧级潜变量滚动替换为固定长度的可渲染隐式状态（NIS），通过分解为场景状态随机转移和姿态条件渲染实现长时一致性和高效推理。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有交互式视频生成系统将状态转移与高频观测合成纠缠在一起，导致长程一致性和推理效率受限。作者希望将场景状态与观测渲染解耦，实现更可控、更一致的世界探索。

Method: 提出NeuWorld框架：(1) 基于Transformer VAE从稀疏有姿态帧学习局部锚定的神经隐式场景（NIS）；(2) 扩散Transformer根据未来相机轨迹和几何感知检索历史来演化NIS；(3) 复用VAE编码器作为统一条件编码器，将相机、参考图像和历史线索映射到同一NIS模态。

Result: 在公开的姿态视图数据上从头训练，无需预训练视频骨干网络或辅助3D重建器，实现了强长时一致性且推理效率优越。

Conclusion: 以场景为中心的隐式状态范式能有效解耦状态转移与观测合成，为交互式视频生成提供了一种更高效、更一致的替代方案。

Original Abstract: Interactive video generation systems for camera-controlled world exploration roll out growing sequences of latent video frames, entangling state transition with high-frequency observation synthesis. We propose Walking in the Implicit, a scene-centric paradigm that changes the rollout variable from frame latents to a fixed-length, renderable implicit state, termed Neural Implicit Scene (NIS). This factorizes interactive generation into stochastic transition of a compact scene state and deterministic pose-conditioned rendering given the sampled state. We instantiate this paradigm as NeuWorld: a transformer VAE learns locally anchored NIS from sparse posed frames, and a diffusion transformer evolves NIS conditioned on future camera trajectories and geometry-aware retrieved history. By reusing the VAE encoder as a unified conditioner, NeuWorld maps camera, reference-image, and history cues into the same NIS modality, avoiding external heterogeneous encoders. Trained from scratch on public posed-view data without pretrained video backbones or auxiliary 3D reconstructors, NeuWorld achieves strong long-horizon consistency with favorable inference efficiency.

中文摘要翻译: 用于相机控制世界探索的交互式视频生成系统会滚动生成不断增长的潜视频帧序列，将状态转移与高频观测合成纠缠在一起。本文提出"行走于隐式空间"（Walking in the Implicit），一种以场景为中心的范式，将滚动变量从帧潜变量转变为固定长度的可渲染隐式状态，称为神经隐式场景（NIS）。该范式将交互式生成分解为紧凑场景状态的随机转移和给定采样状态下的确定性姿态条件渲染。我们以NeuWorld实例化这一范式：一个Transformer VAE从稀疏有姿态帧中学习局部锚定的NIS，一个扩散Transformer根据未来相机轨迹和几何感知检索历史来演化NIS。通过复用VAE编码器作为统一条件器，NeuWorld将相机、参考图像和历史线索映射到同一NIS模态，避免了外部异构编码器。NeuWorld在公开的姿态视图数据上从头训练，无需预训练视频骨干网络或辅助3D重建器，实现了强长时一致性且具有优越的推理效率。

</details>


### [198] [Argus: Metric Panoramic 3D Reconstruction for Indoor Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30047)
*Xi Li,Linyuan Li,Yan Wu,Tong Rao,Kai Zhang,Xinchen Hui,Cihui Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Realsee3D混合数据集（1万室内场景）和Argus前馈网络，通过学习的共视模块选择最优参考视图解决全局姿态漂移，在稀疏无序全景数据上实现SOTA的度量三维重建。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 全景数据的度量前馈三维重建尚未被充分探索，主要原因是缺乏大规模的全景RGB-D训练数据，且稀疏无序采集设置中坐标锚点选择不当会导致全局姿态漂移。

Method: 1) 构建Realsee3D混合数据集（1K真实+9K合成场景，共29.9万全景视角）；2) 提出Argus前馈网络，包含学习的共视模块以选择几何最优参考视图作为度量世界坐标系锚点；3) 将双向像素到世界映射分解为可解释子步骤，每个子步骤有监督，并引入跨坐标联合约束以增强多任务学习的几何一致性。

Result: 在Realsee3D基准上，Argus在相机姿态估计、深度估计和点云重建三项任务上均达到了最先进的度量性能。

Conclusion: 通过大规模混合数据集和精心设计的网络架构（共视模块+可解释子步骤分解与联合约束），可以有效解决全景数据稀疏无序采集下的度量三维重建问题。

Original Abstract: Metric feed-forward 3D reconstruction for panoramic data remains under-explored due to the lack of large-scale panoramic RGB-D training data.
  We present Realsee3D, a hybrid dataset of 10K indoor scenes (1K real, 9K synthetic) with 299K panoramic viewpoints and precise metric annotations,
  and Argus, a feed-forward network trained on it for metric panoramic 3D reconstruction.
  In the sparse unordered capture setting of Realsee3D,
  a poorly chosen coordinate anchor can cause global pose drift.
  Argus addresses this with a learned covisibility module that selects the geometrically optimal reference view to anchor the metric world frame.
  To further improve multi-task learning,
  we decompose the bidirectional pixel-to-world mapping into interpretable sub-steps with per-step supervision and cross-coordinate joint constraints,
  reinforcing geometric consistency across prediction branches.
  On the Realsee3D benchmark,
  Argus achieves state-of-the-art metric performance in camera pose estimation, depth estimation, and point cloud reconstruction.
  Project page: https://argus-paper.realsee.ai.

中文摘要翻译: 面向全景数据的度量前馈三维重建由于缺乏大规模全景RGB-D训练数据而尚未得到充分探索。本文提出Realsee3D，一个包含10K室内场景（1K真实、9K合成）的混合数据集，拥有29.9万个全景视角和精确的度量标注；同时提出Argus，一个在此数据集上训练的用于度量全景三维重建的前馈网络。在Realsee3D的稀疏无序采集设定下，不当的坐标锚点选择会导致全局姿态漂移。Argus通过一个学习的共视模块来解决这一问题，该模块选择几何最优的参考视图来锚定度量世界坐标系。为进一步提升多任务学习，我们将双向像素到世界的映射分解为可解释的子步骤，每个子步骤都带有逐步骤监督和跨坐标联合约束，从而增强预测分支之间的几何一致性。在Realsee3D基准上，Argus在相机姿态估计、深度估计和点云重建中均达到了最先进的度量性能。项目主页：https://argus-paper.realsee.ai。

</details>


### [199] [Bridging the Gap Between Image Restoration and Navigational Safety in Hazy Conditions: A New Visibility Estimation Metric for Maritime Surveillance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30049)
*Wentao Feng,Guobei Peng,Wengang Mao,Ryan Wen Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对现有图像去雾评估指标无法与能见度阈值建立物理可解释关联的问题，提出了一种面向能见度的去雾评估框架。该框架包含一个基于Unity3D构建的船舶模拟能见度数据集（MSVD）和一个利用目标检测精度作为中间指标的能见度评估度量，能够将去雾效果转化为可测量的能见度增益，为航行安全评估提供可解释的可靠依据。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统图像质量评估指标（如PSNR、SSIM、FSIM、FADE、NIQE）无法建立图像恢复质量与实际能见度阈值之间的物理可解释关系，导致去雾性能评估缺乏与航行安全直接关联的量化标准。

Method: 1. 利用Unity3D构建船舶模拟能见度数据集（MSVD），包含不同能见度等级下的成对有雾/清晰图像及精确能见度标注；2. 提出以目标检测精度为中间指标的去雾能见度评估度量，通过建立能见距离与检测性能之间的映射关系，将图像恢复改进转化为可量化的能见度增益。

Result: 在多种成像条件下对六种代表性去雾方法进行实验，结果表明MSVD能为不同能见度等级下的去雾性能评估提供可靠基准，所提度量能实现可解释且可靠的能见距离估计。

Conclusion: 本文提出的面向能见度的评估框架能够有效支撑航行安全与运营效率的评估，弥补了传统图像质量指标在航行安全应用中的局限性。

Original Abstract: Visibility distance is critical to maritime navigational safety because it determines the effective observation range of shipborne and shore-based monitoring systems. Under hazy conditions, degraded visual information shortens observable distance and increases navigational risks and economic losses. Although numerous image dehazing methods have been developed, conventional image quality assessment metrics, such as PSNR, SSIM, FSIM, FADE, and NIQE, cannot establish a physically interpretable relationship between restoration quality and practical visibility thresholds. To address this limitation, this work proposes a visibility-oriented evaluation framework that links dehazing performance with visible-distance estimation. First, a Maritime Simulated Visibility Dataset (MSVD) is constructed using Unity3D to simulate maritime traffic scenes under graded visibility conditions. The dataset provides paired hazy and clear images with precise visibility annotations, enabling quantitative analysis of visibility restoration. Second, a dehazing visibility evaluation metric is developed by using object detection accuracy as an intermediate indicator. By establishing a mapping between visibility distance and detection performance, the proposed metric converts image restoration improvements into measurable visibility gains. Six representative dehazing methods are evaluated using both conventional image quality metrics and the proposed visibility metric. Experimental results under different imaging conditions demonstrate that MSVD provides a reliable benchmark for evaluating dehazing performance across graded visibility levels, while the proposed metric enables interpretable and reliable visible-distance estimation, thereby supporting the assessment of navigational safety and operational efficiency.

中文摘要翻译: 能见度距离对海上航行安全至关重要，因为它决定了船载和岸基监控系统的有效观测范围。在有雾条件下，退化的视觉信息会缩短可观测距离，增加航行风险和经济损失。尽管已有大量图像去雾方法被提出，但传统的图像质量评估指标，如PSNR、SSIM、FSIM、FADE和NIQE，无法在恢复质量与实际能见度阈值之间建立物理可解释的关系。为解决这一局限性，本文提出了一种面向能见度的评估框架，将去雾性能与能见距离估计相关联。首先，利用Unity3D构建了船舶模拟能见度数据集（MSVD），模拟分级能见度条件下的海上交通场景。该数据集提供成对的有雾和清晰图像，并带有精确的能见度标注，从而能够对能见度恢复进行定量分析。其次，提出了一种以目标检测精度作为中间指标的去雾能见度评估度量。通过建立能见距离与检测性能之间的映射关系，所提议度量将图像恢复改进转化为可测量的能见度增益。使用传统的图像质量指标和所提出的能见度度量对六种代表性去雾方法进行了评估。不同成像条件下的实验结果表明，MSVD为评估不同能见度等级下的去雾性能提供了可靠的基准，而所提出的度量能够实现可解释且可靠的能见距离估计，从而支撑航行安全与运营效率的评估。

</details>


### [200] [Illuminating Unified Multimodal Model for Free-form Interleaved Text-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30054)
*Chonghuinan Wang,Zhikai Chen,Chunwei Wang,Yecong Wan,Junwei Yang,Zhixin Wang,Wei Zhang,Jiaqi Xu,Renjing Pei,Xiaohe Wu,Fan Li,Wangmeng Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ILLUME-X是一个统一的跨模态范式，通过改进数据效率、稳定训练过程和引入新评估方法，实现了高质量的文本-图像交错生成，在多项任务上超越先前模型。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 推动多模态智能发展，使生成式AI模型能够自主生成自由形式的交错文本-图像序列，解决现有统一模型在多模态交错生成任务中数据效率低和训练不稳定等问题。

Method: ILLUME-X包含三个关键组件：(i) 扩展的、针对交错文本-图像生成优化的训练数据管道；(ii) 渐进式训练策略，结合自适应目标函数以处理自由长度多模态令牌序列；(iii) 用于评估交错文本-图像序列的客观全面的评价方法ILScore。

Result: ILLUME-X在风格迁移、图像分解和故事叙述等多个交错文本-图像生成任务上优于先前的统一模型。

Conclusion: ILLUME-X通过改进数据效率、稳定训练过程和引入新评估方法，成功实现了高质量的自由形式交错文本-图像生成，为多模态智能发展提供了有效方案。

Original Abstract: The advancement of generative AI models capable of producing text and image marks a critical step forward in the realm of multimodal intelligence, particularly for tasks involving the interleaving of both modalities. To advance this intelligence to the next stage, it is crucial for models to autonomously generate free-form interleaved text-image sequences. In this paper, we introduce ILLUME-X, an advanced unified multimodal paradigm that enables high-quality, free-form interleaved text-image generation by improving multimodal data efficiency and stabilizing the multimodal training process. ILLUME-X comprises three key components: (i) an expanded training data pipeline optimized for interleaved text-image generation, (ii) a progressive training strategy with self-adaptive objectives for free-length multimodal token sequences, and (iii) an objective and comprehensive evaluation method ILScore for interleaved text-image sequences. Notably, our ILLUME-X outperforms previous unified models across multiple interleaved text-image generation tasks like style transfer, image decomposition and storytelling.

中文摘要翻译: 能够生成文本和图像的生成式AI模型的发展，标志着多模态智能领域迈出了关键一步，特别是在涉及两种模态交错的任务中。为了将这一智能推进到下一阶段，模型能够自主生成自由形式的交错文本-图像序列至关重要。在本文中，我们提出ILLUME-X，一种先进的统一多模态范式，通过改进多模态数据效率和稳定多模态训练过程，实现了高质量的自由形式交错文本-图像生成。ILLUME-X包含三个关键组件：(i) 针对交错文本-图像生成优化的扩展训练数据管道，(ii) 结合自适应目标的渐进式训练策略，用于处理自由长度的多模态令牌序列，以及(iii) 用于评估交错文本-图像序列的客观全面的评价方法ILScore。值得注意的是，我们的ILLUME-X在风格迁移、图像分解和故事叙述等多个交错文本-图像生成任务上优于先前的统一模型。

</details>


### [201] [Emergence of a Shared Canonical Object Frame from In-the-Wild Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30058)
*Tom Fischer,Martin Sundermeyer,Adam Kortylewski,Eddy Ilg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自监督方法，通过共享几何瓶颈（粗粒度规范网格）和SfM噪声相机位姿，从野外物体中心视频中自动学习公共规范坐标系，无需任何规范位姿标注，在类别级位姿估计任务上达到与有监督方法竞争的性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统方法建立物体共享规范坐标系需要人工标注，限制了类别和实例多样性的扩展，成为规模化瓶颈。本文旨在消除这一标注依赖，从无标注的野外视频中自动涌现出公共规范坐标系。

Method: 核心思想是通过一个共享的几何瓶颈（粗粒度规范网格，不携带类别特定细节）路由所有训练序列。具体包括：(1) 学习从图像像素到该网格的密集对应关系；(2) 从噪声SfM几何中估计每序列的对齐参数；(3) 利用多视图一致性和特征提取器的语义先验，使公共规范帧自然涌现，无需规范位姿标签或类别条件约束。

Result: 在160,000个野外物体视频上进行自监督训练后，该方法在类别级位姿估计基准上取得了与依赖规范位姿监督的方法相当的竞争性精度。

Conclusion: 证明了通过自监督训练和共享几何瓶颈，可以从野外视频中自动学习公共规范坐标系，有效消除了对人工标注的依赖，为可扩展的类别级位姿估计提供了新途径。

Original Abstract: Comparing object orientations and positions across different instances requires their poses to be expressed in a shared canonical frame. Establishing such frames has traditionally required manual annotation, creating a scaling bottleneck that limits category and instance diversity. We show that a shared canonical frame can instead emerge from self-supervised training on object-centric videos captured in the wild, using only noisy camera poses from Structure-from-Motion. Our key idea is to route all training sequences through a shared geometric bottleneck: a coarse canonical mesh that carries no category-specific detail. By learning dense correspondences from image pixels to this mesh, and estimating per-sequence alignments from noisy SfM geometry, a common canonical frame emerges from multi-view consistency and the semantic priors of the feature extractor, without any canonical pose labels or category conditioning. Trained in a self-supervised manner on 160,000 in-the-wild object videos, our method achieves competitive accuracy on category-level pose estimation benchmarks compared to methods that rely on canonical pose supervision. The code and checkpoint is available on https://github.com/Fischer-Tom/Emergent-Canonical-Frame/.

中文摘要翻译: 比较不同实例之间的物体朝向和位置需要将其姿态表达在共享的规范坐标系中。传统上，建立这样的坐标系需要人工标注，这造成了规模化的瓶颈，限制了类别和实例的多样性。本文证明，共享的规范坐标系可以从在野外捕获的物体中心视频的自监督训练中涌现出来，仅需使用来自运动恢复结构的含噪声相机位姿。我们的关键思想是让所有训练序列通过一个共享的几何瓶颈：一个不携带任何类别特定细节的粗粒度规范网格。通过学习从图像像素到该网格的密集对应关系，并从含噪声的SfM几何中估计每序列的对齐参数，一个公共的规范坐标系便从多视图一致性和特征提取器的语义先验中自然涌现，无需任何规范位姿标签或类别条件约束。该方法在160,000个野外物体视频上以自监督方式训练，在类别级位姿估计基准上达到了与依赖规范位姿监督的方法相当的竞争性精度。代码和模型检查点见https://github.com/Fischer-Tom/Emergent-Canonical-Frame/。

</details>


### [202] [Clinical Risk-Aware Multi-Level Grading for Coronary Artery Stenosis through Curved Feature Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30082)
*Shishuang Zhao,Hongtai Li,Junjie Hou,Yuhang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于弯曲特征重建（CFR）模块和临床风险感知（CR）损失的多级冠状动脉狭窄分级模型，融合CCTA与3D SCPR图像特征，显著提升了分级性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 单独使用CCTA或3D SCPR图像存在固有缺陷：CCTA因血管路径迂曲难以分析，3D SCPR易出现异常扭曲影响分级；且不同狭窄等级对应不同临床风险，需将这种关联融入算法。

Method: 提出弯曲特征重建（CFR）模块，以血管曲线为先验，采用逐点对应策略精准对齐并融合3D SCPR与CCTA图像特征；同时引入临床风险感知（CR）损失，将临床风险相关性融入网络训练。

Result: 在内部数据集上，所提方法显著优于其他方法；多项消融实验验证了各设计模块的有效性。

Conclusion: 融合CCTA和3D SCPR多模态特征并引入临床风险感知机制，可有效提升冠状动脉狭窄多级分级模型的性能，使其更契合临床诊断需求。

Original Abstract: Developing a multi-level grading model for coronary artery stenosis holds great clinical significance for the diagnosis of coronary artery disease. However, designing an effective multi-level deep learning algorithm faces significant challenges. Specifically, utilizing CCTA or 3D SCPR images alone presents inherent shortcomings: CCTA images are difficult to analyze due to the tortuous paths of blood vessels, while 3D SCPR images are prone to abnormal distortions that hinder accurate grading. Furthermore, different stenosis grades are associated with varying clinical risks, and incorporating this association into the algorithm is non-trivial. To address the former problems, we propose the Curved Feature Reconstruction (CFR) module, which uses vessel curves as prior and employs a point-by-point correspondence strategy to precisely align and fuse features from both 3D SCPR and CCTA images. Meanwhile, a Clinical Risk-Aware (CR) Loss is employed to introduce clinical risk relevance into the network training so that the algorithm can better align with the clinical diagnosis. The experimental results on a in-house dataset reveal that our approach significantly outperforms other methods, and several ablation studies also demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed designs.

中文摘要翻译: 开发冠状动脉狭窄的多级分级模型对于冠心病的诊断具有重要的临床意义。然而，设计有效的多级深度学习算法面临巨大挑战。具体而言，单独使用CCTA或3D SCPR图像存在固有缺陷：CCTA图像因血管路径迂曲而难以分析，而3D SCPR图像容易出现异常扭曲，从而阻碍准确分级。此外，不同狭窄等级对应不同的临床风险，将这种关联融入算法并非易事。针对前两个问题，我们提出弯曲特征重建（CFR）模块，该模块以血管曲线为先验，采用逐点对应策略精确对齐并融合3D SCPR与CCTA图像的特征。同时，采用临床风险感知（CR）损失将临床风险相关性引入网络训练，使算法能更好地与临床诊断对齐。在内部数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的方法显著优于其他方法，多项消融实验也验证了我们所提出设计的有效性。

</details>


### [203] [One Forward Beats Two: InnerZoom for Accurate and Efficient GUI Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30084)
*Chen Liu,Ling Chen,Hanzhang Zhou,Liangyu Chen,Chenglin Cai,Xin Yu,Steven Hoi,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出InnerZoom，一种无需额外前向传播的跨层证据桥接框架，通过将原始前向过程中的目标相关线索转化为紧凑的跨层证据状态，并在后续解码层中保留、精炼和重新注入该状态来指导坐标预测，从而在GUI接地任务中实现单次前向的高精度定位，同时减少端到端延迟和计算成本。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于MLLM的GUI接地方法采用自回归坐标生成方式，但诊断分析发现目标区域感知能力在中间解码层出现后未能保留到最终坐标预测中。ZoomIn风格方法虽能改进定位精度，但需要额外的外部裁剪和重新运行过程，增加了端到端延迟和计算成本。因此，需要一种既能保留两遍放大精度优势、又无需额外计算成本的方法。

Method: InnerZoom采用单次前向传播框架，通过跨层证据桥接实现：首先将原始前向过程中的目标相关线索转换为紧凑的跨层证据状态，然后在后续解码层中对该状态进行保留、精炼和重新注入，以引导坐标预测，从而在无需外部裁剪重运行的情况下实现高精度GUI接地定位。

Result: InnerZoom-4B在全部六个GUI接地基准上取得最优性能：OSWorld-G达64.7，UI-Vision达40.2，OSWorld-GR达73.1，MMBench-GUI达87.6，分别超过此前最佳结果4.1、3.2、2.9和2.3个点。在受控4B设置下，相比同SFT+RL基线平均提升5.3个点，超越两遍ZoomIn平均1.3个点，同时端到端延迟降低31.8%，TFLOPs减少约29%。

Conclusion: InnerZoom通过单次前向传播中的跨层证据桥接，有效解决了GUI接地中目标区域感知能力在解码层间流失的问题，在不增加额外计算开销的前提下实现了最先进的定位性能，验证了该方法在精度与效率之间的良好平衡。

Original Abstract: MLLM-based GUI grounding methods commonly formulate target localization as autoregressive coordinate generation, enabling models to leverage the strong instruction-following and semantic understanding capabilities of MLLMs. However, this formulation requires the model to retain region-level target evidence while decoding coordinate tokens with the spatial precision demanded by GUI clicking. Our diagnostic analysis reveals that target-region awareness emerges in intermediate decoder layers but is neither retained nor translated into the final coordinate prediction. Existing ZoomIn-style methods address this issue through an external crop-and-rerun pass, which improves localization but increases end-to-end latency and computational cost. To retain the accuracy benefits of two-pass zooming without this extra cost, we propose InnerZoom, a single-forward framework for cross-layer evidence bridging. InnerZoom transforms target-related cues from the original forward pass into a compact cross-layer evidence state, then preserves, refines, and reinjects this state throughout later decoding layers to guide coordinate prediction. Extensive experimental results suggest that InnerZoom-4B achieves state-of-the-art performance on all six GUI grounding benchmarks, obtaining 64.7 on OSWorld-G, 40.2 on UI-Vision, 73.1 on OSWorld-GR, and 87.6 on MMBench-GUI, surpassing the previous best results by 4.1, 3.2, 2.9, and 2.3 points, respectively. Under a controlled 4B setting, InnerZoom improves the same SFT+RL baseline by 5.3 points on average and outperforms two-pass ZoomIn by 1.3 points on average, while reducing end-to-end latency by up to 31.8% and TFLOPs by about 29%. Code and models will be publicly available.

中文摘要翻译: 基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的GUI接地方法通常将目标定位公式化为自回归坐标生成，使模型能够利用MLLM强大的指令遵循和语义理解能力。然而，这种公式要求模型在解码坐标令牌时保留区域级目标证据，以满足GUI点击所需的空间精度。我们的诊断分析揭示，目标区域感知能力在中间解码层出现，但既未被保留也未被转化为最终的坐标预测。现有的ZoomIn风格方法通过外部裁剪和重新运行的额外前向传递来解决这一问题，虽然提升了定位精度，但增加了端到端延迟和计算成本。为了在不增加额外成本的情况下保留两遍放大方法的精度优势，我们提出了InnerZoom，一种用于跨层证据桥接的单次前向传播框架。InnerZoom将原始前向过程中的目标相关线索转换为紧凑的跨层证据状态，然后在后续解码层中保留、精炼并重新注入该状态，以引导坐标预测。大量实验结果表明，InnerZoom-4B在所有六个GUI接地基准上均取得了最优性能，在OSWorld-G、UI-Vision、OSWorld-GR和MMBench-GUI上分别达到64.7、40.2、73.1和87.6，分别超过此前最佳结果4.1、3.2、2.9和2.3个点。在受控的4B设置下，InnerZoom相比同SFT+RL基线平均提升5.3个点，超越两遍ZoomIn平均1.3个点，同时端到端延迟降低31.8%，TFLOPs减少约29%。代码和模型将公开发布。

</details>


### [204] [LETT-NeXt: A Lightweight RECIST-Guided Model for 3D CT Lesion Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30108)
*Sebastian Aas,Elias Stenhede,Arian Ranjbar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种轻量级、RECIST引导的3D病灶分割模型LETT-NeXt，通过将RECIST直径测量信息编码为提示通道融入CT输入，实现高效准确的3D病灶掩膜预测，在CVPR 2026竞赛中取得竞争性结果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统的RECIST直径测量仅提供病灶范围的有限二维描述，缺乏三维空间信息。为了在利用RECIST临床先验知识的同时实现三维病灶分割，且满足计算资源受限场景下的轻量化需求，作者提出了LETT-NeXt模型。

Method: LETT-NeXt首先提取以RECIST为中心的区域裁剪，将RECIST线段和端点编码为两个提示通道，与CT输入拼接后送入紧凑的MedNeXt-v2编码器-解码器预测病灶掩膜，随后通过提示感知的组件选择和自适应AutoZoom推理优化分割结果。

Result: 在公开验证集上，DSC为79.4±10.1，NSD为72.3±16.2；在隐藏测试集上，DSC为73.9，NSD为67.3，挑战得分为70.6%；CPU推理每例仅需6.9±3.0秒，峰值内存仅3.6GB。

Conclusion: LETT-NeXt在保持轻量化和高效推理（CPU 6.9秒/例，3.6GB内存）的同时，实现了具有竞争力的3D病灶分割性能，验证了将RECIST临床先验有效融入深度学习模型的有效性。

Original Abstract: RECIST diameter measurements are widely used for tumor response assessment, but they provide only a limited 2D description of lesion extent. We present LETT-NeXt, a lightweight RECIST-guided model that predicts 3D lesion masks from CT volumes and RECIST markers for the CVPR 2026 Foundation Models for Pan-cancer Segmentation in CT Images competition. LETT-NeXt extracts a RECIST-centered regional crop, encodes the RECIST line and endpoints as two prompt channels, and concatenates them with the CT input. A compact MedNeXt-v2 encoder--decoder predicts the lesion mask, followed by prompt-aware component selection and adaptive AutoZoom inference. On the public validation set, LETT-NeXt achieved a Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 79.4 $\pm$ 10.1 and a Normalized Surface Dice (NSD) of 72.3 $\pm$ 16.2. On the hidden test set, it achieved a DSC of 73.9 and an NSD of 67.3, corresponding to a challenge score of 70.6\%. On the public validation mirror, LETT-NeXt completed CPU inference in 6.9 $\pm$ 3.0 s per case with a peak memory use of 3.6 GB. Code is available at github.com/Ahus-AIM/lett-next.

中文摘要翻译: RECIST直径测量被广泛用于肿瘤疗效评估，但它们仅提供病灶范围的有限二维描述。我们提出LETT-NeXt，一种轻量级RECIST引导模型，用于从CT体积和RECIST标记中预测三维病灶掩膜，面向CVPR 2026胰腺癌CT图像分割基础模型竞赛。LETT-NeXt提取以RECIST为中心的局部区域裁剪，将RECIST线段和端点编码为两个提示通道，并与CT输入拼接。一个紧凑的MedNeXt-v2编码器-解码器预测病灶掩膜，随后进行提示感知的组件选择和自适应AutoZoom推理。在公开验证集上，LETT-NeXt达到了79.4±10.1的Dice相似系数（DSC）和72.3±16.2的归一化表面Dice（NSD）。在隐藏测试集上，它达到了73.9的DSC和67.3的NSD，对应挑战得分为70.6%。在公开验证镜像上，LETT-NeXt每例CPU推理完成时间为6.9±3.0秒，峰值内存使用为3.6GB。代码已开源至github.com/Ahus-AIM/lett-next。

</details>


### [205] [SciIR: A Large-scale Training Dataset and Benchmark for Scientific Image Reasoning Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30124)
*Zhiyuan Ma,Zhengfeng Shi,Yuning An,Peize Li,Jiabao Wei,Ruijie Li,Junhao Xiao,Jianjun Li,Bowen Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了科学图像推理（SciIR）框架，包含大规模数据集SciIR-82k（8万+科学图像-文本对）和评测基准SciIR-Bench，基于皮尔斯符号学三元组（实体结构、科学过程、科学定律）对科学图像生成进行形式化推理。微调后的Qwen-Image-SciIR模型在基准上从35%提升至43%，揭示了现有模型在科学推理能力上的显著不足。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
