中文摘要翻译: 深度强化学习在机器人和自主系统中取得了显著成功，但仍易受到对抗性扰动的攻击，这会严重降低其性能。对抗性强化学习的研究往往受限于实现碎片化、评估协议不一致以及可重复性差等问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 RoAd-RL，一个开源的基准测试框架，该框架为策略、攻击、防御和鲁棒性度量提供了统一的抽象接口，同时具备可重复的评估流水线，并与 Stable-Baselines3 和 Gymnasium 实现了无缝集成。我们在 LunarLander 和 Highway-v0 环境中，对 DQN、PPO 和 SAC 智能体进行了 192 种攻防配置下的评估。结果表明，不同环境间的鲁棒性存在显著差异，且某些常用的防御方法可能比其旨在缓解的攻击更具危害性，而时间平滑方法则持续表现出强劲的性能。RoAd-RL 为对抗性强化学习研究建立了标准化的基准，并已在 https://pypi.org/project/road-rl 公开提供。

</details>


### [408] [Decision-Value Attribution in Predict-then-Optimize Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29878)
*Konstantinos Ziliaskopoulos,Alexander Vinel,Alice E. Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了决策价值归因（DVA）框架，将Shapley值应用于预测-优化流水线，以归因决策价值而非预测结果，解决了预测解释与操作决策价值不一致的问题。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 标准解释方法解释的是预测结果而非预测所诱导的决策，这在预测-优化系统中存在问题：大的预测变化可能不改变优化器动作，而小的变化却可能改变决策及其实现价值。需要一种能直接归因决策价值的框架。

Method: 提出基于Shapley值的决策价值归因（DVA）框架，定义以下游决策价值为支付函数的合作博弈。包括三个变体：InfoDVA（归因于特征）、DesignDVA（归因于操作配置）、决策价值交互（DVI，量化信息与设计共同创造的价值）。区分pre-DVA（模型完整预测下评估）和post-DVA（实际结果下评估）。

Result: 在电力存储套利和紧急医疗服务覆盖两个案例中验证：预测解释是操作价值的差代理；DVA可指导有针对性的信息-控制干预；优化配置决定了预测信息何时具有决策相关性。

Conclusion: DVA框架能将归因转化为决策层面的诊断工具，度量操作信念与实际表现是否一致，归因结果以操作目标单位表示，并分解相对于基线的增益或损失。

Original Abstract: Predictive models are increasingly embedded in operational decision-making, yet standard explanation methods typically explain forecasts rather than the decisions those forecasts induce. This distinction is important in predict-then-optimize systems: large forecast changes may leave the optimizer's action unchanged, while small changes can alter the selected decision and its realized value. We propose Decision Value Attribution (DVA), a Shapley-based framework for attributing the value of a fixed prediction--optimization pipeline. The framework defines cooperative games whose payoff is the downstream decision value, allowing the players to be information sources, optimization or design parameters, or both. We present three variants: InfoDVA attributes value to features, DesignDVA attributes value to operational configurations, and Decision-Value Interactions (DVI) quantifies how information and design jointly create value. We further distinguish post-DVA, which evaluates decisions using realized outcomes, from pre-DVA, which evaluates decisions under the model's full prediction. This separation turns attribution into a decision-level diagnostic of whether the model's operational beliefs align with realized performance. The resulting attributions are expressed in the units of the operational objective and decompose the gain or loss relative to a baseline. Case studies in electricity storage arbitrage and emergency medical service coverage show that predictive explanations can be poor proxies for operational value, that DVA can guide targeted information-control interventions, and that optimization configurations determine when predictive information is decision-relevant.

中文摘要翻译: 预测模型越来越多地嵌入到操作决策中，然而标准的解释方法通常解释的是预测结果，而非这些预测所诱导的决策。这一区别在"预测-优化"系统中尤为重要：大的预测变化可能不改变优化器的行动，而小的变化却可能改变所选决策及其实现价值。本文提出决策价值归因（DVA），一个基于Shapley值的框架，用于归因固定预测-优化流水线的价值。该框架定义了以下游决策价值为支付函数的合作博弈，允许玩家是信息源、优化或设计参数，或两者兼有。我们提出了三个变体：InfoDVA将价值归因于特征，DesignDVA将价值归因于操作配置，决策价值交互（DVI）量化信息与设计如何共同创造价值。我们进一步区分了post-DVA（使用实际结果评估决策）与pre-DVA（在模型完整预测下评估决策）。这一区分将归因转化为一个决策层面的诊断工具，用于判断模型的操作信念是否与实际表现一致。所得归因以操作目标为单位表示，并分解相对于基线的增益或损失。在电力存储套利和紧急医疗服务覆盖的案例研究中表明，预测解释可能是操作价值的差代理，DVA可以指导有针对性的信息-控制干预，并且优化配置决定了预测信息何时具有决策相关性。

</details>


### [409] [Same Concept, Different Directions: Cross-Modal Feature Heterogeneity in Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29888)
*Chungpa Lee,Jihoon Kwon,Kyle Min,Jy-yong Sohn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现视觉-语言模型的联合嵌入空间中存在跨模态特征异质性（即同一概念在不同模态下特征方向不一致），并据此提出训练模态特定的稀疏自编码器分别保留各模态特征几何结构，再事后对齐对应特征，从而提升重构保真度及跨模态检索与概念操控性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有稀疏自编码器应用于联合嵌入空间时隐含假设了跨模态的语义对应特征共享相同方向，但这一假设未经验证且可能不成立，导致模态分裂等问题——同一概念在不同模态下激活不同隐变量，单纯对齐隐层激活不足以解决特征不匹配。

Method: 提出训练模态特定的稀疏自编码器（modality-specific SAE），分别保留图像和文本模态各自的特征几何结构，然后通过事后（post hoc）对齐方式将对应的跨模态特征进行匹配。

Result: 揭示了跨模态特征异质性是模态分裂的关键驱动因素；证明了仅对齐激活值无法解决底层特征不匹配；所提方法在重构保真度、跨模态检索和概念操控任务上均取得更优性能。

Conclusion: 跨模态特征异质性真实存在且影响显著，模态特定的稀疏自编码器加事后对齐能有效缓解该问题，为可解释、可控的视觉-语言模型提供了新思路。

Original Abstract: Vision-language models map images and text into a joint embedding space. However, these embeddings often entangle multiple semantic features, which limits their interpretability and controllability. While sparse autoencoders have emerged as a useful tool for decomposing these embeddings into monosemantic features, their application to joint embedding spaces has largely relied on an implicit, untested assumption that semantically corresponding features share the same directions across modalities. In this paper, we challenge this assumption by identifying discrepancies in feature directions for the same concept across image and text modalities, a phenomenon we term cross-modal feature heterogeneity. We demonstrate that this heterogeneity is a key driver of the modality split, where a shared concept activates different latents depending on the modality. This finding further reveals why aligning latent activations alone is insufficient to resolve the underlying feature mismatch. Motivated by this observation, we propose an approach that trains modality-specific sparse autoencoders to preserve each modality's feature geometry, and then aligns corresponding features post hoc. Our method improves reconstruction fidelity and enhances performance in cross-modal retrieval and concept steering.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉-语言模型将图像和文本映射到联合嵌入空间中。然而，这些嵌入常常纠缠多种语义特征，限制了其可解释性和可控性。尽管稀疏自编码器已成为将这些嵌入分解为单语义特征的有效工具，但其在联合嵌入空间中的应用大多依赖一个隐含且未经检验的假设：语义对应的特征在不同模态间共享相同方向。在本文中，我们挑战了这一假设，发现了同一概念在图像和文本模态下特征方向存在差异的现象，我们称之为跨模态特征异质性。我们证明这种异质性是模态分裂的关键驱动因素——即一个共享概念会根据模态不同激活不同的隐变量。这一发现进一步揭示了为什么仅对齐隐层激活不足以解决底层的特征不匹配。受此观察启发，我们提出了一种方法：训练模态特定的稀疏自编码器以保留各模态的特征几何结构，然后事后对齐对应的特征。我们的方法提升了重构保真度，并在跨模态检索和概念操控任务中增强了性能。

</details>


### [410] [Golden Hour Divide: Trauma Care Accessibility and Resource Vulnerability in Sri Lanka](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29889)
*Sonath Kirindage,Vihanga Nimsara,Sakindu Rajapaksa,Kavyanga Hathurusinghe,Lahiru Dilshan,Subavarshana Arumugam,Nathali Athukorala,Sandareka Wickramanayake,Nisansa de Silva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究利用H3六边形建模和K-Means聚类，将斯里兰卡25个地区按急诊医疗韧性分为四类政策行动原型，发现北部和东部省份空间缺口超过70%，黄金时间无法实现，且专科医生短缺比床位不足更关键。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 斯里兰卡急救基础设施分布不均，院前服务虽有扩展但向确定性治疗的过渡存在瓶颈，亟需量化评估全国急诊韧性。

Method: 基于最新全国流行病学数据和地形感知H3六边形建模，分析七种危重疾病的空间缺口、临床需求缺口、致死率、覆盖率和资源可用性；再采用无监督K-Means聚类将各地区分为四种政策行动原型。

Result: 北部和东部省份空间缺口超过70%，黄金时间操作上不可实现；专科医生稀缺比床位不足造成的系统性压力更大；对高优先级集群提升25%的可及性可使全国需求缺口降低9.65%。

Conclusion: 欠发达地区实质上是"制度幻象"；战略性重新配置专科医生是实现医疗公平的关键路径。

Original Abstract: Timely intensive care dictates survival, yet emergency infrastructure remains unevenly distributed across Sri Lanka. While pre-hospital services have expanded, the transition to definitive care remains a critical bottleneck. This study evaluates national emergency resilience by quantifying the gap between clinical demand and the availability of specialized resources across all 25 districts. Using the latest national epidemiological data and terrain-aware H3 hexagonal modeling, we analyzed accessibility for seven critical conditions based on spatial gaps, clinical need-gaps, lethality, coverage, and resource availability. Based on these metrics, unsupervised K-Means clustering was applied to categorize districts into four policy-actionable archetypes: Critical Structural Exclusion, Institutional Mirages, Operational Capacity Strain, and High-Resilience Benchmarks. Our study suggests that severe service deficits exist in the Northern and Eastern provinces, where spatial gaps exceed 70%, rendering the Golden Hour operationally impossible. Notably, specialist scarcity drives systemic pressure more than bed capacity; underserved regions effectively function as institutional mirages. This study suggests that improving accessibility by 25% in high-priority clusters would reduce the national need-gap by 9.65%, providing a roadmap for the strategic redistribution of specialists to ensure healthcare equity.

中文摘要翻译: 及时的危重症护理决定着患者的生存，然而斯里兰卡的急救基础设施分布仍然不均衡。尽管院前服务已经有所扩展，向确定性治疗的过渡仍然是关键瓶颈。本研究通过量化所有25个地区的临床需求与专业资源可用性之间的差距，评估了全国的急诊韧性。利用最新的全国流行病学数据和地形感知的H3六边形建模，我们基于空间缺口、临床需求缺口、致死率、覆盖率和资源可用性，分析了七种危重疾病的可及性。基于这些指标，应用无监督K-Means聚类将各地区划分为四种政策行动原型：关键结构性排斥、制度幻象、运营能力紧张和高韧性基准。我们的研究表明，北部和东部省份存在严重的服务缺陷，空间缺口超过70%，使得"黄金时间"在操作上无法实现。值得注意的是，专科医生的稀缺比床位不足带来的系统性压力更大；欠发达地区实质上是"制度幻象"。本研究表明，在高优先级集群中提高25%的可及性将使全国需求缺口降低9.65%，为战略性重新配置专科医生以保障医疗公平提供了路线图。

</details>


### [411] [CW-B: Class Weighted Boosting Framework for Imbalance Resilient Multi Class Cardiac Phenotyping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29907)
*Sijia Li,Xiaoyu Tan,Chen Zhan,Yuanji Ma,Haoyu Wang,Xihe Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CW-B是一种针对真实世界心脏出院表型分类的类别加权XGBoost管道，通过折叠级类别平衡实例加权、缺失指示器增强和类别级错误审计，在不平衡和缺失数据下实现了更优的五分类性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 真实世界的心脏出院记录往往不完整且存在类别不平衡问题，增加了漏诊高风险表型的风险，现有方法对此关注不足。

Method: 提出CW-B管道，包括：(1) 折叠级类别平衡实例加权；(2) 缺失指示器增强；(3) 类别级错误审计，以改进临床优先级表型的识别，同时保持可解释和可审计的决策逻辑。

Result: 在五折分层交叉验证中，CW-B在Accuracy、Macro-F1、Balanced Accuracy和Prioritized F1指标上均优于基于树、集成和神经网络的基线方法。

Conclusion: CW-B提供了一种实用且面向部署的方法，能够在真实临床环境中实现更可靠的心脏出院表型分类。

Original Abstract: Cardiac discharge phenotyping informs post-discharge treatment and follow-up, but real-world records are often incomplete and class-imbalanced, increasing the risk of missed high-risk phenotypes. We propose CW-B, a clinical risk-aligned class-weighted XGBoost pipeline for five-class cardiac discharge phenotyping under real-world class imbalance and missingness. CW-B combines fold-specific class-balanced instance weighting, missingness-indicator augmentation, and classwise error auditing to improve recognition of clinically prioritized phenotypes while preserving interpretable and auditable decision logic. In five-fold stratified cross-validation, CW-B achieves the best Accuracy, Macro-F1, Balanced Accuracy, and Prioritized F1 among tree-based, ensemble, and neural baselines. Overall, CW-B provides a practical and deployment-oriented approach for more reliable cardiac discharge phenotyping in real-world clinical settings.

中文摘要翻译: 心脏出院表型分型有助于指导出院后治疗和随访，但真实世界记录往往不完整且存在类别不平衡，增加了漏诊高风险表型的风险。我们提出CW-B，一种临床风险对齐的类别加权XGBoost管道，用于在真实世界的类别不平衡和缺失数据下进行五类心脏出院表型分类。CW-B结合了折叠级类别平衡实例加权、缺失指示器增强和类别级错误审计，以提高临床优先级表型的识别能力，同时保持可解释和可审计的决策逻辑。在五折分层交叉验证中，CW-B在准确率、宏F1分数、平衡准确率和优先级F1分数上均优于基于树、集成和神经网络的基线方法。总体而言，CW-B为真实临床环境中更可靠的心脏出院表型分类提供了一种实用且面向部署的方法。

</details>


### [412] [EVAF: A Test-Retest Protocol for Selective Parametric Consolidation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29916)
*Haoliang Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EVAF机制，通过门控LoRA整合实现语言代理的选择性经验固化，并设计测试-重测协议量化参数记忆的持久性，实验表明高价高意外经验被优先固化，且记忆存取与内化是两种不同的计算操作。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 长期运行的语言代理需要一种机制来决定在工作上下文消失后哪些经验应该持续存在。现有的检索系统可以重新插入过往文本，但无法表明经验已被选择性地整合到模型自身行为中。

Method: 提出Echo-Valence Attractor Field (EVAF) 机制，采用门控LoRA整合实现选择性参数固化；同时设计测试-重测协议，在受控干扰下测量选择性参数固化的程度。

Result: 在GPT-2和TinyLlama上，EVAF优先固化高价值、高意外性的经验，同时通过互补的路由记忆路径保留可检索的事实记忆。测试-重测测量显示，相比冻结基线、仅检索基线和无门控持续更新基线，EVAF具有更强的干扰后行为持久性，同时保持较低的参数漂移和跨角色污染。

Conclusion: 记忆存取与记忆深度应分离：检索一个事实与内化一种经验是两种不同的计算操作。

Original Abstract: Long-running language agents need mechanisms for deciding which experiences should persist after the working context is gone. Retrieval systems can reinsert past text, but they do not by themselves show that an experience has been selectively consolidated into the model's own behavior. We introduce EVAF, an Echo-Valence Attractor Field mechanism for gated LoRA consolidation, and a test-retest protocol for measuring selective parametric consolidation under controlled interference. Across GPT-2 and TinyLlama, EVAF preferentially consolidates high-valence, high-surprise experiences while preserving retrieval-accessible factual memory through a complementary routed memory path. Test-retest measurements show stronger post-interference behavioral persistence than frozen, retrieval-only, and ungated continual-update baselines, while keeping parameter drift and cross-persona contamination low. The results support a separation between memory access and memory depth: retrieving a fact and internalizing an experience are distinct computational operations.

中文摘要翻译: 长期运行的语言代理需要一种机制来决定在工作上下文消失后哪些经验应该持续存在。检索系统可以重新插入过往文本，但它们本身并不能表明某个经验已被选择性地整合到模型自身的行为中。本文引入了EVAF（Echo-Valence Attractor Field，回声-效价吸引子场）机制，用于实现门控LoRA整合，并提出了一种测试-重测协议，用于在受控干扰下测量选择性参数固化。在GPT-2和TinyLlama上的实验表明，EVAF优先固化高价值、高意外性的经验，同时通过互补的路由记忆路径保留可检索的事实记忆。测试-重测测量显示，与冻结基线、仅检索基线和无门控持续更新基线相比，EVAF在干扰后表现出更强的行为持久性，同时保持较低的参数漂移和跨角色污染。结果支持记忆存取与记忆深度之间的分离：检索一个事实与内化一种经验是两种不同的计算操作。

</details>


### [413] [Bandwidth Selection in Kernel Density Estimation for Model Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29925)
*Han Zhou,Teodora Popordanoska,Matthew Blaschko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出风险对齐（RA）框架，用于优化核密度估计（KDE）中的带宽选择，从而在模型校准评估中获得更可靠的不确定性估计。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 深度学习模型在高风险应用中需要良好的校准不确定性估计，而KDE的可靠性高度依赖带宽选择，但标准方法（如MLE）无法为校准任务选出最优带宽。

Method: 提出风险对齐（RA）框架，通过使KDE重构的风险与经验风险对齐来确定最优带宽，理论上证明该对齐能最小化数据分布上的校准估计偏差，适用于各类指标包括标准校准误差。

Result: 在多种架构和数据集上的大量实验表明，RA始终优于标准带宽选择方法，产生更可靠的校准评估结果。

Conclusion: RA建立了一种有原则的带宽选择准则，能够有效提升校准评估的可靠性。

Original Abstract: As deep learning models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes applications, providing well-calibrated uncertainty estimates has become as critical as achieving high predictive accuracy. While Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) has emerged as a smooth and continuous alternative to traditional binning for quantifying miscalibration, its reliability is heavily dependent on the choice of the kernel bandwidth. Standard selection techniques, such as Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), often fail to produce optimal bandwidths for calibration tasks. In this work, we introduce Risk Alignment (RA), a novel optimization framework that determines the optimal bandwidth by aligning KDE-reconstructed risk with empirical risk. We theoretically demonstrate that this alignment minimizes calibration estimation bias across the data distribution, establishing a principled bandwidth selection criterion applicable to various metrics, including the challenging case of canonical calibration error. Extensive experiments across multiple architectures and datasets show that RA consistently outperforms standard bandwidth selection methods, yielding more reliable calibration assessments.

中文摘要翻译: 随着深度学习模型越来越多地部署在高风险应用中，提供良好校准的不确定性估计已变得与实现高预测精度同等重要。尽管核密度估计（KDE）已作为传统分箱方法的一种平滑连续替代方案，用于量化误校准程度，但其可靠性在很大程度上依赖于核带宽的选择。诸如最大似然估计（MLE）之类的标准选择技术，通常无法为校准任务产生最优带宽。在本文中，我们引入了风险对齐（RA），一种新颖的优化框架，通过将KDE重构的风险与经验风险对齐来确定最优带宽。我们从理论上证明，这种对齐能在数据分布上最小化校准估计偏差，建立了一个适用于各类指标（包括具有挑战性的标准校准误差情况）的有原则的带宽选择准则。跨多种架构和数据集的广泛实验表明，RA始终优于标准带宽选择方法，能够产生更可靠的校准评估结果。

</details>


### [414] [Improved Predictive Performance and Interpretability for Mesomorphic Neural Networks Using Local Fidelity Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29951)
*Hugo L. Hammer,Vajira Thambawita,Kristoffer Herland Hellton,Pål Halvorsen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出可解释介观神经网络（IMN）存在权重坍缩导致解释不可靠的问题，并提出局部保真正则化（LFR）来对齐线性输出权重与局部数据变化，从而在保证预测性能的同时提升模型解释的可靠性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 原始IMN缺乏保障机制，网络可将所有解释方差集中到线性输出层的单个权重上，获得强预测性能但产生无意义的解释；L1稀疏惩罚反而进一步加剧了这种退化配置。

Method: 提出局部保真正则化（LFR），通过惩罚项将线性输出权重与局部数据变化对齐，防止退化权重坍缩，确保解释忠实于局部数据模式。

Result: 在OpenML基准套件上的实验表明，LFR不仅未牺牲准确率，反而相比未正则化的IMN提升了AUROC，且结果与最先进的黑盒模型高度竞争。

Conclusion: LFR在可靠可解释性和优越预测性能之间实现了双重收益，为可解释神经网络提供了有效的正则化方案。

Original Abstract: Interpretable Mesomorphic Neural Networks (IMNs) offer a promising framework that combines the predictive power of deep neural networks with the interpretability of linear models. However, the original formulation lacks safeguards to ensure that the learned interpretations are in fact reliable. In particular, the network is free to concentrate all explanatory variance into a single weight of the linear output layer, achieving strong predictive performance while producing interpretations that are largely meaningless. Paradoxically, the L1 penalty proposed to encourage sparse solutions exacerbates this problem by further incentivizing such degenerate configurations.
  To address this vulnerability, we introduce Local Fidelity Regularization (LFR), a novel penalty term that prevents degenerate weight collapse by aligning the linear output weights with local data variations. This structural constraint guarantees faithful explanations and substantially improves the reliability of model interpretations. Furthermore, empirical evaluations across the OpenML benchmark suite demonstrate that LFR does not compromise accuracy for explainability; rather, it achieved improved AUROC over the unregularized IMN. By yielding results highly competitive with state-of-the-art black-box models, LFR provides the dual benefit of reliable interpretability and superior predictive performance. Source code and usage instructions are available at https://github.com/hugohammer/LFR-IMN.git.

中文摘要翻译: 可解释介观神经网络（IMN）提供了一个有前景的框架，它结合了深度神经网络的预测能力与线性模型的可解释性。然而，原始公式缺乏保障机制来确保学到的解释实际上是可靠的。特别是，网络可以将所有解释方差自由地集中到线性输出层的单个权重上，从而实现强大的预测性能，同时产生基本无意义的解释。矛盾的是，为鼓励稀疏解而提出的L1惩罚通过进一步激励这种退化配置而加剧了该问题。为解决这一脆弱性，我们引入了局部保真正则化（LFR），这是一种新颖的惩罚项，通过将线性输出权重与局部数据变化对齐来防止退化权重坍缩。这一结构性约束保证了忠实的解释，并显著提升了模型解释的可靠性。此外，在OpenML基准套件上的实证评估表明，LFR并未以牺牲准确率来换取可解释性；相反，它相比未正则化的IMN获得了改进的AUROC。通过与最先进的黑盒模型高度竞争的结果，LFR提供了可靠可解释性和优越预测性能的双重收益。源代码和使用说明可在https://github.com/hugohammer/LFR-IMN.git获取。

</details>


### [415] [Exploiting Local Flatness for Efficient Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29952)
*Seonghwan Park,Hyunji Jung,Dongyeop Lee,Namhoon Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了OOD与ID数据在Hessian曲率上的差异，发现OOD数据具有更大曲率，并据此提出轻量级OOD检测器Fold（基于特征Hessian和部分特征归一化）及其自监督调优方案AutoFold，在保持计算效率的同时显著提升了OOD检测性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于损失景观曲率的后验OOD检测方法计算成本高昂，且依赖于关于ID与OOD数据景观平坦度差异的隐式假设，缺乏对这一差异的系统性研究。

Method: 提出Fold方法，利用特征Hessian和部分特征归一化来增强ID-OOD可分性，避免昂贵的参数空间曲率近似；进一步提出AutoFold，通过ID logit掩码合成伪OOD样本实现自监督调优，无需外部数据。

Result: 在OOD基准测试中，Fold相比先前方法平均AUROC提升1.63%，FPR95降低2.30%，计算效率与标准前向传播相当。

Conclusion: Fold提供了一种有原则且实用的鲁棒部署解决方案，兼具理论分析和充分的消融实验支持。

Original Abstract: Detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) data is crucial for reliable machine learning deployment. Among detection strategies, post-hoc methods are particularly attractive due to their efficiency, as they operate directly on pre-trained networks without requiring retraining. Within this paradigm, one promising direction exploits loss-landscape curvature to estimate model uncertainty; however, such methods incur substantial computational cost and rely on implicit assumptions about how landscape flatness differs between in-distribution (ID) and OOD data. In this work, we provide the first systematic investigation of this curvature discrepancy and show that OOD inputs exhibit larger Hessian curvature than ID data, with the gap widening under stronger distributional shifts. Motivated by these observations, we propose Fold, a lightweight flatness-modulated OOD detector that leverages the feature Hessian and partial feature normalization to improve ID-OOD separability while avoiding costly parameter-space curvature approximations. To optimally adapt this normalization across diverse datasets, we further introduce AutoFold, a self-supervised tuning scheme that synthesizes pseudo-OOD samples via ID logit masking for automatic calibration without requiring external data. Experiments on OOD benchmarks show that Fold outperforms prior methods, improving the average AUROC by 1.63% and reducing FPR95 by 2.30%, while maintaining computational efficiency comparable to a standard forward pass. Supported by theoretical analysis and extensive ablations, Fold provides a principled and practical solution for robust real-world deployment.

中文摘要翻译: 检测分布外（OOD）数据对于可靠的机器学习部署至关重要。在各类检测策略中，后验方法因其高效性尤为吸引人，这类方法直接操作于预训练网络，无需重新训练。在此范式内，一个有前景的方向是利用损失景观曲率来估计模型不确定性；然而，这类方法计算成本高昂，且依赖于关于分布内（ID）与OOD数据之间景观平坦度差异的隐式假设。在本文中，我们首次系统研究了这种曲率差异，并表明OOD输入比ID数据具有更大的Hessian曲率，且该差距在分布偏移加剧时进一步扩大。受这些观察启发，我们提出Fold，一种轻量级的平缓度调制OOD检测器，它利用特征Hessian和部分特征归一化来增强ID-OOD可分性，同时避免昂贵的参数空间曲率近似。为了在不同数据集上最优地适应这种归一化，我们进一步引入AutoFold，一种自监督调优方案，通过ID logit掩码合成伪OOD样本以实现自动校准，无需外部数据。在OOD基准上的实验表明，Fold优于先前方法，平均AUROC提升1.63%，FPR95降低2.30%，同时计算效率与标准前向传播相当。在理论分析和广泛消融实验的支持下，Fold为稳健的实部署提供了一种有原则且实用的解决方案。

</details>


### [416] [DuoMem: Towards Capable On-Device Memory Agents via Dual-Space Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29961)
*Peyman Hosseini,Ondrej Bohdal,Ahmed Alajrami,Andrea Maracani,Ignacio Castro,Matthew Purver,Mete Ozay,Savas Ozkan,Taha Ceritli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DuoMem是一种双空间蒸馏框架，通过在上下文空间和参数空间同时蒸馏，将大型语言模型（72B参数）的程序化问题解决能力高效迁移到紧凑模型（4B参数），在ALFWorld任务上将成功率从4.3%提升至77.9%，推理速度提升3倍以上，且仅需不到1000万可训练参数。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 基于LLM的智能体虽能解决复杂程序化任务，但高度依赖大模型、长上下文和多次推理调用，导致先进的记忆增强型智能体难以部署在资源受限设备上。现有方法缺乏有效的知识蒸馏手段将这种程序化推理能力从大模型迁移到小模型。

Method: DuoMem提出双空间蒸馏框架：(1)上下文空间蒸馏——用教师模型生成的高质量程序化记忆替换学生模型自身生成的记忆，作为学生模型输入的前缀；(2)参数空间蒸馏——在教师模型成功轨迹上对轻量级LoRA适配器进行微调。两个空间互补地迁移程序化问题解决能力。

Result: 在ALFWorld基准上，DuoMem将4B参数模型的任务成功率从4.3%提升至77.9%，接近72B教师模型的87.1%；仅增加不到1000万可训练参数和数兆字节预计算教师记忆；推理速度比72B教师模型快3倍以上；在2B-72B共8个模型上验证了两个蒸馏维度的互补性。

Conclusion: DuoMem通过双空间蒸馏有效弥合了大模型与小模型在程序化任务上的性能差距，使紧凑模型在资源受限的边缘设备上实现实时部署成为可能，且两个蒸馏维度贡献互补。

Original Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents can solve complex procedural tasks by interacting with environments over multiple turns, but this ability typically depends on large models, long contexts, and repeated inference calls. This makes advanced memory-augmented agents difficult to deploy on resource-constrained devices. We introduce DuoMem, a dual-space distillation framework that transfers procedural problem-solving ability from a large teacher model to compact student models. DuoMem distils in two complementary spaces: (1)context-space distillation, which replaces student-generated memories with higher-quality teacher-generated procedural memories prepended to the student's input, and (2)parameter-space distillation, which fine-tunes lightweight LoRA adapters on successful teacher trajectories. Evaluated on ALFWorld, a challenging embodied decision-making benchmark, DuoMem boosts a 4B-parameter model from 4.3% to 77.9% task success rate, closing most of the gap to a 72B teacher model (87.1%), while adding fewer than 10M trainable parameters and only a few megabytes of pre-computed teacher memories. Moreover, the DuoMem-enhanced 4B model completes tasks over 3x faster than the 72B teacher in wall-clock time, making it viable for real-time edge deployment, which would be challenging for the teacher.Extensive ablations across eight models spanning 2B-72B parameters reveal that both distillation axes contribute complementary

中文摘要翻译: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体能够通过与环境的多轮交互来解决复杂的程序化任务，但这种能力通常依赖于大模型、长上下文和重复推理调用。这使得先进的记忆增强型智能体难以部署在资源受限的设备上。我们提出DuoMem，一种双空间蒸馏框架，将程序化问题解决能力从大型教师模型迁移到紧凑的学生模型。DuoMem在两个互补空间中进行蒸馏：(1)上下文空间蒸馏，用教师模型生成的高质量程序化记忆替换学生生成的记忆，并将其前置到学生输入中；(2)参数空间蒸馏，在成功的教师轨迹上微调轻量级LoRA适配器。在具有挑战性的具身决策基准ALFWorld上评估，DuoMem将4B参数模型的任务成功率从4.3%提升至77.9%，缩小了与72B教师模型（87.1%）之间的大部分差距，同时仅增加了不到1000万个可训练参数和数兆字节的预计算教师记忆。此外，经过DuoMem增强的4B模型在挂钟时间上完成任务的速度比72B教师模型快3倍以上，使其在教师模型难以实现的实时边缘部署中成为可行方案。在涵盖2B-72B参数的八个模型上进行的广泛消融实验表明，两个蒸馏维度贡献互补。

</details>


### [417] [NeuReasoner: Theory-grounded Mapping of Reasoning Elicitation Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29971)
*Aydin Javadov,Shyngys Aitkazinov,Tobias Hoesli,Florian von Wangenheim,Bjoern Schuller,Joseph Ollier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NeuReasoner——一种基于理论的模块化推理 elicitation 工具，在数学与代码任务外系统探索了大语言模型推理能力 elicitation 的边界，发现 elicitation 在风险决策等任务上存在显著局限，且模型规模与 elicitation 存在双向交互作用。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有研究表明大语言模型的推理能力主要潜藏于基座模型中，后训练仅放大而非引入这些能力，但该结论主要来自数学和代码基准测试，其边界条件（哪些认知任务可通过 elicitation 恢复、哪些会失败）尚未被系统探索。

Method: 提出NeuReasoner，一种理论驱动的 elicitation 工具。每一步中，编排器将受功能特异性启发的神经透镜（Neuro Lens）与来自 Erotetic 推理理论的认知透镜（Cognitive Lens）配对，通过单模型的内部模块化集成二者输出，无需外部工具。

Result: 在足够规模下，NeuReasoner在算术推理、代码生成、贝叶斯推理和奖励学习上匹配或超越思考模式基线；这些收益相对于自一致性及迭代精炼基线（与NeuReasoner每次决策调用预算匹配）依然保持。同时发现清晰边界：风险承担和不确定性下的决策难以通过 elicitation 单独恢复；模型规模与 elicitation 存在双向交互——在某些认知特征上扩大优势，在另一些上则消除优势。

Conclusion: 通过NeuReasoner这一模块化、可解释、理论驱动的 elicitation 工具，本文实证绘制了推理 elicitation 成功与失败的边界，超越了以往结论所依赖的数学和代码基准。

Original Abstract: A growing body of work suggests that the reasoning capabilities of large language models are largely latent in their base form, with post-training primarily amplifying rather than introducing them. However, this evidence comes mainly from mathematical and coding benchmarks, leaving the boundary conditions of that claim largely unexplored, namely which cognitive tasks can be recovered through elicitation and where that recovery fails. To investigate this, we introduce NeuReasoner, a theory-grounded elicitation instrument. At each step, an orchestrator pairs a Neuro Lens, inspired by functional specificity, with a Cognitive Lens, drawn from the Erotetic Theory of Reasoning, and integrates their outputs through internal modularization of a single model, without external tools. We evaluate NeuReasoner on CogBench, a suite of behavioral tasks from cognitive psychology, alongside standard mathematical and coding benchmarks, measuring both its improvement over vanilla inference and its ability to match a model's post-trained thinking mode. At sufficient scale, NeuReasoner matches or exceeds thinking-mode baselines on arithmetic reasoning, code generation, Bayesian reasoning, and reward learning; these gains persist against self-consistency and iterative-refinement baselines matched to NeuReasoner's per-decision call budget. Using NeuReasoner allows us to find clear boundaries: risk-taking and decision making under uncertainty remains hard to recover through elicitation alone, and model scale interacts with elicitation in both directions: widening its advantage on some cognitive signatures while erasing it on others. Overall, through NeuReasoner as a modular, interpretable, theory-grounded elicitation instrument, we empirically map where reasoning elicitation succeeds and fails, beyond the mathematical and coding benchmarks where prior claims have rested.

中文摘要翻译: 越来越多的研究表明，大语言模型的推理能力在很大程度上潜藏于其基座形式之中，后训练主要放大而非引入这些能力。然而，这一证据主要来自数学和编程基准测试，使得该主张的边界条件——即哪些认知任务可以通过 elicitation 恢复，以及恢复在何处失败——在很大程度上尚未被探索。为研究这一问题，我们提出了NeuReasoner，一种基于理论的 elicitation 工具。在每一步中，编排器将受功能特异性启发的神经透镜（Neuro Lens）与源自 Erotetic 推理理论的认知透镜（Cognitive Lens）配对，并通过单模型的内部模块化集成它们的输出，无需外部工具。我们在CogBench（一套来自认知心理学的行为任务集合）以及标准的数学和编程基准测试上评估NeuReasoner，测量其相较于原始推理的提升幅度，以及其匹配模型后训练思考模式的能力。在足够规模下，NeuReasoner在算术推理、代码生成、贝叶斯推理和奖励学习上匹配或超越思考模式基线；这些收益相对于与NeuReasoner每次决策调用预算相匹配的自一致性和迭代精炼基线依然保持。借助NeuReasoner，我们发现了清晰的边界：风险承担和不确定性下的决策仍然难以通过单独的 elicitation 恢复，并且模型规模与 elicitation 存在双向交互作用——在某些认知特征上扩大其优势，在另一些上则消除优势。总体而言，通过NeuReasoner这一模块化、可解释、基于理论的 elicitation 工具，我们实证绘制了推理 elicitation 成功与失败的边界，超越了以往结论所依赖的数学和编程基准。

</details>


### [418] [Atompack: A Storage and Distribution Layer for Read-Heavy Atomistic ML Training Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29975)
*Ali Ramlaoui,Daniel T. Speckhard,Sagar Pal,Fragkiskos D. Malliaros,Alexandre Duval,Victor Schmidt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Atompack是一种面向追加写入的存储格式与分发层，专门为原子级机器学习数据集的训练流水线设计。它通过追加记录、提交不可变索引以及基于内存映射的读取路径，在保证紧凑存储的同时，大幅提升随机洗牌读取性能。实验表明，在64原子工作负载下，Atompack相比ASE LMDB在训练风格洗牌读取上快96倍，且产物体积小79%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有存储格式（如HDF5、LMDB、ASE等）主要面向交互式科学数据管理，而非机器学习训练流水线的需求。训练流水线需要反复读取完整的分子记录并以随机顺序消费，现有方案在随机索引吞吐量、共享文件系统行为、存储紧凑性和写入效率方面存在不足。

Method: Atompack采用追加写入（append-oriented）方式高效构建数据集，随后提交不可变索引，并通过内存映射（memory-mapped）读取路径为训练提供完整的分子记录服务，支持高效的顺序读取和随机洗牌读取。

Result: 在64原子代表性工作负载上，Atompack相比ASE LMDB在训练风格的洗牌读取上快96倍，产物体积小79%；同时与HDF5、LMDB、ASE等多种基线进行了顺序读取、随机读取、共享文件系统行为、写入吞吐量和产物大小的全面对比。

Conclusion: 服务完整的分子记录（而非字段分块或重建对象）能够显著提升训练洗牌吞吐量，同时保持产物足够紧凑以适合公开发布和分发。

Original Abstract: Atomistic machine learning datasets are increasingly used for training: large immutable snapshots are read repeatedly, shuffled across epochs, staged across clusters' storage systems, and republished as reusable scientific artifacts. This workload differs from interactive scientific curation, where mutable records and ad hoc inspection are often more important than random indexed throughput. We present Atompack, an append-oriented storage format and distribution layer designed around a simple workload: training pipelines usually consume complete molecular records, while the order of records is randomized by the learning algorithm. Atompack appends records efficiently during dataset construction, then commits an immutable index and serves records through a memory-mapped read path optimized for training. We compare Atompack with HDF5, LMDB, and ASE baselines representing array stores, key-value records, serialized records, and object-oriented databases. The benchmarks measure sequential reads, shuffled reads, shared-filesystem behavior, write throughput, and artifact size. On a representative 64-atom workload, Atompack is 96x faster than ASE LMDB on shuffled training-style reads while producing artifacts about 79\% smaller. The results indicate that serving complete molecule records, rather than field chunks or reconstructed objects, improves shuffled training throughput while keeping artifacts compact enough for public distribution.

中文摘要翻译: 原子机器学习数据集越来越多地用于训练：大型不可变快照被反复读取、跨周期洗牌、跨集群存储系统分发，并作为可重用的科学制品重新发布。这一工作负载不同于交互式科学管理，后者的可变记录和临时检查往往比随机索引吞吐量更重要。本文提出Atompack，一种面向追加写入的存储格式与分发层，其设计围绕一个简单的工作负载：训练流水线通常消费完整的分子记录，而记录的顺序由学习算法随机化。Atompack在数据集构建期间高效追加记录，然后提交不可变索引，并通过面向训练优化的内存映射读取路径提供记录服务。我们将Atompack与代表数组存储、键值记录、序列化记录和面向对象数据库的HDF5、LMDB和ASE基线进行比较。基准测试测量了顺序读取、洗牌读取、共享文件系统行为、写入吞吐量和制品大小。在代表性的64原子工作负载上，Atompack在训练风格的洗牌读取上比ASE LMDB快96倍，同时制品体积小约79%。结果表明，服务完整分子记录（而非字段分块或重建对象）能够提高训练洗牌吞吐量，同时保持制品足够紧凑以适合公开发布。

</details>


### [419] [Stabilizing Extrapolation in Looped Transformers via Learned Stochastic Stopping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29983)
*Hsun-Yu Kuo,El Mahdi Chayti,Patrik Reizinger,Wieland Brendel,Martin Jaggi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了循环Transformer在变长算法任务中长度外推的脆弱性问题，发现序列长度与循环次数之间的虚假相关性是导致高OOD方差的主要原因。通过在训练中引入循环次数的随机性（包括启发式方法和RL-Halting学习策略），可以有效降低OOD方差并稳定预测，表明训练阶段应设计“何时停止”策略。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 循环Transformer在变长算法任务中虽能展现长度泛化能力，但该行为脆弱，即使在分布内表现良好的解决方案中，也会产生很高的分布外（OOD）方差。作者将这种方差追溯到简单算法任务中序列长度与循环次数之间的虚假相关性。

Method: 1) 在训练过程中引入循环次数的随机性（启发式随机化方案）；2) 进一步分析RL-Halting方法作为学习得到的随机调度策略，以改善准确率-稳定性权衡。

Result: 在二进制加法、Dyck-1、Unique Set和Copy任务上，引入循环随机性显著降低了OOD方差并稳定了推理时的预测。RL-Halting学习策略通常能改善准确率-稳定性权衡，但有时也可能稳定次优计算。

Conclusion: “何时停止”应当被视为训练阶段的设计选择，而不仅仅是推理阶段的计算分配规则。

Original Abstract: Looped Transformers, which repeatedly apply a shared transformer block, are an architecturally natural fit for variable-length algorithmic tasks. Although they can exhibit strong length generalization beyond the length of training sequences, this behavior is brittle, yielding high out-of-distribution (OOD) variance, even across well-performing in-distribution solutions. We trace this variance to the spurious correlation in simple algorithmic tasks between sequence length and number of loops. Introducing stochasticity into the number of loops during training sharply reduces OOD variance and stabilizes predictions across inference-time loop counts. To improve upon heuristic randomization schemes, we further analyze RL-Halting as a learned stochastic schedule and find that it generally improves the accuracy-stability trade-off. Across binary addition, Dyck-1, Unique Set, and Copy, learned stochastic stopping often improves this trade-off but can also stabilize a suboptimal computation. Our work suggests that "when to stop" should be treated as a training-time design choice, not merely an inference-time computation-allocation rule.

中文摘要翻译: 循环Transformer通过重复应用一个共享的Transformer模块，在架构上天然适合变长算法任务。尽管它们可以在训练序列长度之外展现出强大的长度泛化能力，但这一行为是脆弱的，即使在分布内表现良好的解中也会产生较高的分布外（OOD）方差。我们将这种方差追溯到简单算法任务中序列长度与循环次数之间的虚假相关性。在训练过程中引入循环次数的随机性显著降低了OOD方差，并稳定了跨推理时循环次数的预测。为了改进启发式随机化方案，我们进一步分析了RL-Halting作为一种学习得到的随机调度策略，发现它通常能改善准确率-稳定性的权衡。在二进制加法、Dyck-1、Unique Set和Copy任务上，学习得到的随机停止通常能改善这一权衡，但也可能稳定次优的计算。我们的工作表明，“何时停止”应被视为训练阶段的设计选择，而不仅仅是推理阶段的计算分配规则。

</details>


### [420] [T3R: Deeper Test-Time Adaptation for Graph Neural Networks via Gradient Rotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30011)
*Huy Truong,Alexander Lazovik,Victoria Degeler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出T3R方法，利用多Rotograd矩阵改进测试时训练（TTT）在图神经网络上的适配效果，通过旋转自监督信号生成目标任务的替代梯度，实现对模型大部分参数的深层更新，显著提升了GNN在分布偏移下的性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现实系统中部署的GNN通常使用固定权重，在分布偏移下性能下降。传统微调需要昂贵的标注数据，而现有TTT方法仅能对部分参数进行浅层更新，适配能力有限。

Method: T3R利用多个Rotograd矩阵提升目标任务与辅助任务之间的任务亲和度；同时引入旋转技术，利用这些矩阵重新定向自监督信号，为目标任务生成替代梯度（surrogate gradients），实现对几乎整个架构的深层适配。

Result: 在回归数据集上，MAE比标准推理降低0.172；在跨域OGB分类基准上，相比无适配模型取得了至少9.37%的相对改进。

Conclusion: T3R展示了在传统微调或重新训练不可行的场景下，为基于图的系统构建适配管道的潜力。

Original Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) deployed in real-world systems typically have fixed weights, often leading to degraded performance under distribution shifts. This issue can be mitigated by conventional fine-tuning, but in many real-world cases, collecting labeled data is expensive or infeasible. A potential approach is Test-Time Training (TTT), which adapts models' weights using unlabeled test data, yet it is typically limited to shallow updates that affect only a subset of model parameters. We propose T3R, leveraging multiple Rotograd matrices to improve task affinity between the target and auxiliary tasks, essential for effective test-time training. T3R further introduces a rotation technique that reorients self-supervised signals using these matrices to create surrogate gradients for the target task, allowing deeper adaptation across nearly the entire architecture. Empirically, T3R reduces MAE by 0.172 points over standard inference in regression datasets and achieves at least 9.37% relative improvement on cross-domain OGB classification benchmarks compared to models without adaptation. These results highlight the potential to develop an adaptation pipeline for graph-based systems, particularly in settings where conventional fine-tuning or retraining is infeasible.

中文摘要翻译: 部署在现实系统中的图神经网络（GNN）通常使用固定权重，这往往导致在分布偏移下性能下降。传统微调可以缓解这一问题，但在许多现实场景中，收集标注数据成本高昂或不可行。测试时训练（TTT）是一种潜在方法，它利用无标注的测试数据调整模型权重，但TTT通常局限于仅影响部分模型参数的浅层更新。我们提出T3R方法，利用多个Rotograd矩阵来提升目标任务与辅助任务之间的任务亲和度，这对于有效的测试时训练至关重要。T3R进一步引入了一种旋转技术，利用这些矩阵重新定向自监督信号，为目标任务生成替代梯度，从而实现对几乎整个架构的深层适配。实验结果表明，在回归数据集上，T3R相比标准推理将MAE降低了0.172；在跨域OGB分类基准上，相比无适配模型取得了至少9.37%的相对改进。这些结果突显了在传统微调或重新训练不可行的场景下，为基于图的系统构建适配管道的潜力。

</details>


### [421] [Heads, Not Backbones: Output Heads Dominate Architectures on Fat-Tailed Returns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30037)
*Sichao He,Yansong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在金融收益率的短期预测中，输出头（尤其是混合高斯密度头）对CRPS指标的影响显著优于骨干网络架构，混合头在危机时期能捕捉尾部风险。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 探究在短周期肥尾金融收益率预测中，骨干网络架构与输出头哪个对预测性能更重要。

Method: 对比四种现代骨干网络（TimesNet、DLinear、N-BEATS、iTransformer）在三种输出头（点估计头、单高斯密度头、混合高斯密度头K=4）下的预测性能，在标普500月对数收益率（1871-2023）上使用锚定滚动验证进行评估。

Result: 输出头形成严格梯度：点→高斯提升CRPS约1.3%；高斯→混合再提升约2.4%。骨干网络间CRPS变化小于1.5%（点估计行及骨干均值轴），密度头骨干差异可达5.1%（由N-BEATS驱动），但仍被头梯度（3.7百分点）压制。混合头在高波动（1970年代滞涨期h=12）提升达13.9%。短周期头主导，长周期（h≥6）骨干重新领先。

Conclusion: 在短周期肥尾收益率预测中，输出头比骨干网络更重要，混合高斯分布能在危机时期（风险管理真正重要时）比单高斯提供额外价值。

Original Abstract: In a deep forecasting pipeline for fat-tailed financial returns at short horizons, which matters more - the backbone architecture or the output head? We compare four modern backbones (TimesNet, DLinear, N-BEATS, iTransformer) under three output heads: a point head, a single-Gaussian density head, and a Gaussian mixture density head with K=4 components. On S and P 500 monthly log-returns (1871-2023) under anchored walk-forward validation, the three heads form a strict gradient: switching from point to Gaussian improves CRPS by about 1.3 percent; switching from Gaussian to mixture adds a further about 2.4 percent. Switching between backbones, in contrast, changes CRPS by less than 1.5 percent on the point-head row and on the backbone-mean axis; density-head backbone spread is larger (up to 5.1 percent on the h=1 Gaussian row, driven by N-BEATS) but the head gradient (3.7 percentage points) still dominates. The Model Confidence Set on squared errors does not exclude any of the 12 variants at the 5 percent level: the head separates them only on distributional metrics (CRPS, pinball, coverage), not on squared error. The mixture head incremental value over a single Gaussian is largest in the highest-volatility regimes (13.9 percent in 1970s stagflation at h=12), confirming the mixture captures tail risk beyond what a unimodal Gaussian can express. The picture is horizon-dependent: the head dominates at short horizons, but at long horizons (h >= 6) the backbone re-takes the lead - an h-split we document against classical baselines (section 5.1). We conclude that on fat-tailed returns at short horizons, the head dominates the backbone, and the mixture distribution adds genuine value over a single Gaussian during crisis periods when risk-management decisions actually matter.

中文摘要翻译: 在面向短周期肥尾金融收益率的深度预测流水线中，哪一点更重要——是骨干网络架构还是输出头？我们比较了四种现代骨干网络（TimesNet、DLinear、N-BEATS、iTransformer）在三种输出头下的表现：点估计头、单高斯密度头和包含K=4分量的混合高斯密度头。基于标普500月对数收益率（1871-2023年）的锚定滚动验证，三种输出头形成严格的梯度：从点估计切换到高斯头使CRPS提升约1.3%；从高斯头切换到混合头再提升约2.4%。相比之下，骨干网络之间的切换在点估计行和骨干均值轴上带来的CRPS变化不足1.5%；密度头对应的骨干网络差异更大（在h=1的高斯行中高达5.1%，由N-BEATS驱动），但输出头梯度（3.7个百分点）仍占主导地位。基于平方误差的模型置信集在5%显著性水平下未排除12个变体中的任何一个：输出头仅在分布指标（CRPS、分位数损失、覆盖率）上区分模型，而非平方误差。混合头相对于单高斯的增量价值在高波动率 regimes 中最大（在h=12的1970年代滞涨时期达到13.9%），证实了混合分布能够捕捉单峰高斯无法表达的尾部风险。该结论具有时间窗口依赖性：在短窗口下输出头占主导，但在长窗口（h≥6）下骨干网络重新取得领先——这一按窗口长度划分的结论我们对照经典基线进行了记录（第5.1节）。我们得出结论：在短周期的肥尾收益率预测中，输出头主导骨干网络，且混合分布在危机时期（风险管理决策真正重要的时刻）比单高斯分布具有真正的增值价值。

</details>


### [422] [Building Multi-Task Agentic LLMs via Two-Phase Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30044)
*Huaijie Wang,Shusheng Xu,Yi Wu,Kaifeng Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种两阶段蒸馏方法（离策略蒸馏后接在策略精炼）来训练多任务强化学习模型，解决了单独使用离策略蒸馏（模式覆盖导致性能下降）或在策略蒸馏（需要强初始化）的缺陷，最终使单个模型达到单任务专家水平。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 训练能执行多个任务的通用模型是迈向通用人工智能的关键一步。直接混合训练多任务模型效果不佳，而通过蒸馏分别训练的单任务RL专家来构建多任务模型时，离策略蒸馏在多任务设置下因前向KL散度的模式覆盖特性导致性能退化；在策略蒸馏虽为模式寻找但需要强初始化。因此需要一种结合两者优势的方法。

Method: 提出两阶段方法：第一阶段进行离策略蒸馏（模式覆盖），将多个单任务专家知识蒸馏到一个学生模型中；第二阶段进行在策略精炼（模式寻找），用学生在自身策略下生成的rollout数据对模型进行微调，弥补离策略蒸馏的模式平均问题。

Result: 在对话智能体和基于文本的游戏任务上，两阶段方法使单个模型在每个任务上均匹配单任务RL专家性能；而单独使用离策略蒸馏或在策略蒸馏均无法达到这一水平。

Conclusion: 两阶段蒸馏策略（离策略蒸馏+在策略精炼）能有效解决多任务强化学习中的蒸馏退化问题，是直接训练多任务模型的有效替代方案。

Original Abstract: A key step toward artificial general intelligence is to train models that can perform multiple tasks. In this paper, we study how to build such models by first training separate RL experts for individual tasks and then consolidating them via distillation, as an alternative to directly training a single model on mixed tasks. We show that off-policy distillation degrades in multi-task settings due to the mode-covering nature of forward KL: aggregating data from multiple tasks introduces a large number of behavioral modes that can exceed the student's capacity, forcing it to average across behaviors and leading to degraded performance. In contrast, on-policy distillation is mode-seeking but requires strong initialization. Inspired by these observations, we propose a two-phase approach: off-policy distillation followed by on-policy refinement. Evaluation across conversational agents and text-based games confirms that this two-phase approach matches single-task RL expert performance for each individual task, whereas off-policy or on-policy distillation alone fails to match this performance.

中文摘要翻译: 训练能够执行多个任务的模型是迈向通用人工智能的关键一步。本文研究如何通过先为各个任务分别训练独立的RL专家，再通过蒸馏将其整合来构建此类模型，作为直接在混合任务上训练单一模型的替代方案。我们发现，由于前向KL散度的模式覆盖特性，离策略蒸馏在多任务设置下会退化：聚合多个任务的数据会引入大量行为模式，超出学生模型的能力范围，迫使其在行为之间进行平均，导致性能下降。相比之下，在策略蒸馏具有模式寻找特性，但需要强初始化。受这些观察启发，我们提出一种两阶段方法：离策略蒸馏后接在策略精炼。在对话智能体和基于文本的游戏上的评估证实，该两阶段方法在每个单独任务上均匹配单任务RL专家的性能，而单独的离策略蒸馏或在策略蒸馏则无法达到这一水平。

</details>


### [423] [From Failure Taxonomy to Intervention: A Diagnostic Methodology for Industry-Scale AVLM in Video and Live-Streaming Platform Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30059)
*Shuchang Ye,Jinqiang Yu,Zhujun Xiao,Yajing Kong,Yist Y. Lin,Yang Ma,Jiaxi Liu,Xiaolei Xu,Zheng Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向工业级音视频语言模型（AVLM）开发的诊断方法论，通过将模型故障映射到可观察的故障特征分类体系，并将每类故障链接到对应的干预空间，从而系统性地指导模型开发与对齐，替代传统的启发式试错法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有公开多模态基础模型研究主要报告架构、训练策略、数据缩放和基准结果，但缺乏如何定位故障并将其转化为针对性模型开发干预的系统性指导。平台在内部模型开发中依赖启发式试错，导致改进难以归因、故障难以溯源。

Method: 提出一种诊断方法论：将模型故障归纳为可观察的故障特征分类体系（taxonomy of observable failure signatures），并将每类故障链接到一个干预空间（intervention space）。该方法被实例化应用于一个大型视频和直播平台的AVLM基础模型的开发与对齐全生命周期中。

Result: 该系统支持超过100个地区，专为处理来自全球平台流量的噪声、模糊且高度多样化的内容而设计，并在实际工业规模部署中验证了有效性。

Conclusion: 通过系统化的故障诊断和干预映射方法，可以替代启发式试错，实现工业级AVLM模型的高效开发和精准对齐，满足平台特定的数据分布、策略目标和安全约束。

Original Abstract: Industry-scale video and live-streaming moderation imposes requirements that are difficult to satisfy with generic pretrained public models or external APIs, including adaptation to platform-specific data distributions, policy-specific objectives, and product-level safety constraints. As a result, platforms must undertake internal model development, naturally turning to shared public research for guidance. However, existing multimodal foundation-model studies primarily report architectures, training recipes, data scaling strategies, and benchmark results, but provide less systematic guidance on how failures should be localized and translated into targeted model-development interventions. Interventions are essential because deployment failures are rarely self-explanatory. Similar failures can originate from different causes. Without targeted interventions, improvement reduces to heuristic trial-and-error, where benchmark improvements are weakly attributable, and failures are difficult to trace to their underlying causes. To address this gap, we present a diagnostic methodology for industry-scale Audio-Visual-Language Models AVLM development. The methodology maps model failures into a taxonomy of observable failure signatures and links each class of failure to an intervention space. We instantiate this methodology across the development and alignment lifecycle of an AVLM foundation model for a large-scale video and live-streaming platform. The resulting system supports over 100 regions and is designed for noisy, ambiguous, and highly diverse content drawn from global platform traffic.

中文摘要翻译: 工业规模的视频和直播内容审核提出了难以通过通用预训练公开模型或外部API满足的要求，包括适应平台特定的数据分布、策略特定的目标以及产品级别的安全约束。因此，平台必须进行内部模型开发，自然会转向共享的公开研究寻求指导。然而，现有的多模态基础模型研究主要报告架构、训练配方、数据扩展策略和基准结果，但较少提供关于应该如何定位故障并将其转化为针对性模型开发干预的系统性指导。干预措施至关重要，因为部署故障很少能自解释。相似的故障可能源于不同的原因。缺乏针对性干预，改进就退化为启发式试错，此时基准改进的归因性弱，且故障难以追溯到其根本原因。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了一种面向工业级音视频语言模型（AVLM）开发的诊断方法论。该方法将模型故障映射到可观察的故障特征分类体系中，并将每类故障链接到一个干预空间。我们在大规模视频和直播平台的AVLM基础模型的开发与对齐全生命周期中实例化了该方法。最终系统支持超过100个地区，专为处理来自全球平台流量的噪声、模糊且高度多样化的内容而设计。

</details>


### [424] [Data-Driven Energy-Based Learning via Gibbs Measures on Hierarchical Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30064)
*L. U. Abdullaev,F. Herrera,U. A. Rozikov,M. V. Velasco*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于分层结构上吉布斯测度的数据驱动概率框架，将经验损失函数转化为相互作用势能，定义了一个能量基模型。该框架下的吉布斯分布描述了数据生成的平衡学习状态家族，并通过非线性积分固定点方程刻画了可容许学习状态。研究表明，分层学习系统可能表现出相变现象，在临界逆温度以上出现多个吉布斯测度，对应不同的平衡预测状态。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统的经验风险最小化仅从数据中寻找单一最优参数，忽略了数据可能定义更丰富的概率推理景观。本文旨在建立一个概率框架，将数据不仅用于确定单一最优模型，而是定义一组可能的推理状态，从而更全面地捕捉数据中的不确定性。

Method: 基于吉布斯测度构建分层学习系统的概率框架，将经验损失函数转化为相互作用势能定义能量基模型；推导有限体积分布的一致性条件，得到非线性积分固定点方程；在平移不变解情形下，将问题简化为数据相关核诱导的正紧算子分析；通过数值实验验证非可分核的多解分支现象。

Result: 推导了描述可容许学习状态的非线性积分固定点方程；在平移不变条件下，建立了核诱导正紧算子的存在唯一性条件；发现了分层学习系统的相变现象：在Cayley树上的某些经验核下，超过临界逆温度后会出现多个吉布斯测度；数值实验展示了多个解分支的出现以及多种数据诱导学习状态的共存。

Conclusion: 本文为能量基学习提供了新视角：数据不仅仅通过最小化确定一个最优模型，而是定义了一个完整的概率推理景观，其中包含多种可能的推理状态。这一框架在经验损失景观与树结构上的概率推理之间建立了严谨的联系。

Original Abstract: We introduce a data-driven probabilistic framework for learning systems based on Gibbs measures on hierarchical structures. Unlike standard empirical risk minimization, where a dataset is used to identify a single optimal parameter, our approach transforms the empirical loss function into an interaction potential defining an energy-based model. The resulting Gibbs distribution describes a family of equilibrium learning states generated by the data.
  We formulate the consistency conditions of the associated finite-volume distributions and derive nonlinear integral fixed-point equations whose solutions characterize the admissible learning states. These equations provide a rigorous connection between empirical loss landscapes and probabilistic inference on trees. For translation-invariant solutions, the problem reduces to the analysis of positive compact operators induced by data-dependent kernels, allowing us to establish existence and uniqueness conditions in the one-dimensional setting.
  Furthermore, we show that hierarchical learning systems may exhibit phase-transition phenomena: for certain empirical kernels on Cayley trees, multiple Gibbs measures emerge beyond a critical inverse temperature, corresponding to distinct equilibrium prediction regimes. Numerical experiments with non-separable kernels illustrate the appearance of multiple solution branches and demonstrate the coexistence of several data-induced learning states.
  Our results provide a new perspective on energy-based learning, where data do not merely determine an optimal model through minimization but define an entire probabilistic landscape of possible inference states.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了一种基于分层结构上吉布斯测度的数据驱动概率学习框架。与标准经验风险最小化（利用数据集确定单一最优参数）不同，我们的方法将经验损失函数转化为定义能量基模型的相互作用势能。由此产生的吉布斯分布描述了由数据生成的一族平衡学习状态。我们推导了相关有限体积分布的一致性条件，并得到了非线性积分固定点方程，其解刻画了可容许的学习状态。这些方程在经验损失景观与树结构上的概率推理之间建立了严谨的联系。对于平移不变解，问题简化为由数据相关核诱导的正紧算子分析，使我们能够在一维情形下建立存在唯一性条件。此外，我们展示了分层学习系统可能表现出相变现象：在Cayley树上的某些经验核下，超过临界逆温度后会出现多个吉布斯测度，对应不同的平衡预测状态。针对非可分核的数值实验展示了多个解分支的出现，并证明了多种数据诱导学习状态的共存。我们的结果为能量基学习提供了新视角：数据不仅仅通过最小化确定一个最优模型，而是定义了一个完整的概率推理景观。

</details>


### [425] [Neural Subspace Reallocation: Continual Learning as Retrieval-Based Subspace Memory Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30067)
*Byeong Hoon Yoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出神经子空间重分配（NSR），将持续学习重新定义为参数子空间上的内存管理。通过压缩、存储、召回和重分配LoRA模块，实现高效的任务知识复用与遗忘控制。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有方法将LoRA模块视为一次性任务适配器导致遗忘严重，缺乏有效的历史知识复用机制，尤其在循环任务场景下表现不佳。

Method: NSR通过四个步骤的循环实现持续学习：(1) 用SVD压缩已学LoRA；(2) 存入任务知识库；(3) 通过嵌入相似度召回相关旧LoRA以热启动新任务或返回任务；(4) 重分配活跃子空间，并用蒸馏保护旧任务。

Result: 理论上证明了无记忆分配策略在循环环境中的累积遗憾下界；在Split-CIFAR-100上循环恢复时间降低10倍；在5-Datasets基准上达到最高准确率和最低遗忘，后向迁移比无记忆启发式方法好约9倍；受控实验表明相似度检索规则优于或持平强化学习控制器；压缩后每任务仅0.29 MB参数。

Conclusion: 核心发现是：在固定容量下，推动持续学习性能的关键因素是内存机制（压缩和相似度检索），而非学习得到的分配策略。

Original Abstract: We introduce Neural Subspace Reallocation (NSR), which reframes continual learning as memory management over parameter subspaces. Instead of treating Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) modules as disposable per-task adapters, NSR manages them as compressible, retrievable memory units on a frozen backbone through a recurring cycle: (1) compress learned LoRAs via SVD, (2) reserve them in a TaskKnowledgeBank, (3) recall related past LoRAs by embedding similarity to warm-start new or returning tasks, and (4) reallocate the active subspace accordingly, with distillation protecting prior tasks. We prove that in cyclic environments any memoryless allocation policy incurs cumulative regret Omega(T(M-1)Delta_switch) relative to a history-aware policy backed by the Bank (Theorem 1). Empirically, on Split-CIFAR-100 the Bank reduces cyclic recovery time by 10x, exactly as predicted, and on the heterogeneous 5-Datasets benchmark NSR achieves the highest accuracy and the least forgetting, about 9x closer to zero backward transfer than the memoryless heuristics. Crucially, we run a controlled study that isolates which component matters: holding the Bank fixed and varying only the allocation rule, we find that a simple similarity-based retrieval rule matches or beats a learned reinforcement-learning controller (recovering recurring tasks in 0 vs 1.8 steps and reaching equal accuracy). Our central, honest finding is therefore that the memory mechanism -- compression and similarity retrieval -- rather than a learned allocation policy, drives continual-learning performance under fixed capacity. A memory-budget analysis confirms the compressed Bank stays small -- 0.29 MB of parameter memory per task -- so a top-K retention cap bounds the total footprint while preserving fast recovery for retained tasks.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了神经子空间重分配（NSR），它将持续学习重新定义为参数子空间上的内存管理。NSR不将低秩自适应（LoRA）模块视为一次性任务适配器，而是通过一个循环周期在冻结的主干网络上将它们管理为可压缩、可检索的记忆单元：(1) 通过SVD压缩已学LoRA，(2) 将其存入任务知识库，(3) 通过嵌入相似度召回相关的历史LoRA，以热启动新任务或返回的任务，(4) 相应地重分配活跃子空间，并用知识蒸馏保护先前任务。我们证明，在循环环境中，任何无记忆分配策略相对于依赖知识库的历史感知策略，会产生累积遗憾Ω(T(M-1)Δ_switch)（定理1）。在实验上，在Split-CIFAR-100上，知识库将循环恢复时间降低了10倍，与理论预测完全一致；在异构的5-Datasets基准上，NSR达到了最高准确率和最少遗忘，其后向迁移比无记忆启发式方法接近约9倍。关键的是，我们进行了一项受控研究来隔离哪个组件真正起作用：固定知识库并仅改变分配规则，我们发现简单的基于相似度的检索规则匹配或超越了学习得到的强化学习控制器（恢复循环任务分别在0步 vs 1.8步，且达到相同准确率）。因此，我们核心的诚实发现是：在固定容量下，推动持续学习性能的机制是内存机制——压缩和相似度检索——而非学习得到的分配策略。内存预算分析证实压缩后的知识库保持小型化——每任务仅0.29 MB参数——因此top-K保留上限约束了总内存占用，同时为保留的任务保持快速恢复能力。

</details>


### [426] [Predictive Objectives Discard Exogenous Control-Relevant Features: A Controlled Mechanistic Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30068)
*Ayan Pendharkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现JEPA-style的联合嵌入预测目标函数会丢弃外生的但控制相关的特征，因为其优化的是时间可预测性而非控制相关性。仅需2%的奖励标注数据即可恢复该特征。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的JEPA-style预测目标函数在学习表征时，会丢弃那些尽管易于编码、但不受智能体控制的控制相关特征，导致表征对控制任务不够有用。亟需理解该失败模式的成因并寻找解决方案。

Method: 设计了一个2×2的控制实验，独立改变特征的可控性和相关性，使用"可预测性旋钮"解耦特征的时间可预测性与控制相关性。比较了六种目标函数：重建、JEPA、动作条件JEPA、基于可控性的JEPA、随机策略下的逆动力学、以及奖励引导的JEPA。

Result: 所有无奖励的预测目标函数对外生控制相关特征的分类准确率接近随机水平，而奖励引导的JEPA能选择性保留该特征。仅需2%的奖励标注数据即可恢复特征，该结论在两种环境、16到1024的潜在维度下均成立。JEPA的潜在空间几何结构仅达到监督参考的一小部分类别分离度。

Conclusion: JEPA-style目标函数会丢弃外生但控制相关的特征，而奖励引导（reward-grounded）是高效且鲁棒的解决方案，少量奖励标注即可弥补该缺陷。

Original Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive (JEPA-style) objectives learn representations by predicting future latents. In doing so they can discard features that are exogenous (uncontrollable by the agent) yet control-relevant, even when those features are trivially encodable. This occurs because the objective optimizes temporal predictability rather than control-relevance. We isolate this failure mode in a controlled 2x2 experimental design that varies feature controllability and relevance independently, using a predictability knob that decouples a feature's temporal predictability from its control-relevance. Comparing six objectives: reconstruction, JEPA, action-conditioned JEPA, controllability-based JEPA, inverse dynamics under a random policy, and reward-grounded JEPA, we observe that all evaluated reward-free predictive objectives leave the exogenous control-relevant feature near chance accuracy, while a reward-grounded variant retains it selectively. The remedy is label-efficient and robust: as little as 2% of reward-labeled transitions recovers the feature, the effect holds across two environments with different surface forms, and it persists across latent dimensions from 16 to 1024. Comparing the learned latent geometry against bisimulation theory's prediction, the JEPA latent realizes only a small fraction of the class separation a supervised reference attains.

中文摘要翻译: 联合嵌入预测（JEPA-style）目标函数通过预测未来潜在表示来学习表征。在此过程中，它们会丢弃那些虽然是外生的（不受智能体控制）但对控制相关的特征，即使这些特征很容易被编码。这是因为该目标函数优化的是时间可预测性而非控制相关性。我们在一个受控的2×2实验设计中独立变化特征的可控性和相关性，使用一个可预测性旋钮将特征的时间可预测性与其控制相关性解耦，从而分离出这一失败模式。比较六种目标函数：重构、JEPA、动作条件JEPA、基于可控性的JEPA、随机策略下的逆动力学以及奖励引导的JEPA，我们观察到所有被评估的无奖励预测目标函数都将外生控制相关特征的准确率留在了接近随机水平，而奖励引导的变体则有选择性地保留了该特征。解决方案是标签高效且鲁棒的：仅需2%的奖励标注过渡即可恢复该特征，该效果在两种不同表面形式的环境中均成立，并且在16到1024的潜在维度上保持一致。将学习到的潜在几何结构与双模拟理论的预测进行比较，JEPA潜在空间仅实现了监督参考所达到的类别分离的一小部分。

</details>


### [427] [Online Data Selection for Instruction Tuning via Gaussian Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30077)
*Jun Wang,Quoc Phong Nguyen,Julien Monteil,Vu Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GAIA框架，利用高斯过程回归对语义空间中的效用流形进行全局建模，通过自适应策略融合机制动态优先选择高效用样本，解决了现有LLM数据选择方法仅依赖局部批量优化的局限。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有LLM训练中的在线数据选择方法多为"批量约束型"，仅在随机批次内进行局部效用优化，缺乏全局视角，难以在非平稳质量评分下实现鲁棒的数据选择。

Method: GAIA框架：1）利用高斯过程回归对跨语义空间的连续效用流形进行全局建模；2）设计自适应策略融合机制动态优先选择高效用样本；3）将策略后验更新建模为经典fixed-share Hedge框架，继承动态遗憾保证以应对非平稳训练质量评分。

Result: 在三个数据集上的实验表明，GAIA显著优于包括GREATS在内的最新基线方法。

Conclusion: GAIA是一种可扩展且鲁棒的高效指令调优解决方案，通过全局数据估值和动态策略更新克服了局部批量优化的局限。

Original Abstract: With Large Language Model (LLM) pre-training and fine-tuning shifting its focus from data volume to data quality, quality data selection has emerged as a critical research topic. Existing online data selection methods for LLM training are typically "batch-constrained", limiting optimization to local utility within random batches. To overcome this, we propose GAIA (Global Adaptive Instruction tuning via GAussian processes), a framework that formulates data valuation as a global estimation process. GAIA employs Gaussian Process regression to model continuous utility manifolds across the semantic space, utilizing an adaptive strategy fusion mechanism to dynamically prioritize high-utility samples. By casting the strategy-posterior update as an instance of the classical fixed-share Hedge framework for tracking the best expert, we inherit a dynamic-regret guarantee that characterizes GAIA's robustness under non-stationary quality scores during training. Empirical evaluations on three datasets demonstrate that GAIA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines like \greats, establishing our method as a scalable and robust solution for efficient instruction tuning.

中文摘要翻译: 随着大语言模型（LLM）预训练和微调的重心从数据数量转向数据质量，质量数据选择已成为一个关键研究课题。现有用于LLM训练的在线数据选择方法通常具有"批量约束"特点，其优化仅限于随机批次内的局部效用。为克服这一局限，我们提出了GAIA（基于高斯过程的全局自适应指令调优）框架，将数据估值形式化为一个全局估计过程。GAIA采用高斯过程回归对跨语义空间的连续效用流形进行建模，并利用自适应策略融合机制动态优先选择高效用样本。通过将策略后验更新建模为经典fixed-share Hedge框架以追踪最优专家，我们继承了动态遗憾保证，刻画了GAIA在训练过程中面对非平稳质量评分时的鲁棒性。在三个数据集上的实验评估表明，GAIA显著优于GREATS等最新基线方法，确立了我们方法作为可扩展且鲁棒的高效指令调优解决方案的地位。

</details>


### [428] [Query-Aware Spreading Activation for Multi-Hop Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30133)
*Illia Makarov,Mykola Glybovets*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散激活的查询感知图RAG方法，通过单次语义门控（余弦相似度）实现查询感知的图遍历，并将整个检索过程表达为单条Cypher查询在Neo4j中执行，无需将图加载到Python内存中。在MuSiQue上匹配QAFD-RAG，优于HippoRAG；消融实验证实语义门控同时提升F1和降低延迟。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于知识图谱的检索增强生成（Graph RAG）在多数系统中存在“查询盲”问题：问题仅用于设置种子节点，后续图遍历仅依赖图结构而忽略查询语义。QAFD-RAG虽实现查询感知遍历但需将全图加载到Python内存并使用迭代求解器，难以与图数据库集成。

Method: 提出一种扩散激活方法：每步使用语义门控——候选实体描述与问题之间的余弦相似度作为步权重，迭代次数固定。整个检索流程（种子映射、传播、Top-K选择和上下文组装）被表达为单条Cypher查询，在Neo4j中一次往返执行，图数据始终不离开数据库。

Result: 在MuSiQue上，本方法精确匹配（EM）达32.80（QAFD-RAG为33.50），优于最强纯结构基线HippoRAG达5.3 EM和3.4 F1。在2WikiMultiHopQA上HippoRAG和QAFD-RAG因其短语-节点架构仍具优势。消融实验表明，禁用门控后F1下降3.6-7.4点，检索延迟增加1.5-4.9倍。

Conclusion: 所提出的单次语义门控扩散激活方法能够在保持查询感知能力的同时，显著简化系统架构（单条Cypher查询、固定迭代次数、无需将图加载到内存），在多数指标上匹配或超越现有方法，并同时提升检索质量与效率。

Original Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation built on knowledge graphs (Graph RAG) outperforms flat passage retrieval on multi-hop question answering by leveraging graph structure. In most existing systems, however, the question only sets the seed nodes; the subsequent traversal becomes "query-blind", depending solely on the graph structure. The exception is QAFD-RAG, which implements query-aware traversal via a flow-diffusion solver with combined edge re-weighting. This architecture requires loading the full graph into Python memory and an iterative solver with a variable number of iterations complicating integration with the graph database. We propose a spreading-activation method that achieves the same query-aware traversal with a single per-step semantic gate: the step weight is the cosine similarity between the candidate entity's description and the question, and the number of iterations is fixed. The whole retrieval procedure - seed mapping, propagation, top-K selection and context assembly - is expressed as a single Cypher query executed in one round-trip to Neo4j; the graph never leaves the database. On MuSiQue our method matches QAFD-RAG by exact match (32.80 vs 33.50) and outperforms the strongest purely-structural baseline in our comparison, HippoRAG, by 5.3 EM and 3.4 F1; on 2WikiMultiHopQA HippoRAG and QAFD-RAG retain an advantage due to their phrase-node architectures. An ablation with the gate disabled confirms that the gate is the source of a simultaneous F1 gain of 3.6 to 7.4 points and a retrieval-latency reduction by a factor of 1.5 to 4.9.

中文摘要翻译: 基于知识图谱的检索增强生成（Graph RAG）通过利用图结构，在多跳问答上优于平面段落检索。然而，在大多数现有系统中，问题仅用于设置种子节点；后续遍历变得"查询盲"，仅依赖图结构。唯一的例外是QAFD-RAG，它通过结合边重新加权的流扩散求解器实现了查询感知遍历。该架构需要将全图加载到Python内存中，并使用迭代次数可变的求解器，增加了与图数据库集成的复杂性。我们提出一种扩散激活方法，通过单步语义门控实现相同的查询感知遍历：步权重是候选实体描述与问题之间的余弦相似度，且迭代次数固定。整个检索流程——种子映射、传播、Top-K选择和上下文组装——被表达为单条Cypher查询，在Neo4j中一次往返执行；图数据始终不离开数据库。在MuSiQue上，我们的方法在精确匹配上匹配QAFD-RAG（32.80 vs 33.50），并超过我们比较中最强的纯结构基线HippoRAG达5.3 EM和3.4 F1；在2WikiMultiHopQA上，HippoRAG和QAFD-RAG因其短语-节点架构仍具优势。消融实验表明，禁用门控后，F1同时下降3.6至7.4个百分点，检索延迟增加1.5至4.9倍，证实了门控的作用。

</details>


### [429] [Robust Strategic Classification under Decision-Dependent Cost Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30136)
*Sura Alhanouti,Güzin Bayraksan,Parinaz Naghizadeh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对现有战略分类研究假设操纵成本固定的局限性，提出并分析了一个具有决策依赖不确定性集的两阶段鲁棒优化框架，以捕捉操纵成本随算法决策演化的动态特性，从而减少不确定性并更有效地抑制策略性博弈行为。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有战略分类研究均假设操纵成本固定且独立于分类器的决策，然而实际中操纵成本会随算法过往决策而动态演化（今天的决策会影响明天的成本），因此需要建立能够捕获这种依赖关系的模型。

Method: 提出并分析了一个两阶段鲁棒优化框架，采用决策依赖不确定性集来建模操纵成本与分类器决策之间的动态依赖关系。

Result: 意识到策略依赖成本不仅能减少不确定性，还能更好地抑制算法系统随时间推移被博弈（gaming）的现象。

Conclusion: 将操纵成本建模为决策依赖的变量比固定成本假设更符合实际，且能有效减少战略行为，提升算法的鲁棒性。

Original Abstract: Humans facing algorithmic decision systems have been found to ``game'' them by altering their input data (at a cost to them) in order to favorably change the algorithmic outcomes they receive (at a cost to the algorithm). The growing literature on strategic classification seeks to develop robust machine learning algorithms that account for, and reduce, unwanted strategic behavior. A limitation of these existing works is that they assume the cost of strategic behavior to be fixed and independent of the classifier's decision. In practice, however, manipulation costs evolve and depend on past algorithmic decisions: today's decisions influence tomorrow's costs. This paper proposes and analyzes a two-stage robust optimization framework with a decision-dependent uncertainty set to capture such dependencies. We highlight that awareness of policy-dependent costs not only reduces uncertainty, but also better curtails gaming of the algorithmic system over time.

中文摘要翻译: 面对算法决策系统的人类已被发现会通过改变其输入数据（需要付出代价）来"博弈"系统，从而以有利于自身的方式改变其收到的算法结果（同时给算法带来代价）。日益增多的战略分类文献致力于开发鲁棒的机器学习算法，以应对并减少不期望的战略行为。现有工作的一个局限性在于它们假设战略行为的成本是固定的，且独立于分类器的决策。然而在实践中，操纵成本会演化，并且依赖于过去的算法决策：今天的决策会影响明天的成本。本文提出并分析了一个具有决策依赖不确定性集的两阶段鲁棒优化框架，以捕获此类依赖关系。我们强调，意识到策略依赖成本不仅能减少不确定性，还能更好地抑制算法系统随时间推移被博弈的现象。

</details>


### [430] [Federated Learning with Energy-Based Structured Probabilistic Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30161)
*Dario Fenoglio,Daniil Kirilenko,Martin Gjoreski,Marc Langheinrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种利用条件随机场（CRF）优化联邦学习客户端聚合权重的框架，通过建模客户端个体可靠性与客户端间交互，在非IID数据下提升了全局模型的收敛性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有联邦学习通常使用固定或启发式加权规则聚合客户端更新，在客户端数据异质且贡献不一致时，这种聚合方式可能是次优的。

Method: 提出使用条件随机场（CRF）优化客户端聚合权重：定义单个客户端的单元势能（建模个体可靠性）和所有客户端对的成对势能（建模客户端间交互），通过CRF推理得到聚合权重。

Result: 在非IID异质数据下，该方法在性能上持续优于多个经典联邦学习基线方法。

Conclusion: 利用CRF建模客户端个体可靠性和交互关系可以生成更优的聚合权重，从而提升联邦学习在异质场景下的训练效果。

Original Abstract: Federated learning typically aggregates client updates using fixed or heuristic weighting rules, which can be suboptimal when clients have heterogeneous data and varying contributions to the global model. We propose a framework that refines client aggregation weights using Conditional Random Fields (CRFs). Our method defines unary potentials for individual clients and pairwise potentials for all client pairs, allowing the server to model both client-specific reliability and interactions between clients. The resulting CRF inference produces aggregation weights that enable better convergence of the global training objective. Experiments show that, under non-IID heterogeneity, our approach consistently improves performance over well-established federated learning baselines.

中文摘要翻译: 联邦学习通常使用固定的或启发式的加权规则来聚合客户端更新，当客户端存在异质数据且对全局模型的贡献不一致时，这种方式可能是次优的。我们提出了一种利用条件随机场（CRF）优化客户端聚合权重的框架。该方法为每个客户端定义单元势能，并为所有客户端对定义成对势能，使得服务器能够同时建模单个客户端的可靠性和客户端之间的交互关系。通过CRF推理得到的聚合权重能够使全局训练目标更好地收敛。实验表明，在非独立同分布（非IID）的异质数据下，我们的方法在性能上持续优于多个经典联邦学习基线方法。

</details>


### [431] [Beyond Drug Discovery: The Nanotechnology Molecular Optimization (NMO) Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30170)
*Matthias Blaschke,Daniel Kienzle,Zsuzsanna Koczor-Benda,Julian Lorenz,Rainer Lienhart,Fabian Pauly*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了纳米技术分子优化（NMO）基准，用基于物理的量子模拟替代传统代理指标，以推动生成分子模型从简单的排行榜优化转向真正的科学发现。研究发现先进方法在刚性结构约束和崎岖适应度景观下表现较差，而简单方法反而更优；作者提出新的基线方法，包括新型表示和领域无关预训练策略，超越了现有最先进的物理性质并发现了新的结构基序。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 当前生成分子设计依赖于药物样性质的简单代理基准和在大规模制药数据集上预训练的模型，这限制了模型向与药物发现结构不同的领域的迁移能力。为克服这一局限并推动发现走向真实、科学严谨的目标，作者引入了NMO基准，连接机器学习和量子材料科学。

Method: 提出了NMO基准，用量子模拟替代代理预言机，并引入严格协议优先考虑科学实用性。开发了新基线方法，包括一种用于建模结构约束的新型表示，以及一种消除制药数据集偏见的领域无关预训练策略。

Result: 先进的分子优化方法在NMO任务上表现不如更简单的方法。新基线方法超越了最先进的物理性质，并揭示了先前未知的结构基序，为纳米技术社区提供了新的见解。

Conclusion: 证明机器学习可以驱动真正的科学发现，而不仅仅是优化排行榜指标。物理驱动的基准和领域无关策略是打破领域偏见、实现跨学科科学发现的关键。

Original Abstract: Generative molecular design is shaped by simple proxy benchmarks for drug-like properties and models pretrained on large pharmaceutical datasets. This combination yields strong benchmark metrics but limits transferability to domains structurally distinct from drug discovery. To overcome this limitation and drive discovery toward real, scientifically grounded targets, we introduce the Nanotechnology Molecular Optimization (NMO) Benchmark, which bridges machine learning (ML) and quantum materials science. NMO acts simultaneously as a rigorous testbed for the ML community and a discovery engine for nanotechnology research. The suite replaces proxy oracles with quantum simulations and introduces strict protocols that prioritize scientific utility over leaderboard-oriented overfitting. The physics-based NMO tasks impose hard structural constraints and rugged fitness landscapes, posing fundamentally new requirements on generative models. Notably, advanced molecular optimization methods underperform much simpler approaches on the NMO tasks. We develop a new baseline method identifying the critical components to solve the NMO tasks, including a novel representation for modeling structural constraints and a domain-agnostic pretraining strategy to eliminate pharmaceutical dataset bias. Our results surpass state-of-the-art physical properties and reveal previously unknown structural motifs, offering new insights for the nanotechnology community and demonstrating that ML can drive genuine scientific discovery.

中文摘要翻译: 生成分子设计长期受限于基于药物样性质的简单代理基准以及在大规模制药数据集上预训练的模型。这种组合虽然能获得优异的基准指标，但限制了向与药物发现结构不同的领域的迁移能力。为克服这一局限并推动发现走向真正有科学依据的目标，我们提出了纳米技术分子优化（NMO）基准，该基准连接了机器学习与量子材料科学。NMO同时作为机器学习社区的严格测试平台和纳米技术研究的发现引擎。该基准用量子模拟替代代理预言机，并引入严格协议，优先考虑科学实用性而非排行榜导向的过拟合。基于物理的NMO任务施加了硬性结构约束和崎岖的适应度景观，对生成模型提出了全新的要求。值得注意的是，先进的分子优化方法在NMO任务上表现不如更简单的方法。我们开发了一种新的基线方法，识别出解决NMO任务的关键组件，包括用于建模结构约束的新型表示，以及消除制药数据集偏见的领域无关预训练策略。我们的结果超越了最先进的物理性质，并揭示了先前未知的结构基序，为纳米技术社区提供了新的见解，证明机器学习可以驱动真正的科学发现。

</details>


### [432] [Characterizing Optimizer-Dependent Training Dynamics Through Hessian Eigenvector Displacement and Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30226)
*Marcelina Marjankowska,Valerio Modugno,Paolo Barucca*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络训练中Hessian矩阵主特征向量的演化动态，发现SGD使曲率方向趋于稳定，而Adam导致特征向量持续重组并出现参数局部化现象。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: Hessian特征值已被广泛用于分析神经网络的锐度、泛化和优化动态，但特征向量的演化规律尚不清晰。本文旨在揭示Hessian主特征向量在训练过程中的变化模式及其对学习轨迹的影响。

Method: 在多类分类任务上训练多层感知机，通过两个互补统计量追踪特征向量动态：(i) 位移（借鉴玻璃系统分析），(ii) 逆参与比（IPR）衡量局部化程度。并与架构诱导的随机零模型进行比较。

Result: SGD训练中主导曲率方向逐渐稳定；Adam则表现出显著的特征向量持续重组，并且出现局部化现象——少数参数贡献了不成比例的主导曲率。

Conclusion: Hessian特征向量动态能有效捕捉不同优化器行为的关键差异及其导致的训练轨迹区别。

Original Abstract: Hessian spectral properties are a standard tool in analysing neural-network training, with eigenvalues linked to sharpness, generalization, and optimization dynamics. Eigenvalues quantify curvature magnitude, while eigenvectors identify which parameters generate that curvature. In this work, we study how the leading Hessian eigenvectors evolve during training and how they affect the learning trajectories. We track the training dynamics of multilayer perceptrons on a classification problem and measure eigenvector dynamics through two complementary statistics: (i) displacement over time, inspired by analyses of glassy systems, and (ii) localization via the inverse participation ratio. The metrics are compared against a random null model of the Hessian induced by the architecture. Our results reveal clear optimizer-dependent behaviour. SGD leads to progressively more stable leading curvature directions, while Adam exhibits substantially stronger reorganization of eigenvectors throughout training. We also observe a localization phenomenon under Adam, where a small subset of parameters contributes disproportionately to the leading curvature directions. These results suggest that Hessian eigenvector dynamics capture key differences in optimizer behaviour and the resulting training trajectories.

中文摘要翻译: Hessian谱性质是分析神经网络训练的标准工具，其特征值与锐度、泛化和优化动力学相关联。特征值量化曲率大小，而特征向量则识别产生该曲率的参数。本文研究训练过程中Hessian主导特征向量的演化及其对学习轨迹的影响。我们在分类任务上追踪多层感知机的训练动态，通过两个互补统计量测量特征向量动力学：(i) 位移（受玻璃系统分析启发），(ii) 通过逆参与比衡量的局部化程度。各指标与架构诱导的Hessian随机零模型进行比较。结果表明存在明确的优化器依赖行为：SGD使主导曲率方向逐步趋于稳定，而Adam在整个训练过程中表现出显著更强的特征向量重组。我们还在Adam下观察到局部化现象，即一小部分参数对主导曲率方向产生了不成比例的贡献。这些结果表明，Hessian特征向量动态能够捕捉优化器行为的关键差异及其导致的训练轨迹区别。

</details>


### [433] [B3O: Scalable Boltzmann Batch Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30228)
*Maximilian Bloor,Liyuan Xu,Hrvoje Stojic,Victor Picheny*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: B3O将批量贝叶斯优化重新定义为纯采样问题，通过从采集函数的玻尔兹曼分布中直接采样来生成批量查询，避免了现有大批量方法的计算瓶颈，理论上证明了仅增加可忽略的额外遗憾，实验上在多个任务中表现优异。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现代工程工作流依赖大规模并行仿真，迫切需要可扩展的大批量贝叶斯优化方法，但现有批量BO方法计算成本高或依赖近似方法导致批次多样性不足。

Method: 提出B3O框架，将批量生成重构为纯采样问题：直接从采集函数定义的玻尔兹曼分布中采样查询点，避免了现有大批量方法的计算瓶颈。

Result: 理论上证明从该分布采样的查询仅带来可忽略的额外遗憾；实验上在标准合成基准测试中优于现有批量BO方法，并在多目标电极设计和混合变量赛车配置等复杂应用任务中表现鲁棒。

Conclusion: B3O通过将批量生成转化为玻尔兹曼采样问题，有效解决了大批量贝叶斯优化的可扩展性和批次多样性问题，兼具理论保证和实际有效性。

Original Abstract: Modern engineering workflows increasingly rely on massive parallel simulation, driving the need for scalable, large-batch Bayesian Optimization (BO). Existing batch BO methods, however, incur large computational cost or rely on approximations that erode batch diversity. We propose B3O (Boltzmann Batch Bayesian Optimization), a framework that reframes batch generation as a pure sampling problem: drawing samples directly from the Boltzmann distribution defined by the acquisition function avoids the bottlenecks of existing large-batch methods. Theoretically, we prove that queries sampled from this distribution incur only negligible additional regret. Empirically, B3O outperforms existing batch BO methods on standard synthetic benchmarks and adapts robustly across complex applied tasks, including multi-objective electrode design and mixed-variable race car configuration.

中文摘要翻译: 现代工程工作流日益依赖大规模并行仿真，驱动了对可扩展的大批量贝叶斯优化（BO）的需求。然而，现有批量BO方法要么计算成本高昂，要么依赖损害批次多样性的近似方法。我们提出B3O（玻尔兹曼批量贝叶斯优化），该框架将批量生成重构为纯采样问题：直接从采集函数定义的玻尔兹曼分布中采样查询点，从而避免了现有大批量方法的瓶颈。理论上，我们证明从该分布采样的查询仅带来可忽略的额外遗憾。实验上，B3O在标准合成基准测试中优于现有批量BO方法，并在包括多目标电极设计和混合变量赛车配置在内的复杂应用任务中展现出鲁棒的自适应能力。

</details>


### [434] [Curvature-Guided Sheaf Diffusion for Unsupervised Community Detection on Heterophilic Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30249)
*Feifan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种全无监督的异质图社区检测算法CGSD，利用边的离散Forman-Ricci曲率作为拓扑信号，通过曲率门控的束扩散编码器和曲率感知谱聚类器实现，在五个异质图基准上取得有竞争力的结果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 异质图中相连节点常属于不同类别，传统无监督社区检测方法（如模块度方法、谱方法）忽略节点特征，而深度图聚类方法依赖对比学习或生成式机制，缺乏可解释性。因此需要一种既利用拓扑结构又不依赖监督信号、同时可解释的无监督社区检测方法。

Method: CGSD包含三个核心贡献：(i) 曲率门控束扩散编码器——通过σ(κ_e)对边消息进行门控，使用三种无标签结构损失（模块度、抗坍缩、曲率加权重构）训练；(ii) 曲率感知谱聚类器CSpec——在Ng-Jordan-Weiss聚类前，用σ(ακ_{e^*})对嵌入的k-NN亲和度重新加权；(iii) 统一的无标签评估框架，与九种真正无监督基线对比。

Result: 在Cora、Cornell、Texas、Wisconsin、Chameleon五个异质图基准上，CGSD在Wisconsin和Chameleon上取得最优结果，在其余三个上具有竞争力。聚类器CSpec在相同嵌入上相比K-Means将平均NMI从0.091提升至0.107（提升15%，配对t检验p=0.008）。社区内和社区间的曲率分布明显分离，机制可解释。

Conclusion: CGSD通过将边曲率作为单一拓扑信号并应用于编码器和聚类器两个阶段，实现了全无监督、可解释且性能有竞争力的异质图社区检测。曲率感知谱聚类器是性能提升的关键驱动因素。

Original Abstract: Detecting communities in heterophilic graphs -- where connected nodes often belong to different classes -- is hard for unsupervised methods: classical modularity and spectral methods are feature agnostic, while deep graph-clustering methods rely on contrastive or generative machinery that is opaque. We propose Curvature-Guided Sheaf Diffusion (CGSD), a fully unsupervised community-detection algorithm that uses the discrete Forman--Ricci curvature of each edge as its single topological signal, propagated through every stage of an end-to-end pipeline. CGSD makes three concrete contributions: (i)~a curvature-gated sheaf-diffusion encoder that gates edge messages by $σ(κ_e)$ and is trained from three label-free structural losses (modularity, anti-collapse, curvature-weighted reconstruction); (ii)~a curvature-aware spectral clusterer (CSpec) that re-weights the $k$-NN affinity of the embedding by $σ(ακ_{e^*})$ before Ng--Jordan--Weiss; and (iii)~a unified label-free evaluation against nine truly-unsupervised baselines. On five heterophilic benchmarks (Cora, Cornell, Texas, Wisconsin, Chameleon), CGSD wins outright on Wisconsin and Chameleon and is competitive on the remaining three against nine unsupervised baselines. The gain over the strongest baseline is driven by the clusterer, not the encoder: on the same embedding, CSpec improves mean NMI from $0.091$ with $K$-Means to $0.107$ ($+15\%$, paired $t$-test $p=0.008$). The mechanism is interpretable: intra-community and inter-community curvature distributions are visibly separated. Code is open-sourced at https://github.com/woodywff/cgsd.

中文摘要翻译: 在异质图中检测社区——其中相连节点常属于不同类别——对无监督方法而言是困难的：经典的模块度方法和谱方法忽略特征，而深度图聚类方法依赖不透明的对比学习或生成式机制。我们提出曲率引导的束扩散（Curvature-Guided Sheaf Diffusion, CGSD），一种完全无监督的社区检测算法，它将每条边的离散Forman-Ricci曲率作为单一拓扑信号，并在端到端管线的每个阶段进行传播。CGSD做出三项具体贡献：(i) 曲率门控束扩散编码器——通过σ(κ_e)对边消息进行门控，并从三种无标签结构损失（模块度、抗坍缩、曲率加权重构）训练；(ii) 曲率感知谱聚类器（CSpec）——在Ng-Jordan-Weiss聚类之前，用σ(ακ_{e^*})对嵌入的k-NN亲和度重新加权；以及(iii) 一个统一的、与九种真正无监督基线对比的无标签评估框架。在五个异质图基准（Cora、Cornell、Texas、Wisconsin、Chameleon）上，CGSD在Wisconsin和Chameleon上完胜，并在其余三个上对九种无监督基线具有竞争力。相比最强基线的提升来自聚类器而非编码器：在相同嵌入上，CSpec将平均NMI从K-Means的0.091提升至0.107（提升15%，配对t检验p=0.008）。该机制是可解释的：社区内和社区间的曲率分布明显分离。代码已在https://github.com/woodywff/cgsd开源。

</details>


### [435] [KnowsTFM: Knowledge-Informed Fine-Tuning of Small Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30258)
*Boshko Koloski,Xiangjian Jiang,Senja Pollak,Blaž Škrlj,Mateja Jamnik,Nikola Simidjievski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出知识注入微调方法（KnowTab），通过两种互补机制（基于知识图谱的结构注意力先验和参数高效的低秩更新）将领域结构化知识注入小型表格基础模型（如TabPFN、TabICL变体），从而提升其在数据稀缺、高维且分布偏移的专业领域中的性能。实验表明该方法在专业领域有显著提升，但在通用领域增益有限，同时发现持续微调前沿模型可能导致预训练知识崩溃。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有表格基础模型在通用小/中规模任务上表现良好，但在数据稀缺、高维且分布偏移的专业领域中仍无法超越精心设计的领域专用方法。同时，许多专业领域存在以知识图谱和知识库形式提供的结构化关系知识，但如何利用这些知识来改进和引导小型专业表格基础模型尚不清楚。

Method: 提出知识注入微调框架（KnowTab），包含两种互补机制：(1) 基于知识图谱的结构注意力先验，将领域结构化知识注入注意力层；(2) 参数高效的低秩更新（LoRA-style），在微调时仅更新少量参数。该方法适用于TabPFN和TabICL风格的小型表格基础模型变体，这些变体在受控合成先验族上预训练。

Result: (1) 在专业领域设置中，注入领域结构化知识进行微调相比原始变体取得了有意义的性能提升；(2) 在通用领域任务上增益微乎其微；(3) 持续微调前沿模型可能触发预训练知识和机制的崩溃。

Conclusion: 知识注入微调能有效提升小型表格基础模型在专业领域中的表现，但收益集中在领域特定场景而非通用任务。同时需警惕持续微调对预训练知识的破坏性影响。

Original Abstract: Tabular foundation models have advanced deep learning for tabular data by delivering strong default performance across many small and medium tasks. Yet in niche domains, where data is scarce, high-dimensional, and shifted from the pretraining distribution, they may still fail to outperform carefully designed domain-specific methods. Many such domains also provide curated relational knowledge in the form of knowledge graphs and knowledge banks, but how to use this knowledge to improve and steer \textit{small} specialist tabular foundation models remains unclear. We address this problem through \textbf{Know}ledge-informed fine-tuning of \textbf{s}mall \textbf{T}abular \textbf{F}oundation \textbf{M}odels (\modelname). Specifically, we study nanoscale TabPFN- and TabICL-style variants, pretrained under controlled synthetic prior families and adapted using two complementary mechanisms: structural attention priors derived from knowledge graphs and parameter-efficient low-rank updates. We show that injecting domain-specific structural knowledge during fine-tuning yields meaningful gains over vanilla variants in specialist settings, whereas gains on general-domain tasks are marginal. We further observe that continual fine-tuning of frontier models can trigger collapse of pretrained knowledge and mechanisms.

中文摘要翻译: 表格基础模型通过在许多中小规模任务上提供强大的默认性能，推动了表格数据深度学习的发展。然而，在数据稀缺、高维且与预训练分布存在偏移的专业领域中，它们仍然可能无法超越精心设计的领域专用方法。许多此类领域也提供以知识图谱和知识库形式呈现的策展关系知识，但如何利用这些知识来改进和引导小型专业表格基础模型仍不清楚。本文通过知识注入微调小型表格基础模型（KnowTab）来解决这一问题。具体而言，我们研究了纳米级TabPFN和TabICL风格的变体，这些变体在受控合成先验族上进行预训练，并通过两种互补机制进行适配：源自知识图谱的结构注意力先验和参数高效的低秩更新。我们发现，在专业领域设置中注入领域结构化知识进行微调相比于原始变体取得了有意义的提升，而在通用领域任务上的增益微乎其微。我们进一步观察到，对前沿模型进行持续微调可能会触发预训练知识和机制的崩溃。

</details>


### [436] [When Is a Draft Accepted? A Theory of Acceptance in Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30265)
*Aaryam Sharma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对推测解码在贪婪解码、松弛接受准则和树形候选集等实际场景中的确定性局部接受事件，建立了一套理论框架，推导了精确的KL散度证书和基于边际的边界，并通过Qwen3模型验证了松弛和树形准则能显著扩大认证接受区域。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有推测解码理论主要研究随机、保分布的场景（精确采样目标分布），而实际系统多采用贪婪解码、松弛接受规则或树形候选集，其成功取决于局部排序和阈值事件而非精确分布等价，缺乏相应的理论分析。

Method: (1) 将多种常见接受准则的拒绝域表征为目标分布的低水平集；(2) 推导拒绝所需的精确KL散度，给出严格贪婪解码、加性/乘性松弛接受、top-m松弛准则和熵阈值接受的精确证书与尖锐边际边界；(3) 将框架扩展到贪婪树解码，推导目标贪婪token仍被drafter的top-m候选覆盖的精确证书和仅边际证书。

Result: 在Qwen3模型上的评估表明，松弛和树形准则能显著扩大认证接受区域，尤其是在目标模型分布边际较低的解码步骤上。

Conclusion: 本文通过刻画实际推理系统中常见的确定性局部接受事件，补充了现有推测解码的保分布分析，为理解松弛和树形准则的有效性提供了理论基础。

Original Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language model inference by using a fast drafter to propose candidate tokens that are then verified by a larger target model. Existing theory largely studies the stochastic, distribution-preserving setting, where the goal is to exactly sample from the target distribution. In contrast, many practical systems use greedy decoding, relaxed acceptance rules, or tree-based candidate sets, where success is governed by local ranking and threshold events rather than exact distributional equality. We develop a theory for these regimes. We identify that many common acceptance criteria have rejection regions that can be characterized as lower level sets of the target distribution. For these, we characterize the exact KL divergence required for rejection yielding exact certificates and sharp margin-based bounds for strict greedy decoding, additive and multiplicative relaxed acceptance, top-(m) relaxed criteria, and entropy-thresholded acceptance. We then extend the framework to greedy tree decoding, deriving exact and margin-only certificates for when the target greedy token remains covered by the drafter's top-(m) candidates. Finally, we evaluate the resulting certificates on Qwen3 models, showing that relaxed and tree-based criteria substantially enlarge the region of certified acceptance, especially on decoding steps with low target model distribution margin. These results complement existing distribution-preserving analyses of speculative decoding by characterizing the deterministic local acceptance events common in practical inference systems.

中文摘要翻译: 推测解码通过使用快速草稿模型提出候选令牌，再由较大的目标模型验证，从而加速语言模型推理。现有理论主要研究随机、保分布的场景，其目标是精确地从目标分布中采样。相比之下，许多实际系统采用贪婪解码、松弛接受规则或树形候选集，其成功取决于局部排序和阈值事件，而非精确的分布等价性。我们为这些场景发展了一套理论。我们发现，许多常见接受准则的拒绝域可以被表征为目标分布的低水平集。针对这些准则，我们刻画了拒绝所需的精确KL散度，从而为严格贪婪解码、加性和乘性松弛接受、top-m松弛准则以及熵阈值接受提供了精确证书和尖锐的基于边际的边界。然后，我们将该框架扩展到贪婪树解码，推导了当目标贪婪令牌仍被草稿模型的top-m候选覆盖时的精确证书和仅边际证书。最后，我们在Qwen3模型上评估了所得证书，表明松弛和基于树的准则能显著扩大认证接受区域，尤其是在目标模型分布边际较低的解码步骤上。这些结果通过刻画实际推理系统中常见的确定性局部接受事件，补充了现有推测解码的保分布分析。

</details>


### [437] [Towards Continual Motion-Language Agents: LoRA Variants for Incremental Motion Understanding and Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30266)
*Bertram Taetz,Hugo Albuquerque Cosme da Silva,Gabriele Bleser-Taetz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了双向运动-语言智能体在持续学习场景下的稳定性-可塑性权衡问题，提出基于混合专家架构和LoRA的持续学习方法，在五任务基准上实现了近零遗忘，并发现硬专家选择优于软专家混合。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有运动-语言基础模型在静态场景表现良好，但自主智能体在动态环境中需要持续学习新运动概念（如新运动风格或专业手势），同时不能灾难性遗忘已有技能，因此需要研究双向运动-语言学习中的稳定性-可塑性权衡问题。

Method: 基于冻结的大语言模型主干，引入低秩适应（LoRA）变体减轻任务间干扰；提出混合专家（MoE）架构，利用自编码器路由在推理时选择任务特定专家，无需任务标签。

Result: 在从HumanML3D通过语义聚类构建的五任务基准上，方法在M2T和T2M两个方向均实现近零遗忘，同时保持高质量生成和描述能力；硬专家选择显著优于软专家混合；发现token级准确率与下游生成质量之间存在不一致性。

Conclusion: 提出的方法能有效缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘，保持专家隔离对维持性能至关重要；未来需要更全面的评估协议来应对token级准确率与生成质量之间的分歧。

Original Abstract: Motion-language agents must possess the bidirectional capability to both understand human movement (motion-to-text, M2T) and generate it from natural language (text-to-motion, T2M). While foundational models have achieved strong performance in static settings, autonomous agents operating in dynamic environments must continuously incorporate new motion concepts -- such as novel athletic styles or specialized gestures -- without catastrophic forgetting of previously acquired skills. We investigate the stability-plasticity trade-off in bidirectional motion-language learning under sequential task exposure. Building on a frozen large language model backbone, we introduce low-rank adaptation (LoRA) variants designed to mitigate inter-task interference. We specifically propose mixture-of-experts architectures that utilize an autoencoder-based router to select task-specific experts at inference time, so that no task-label is needed. To evaluate these methods, we establish a reproducible five-task benchmark derived from HumanML3D through semantic clustering of motion descriptions. Our experimental results demonstrate near-zero forgetting across both M2T and T2M directions while maintaining high generation and captioning quality. Furthermore, we show that hard expert selection via routing significantly outperforms soft expert blending in quality metrics, indicating that preserving expert isolation is critical for maintaining performance in our continual learning setting. Finally, we observe that a divergence between token-level accuracy and downstream generation quality may occur, highlighting the need for more comprehensive evaluation protocols in future research on lifelong motion-language agents.

中文摘要翻译: 运动-语言智能体必须具备双向能力：既能理解人类动作（动作到文本，M2T），也能从自然语言生成动作（文本到动作，T2M）。虽然基础模型在静态场景中取得了优异性能，但在动态环境中运行的自主智能体必须持续融入新的运动概念——例如新颖的运动风格或专业手势——同时避免灾难性遗忘先前习得的技能。本文研究了在顺序任务暴露下双向运动-语言学习中的稳定性-可塑性权衡。基于冻结的大语言模型主干，我们引入了旨在减轻任务间干扰的低秩适应（LoRA）变体。我们特别提出了混合专家架构，利用自编码器路由在推理时选择任务特定专家，无需任务标签。为评估这些方法，我们通过语义聚类运动描述，从HumanML3D构建了一个可复现的五任务基准。实验结果表明，在M2T和T2M两个方向上均实现了近零遗忘，同时保持了高质量的生成和描述能力。此外，我们发现通过路由进行硬专家选择在质量指标上显著优于软专家混合，这表明保持专家隔离对于在我们的持续学习场景中维持性能至关重要。最后，我们观察到token级准确率与下游生成质量之间可能存在分歧，这凸显了未来关于终身运动-语言智能体的研究需要更全面的评估协议。

</details>


### [438] [DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview: A Low-Compute Real-Time Controllable World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30292)
*Daniyel Ayupov,Artur Markov-Tsoy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview 是一个面向实时交互世界模拟的预览级基础世界模型，采用 LongLive 自回归视频堆栈和残差动作路径，支持键盘鼠标控制、多模态初始化、分钟级交互展开，在单张 RTX 4090 上以低内存占用达到 14-15 FPS，展示了在消费级 GPU 上实现实时可控世界模型预览的低计算量路线。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有前沿世界模拟器计算量巨大，难以在消费级 GPU 上运行。本文旨在探索一条低计算量、可在消费级 GPU 上实时运行的交互式世界模型路线，弥补前沿模型在低算力适配和广泛交互能力覆盖方面的不足。
