Method: 基于 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 开源视频主干，采用 LongLive 自回归视频堆栈，并引入受 Matrix-Game 系列启发的残差动作路径（residual action pathway），通过针对性适配训练构建预览系统。

Result: 支持实时键盘鼠标控制、多模态初始化、中途重新提示、双视角操作，在单张 RTX 4090 上以原生 480p 分辨率达到 14-15 FPS，内存占用低，可实现分钟级交互式展开。

Conclusion: DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview 尚未达到记忆完备或前沿质量的水平，但展示了一条在消费级 GPU 上实现实时可控世界模型预览的实用低计算量路线。

Original Abstract: We present DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview, a preview foundational world model for real-time interactive world simulation. The system adapts the LongLive 1 autoregressive video stack, itself derived from Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, with a residual action pathway inspired by the Matrix-Game family. DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview focuses on a complementary axis to frontier-scale world simulators: low-compute adaptation, consumer-GPU runtime, and broad interactive capability coverage. It supports live keyboard and mouse control, multimodal initialization, mid-stream reprompting, dual-view operation, and minute-scale interactive rollouts at native 480p resolution, reaching up to 14 to 15 FPS FPS on a single RTX 4090 with a low memory footprint. By leveraging open video backbones and applying targeted adaptation runs, we build the preview system with high cost-efficiency. DF-World 0.1 Preview is not yet a memory-complete or frontier-quality world simulator, but demonstrates a practical low-compute route toward real-time controllable world-model previews on consumer GPUs.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了 DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview，一个用于实时交互世界模拟的预览级基础世界模型。该系统采用 LongLive 自回归视频堆栈（其本身源自 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B），并结合了受 Matrix-Game 系列启发的残差动作路径。DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview 聚焦于与前沿规模世界模拟器互补的维度：低计算量适配、消费级 GPU 运行时以及广泛的交互能力覆盖。它支持实时键盘鼠标控制、多模态初始化、中途重新提示、双视角操作，以及原生 480p 分辨率下达到分钟级的交互式展开，在单张 RTX 4090 上以低内存占用达到 14 至 15 FPS。通过利用开源视频主干并进行针对性适配训练，我们以高成本效益构建了该预览系统。DF-World 0.1 Preview 尚未达到记忆完备或前沿质量的世界模拟器水平，但它展示了一条在消费级 GPU 上实现实时可控世界模型预览的实用低计算量路线。

</details>


### [439] [Toward an Energy-Optimized Operation of Data Centers Located in Wind Farms Using Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30316)
*Jan Stenner,Alexander Kilian,Sebastian Peitz,Hermann de Meer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习在集成风电的高性能计算数据中心中作为在线控制器进行负载迁移，发现纯强化学习存在信用分配问题，并通过模仿学习和奖励塑形两种方法进行改进，最终在离线优化器存在性能差距的背景下建立了可复现的基准框架。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在风电集成的高性能计算数据中心中，强化学习作为在线控制器进行负载迁移时存在信用分配问题，倾向于在白天未充分利用免费风能，亟需有效的改进方法。

Method: 构建了可复现的固定天仿真框架（含合成风能、电价信号及延迟完成反馈），聚焦单风机+单数据中心的最小场景；评估两种互补策略：基于优化的模仿学习和基于势能的奖励塑形；使用PPO和带额外同策略更新例程的SAC变体进行多种子训练。

Result: PPO和带同策略更新的SAC变体在学习策略中表现优异；模仿学习和奖励塑形在相关配置下均能带来改进；但强化学习与离线优化器之间仍存在性能差距（优化器具有全天前瞻性离线规划能力）。

Conclusion: 该基准测试和消融实验为将方法扩展到更丰富的多站点和连续时间场景提供了透明的基础。

Original Abstract: This paper studies Reinforcement Learning as an online controller for curtailment-aware workload shifting in wind-turbine-integrated high-performance computing (HPC) data centers. We introduce a reproducible fixed-day simulation framework with synthetic wind and price signals and delayed completion feedback, designed to be extensible toward more complex scenarios. As a controlled benchmarking basis, we then focus on the minimal case with one wind turbine and one co-located data center. In this setting, pure Reinforcement Learning exhibits a pronounced credit-assignment problem and tends to underuse free wind energy early in the day. We therefore evaluate two complementary countermeasures: optimization-based Imitation Learning and potential-based Reward Shaping. Across multi-seed training and a 200-day test set, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) variant with an additional on-policy update routine achieve strong empirical performance among learned policies, and both Imitation Learning and Reward Shaping provide improvements in relevant configurations. A performance gap to the optimizer remains, which is expected: the optimizer plans offline with full-day foresight, whereas Reinforcement Learning must decide online from current observations without future realizations. The benchmark and ablation results provide a transparent basis for extending the approach toward richer multi-site and continuous-time scenarios.

中文摘要翻译: 本文研究强化学习作为在线控制器在集成风电的高性能计算数据中心中实现负载迁移（curtailment-aware workload shifting）的应用。我们引入了一个可复现的固定天仿真框架，包含合成风能与电价信号以及延迟完成反馈机制，该框架设计为可扩展至更复杂的场景。作为受控基准测试的基础，我们聚焦于一台风机与一个同址数据中心的最小化场景。在此设置下，纯强化学习表现出明显的信用分配问题，倾向于在白天未能充分利用免费风能。因此，我们评估了两种互补的改进策略：基于优化的模仿学习和基于势能的奖励塑形。经过多种子训练和200天测试集的验证，近端策略优化（PPO）和一种带有额外同策略更新例程的软演员-评论家（SAC）变体在学习策略中取得了优异的实证表现，同时模仿学习和奖励塑形在相关配置下均带来了性能提升。与优化器之间仍存在性能差距，这是预期的结果：优化器具备全天前瞻性进行离线规划，而强化学习必须基于当前观测进行在线决策，无法获知未来实现值。该基准测试与消融实验为将该方法扩展到更丰富的多站点和连续时间场景提供了透明的基础。

</details>


### [440] [FlexTab: A Flexible Encoder-Decoder Architecture for In-Context Learning Across Diverse Tabular Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30336)
*Marek Polewczyk,Maximilian Schambach,Marco Spinaci,Sam Thelin,Johannes Höhne*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlexTab 是一种灵活的编码器-解码器架构，通过任务无关的编码器和任务特定的解码器实现表格数据的上下文学习，在多个任务上达到或超越最先进性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有表格上下文学习方法将特征表示与特定的预测目标纠缠在一起，无法跨多个下游任务共享表示，缺乏灵活性和通用性。

Method: 采用单一任务无关编码器生成目标无关的行嵌入，搭配多个任务特定解码器，在大规模真实无标注表格数据上联合训练。

Result: 在分类、回归、异常检测和实体匹配上达到最先进水平；在关系型数据库的实体分类上与专用模型竞争力相当。

Conclusion: 一个共享编码器搭配任务特定解码器可以作为多种表格预测问题的通用骨干网络。

Original Abstract: We introduce FlexTab, a flexible encoder-decoder architecture for in-context learning on tabular data that pairs a single, task-agnostic encoder with a suite of task-specific decoders. Unlike existing tabular in-context learners, which entangle feature representations with a specific prediction target, our design produces \textit{target-agnostic} row embeddings that can be leveraged across a wide range of downstream tasks within a table-native in-context learning setup. We demonstrate this flexibility on six distinct problems: classification, regression, anomaly detection, clustering, entity matching, and entity classification in relational databases. Both the encoder and the task-specific decoders are trained on a large corpus of real-world, unlabeled tables. FlexTab achieves state-of-the-art performance on classification, regression, anomaly detection and entity matching, while remaining competitive with specialized models on entity classification in a relational setting. These results demonstrate that a single shared encoder, paired with task-specific decoders, can serve as an effective general-purpose backbone for diverse tabular prediction problems. The inference code and checkpoints will be made publicly available at https://github.com/SAP-samples/flextab.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出FlexTab，一种灵活的编码器-解码器架构，用于表格数据的上下文学习。该架构将单个任务无关编码器与一组任务特定解码器配对。与现有的表格上下文学习器将特征表示与特定预测目标纠缠不同，我们的设计产生目标无关的行嵌入，可以在表格原生的上下文学习设置中跨广泛的 downstream 任务利用。我们在六个不同问题上展示了这种灵活性：分类、回归、异常检测、聚类、实体匹配以及关系数据库中的实体分类。编码器和任务特定解码器均在大量真实世界的无标注表格语料库上训练。FlexTab 在分类、回归、异常检测和实体匹配上达到了最先进的性能，同时在关系设置中的实体分类上与专用模型保持竞争力。这些结果表明，一个共享编码器搭配任务特定解码器可以作为多种表格预测问题的有效通用骨干网络。推理代码和检查点将在 https://github.com/SAP-samples/flextab 公开发布。

</details>


### [441] [DRIFT: Difficulty Routing Self-DIstillation with Rhythm-Gated Exploration and Success BuFfer Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30345)
*Haisen Luo,Yiwei Liu,Haoning Wang,Dan Liu,Junxi Yin,Haotian Wang,Lei Zhang,Xiaoyu Tian,Shuaiting Chen,Yuansheng Song,Baoyan Guo,Xiongfei Yan,Bolan Yang,Chengwei Liu,Ming Cui,Jiong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DRIFT框架，通过难度路由（Difficulty Routing）和节奏门控（Rhythm Gating）实现大模型在线自进化，在五个基准上超越GRPO和SDPO，平均79.5%准确率，ToolUse达79.2%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有自蒸馏和强化学习方法缺乏问题级别的学习进度跟踪机制，导致对简单问题过优化、困难问题弱监督、边界案例探索不足，无法实现稳定的自改进。

Method: DRIFT框架包含两个核心机制：难度路由（Difficulty Routing）在问题级别识别学习状态，动态分配自蒸馏和强化学习信号；节奏门控（Rhythm Gating）在token级别优化策略更新，聚焦关键推理位置。同时引入成功缓冲区和两阶段课程学习策略。

Result: 在五个基准和三种模型规模上，DRIFT全面超越GRPO和SDPO。平均准确率79.5%，超过GRPO 9.5%和SDPO 7.5%。在ToolUse上达79.2%，超过GRPO 13.5%、SDPO 10.7%，均达新SOTA。

Conclusion: DRIFT通过问题级别和token级别的双重自适应优化机制，有效解决了自我进化中的过优化和弱监督问题，实现了稳定且显著的性能提升。

Original Abstract: Enabling large language models to achieve stable self-improvement without external expert supervision remains a central challenge in complex reasoning tasks. Existing self-distillation and reinforcement learning methods lack explicit mechanisms for tracking problem-level learning progress and adapting optimization strategies accordingly. Consequently, training may over-optimize easy problems, receive weak supervision from hard problems, and fail to sufficiently explore borderline cases. To resolve these issues, we propose DRIFT, an online self-evolution policy optimization framework for large language models. DRIFT regulates the model's self-improvement process through the joint use of Difficulty Routing and Rhythm Gating. The former identifies the model's learning state at the problem level and dynamically allocates self-distillation and reinforcement learning signals, while the latter refines policy updates at the token level, concentrating exploration on critical reasoning positions. By further incorporating a success buffer and a two-stage curriculum learning strategy, DRIFT preserves high-quality historical experience while progressively guiding the model from reliable behavior acquisition toward stable policy evolution. Evaluated across five benchmarks and three model scales, DRIFT surpasses the peak performance of both GRPO and SDPO across all evaluated metrics. On the average score over the five benchmarks, DRIFT achieves 79.5$\%$, outperforming GRPO by 9.5$\%$ and SDPO by 7.5$\%$, establishing a new state-of-the-art result. Notably, on ToolUse, DRIFT reaches an accuracy of 79.2$\%$, improving over GRPO by 13.5$\%$ and SDPO by 10.7$\%$, setting a new state-of-the-art and substantially outperforming all concurrent methods.

中文摘要翻译: 在复杂推理任务中，让大型语言模型在无需外部专家监督的情况下实现稳定的自我改进仍是一个核心挑战。现有的自蒸馏和强化学习方法缺乏显式机制来跟踪问题级别的学习进度并相应调整优化策略。因此，训练可能会对简单问题过优化，从困难问题中获得的监督信号弱，且未能充分探索边界案例。为解决这些问题，我们提出DRIFT，一种面向大型语言模型的在线自进化策略优化框架。DRIFT通过联合使用难度路由（Difficulty Routing）和节奏门控（Rhythm Gating）来调控模型的自我改进过程。前者在问题级别识别模型的学习状态，动态分配自蒸馏和强化学习信号；后者在token级别精细化策略更新，将探索集中在关键推理位置。通过进一步引入成功缓冲区（success buffer）和两阶段课程学习策略，DRIFT在保留高质量历史经验的同时，逐步引导模型从可靠的行为获取走向稳定的策略进化。在五个基准和三种模型规模上的评估显示，DRIFT在所有评估指标上均超越了GRPO和SDPO的峰值性能。在五个基准的平均得分上，DRIFT达到79.5%，超过GRPO 9.5%、SDPO 7.5%，创造了新的最先进结果。值得注意的是，在ToolUse上，DRIFT达到79.2%的准确率，比GRPO提升13.5%、比SDPO提升10.7%，不仅刷新了SOTA，而且大幅超越所有同期方法。

</details>


### [442] [On the Vulnerability of Parameter-Level Defenses to Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30360)
*Kuangpu Guo,Qingyan Zheng,Jian Liang,Yongcan Yu,Zilei Wang,Ran He,Tieniu Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了现有基于参数级线性变换的模型合并防御方法的根本弱点——其保护的任务向量幅值较小，模型权重仍以预训练模型为主。基于此发现，提出锚点引导攻击（AGA），通过将保护模型与预训练锚点对齐来解析恢复变换矩阵，从而绕过防御。同时提出锚点排斥微调（ARF）作为有效防御手段。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 无训练集成的专家模型合并存在严重安全风险，使免费搭车者可未经授权组合专业模型。现有参数级防御虽然通过线性参数变换来抵御这一威胁，但其保护效果有限，亟需系统性分析其弱点并设计更鲁棒的防御方案。

Method: 1. 系统分析现有参数级线性变换防御，发现其保护的任务向量幅值较小，受保护权重仍以预训练模型为主导。2. 将预训练模型视为静态参考锚点，提出Anchor-Guided Attack (AGA)，通过将保护模型与该锚点对齐来解析恢复变换矩阵。3. 提出Anchor-Repulsive Fine-tuning (ARF) 作为防御方法，通过微调削弱锚点主导性以抵御AGA攻击。

Result: 大量实验验证了AGA在现实且防御无关的场景下持续绕过个体防御和组合防御。同时，ARF防御方法有效击败了所提出的AGA攻击。

Conclusion: 现有参数级线性变换防御因任务向量幅值小、权重受预训练模型主导而存在根本性脆弱性；AGA攻击可有效绕过这些防御；ARF微调能有效缓解锚点主导性，从而抵御该攻击。

Original Abstract: The training-free integration of expert models via model merging has exposed significant security risks, enabling free-riders to combine specialized models without authorization. Recent works propose parameter-level defenses that employ linear parameter transformations to neutralize this threat. In this paper, we systematically analyze such defenses and reveal that their protected task vectors are inherently small in magnitude. Consequently, the protected weights remain overwhelmingly dominated by the pretrained model. Based on this observation, we designate the pretrained model as a static reference anchor and propose the Anchor-Guided Attack (AGA) to circumvent existing safeguards. Specifically, AGA aligns the protected model with this anchor to recover the transformation matrix analytically. Extensive evaluations validate that AGA consistently bypasses both individual and composite defenses under realistic defense-agnostic scenarios. Furthermore, we provide Anchor-Repulsive Fine-tuning (ARF), a defense method to mitigate the anchor dominance leveraged by AGA. Empirical results confirm that ARF effectively defeats the proposed attack. Our code is available at https://github.com/krumpguo/secure-merge-attack.

中文摘要翻译: 通过模型合并实现的无训练专家模型集成暴露出严重的安全风险，使得免费搭车者能够在未经授权的情况下组合专业模型。近期研究提出了基于参数级别的防御方法，通过线性参数变换来消除这一威胁。本文系统性地分析了此类防御方法，揭示了其受保护的任务向量本质上是小幅值的。因此，受保护的权重仍然以预训练模型为主导。基于这一观察，我们将预训练模型视为静态参考锚点，并提出锚点引导攻击（AGA）来规避现有防御。具体而言，AGA将受保护模型与该锚点对齐，从而解析地恢复变换矩阵。大量实验验证了AGA在现实且防御无关的场景下持续绕过个体防御和组合防御。此外，我们提出了锚点排斥微调（ARF）作为一种防御方法，用于缓解AGA所利用的锚点主导性。实证结果表明，ARF有效击败了所提出的攻击。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/krumpguo/secure-merge-attack 获取。

</details>


### [443] [FlowAWR: Online Adaptive Flow Reinforcement via Advantage-Weighted Rectification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30376)
*Zheming Fu,Ruizhe He,Wei Shang,Xiaoxiao Ma,Lei Wang,Chang Liu,Siming Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlowAWR提出了一种基于最优速度场的优势加权矫正方法，将连续生成策略优化转化为监督回归问题，无需SDE采样器和CFG，在SD3.5-Medium上实现了2-5倍的收敛加速和更优的对齐性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于密度近似的策略梯度方法依赖随机SDE采样器构建可处理的转移核，导致训练-推理不一致并需要无分类器引导(CFG)；而隐式框架如DiffusionNFT使用启发式固定幅度矫正，无法根据组内相对质量调整优化强度。

Method: 从KL约束奖励最大化的最优策略出发，推导出最优速度场具有幅度感知的优势加权矫正形式，将连续生成策略优化转化为对理论最优速度场的监督回归，实现无SDE优化和无CFG生成。

Result: 在SD3.5-Medium上，FlowAWR在1.2k步达到24.12 PickScore，而DiffusionNFT需2.0k步达23.82，FlowGRPO需>4k步达23.50；收敛速度提升2-5倍；在多奖励约束下保持生成质量和域外性能稳定。

Conclusion: FlowAWR通过理论推导出最优速度场的解析形式，有效解决了连续生成策略优化中的训练-推理不一致和优化强度自适应问题，在效率和性能上均显著优于现有方法。

Original Abstract: Aligning generative flow models on continuous spaces via online reinforcement learning is constrained by intractable trajectory likelihoods. Existing density-approximated policy gradient methods rely on stochastic SDE samplers to construct tractable transition kernels, which introduce training-inference inconsistencies and necessitates Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG).
  While implicit frameworks such as DiffusionNFT directly optimize forward-process velocity fields, its heuristic fixed-magnitude corrections prevent optimization strength from relative intra-group quality.
  We propose \textit{Flow Advantage-Weighted Rectification} (\textbf{FlowAWR}), a paradigm that recasts continuous generative policy optimization as supervised regression toward a theoretically optimal velocity field.
  Starting from the optimal policy of a KL-constrained reward maximization, FlowAWR derives the optimal velocity field that admits a magnitude-aware, advantage-weighted rectification form, yielding SDE-free optimization and CFG-free generation.
  In comparative evaluations on SD3.5-Medium, FlowAWR achieves improved alignment performance alongside a 2$\times$ to 5$\times$ convergence acceleration over DiffusionNFT (e.g., reaching a 24.12 PickScore in 1.2k steps, versus 23.82 in 2.0k steps for DiffusionNFT and 23.50 in $>$4k steps for FlowGRPO). Under multi-reward constraints, FlowAWR sustains generation quality, satisfying structural rules while maintaining stable out-of-domain performance.

中文摘要翻译: 在连续空间上通过在线强化学习对齐生成流模型受到轨迹似然不可处理性的制约。现有的密度近似策略梯度方法依赖随机SDE采样器来构建可处理的转移核，这引入了训练-推理不一致性，并且需要无分类器引导(CFG)。虽然诸如DiffusionNFT的隐式框架直接优化前向过程的速冻场，但其启发式的固定幅度矫正无法使优化强度适应组内相对质量。我们提出\textit{Flow Advantage-Weighted Rectification}（\textbf{FlowAWR}）——一种将连续生成策略优化重新定义为对理论最优速度场的监督回归的新范式。从KL约束奖励最大化的最优策略出发，FlowAWR推导出具有幅度感知的优势加权矫正形式的最优速度场，实现了无SDE优化和无CFG生成。在SD3.5-Medium上的对比评估中，FlowAWR实现了更好的对齐性能，同时相比DiffusionNFT实现了2至5倍的收敛加速（例如，在1.2k步达到24.12 PickScore，而DiffusionNFT在2.0k步达到23.82，FlowGRPO在超过4k步达到23.50）。在多奖励约束下，FlowAWR保持生成质量，满足结构规则的同时维持稳定的域外性能。

</details>


### [444] [Scalar Representations of Neural Network Training Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30384)
*Pedro Jiménez-González,Miguel C. Soriano,Lucas Lacasa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将神经网络训练轨迹视为时序网络，通过标量嵌入方法将其降维到一维空间，并证明该低维表示能够保留原始高维参数空间中的关键动力学特征（如初始条件敏感性、最大Lyapunov指数），进而定义了特征时间去量化轨迹去相关时间，并发现渐近训练状态的间隔分布服从偏对数正态分布。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 神经网络训练过程在高维损失景观中演化，大量可训练参数使得直接分析动力学特性十分困难，因此需要一种有效的低维表示方法来简化分析和可视化。

Method: 将神经网络训练轨迹视为时序网络，采用时序网络的标量嵌入策略将高维参数轨迹映射到一维标量时间序列，从而实现对训练动力学的低维表征。

Result: 1) 标量嵌入保留了原始参数空间的主要动力学特征，包括对特定学习率下初始条件敏感性的出现；2) 能准确重建网络的最大Lyapunov指数；3) 定义了类似Lyapunov时间的特征时间，刻画了初始邻近轨迹的指数分离饱和时刻；4) 渐近训练状态的间隔分布在重新标度后呈现统一形式，且与偏对数正态分布吻合。

Conclusion: 标量低维嵌入为研究和可视化神经网络优化轨迹的动力学特性提供了一种有效的框架。

Original Abstract: Training in artificial neural networks can be viewed as a trajectory evolving through a high-dimensional loss landscape. However, the large number of trainable parameters makes the direct analysis of these dynamics challenging. In this work, we treat such training trajectories as temporal networks and apply recently proposed strategies for the scalar embedding of temporal networks. We investigate whether such a scalar embedding provides a meaningful low-dimensional representation of neural network training dynamics. Using a multilayer perceptron trained on the MNIST classification task, we show that the embedding preserves the main dynamical features observed in the original parameter space, including the emergence of sensitivity to initial conditions for specific learning rate regimes and an accurate reconstruction of the network's maximum Lyapunov exponent. We then use the embedded scalar trajectory to define a characteristic time, analogous to a Lyapunov time, after which the exponential separation between initially close embedded trajectories saturates. This characteristic time captures the typical decorrelation time between initially close network trajectories in the original high-dimensional system. Finally, we investigate the statistical organization of asymptotic training states through a spacing observable defined in the embedded space. We find that the distributions of rescaled asymptotic spacings collapse onto a common form across initial conditions and are compatible with a skew lognormal distribution. Altogether, our results suggest that scalar low-dimensional embeddings provide a useful framework for studying and visualizing the dynamical properties of neural network optimization trajectories.

中文摘要翻译: 人工神经网络的训练可以视为一条在高维损失景观中演化的轨迹。然而，大量可训练参数使得直接分析这些动力学变得具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们将此类训练轨迹视为时序网络，并应用近期提出的时序网络标量嵌入策略。我们探究了这种标量嵌入是否能为神经网络训练动力学提供有意义的低维表征。通过在MNIST分类任务上训练的多层感知机，我们证明该嵌入保留了原始参数空间中观察到的主要动力学特征，包括在特定学习率 regime 下初始条件敏感性的出现，以及网络最大Lyapunov指数的准确重建。然后，我们利用嵌入的标量轨迹定义了一个特征时间（类似于Lyapunov时间），在此时间之后，初始邻近的嵌入轨迹之间的指数分离达到饱和。该特征时间刻画了原始高维系统中初始邻近网络轨迹的典型去相关时间。最后，我们通过嵌入空间中定义的间隔观测量，研究了渐近训练状态的统计组织模式。我们发现，重新标度后的渐近间隔分布在各种初始条件下坍缩为统一形式，并且与偏对数正态分布相符合。总体而言，我们的结果表明，标量低维嵌入为研究和可视化神经网络优化轨迹的动力学特性提供了一个有用的框架。

</details>


### [445] [Predict, Reuse, and Repair: Accelerating Dynamic Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30389)
*Tianyu Wang,Gourav Rattihalli,Aditya Dhakal,Junbo Li,Zhiwei Ren,Dejan Milojicic,Longfei Shangguan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRR是一个推测-重用-修复运行时系统，通过利用动态稀疏注意力（DSA）选择的时间局部性，在选择完成前推测性地执行注意力计算，并增量修复遗漏的块，从而将长上下文LLM解码延迟降低多达40%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 动态稀疏注意力（DSA）虽然通过只关注每个查询的top-K KV块来加速长上下文LLM解码，但其串行的选择-到-注意力依赖关系成为新的延迟瓶颈。

Method: PRR包含三个核心组件：（1）轻量级EMA（指数移动平均）预测器，利用DSA选择的时间局部性预测可能的块；（2）基于性能剖析的推测预算，确保推测工作不处于关键路径上；（3）基于FlashAttention的修复内核，利用在线softmax统计将遗漏的块增量合并到部分注意力状态中。

Result: 在长上下文基准测试和代表性DSA方法上，PRR将每个token的解码延迟降低了多达40%，同时保持了下游任务的准确性。

Conclusion: PRR通过推测-重用-修复范式有效消除了DSA中串行依赖带来的延迟瓶颈，在不牺牲精度的情况下显著提升了长上下文LLM的解码效率。

Original Abstract: Dynamic sparse attention (DSA) accelerates long-context LLM decoding by attending to only the top-K KV blocks relevant to each query, but it introduces a serialized selection-to-attention dependency that emerges as a new latency bottleneck. We present PRR, a speculate-reuse-repair runtime that exploits temporal locality in DSA selections to predict likely blocks, speculate the attention over them while selection is in flight, and incrementally repair missed blocks once the true selected set is known. PRR uses a lightweight EMA-based predictor, a profiling-guided speculation budget that keeps speculative work off the critical path, and a FlashAttention-based repair kernel that folds missed blocks into the partial attention state using online-softmax statistics. Across long-context benchmarks and representative DSA methods, PRR reduces per-token decoding latency by up to 40% while preserving downstream task accuracy. Github: https://github.com/Tianyu9748/Incremental_FlashAttention

中文摘要翻译: 动态稀疏注意力（DSA）通过关注每个查询的top-K KV块来加速长上下文大语言模型（LLM）解码，但它引入了串行的选择到注意力的依赖关系，这成为了新的延迟瓶颈。我们提出PRR，一个推测-重用-修复运行时系统，它利用DSA选择中的时间局部性来预测可能的块，在选择进行中推测性地执行对这些块的注意力计算，并在已知真实选择集后增量修复遗漏的块。PRR使用基于指数移动平均（EMA）的轻量级预测器、基于性能剖析的推测预算（确保推测工作不处于关键路径），以及基于FlashAttention的修复内核（利用在线softmax统计将遗漏块增量合并到部分注意力状态中）。在长上下文基准测试和代表性DSA方法上，PRR将每个token的解码延迟降低了多达40%，同时保持了下游任务的准确性。GitHub: https://github.com/Tianyu9748/Incremental_FlashAttention

</details>


### [446] [Beyond IID: How General Are Tabular Foundation Models, Really?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30410)
*Lennart Purucker,Andrej Tschalzev,Nick Erickson,Gioia Blayer,David Holzmüller,Alan Arazi,Alexander Pfefferle,Mustafa Tajjar,Gaël Varoquaux,Frank Hutter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BeyondArena，首个面向表格数据的统一全面基准测试平台，并配套Data Foundry框架，用于系统评估表格基础模型在不同任务类型、数据规模和特征维度上的表现。实验表明现有表格基础模型仅在中小规模IID数据上表现优异，而在非IID、大规模和高维数据上传统方法仍占主导。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有表格基础模型的评估碎片化，不同学科各自为政，模型研究者只能依赖标准基准测试，而这些基准主要聚焦于表格基础模型已擅长的IID任务，排除了最具挑战性的场景，导致研究进展局限于对IID数据的边际改进，而非解决更广泛、更困难的问题。

Method: 提出BeyondArena统一基准测试平台，支持多种任务类型（IID、时序、分组），覆盖不同样本量和特征维度尺度，包含多样化特征类型（含文本、高基数特征），涵盖广泛学科领域。同时提出Data Foundry框架，包含Python框架和元数据模式，用于策划和整理表格数据集以实现统一评估。

Result: 在11个模型和142个策划数据集上的实验结果显示，现有表格基础模型在小型到中型的IID数据上表现优异，而传统的基于树的方法和深度学习模型在非IID、大规模和高维数据集上仍然占据主导地位。

Conclusion: BeyondArena能够引导模型研究聚焦于表格数据中最具挑战性的问题，推动真正基础性表格模型的发展，避免研究者仅关注IID数据上的边际改进。

Original Abstract: Foundation models for predictive machine learning on tabular data have recently gained significant traction in academia and industry. Research communities across disciplines are increasingly evaluating tabular foundation models on diverse datasets and tasks. However, these task- and discipline-specific evaluations remain largely inaccessible to model researchers because benchmark software and evaluation protocols are fragmented. As a result, model researchers rely on standard benchmarks, which are mostly defined for tasks where tabular foundation models already excel. The most challenging scenarios are excluded, limiting meaningful progress in the field by focusing on marginal improvements on IID data rather than on broader, more demanding challenges. To overcome this, we introduce BeyondArena, the first unified holistic benchmark for tabular data that supports diverse task types (IID, temporal, grouped), across sample size and feature dimensionality scales, with diverse feature types (with text, with high cardinality) from a broad range of disciplines. To enable unified benchmarking beyond standard benchmarks, we introduce Data Foundry, a Python framework and metadata schema for curating tabular datasets for predictive machine learning. Our results across 11 models and 142 curated datasets show that existing tabular foundation models excel on tiny- to medium-sized IID data, while traditional tree-based and deep learning models still dominate on non-IID, large, and high-dimensional datasets. BeyondArena guides model research for the most demanding challenges in tabular data, enabling progress towards truly foundational tabular models.

中文摘要翻译: 用于表格数据预测性机器学习的基础模型最近在学术界和工业界引起了广泛关注。跨学科的研究社区正在越来越多的数据集和任务上评估表格基础模型。然而，这些针对特定任务和学科的评估结果对模型研究人员来说大多难以获取，因为基准测试软件和评估协议是碎片化的。因此，模型研究者依赖标准基准测试，而这些基准主要定义在表格基础模型已经表现出色的任务上。最具挑战性的场景被排除在外，仅关注独立同分布（IID）数据上的边际改进，限制了该领域有意义的进展。为克服这一问题，我们提出了BeyondArena，这是首个面向表格数据的统一全面基准测试平台，支持多种任务类型（IID、时序、分组），覆盖不同样本量和特征维度尺度，包含来自广泛学科领域的多样化特征类型（含文本、高基数特征）。为了实现超越标准基准的统一评估，我们引入了Data Foundry，一个用于策划表格数据集以实现预测性机器学习的Python框架和元数据模式。我们在11个模型和142个策划数据集上的结果表明，现有的表格基础模型在小型到中型的IID数据上表现优异，而传统的基于树的模型和深度学习模型在非IID、大规模和高维数据集上仍然占据主导地位。BeyondArena引导模型研究聚焦于表格数据中最具挑战性的问题，推动真正基础性表格模型的发展。

</details>


### [447] [Diffusion Fine-tuning with Rewarded Moment Matching Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30414)
*Alexis Jacq,Guillaume Couairon,Valentin De Bortoli,Quentin Berthet,Arnaud Doucet,Romuald Elie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Rewarded Moment Matching Distillation (RMMD)框架，同时进行扩散模型蒸馏和奖励函数最大化，在FID-Reward帕累托前沿上优于现有方法，并在气象预报模型GenCast上实现7.5倍加速且超越教师模型。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 蒸馏和强化学习微调是扩散模型后训练的两大支柱，但传统上被孤立研究，两者之间的交互机制尚不明确，特别是微调如何影响蒸馏模型的生成质量尚不清楚。

Method: 提出RMMD框架，通过调整采样循环以进行on-policy训练，并重新利用蒸馏损失作为积分KL正则化的代理，从而同时实现扩散模型蒸馏和奖励函数最大化。

Result: 在ImageNet上FID-Reward帕累托前沿优于DI++、DRaFT和HyperNoise等基线；在GenCast气象预报模型上实现7.5倍加速，在93%目标天气变量上超越教师模型，且校准性更好。

Conclusion: RMMD证明了同时进行蒸馏和强化学习微调的有效性，并能够扩展到复杂的高维科学领域。

Original Abstract: Distillation and Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning are the primary pillars of diffusion post-training. While traditionally studied in isolation, the interaction between these phases remains poorly understood, and in particular how fine-tuning impacts the generative quality of distilled models. We introduce Rewarded Moment Matching Distillation (RMMD), a novel framework that simultaneously distills diffusion models and maximizes a reward function. RMMD preserves the high-fidelity ``naturalness'' characteristic of advanced distillation (such as 8-step Moment Matching) by adapting the sampling loop for on-policy training and repurposing the distillation loss as a proxy for integral KL regularization. By evaluating the FID-Reward Pareto fronts on ImageNet, we demonstrate that RMMD achieves superior trade-offs compared to single-step baselines (DI++) and multi-step competitors (DRaFT, HyperNoise). Finally, we apply RMMD to GenCast, a state-of-the-art weather forecasting model, to distill it while optimizing the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) metric. The resulting distilled model achieves a 7.5x speedup while outperforming the teacher model on 93% of target weather variables, and being better calibrated. This proves that RMMD scales to complex, high-dimensional scientific domains.

中文摘要翻译: 蒸馏和强化学习（RL）微调是扩散模型后训练的两大支柱。虽然传统上被孤立研究，但这些阶段之间的交互机制仍未被充分理解，特别是微调如何影响蒸馏模型的生成质量。我们提出了Rewarded Moment Matching Distillation (RMMD)，一个新颖的框架，能够同时进行扩散模型蒸馏和奖励函数最大化。RMMD通过调整采样循环以进行on-policy训练，并重新利用蒸馏损失作为积分KL正则化的代理，从而保留了先进蒸馏（如8步Moment Matching）的高保真"自然性"特征。通过在ImageNet上评估FID-Reward帕累托前沿，我们证明了RMMD相比单步基线（DI++）和多步竞争者（DRaFT, HyperNoise）实现了更优越的权衡。最后，我们将RMMD应用于GenCast（一种最先进的气象预报模型），在优化连续排名概率得分（CRPS）指标的同时对其进行蒸馏。得到的蒸馏模型实现了7.5倍加速，同时在93%的目标天气变量上优于教师模型，且校准性更好。这证明了RMMD能够扩展到复杂的高维科学领域。

</details>


### [448] [Experience Augmented Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30420)
*Jinda Lu,Kexin Huang,Junkang Wu,Shuo Yang,Jinghan Li,Chiyu Ma,Shaohang Wei,Xiang Wang,Guoyin Wang,Jingren Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出经验增强策略优化（EAPO）方法，通过策略自适应地复用先验RL优化策略作为动作级经验，在关键决策点选择性注入经验，并配合自适应重要性采样，以提升LLM推理能力并降低采样成本。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有RLVR方法通常从头开始进行on-policy优化，采样成本高且无法高效利用累积经验；即使尝试复用固定推理轨迹，也会因策略漂移导致策略不匹配问题。因此需要一种策略自适应的经验复用方式。

Method: 提出EAPO：1) 利用先验RL优化策略作为动作级经验先验；2) 在rollout的关键决策点选择性注入经验；3) 结合自适应重要性采样方案，确保从经验增强rollout中进行稳定无偏的学习。

Result: 在Qwen-2.5-math 7b和Qwen-3-8B上，基于五个不同基准的实验表明，EAPO在推理性能上持续优于当前最先进的RLVR方法。

Conclusion: 经验在RLVR中不应作为固定推理轨迹复用，而应以策略自适应的方式表达。EAPO方法有效实现了这一理念，提升了推理性能。

Original Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, existing RLVR methods typically rely on on-policy optimization from scratch, resulting in high sampling costs and inefficient utilization of accumulated experience. As model capabilities and policy behaviors evolve during training, recent attempts to reuse experience via fixed reasoning trajectories further suffer from policy mismatch. Motivated by these limitations, we argue that experience in RLVR should not be reused as fixed reasoning trajectories, but instead expressed in a policy-adaptive manner. In this work, we propose Experience-Augmented Policy Optimization (EAPO), which leverages a prior RL-optimized policy as an action-level experience prior and selectively injects experience at critical decision points during rollout. To ensure stable and unbiased learning from experience-augmented rollouts, EAPO further incorporates an adapted importance sampling scheme. Experiments on using Qwen-2.5-math 7b and Qwen-3-8B on five different benchmarks demonstrate that EAPO consistently improves reasoning performance over state-of-the-art RLVR methods.

中文摘要翻译: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是提升大语言模型（LLMs）推理能力的一种强大范式。然而，现有RLVR方法通常依赖从头开始的on-policy优化，导致高昂的采样成本以及累积经验的低效利用。由于训练过程中模型能力和策略行为会不断演化，近期通过固定推理轨迹复用经验的尝试进一步遭受策略不匹配问题的影响。受这些局限性驱动，我们认为RLVR中的经验不应作为固定推理轨迹复用，而应以策略自适应（policy-adaptive）的方式表达。在本工作中，我们提出经验增强策略优化（EAPO），该方法利用先验的RL优化策略作为动作级经验先验，并在rollout过程中于关键决策点选择性注入经验。为确保从经验增强rollout中进行稳定无偏的学习，EAPO进一步融合了一种自适应重要性采样方案。在Qwen-2.5-math 7b和Qwen-3-8B上基于五个不同基准的实验表明，EAPO在推理性能上持续优于最先进的RLVR方法。

</details>


### [449] [Proofs of Ownership for Machine Learning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30423)
*Ran Canetti,Shafi Goldwasser,Or Zamir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对机器学习模型的所有权证明进行了形式化研究，提出了一个三方博弈框架（模型所有者、窃取者、法官），并证明了在标准密码学假设下，分类器概念类可证明所有权当且仅当该类不可自纠正。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 随着机器学习的广泛采用，保护模型所有权成为一个关键挑战。本文旨在正式研究模型所有权证明问题，即在什么条件下可以证明一个被盗模型源自特定的创建者。

Method: 将所有权证明建模为三方博弈（所有者、窃取者、法官），采用密码学方法，建立与Blum-Luby-Rubinfeld自纠正概念的联系，给出黑盒设定下分类器所有权证明的充分必要条件。

Result: 在标准密码学假设下，分类器概念类可证明所有权当且仅当该概念类不可自纠正。该结果具有构造性，并可扩展至多个相关设定。

Conclusion: 机器学习模型的所有权证明存在一种清晰的二分法：所有权可证明性等价于概念类的不可自纠正性。这为模型所有权保护提供了理论基础。

Original Abstract: With the increasing adoption of Machine Learning, protecting model ownership has become an essential challenge. We initiate a formal study of Proof of Ownership for machine learning models: under what conditions can one prove that a stolen model originated from a particular creator? We model proofs of ownership as a game among three parties: a model owner, a thief, and a judge. The owner transforms the original model into a slightly perturbed model together with a proof of ownership. The thief then obtains the transformed model and attempts to minimally modify it so that it remains useful but escapes detection as owned by the model owner. Finally, the judge receives a model and a proof of ownership, and must decide whether the given model is a modified version of some model created by the model owner, or else the given model was developed independently.
  Our main result is a dichotomy for classifiers in the black-box setting: Under standard cryptographic assumptions, ownership of models for some concept class can be proven in the above sense {\em if and only if} the concept class is not self-correctable, in a sense close to that of Blum, Luby and Rubinfeld, STOC'90. The result is constructive and extends, with some variations, to a number of related settings.

中文摘要翻译: 随着机器学习的日益普及，保护模型所有权已成为一项重要挑战。我们首次对机器学习模型的所有权证明进行了形式化研究：在什么条件下，可以证明一个被盗模型源自特定的创建者？我们将所有权证明建模为三方（模型所有者、窃取者和法官）参与的博弈。所有者将原始模型转换为略微扰动的模型，并附带所有权证明。窃取者获取该转换后的模型，并尝试对其最小程度地修改，使其保持可用性但逃避被检测为所有者拥有的模型。最后，法官接收模型和所有权证明，必须判定给定模型是所有者创建模型的修改版本，还是独立开发的模型。我们的主要结果是黑盒设定下分类器的一个二分法：在标准密码学假设下，某个概念类的模型所有权可以按上述意义被证明，当且仅当该概念类不可自纠正——其含义接近于Blum、Luby和Rubinfeld（STOC'90）的定义。该结果是构造性的，并可在一些变体下推广到多个相关设定。

</details>


### [450] [Arko-T: A Foundation Model for Text-to-Structured 3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30429)
*Liang Wang,Zhaoyang Xi,Zekai Xiang,Heng Meng,Qishan Zhang,Pingyi Zhou,Jin Liu,Litao Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Arko-T是一个40亿参数的多模态文本到设计模型，能够将自然语言描述直接转化为可执行、可编辑的参数化CAD程序。与七个前沿大语言模型在12项指标上的对比表明，Arko-T在8项指标上取得最佳、3项指标上取得次优，且成本仅为十分之一，证明中等规模的针对性设计训练可媲美通用大模型在结构化CAD生成上的表现。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有文本到3D系统只能生成用于渲染的形状，而非可编辑的设计。作者希望将自然语言意图直接映射为可执行、可编辑的参数化CAD程序，保留CAD工件的特征、参数和构造逻辑，使其真正具备可编辑性。

Method: 提出Arko-T模型（40亿参数），通过将数据整理、代码归一化和执行监督对齐到"设计状态"这一形式化概念，使整个流程各阶段都服务于保留CAD的可编辑特征、参数和构造逻辑，而非仅优化代码的可执行性。

Result: 在12项指标上与7个前沿大语言模型对比，Arko-T在8项指标上取得最佳成绩，在另外3项上获得第二，同时每个基准测试的成本约为前沿模型的十分之一。

Conclusion: 中等规模的针对性设计级训练能够匹敌甚至超越前沿通用大模型在结构化CAD生成任务上的表现，证明了"设计级对齐"策略的有效性。

Original Abstract: Text-to-3D systems can now synthesize a mechanical part from a single sentence, yet the result is a shape to render, not a design to edit. We present Arko-T, a 4B-parameter text-to-design model that maps natural-language intent directly into executable, parametric CAD programs. Rather than optimizing for code executability alone, Arko-T aligns every stage of the pipeline to a formal notion of design state, so that data curation, code normalization, and execution-grounded supervision all work to preserve the features, parameters, and construction logic that make a CAD artifact editable. Benchmarked against seven frontier LLMs across 12 metrics, Arko-T attains the best score on 8 and the second-best on 3 more, at roughly one-tenth the per-benchmark cost. The results suggest that targeted design-level training at moderate scale can match frontier general-purpose models on structured CAD generation.

中文摘要翻译: 现有文本到3D系统能够从单句描述中合成机械零件，但其结果只是一个用于渲染的形状，而非可编辑的设计。本文提出Arko-T——一个40亿参数的文本到设计模型，能够将自然语言意图直接映射为可执行、参数化的CAD程序。不同于仅优化代码可执行性，Arko-T将流程的每个阶段都与形式化的"设计状态"概念对齐，使得数据整理、代码归一化和执行监督都服务于保留CAD工件的特征、参数和构造逻辑——这些正是CAD工件可编辑性的关键。在12项指标上与七个前沿大语言模型的对比基准测试中，Arko-T在8项指标上取得最佳成绩，在另外3项上获得第二名，而每个基准测试的成本仅为前沿模型的十分之一。结果表明，中等规模的针对性设计级训练能够匹敌前沿通用大模型在结构化CAD生成任务上的表现。

</details>


### [451] [Transformer Architectures as Complete Bayes Processes: A Formal Proof in the Measure-Theoretic Kernel Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30440)
*Haobo Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过测度论核框架，严格证明了当Transformer内部更新机制满足贝叶斯联合分布条件时，其前向计算等价于精确的贝叶斯后验更新。从核心贝叶斯Transformer到完整多层堆叠架构，逐层证明了该等价性，并推导了注意力机制与概率分布之间的形式化桥梁。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有Transformer模型在理论上缺乏对内部计算过程的概率解释，尤其是在后验推理方面。作者希望建立Transformer架构与贝叶斯后验推断之间的严格形式化等价关系，为Transformer的深度理解提供理论基础。

Method: 在测度论核框架下定义抽象层次体系（核心贝叶斯Transformer→语义Transformer→完整QKV/注意力/残差/MLP块→多层堆叠），利用Radon-Nikodym微分推导贝叶斯公式，并证明softmax注意力机制在keys上诱导出有效的概率分布。

Result: 证明了在贝叶斯联合分布条件下，各层级的更新核几乎处处等于后验；推导了块级架构的显式贝叶斯公式并证明了其归一化性；建立了抽象核框架与具体注意力实现之间的桥梁。

Conclusion: 当满足联合分布条件时，Transformer的前向计算在形式化意义上等价于严格的贝叶斯后验更新，揭示了Transformer架构与贝叶斯推断之间的深层联系。

Original Abstract: We present a complete formal proof that transformer architectures, when their internal update mechanisms satisfy a Bayes joint-distribution condition, implement exact Bayesian posterior inference. Working within the measure-theoretic kernel framework, we define a hierarchy of abstractions -- from the core Bayesian transformer, through semantic transformers with explicit update kernels, to full transformer blocks with QKV/attention/residual/MLP pipelines, and finally multilayer stacks -- and prove at each level that the Bayes joint semantics implies the update kernel equals the posterior almost everywhere. For the block-level architecture, we derive the explicit Bayes formula through Radon-Nikodym differentiation and prove its normalization. We additionally prove that the softmax attention mechanism induces a valid probability distribution over keys, establishing the bridge between the abstract kernel framework and concrete attention implementations. The framework makes no architectural assumptions beyond the Markov kernel structure and exposes explicit conditions under which a transformer block is provably Bayesian. In essence, when this joint distribution condition is satisfied, the forward computation of a Transformer is formally equivalent to a rigorous Bayesian posterior update.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了一个完整的形式化证明：当Transformer架构的内部更新机制满足贝叶斯联合分布条件时，其实现的是精确的贝叶斯后验推断。在测度论核框架内，我们定义了一个抽象层次体系——从核心贝叶斯Transformer，经过具有显式更新核的语义Transformer，到具有QKV/注意力/残差/MLP管线的完整Transformer块，最后到多层堆叠——并在每一层证明贝叶斯联合语义意味着更新核几乎处处等于后验。对于块级架构，我们通过Radon-Nikodym微分推导出显式的贝叶斯公式并证明了其归一化性。我们还证明了softmax注意力机制在keys上诱导出一个有效的概率分布，从而建立了抽象核框架与具体注意力实现之间的桥梁。该框架不依赖除马尔可夫核结构之外的任何架构假设，并揭示了Transformer块可被证明为贝叶斯的显式条件。本质上，当这一联合分布条件得到满足时，Transformer的前向计算在形式化上等价于一个严格的贝叶斯后验更新。

</details>


### [452] [When Does Online Imitation Learning Help in LLM Post-Training? The Role of (Non-)Realizability Beyond Horizon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30445)
*Huaqing Zhang,Jingchu Gai,Juno Kim,Bingbin Liu,Andrej Risteski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了“误差累积是在线模仿学习优势主要来源”的传统观点，证明在线交互的优势取决于学生策略类是否能表示专家策略（可实现性）。在可实现设定下，离线模仿学习已能达到专家水平；在不可实现设定下，离线学习存在信息论瓶颈，而在线学习在特定结构特征下仍能取得高性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 澄清在线模仿学习（在线策略蒸馏）相比离线监督微调（SFT）的优势根源，检验误差累积是否为在线IL优势的主要来源，并理解在线交互在何种条件下真正发挥作用。

Method: 通过理论分析与实证实验相结合的方式：在可实现性假设下进行实证对比离线与在线IL的表现；在不可实现（错误设定）场景下提出信息论瓶颈分析，并给出关于奖励的错误设定的结构刻画，证明在线IL在此条件下仍能取得高性能。

Result: （1）在可实现设定下，离线IL已能匹配专家性能；（2）在不可实现设定下，即使当horizon H=1时，离线IL仍存在信息论瓶颈；（3）提出了一种关于奖励的错误设定的结构特征，在该特征下，尽管专家与学生策略之间存在较大的分布不匹配，在线IL仍能实现高性能。

Conclusion: 在线模仿学习的优势主要来源于设定是否可实现，而非传统认为的误差累积问题。在不可实现设定下，离线IL存在根本性的信息瓶颈，而在线IL通过交互可以克服这一瓶颈。

Original Abstract: Online imitation learning (IL), particularly on-policy distillation, has emerged as a strong LLM post-training approach, often outperforming offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Yet a principled understanding of when and why online interaction helps remains unclear. In this work, we challenge the view that error accumulation is the main source of online IL's advantage, and instead show that the benefits of online interaction depend critically on whether the setting is realizable, i.e., whether the student policy class can represent the expert policy. Under realizability, we empirically find that offline IL already matches expert performance. In contrast, in non-realizable (misspecified) settings, we prove that offline IL encounters an information-theoretic bottleneck even when horizon $H=1$, and propose a structural characterization of misspecification relative to the reward, under which online IL provably achieves high performance despite a large distributional mismatch between the expert and student policies.

中文摘要翻译: 在线模仿学习，特别是在线策略蒸馏，已成为一种强大的大语言模型后训练方法，其表现通常优于离线监督微调。然而，关于在线交互何时以及为何能够带来优势的原则性理解尚不清晰。在这项工作中，我们挑战了“误差累积是在线模仿学习优势主要来源”的观点，并证明在线交互的收益关键取决于设定是否可实现，即学生策略类能否表示专家策略。在可实现设定下，我们通过实验发现离线模仿学习已能达到专家性能。相比之下，在不可实现（错误设定）设定中，我们证明即使当horizon H=1时，离线模仿学习仍面临信息论瓶颈，并提出了一种关于奖励的错误设定的结构特征。在该特征下，尽管专家策略与学生策略之间存在较大的分布不匹配，在线模仿学习仍被证明能够实现高性能。

</details>


### [453] [Internal-State Probes Read the Situation, Not the Action: Three Negative Results for Pre-Action Misalignment Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30449)
*Max Fomin,Elad David,Amit LeVi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过三项实例检验发现，模型内部表征的读出来作为“行动前监控器”（pre-action monitor）的宣称无法成立，因为每个方法都受到泛化性或特异性检验的削弱，并贡献了一套将内部读出的宣称转化为行动前测试的方法论及负面结果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 探究模型内部表征的读出来是否能在有害文本或工具动作被实际生成之前，就识别出它们，从而实现更强有力的“行动前监控”，而不仅仅是描述提示、构造对比或当前轨迹。

Method: 在三个模型家族上测试了三种内部读出方法：Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct的微调/基座方向、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct在最后一不安全前缀token上的探针、Gemma-3-27B-IT在敲诈工具动作场景中使用情感概念向量进行投影和操控。对每种方法进行构造效度、语义可读性和操控效应的检验，并设计泛化性（跨场景/动作泛化）和特异性（概念特异性控制）测试。

Result: Qwen方向AUC达1.000但在0/143个assistant回答前上下文和0/342个不安全轨迹续写前缀行上阈值为零；Llama特征解码提示域几乎完美(AUC 0.999)，但最佳未来行为探针仅达AUC 0.801且多数跨域迁移为负；Gemma情感投影语义有意义但最小对在首差输入前状态不可区分，操控特异性被无关方向（如猫、天气、体育、地理）削弱。

Conclusion: 构造效度、语义可读性和操控效应都无法成为鲁棒的行动前监控器；监控宣称必须同时通过场景/动作泛化和概念特异性控制检验。本文贡献了将内部读出宣称转化为行动前测试的方法论，并报告了有范围的负面结果。

Original Abstract: Probes on model internals could help monitor agentic systems if they identify harmful text or tool actions before those actions are generated. We ask when an internal readout supports this stronger pre-action claim, rather than merely describing the prompt, construction contrast, or current trajectory. We test three methods across three model families: a Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct fine-tune/base direction, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct probes at the last token of unsafe prefills, and Gemma-3-27B-IT emotion-concept vectors used for projection and steering in a blackmail tool-action scenario. Across these cases, construction validity, semantic legibility, and steering effects do not become robust pre-action monitors: each is undercut by a generalization or specificity check. The Qwen direction separates fine-tune from base at AUC 1.000, yet crosses its threshold on 0/143 audited pre-assistant turn contexts and on 0/342 Qwen prefill rows where the model continues the unsafe trajectory. The Llama features decode prompt domain almost perfectly (AUC 0.999), while the best future-behavior probe reaches AUC 0.801 and only +5.1 pp accuracy lift over majority; single-source cross-domain transfer is non-positive on five of six ordered pairs. Gemma emotion projections are semantically meaningful, but a shared-prefix minimal pair has indistinguishable states before the first differing input, and steering specificity weakens against unrelated learned directions such as cats}, weather, sports, and geography. We contribute a methodology for converting internal-readout claims into pre-action tests, and report scoped negative results: monitor claims must survive both scenario/action generalization and concept-specificity controls. Code is released at https://github.com/maxf-zn/misalignment_monitoring

中文摘要翻译: 对模型内部状态的探针，如果能在有害文本或工具动作被实际生成之前就识别出它们，就有可能帮助监控智能体系统。我们探究内部读出来何时支持这种更强的“行动前”宣称，而不仅仅是描述提示、构造对比或当前轨迹。我们在三个模型家族上测试了三种方法：Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct的微调/基座方向、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct在最后一个不安全前缀词元上的探针、以及Gemma-3-27B-IT在敲诈工具动作场景中使用情感概念向量进行的投影和操控。在这些案例中，构造效度、语义可读性和操控效应都无法成为鲁棒的行动前监控器：每一种都被泛化性或特异性检验所削弱。Qwen方向以AUC 1.000区分了微调模型与基座模型，但在0/143个经审计的assistant回答前上下文和0/342个模型继续不安全轨迹的Qwen前缀行上均未达到阈值。Llama特征几乎完美地解码了提示域（AUC 0.999），而最佳未来行为探针仅达到AUC 0.801，比多数类仅高出+5.1个百分点的准确率提升；六个有序对中有五个的单源跨域迁移为非正向。Gemma情感投影在语义上是有意义的，但共享前缀的最小对比对在第一个差异输入之前的状态无法区分，并且操控特异性被无关的已学习方向（如猫、天气、体育和地理）削弱。我们贡献了一套将内部读出宣称转化为行动前测试的方法论，并报告了有范围的负面结果：监控宣称必须同时通过场景/动作泛化和概念特异性控制检验。代码已发布在https://github.com/maxf-zn/misalignment_monitoring。

</details>


### [454] [Exploring Differences Between Tabular Enterprise Data and Public Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30452)
*Myung Jun Kim,Maximilian Schambach,Frank Essenberger,Andre Sres,Johannes Höhne*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 企业表格数据与典型基准数据集存在显著差异，在通用基准上表现良好的表格模型在企业数据上可能表现不佳，反之亦然，表明需要构建企业级基准。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 企业表格数据在数据科学中占据主导地位，但现有基准测试缺乏对企业数据特性的关注，导致模型在真实企业场景中的泛化能力未知。

Method: 通过分析企业数据的数据统计特征，并在企业数据上评测TabPFN、TabICL和ConTextTab等表格模型的性能表现，对比其与典型表格基准上的性能差异。

Result: 企业数据与典型表格基准存在显著差异；在典型基准上表现良好的表格模型可能在真实企业数据上表现差，反之亦然。

Conclusion: 现有表格基准无法充分反映企业数据特性，缺乏泛化能力，亟需构建具有企业级特征的额外基准。

Original Abstract: Tabular data dominate the landscape of data science, increasingly attracting innovative machine learning models and tailored benchmarks. Yet, little is known for enterprise data, where tables constitute the backbone of business operations. To broaden the benchmarking landscape for business applications, this work aims to actualize the characteristics of enterprise data by providing an analysis of data statistics and performance measurements of tabular models such as TabPFN, TabICL and ConTextTab. Through our analysis, we find enterprise data markedly differ from tabular benchmarks and we demonstrate that a tabular model that performs well on typical tabular benchmarks may perform poorly on real world enterprise data -- and vice versa. This lack of generalization underlines the need for additional benchmarks with enterprise-grade characteristics.

中文摘要翻译: 表格数据主导着数据科学的格局，日益吸引着创新的机器学习模型和定制化基准。然而，对于构成业务运营支柱的企业数据，我们知之甚少。为了拓宽业务应用的基准评测范围，本文旨在通过分析数据统计特征以及TabPFN、TabICL和ConTextTab等表格模型的性能评估，来实现企业数据特性的具体化。通过分析，我们发现企业数据与典型表格基准存在显著差异，并且我们证明，在典型表格基准上表现良好的表格模型可能在真实企业数据上表现不佳——反之亦然。这种泛化能力的缺失凸显了对具有企业级特征的额外基准的需求。

</details>


### [455] [Curvature-Weighted Gradient Diversity: A Noise Measure for Geometry-Adaptive SGD Schedules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30455)
*Muhammad Hamza,Ayush Goel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出曲率加权梯度多样性（CWGD）指标，通过Hessian逆平方根加权每样本梯度多样性，更紧地刻画有效优化噪声，并基于此设计CWGD-Cosine学习率调度，在强凸二次目标上可将渐近优化误差降低至多两倍，实际实验中比标准余弦退火低约20%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 标准小批量SGD的收敛分析用单一方差项建模梯度噪声，忽略了高曲率方向噪声影响更小（因为学习率已被约束）这一几何特性，导致噪声建模不够精确。

Method: 提出曲率加权梯度多样性（CWGD），用Hessian逆平方根加权每样本梯度多样性；基于CWGD设计CWGD-Cosine学习率调度，使用基于Hutchinson方法的对角Hessian估计器（对二次目标精确）。

Result: ①理论证明：在强凸二次目标、对角Hessian和各向同性噪声下，CWGD调制的余弦学习率可将渐近优化误差最多降低两倍；②实验：在不同条件数、批次大小和噪声结构下，CWGD-Cosine比标准余弦退火最终优化误差低约20%，开销可忽略；③识别并修正了一种退化曲率估计器，分析了鲁棒性和局限性。

Conclusion: CWGD是一种原则性的、几何感知的优化噪声度量，能更准确地刻画有效噪声，为更一般的学习问题提供了有前景的扩展方向。

Original Abstract: The standard convergence analysis of mini-batch stochastic gradient descent (SGD) models gradient noise using a single variance term that treats all parameter directions equally, ignoring the fact that noise in high-curvature directions has less impact because learning rates are already constrained there. We introduce Curvature-Weighted Gradient Diversity (CWGD), a geometry-aware measure that weights per-sample gradient diversity by the inverse square root of the Hessian, providing a tighter proxy for the effective optimization noise. For strongly convex quadratic objectives with diagonal Hessians and isotropic noise, we prove that a CWGD-modulated cosine learning-rate schedule can reduce the asymptotic optimization error floor by up to a factor of two compared with standard cosine annealing. We implement this idea as CWGD-Cosine using a Hutchinson-based diagonal Hessian estimator that is exact for quadratic objectives. Across a range of condition numbers, batch sizes, and noise structures, CWGD-Cosine consistently achieves approximately 20% lower final optimization error than standard cosine annealing while incurring negligible overhead in the quadratic setting. We also identify and correct a degenerate curvature estimator, analyze the robustness of the proposed estimator, and explicitly discuss the limitations of the method, including Hessian staleness in non-convex optimization. These results establish CWGD as a principled geometry-aware measure of optimization noise and motivate future extensions to more general learning problems.

中文摘要翻译: 小批量随机梯度下降（SGD）的标准收敛分析使用单一方差项对梯度噪声进行建模，该方法平等对待所有参数方向，忽略了高曲率方向上的噪声影响更小（因为学习率在这些方向上已受到约束）这一事实。我们引入了曲率加权梯度多样性（CWGD），这是一种几何感知的度量，通过Hessian矩阵的逆平方根对每样本梯度多样性进行加权，从而为有效优化噪声提供了更紧的代理。对于具有对角Hessian矩阵和各向同性噪声的强凸二次目标，我们证明基于CWGD调制的余弦学习率调度可以将渐近优化误差下限相比标准余弦退火最多降低两倍。我们通过基于Hutchinson方法的对角Hessian估计器实现这一想法，称为CWGD-Cosine，该估计器对于二次目标是精确的。在一系列条件数、批次大小和噪声结构下，CWGD-Cosine一致地实现了比标准余弦退火低约20%的最终优化误差，同时在二次设定下引入的开销可忽略不计。我们还识别并修正了一种退化的曲率估计器，分析了所提估计器的鲁棒性，并明确讨论了该方法的局限性，包括非凸优化中的Hessian过时问题。这些结果确立了CWGD作为一种原则性的、几何感知的优化噪声度量，并为未来扩展到更一般的学习问题提供了动力。

</details>


### [456] [HSAP: A Hierachical Sequence-aware Parallelism for Hybrid-Context Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30460)
*Songxin Zhang,Zejian Xie,Zhuoyang Song,Cong lin,Junyu Lu,Jiaxing Zhang,Bingyi Jing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种序列感知并行（Sequence-Aware Parallelism）算法，通过JIT编译优化通信策略和分层框架，解决了混合上下文打包序列在因果注意力计算中的跨污染问题，在多个指标上优于现有序列并行方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有序列并行范式无法正确处理混合上下文打包序列上的因果注意力计算（即跨污染问题），要么忽略混合上下文场景，要么牺牲并行度来支持该场景。

Method: 提出序列感知并行算法，利用JIT编译在NCCL层面优化所有设备组的通信策略，并将现有序列并行范式整合到分层序列感知并行框架中，同时详细设计了分层框架的内存与通信开销管理。

Result: 通过多项实验证明，所提出的方法在多个指标上优于现有的最先进序列并行方法。

Conclusion: 所提出的序列感知并行算法能有效结合现有序列并行范式的优势，克服其缺陷，在支持混合上下文打包序列的高效并行训练方面取得显著提升。

Original Abstract: In this paper, we aim to combine the advantages of existing sequence parallelism paradigms and overcomes their drawbacks, the most serious of which is the incapability to correctly compute causal attention on the hybrid-context packed sequences, in a stronger sequence parallelism framework. The practical technique of packing sequences for efficiently pretraining and fine-tuning large language models causes cross-contamination problem in attention computation, which can be effectively solved when no parallelism in the sequence length dimension is taken. However, in sequence parallelism, existing approaches either ignore the scenario of hybrid-context sequences or conversely sacrifice and limit parallelism degree for supporting the scenario. To this end, we innovatively propose an efficient Sequence-Aware Parallelism algorithm to conquer the obstacles of intensive tensor transmission and partial attention computation across multiple device groups. Our algorithm utilizes JIT (Just-In-Time) compilation to optimize the communication strategy of all device groups in NCCL level. Further, we integrate existing sequence parallelism paradigms into a Hierachical Sequence-Aware Parallelism framework which benefits from our sequence-aware algorithm. We additionally elaborate on the memory and communication overhead management of the hierachical framework to optimize its performance. Through multiple experiments, we demonstrate that our proposed approach outperform other state-of-the-arts sequence parallelism approches in multiple metrics.

中文摘要翻译: 在本文中，我们旨在结合现有序列并行范式的优势，并克服其缺陷——其中最严重的问题是，在更强的序列并行框架下无法正确计算混合上下文打包序列上的因果注意力。在高效预训练和微调大语言模型时，序列打包技术的实际应用会导致注意力计算中的跨污染问题，当不在序列长度维度上进行并行化时，该问题可以有效地解决。然而，在序列并行方法中，现有方法要么忽略了混合上下文序列的场景，要么相反地为支持该场景而牺牲并限制了并行度。为此，我们创新性地提出了一种高效的序列感知并行算法，以克服跨多个设备组的密集张量传输和部分注意力计算等障碍。该算法利用JIT（即时编译）技术在NCCL层面优化所有设备组的通信策略。此外，我们将现有序列并行范式整合到一个分层序列感知并行框架中，该框架受益于我们的序列感知算法。我们还详细阐述了分层框架的内存与通信开销管理，以优化其性能。通过多项实验，我们证明了所提出的方法在多个指标上优于现有的最先进序列并行方法。

</details>


### [457] [MuonSSM: Orthogonalizing State Space Models for Sequence Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30461)
*Thai-Khanh Nguyen,Ngoc-Bich-Uyen Vo,Thieu N. Vo,Tan M. Nguyen,Cuong Pham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MuonSSM通过显式调节状态空间模型的更新几何（而非转移矩阵），引入动量路径和轻量级Newton-Schulz变换对低秩输入注入进行谱条件约束，在保持并行扫描复杂度的同时稳定训练、提升长序列建模性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有状态空间模型在处理超长序列时，因一阶更新条件数差和更新几何不平衡，导致训练不稳定和记忆退化。

Method: 提出MuonSSM框架：1) 在SSM中引入基于动量的路径；2) 对低秩输入注入施加轻量级Newton-Schulz变换，获得有界且谱条件良好的更新；3) 保持并行扫描计算复杂度不变。

Result: 在语言、视觉和时间序列基准上，集成到多种SSM骨干后，在准确率、鲁棒性和长上下文性能上均取得一致的提升。

Conclusion: 证明了更新的几何条件化是实现稳定、可扩展序列建模的一种有原则的路径。

Original Abstract: State space models (SSMs) have emerged as efficient linear-time alternatives to attention for long-sequence modeling. However, existing SSMs often suffer from instability and memory degradation over extended horizons due to poorly conditioned first-order updates and unbalanced update geometry. We introduce MuonSSM, a general framework that stabilizes SSM training by explicitly conditioning the geometry of memory updates rather than the recurrent transition matrix. MuonSSM augments SSMs with a momentum-based pathway and a lightweight Newton Schulz transformation on low-rank input injections, yielding bounded and spectrally conditioned updates while preserving parallel scan complexity. Theory shows that MuonSSM improves gradient propagation, mitigates spectral amplification, and enriches memory representations over long horizons. Extensive experiments across language, vision, and time-series benchmarks show consistent gains in accuracy, robustness, and long-context performance when integrated into diverse SSM backbones. These results establish geometric conditioning of updates as a principled pathway to stable, scalable sequence modeling.

中文摘要翻译: 状态空间模型（SSM）已作为注意力的高效线性时间替代方案，用于长序列建模。然而，由于一阶更新条件数差和更新几何不平衡，现有SSM在扩展时间跨度上常遭受不稳定和记忆退化。我们提出MuonSSM，一个通用框架，通过显式调节记忆更新的几何（而非循环转移矩阵）来稳定SSM训练。MuonSSM在SSM中引入基于动量的路径，并对低秩输入注入施加轻量级Newton-Schulz变换，在保持并行扫描复杂度的同时，产生有界且谱条件良好的更新。理论表明，MuonSSM改善了梯度传播、减轻了谱放大并在长跨度上丰富了记忆表示。在语言、视觉和时间序列基准上的大量实验表明，当集成到多种SSM骨干时，在准确率、鲁棒性和长上下文性能上均取得一致的提升。这些结果确立了更新几何条件化作为稳定、可扩展序列建模的一种有原则的路径。

</details>


### [458] [Discovering Collaboration from Novelty: Random Network Distillation for Clustered Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30499)
*Davide Domini,Gianluca Aguzzi,Ivana Dusparic,Danilo Pianini,Mirko Viroli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于随机网络蒸馏(RND)的轻量级聚类联邦学习方法，将聚类与主训练解耦，在联邦训练前通过RND预测误差作为新颖性信号发现客户端分组，无需共享原始数据或反复评估主模型，适用于非独立同分布数据下的自主大规模分布式系统。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 联邦学习在非独立同分布数据下表现不佳，单个全局模型难以代表客户端分布的多样性。现有聚类联邦学习方法将聚类分配与主训练循环耦合，增加了计算和通信开销。

Method: 每个客户端在本地数据上训练一个紧凑的随机网络蒸馏(RND)预测器，利用其预测误差作为新颖性信号来估计与其他客户端的相似性，从而在联邦训练前发现有意义的客户端分组，且无需共享原始数据或反复评估主模型。联邦结构在运行时从局部新颖性估计中自发形成。

Result: 该方法将聚类与学习解耦，提供了一种任务无关且高效的机制，适用于无法预先指定聚类数量或协作结构的自主大规模分布式系统，能够在非独立同分布数据下实现自主协作。

Conclusion: 通过将聚类与联邦学习主过程解耦，所提方法为处理非独立同分布数据的联邦学习提供了一种轻量级、任务无关且可自主运行的解决方案，特别适合大规模分布式系统。

Original Abstract: Federated Learning often suffers under non-independently and identically distributed data, where a single global model may fail to represent the diversity of client distributions. Clustered Federated Learning mitigates this issue by training specialized models for groups of similar clients, but existing approaches often couple cluster assignment with the main training loop, increasing computational and communication costs. We propose a lightweight clustering approach based on Random Network Distillation. Each client trains a compact Random Network Distillation predictor on its local data and uses its prediction error as a novelty signal to estimate similarity with other clients. This enables the discovery of meaningful client groups before federated training, without sharing raw data or repeatedly evaluating the main model. Crucially, the resulting federations emerge from local novelty estimates at runtime, making the method suitable for autonomous large-scale distributed systems where neither the number of clusters nor the collaboration structure can be specified a priori. Overall, by decoupling clustering from learning, the method provides a task-agnostic and efficient mechanism for autonomous collaboration under non-independently and identically distributed data.

中文摘要翻译: 联邦学习在非独立同分布数据下通常表现不佳，此时单一的全局模型可能无法代表客户端分布的多样性。聚类联邦学习通过为相似客户端组训练专门模型来缓解这一问题，但现有方法往往将聚类分配与主训练循环耦合，增加了计算和通信开销。本文提出一种基于随机网络蒸馏的轻量级聚类方法。每个客户端在其本地数据上训练一个紧凑的随机网络蒸馏预测器，并利用其预测误差作为新颖性信号来估计与其他客户端的相似性。这使得在联邦训练之前就能发现有意义的客户端分组，无需共享原始数据或反复评估主模型。关键在于，最终的联邦结构在运行时从局部新颖性估计中自发形成，使得该方法适用于无法预先指定聚类数量或协作结构的自主大规模分布式系统。总体而言，通过将聚类与学习解耦，该方法为在非独立同分布数据下实现自主协作提供了一种任务无关且高效的机制。

</details>


### [459] [Muon learns balanced solutions in matrix factorization without slow saddle-to-saddle dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30509)
*Mark Rhee,Jamie Simon,Dhruva Karkada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统分析了Muon优化器与梯度下降在矩阵分解（低秩矩阵逼近）问题中的动力学差异，揭示了Muon在避免慢速鞍点动力学、超越临界学习率稳定性以及守恒量特性三方面的独特行为，并利用这些性质设计了快速对齐的学习率调度策略。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 理解Muon优化器在矩阵分解这一最小化学习问题中的动力学特性，揭示其与梯度下降的本质差异，为更高效地使用Muon优化器提供理论依据。

Method: 通过理论分析对比Muon优化器与梯度下降在矩阵分解问题中的参数轨迹动力学，重点研究三个方面的差异：鞍点动力学行为、学习率稳定性阈值、以及守恒量性质。并利用Muon的结构性质设计高效的学习率调度策略。

Result: 1) Muon避免慢速鞍点间动力学，同时学习所有顶部模态，小模态先收敛；2) Muon在学习率超过局部锐度临界阈值时仍保持稳定，使学习率摆脱条件数约束；3) Muon流守恒$\sqrt{\mathbf{P}^\top \mathbf{P}}-\sqrt{\mathbf{Q}^\top \mathbf{Q}}$，而梯度流守恒$\mathbf{P}^\top\mathbf{P} - \mathbf{Q}^\top\mathbf{Q}$；4) 推导了简单设定下的对齐速率并推广到一般情况；5) 构建了两步即可实现近乎完美对齐的学习率调度策略。

Conclusion: Muon优化器在矩阵分解中展现出与梯度下降截然不同的动力学特性，这些特性使其在训练效率、稳定性和对齐速度上具有显著优势，尤其是通过精心设计的学习率调度可实现极速收敛。

Original Abstract: Matrix factorization (i.e., problems of the form $\min_{\mathbf{P},\mathbf{Q}} \|\mathbf{M}^\star - \mathbf{P}^\top\mathbf{Q}\|_\mathrm{F}^2$) is a minimal learning problem that exhibits both nonlinear parameter dynamics and representation learning. In this setting, we study how parameter trajectories under the Muon optimizer differ from those of gradient descent. We identify three main dynamical differences: 1) Muon avoids the slow saddle-to-saddle dynamics from small initialization. Muon instead learns all the top modes of $\mathbf{M}^\star$ at the same rate, with the smaller modes converging first. 2) Muon remains stable even when the learning rate exceeds the critical threshold set by the local loss sharpness. This frees the learning rate from the condition number of the problem, enabling rapid convergence via exponential learning rate annealing. 3) Once the weights are aligned with each other and the target, Muon flow conserves the matrix quantity $\sqrt{\mathbf{P}^\top \mathbf{P}}-\sqrt{\mathbf{Q}^\top \mathbf{Q}}$, while gradient flow is known to conserve the matrix $\mathbf{P}^\top\mathbf{P} - \mathbf{Q}^\top\mathbf{Q}$. Despite having distinct conserved quantities, both optimizers find the so-called \textit{balanced} solution from vanishing initialization. When training from small random initialization, the weights spontaneously align early in training. We derive the alignment rates in simple settings and show that they predict the empirical alignment rates in general. Finally, we exploit structural properties of Muon to construct a learning rate schedule that achieves near-perfect alignment in only two optimization steps.

中文摘要翻译: 矩阵分解（即形如$\min_{\mathbf{P},\mathbf{Q}} \|\mathbf{M}^\star - \mathbf{P}^\top\mathbf{Q}\|_\mathrm{F}^2$的问题）是一个同时展现非线性参数动力学和表示学习的最小化学习问题。在此设定下，我们研究了Muon优化器与梯度下降的参数轨迹差异。我们识别出三个主要的动力学差异：1) Muon避免了从小初始化开始的慢速鞍点间动力学，而是以相同速率学习$\mathbf{M}^\star$的所有顶部模态，其中较小的模态先收敛。2) 即使学习率超过由局部损失锐度设定的临界阈值，Muon仍保持稳定。这使得学习率摆脱了问题条件数的约束，从而能够通过指数学习率退火实现快速收敛。3) 一旦权重彼此对齐并与目标对齐，Muon流会守恒矩阵量$\sqrt{\mathbf{P}^\top \mathbf{P}}-\sqrt{\mathbf{Q}^\top \mathbf{Q}}$，而梯度流已知守恒矩阵$\mathbf{P}^\top\mathbf{P} - \mathbf{Q}^\top\mathbf{Q}$。尽管具有不同的守恒量，两种优化器从零初始化出发都能找到所谓的"平衡"解。当从小随机初始化进行训练时，权重在训练早期自发对齐。我们推导了简单设定下的对齐速率，并证明了这些速率能够预测一般情况下的经验对齐速率。最后，我们利用Muon的结构性质构建了一个学习率调度策略，该策略仅需两步优化即可实现近乎完美的对齐。

</details>


### [460] [Informational Frustration in Neural Manifolds: Shannon Bottlenecks and the Limits of Learnability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30512)
*Srinivasa Rao P.,Vangmayi P Reddy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文引入了一个统一的理论框架，将信息论、拓扑学和统计力学联系起来，用以解释深度神经网络在过参数化情况下仍能泛化的原因。核心概念是“熵可学习性界限”（ELH），并提出了“香农-拓扑瓶颈定理”，揭示了泛化失败的本质是一种“信息挫折”的相变。此外，论文将“顿悟”（grokking）解释为“熵释放”，并提出了实用的“熵梯度下降”（EGD）算法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统的VC维度和Rademacher复杂度等理论框架预测现代过参数化深度网络会出现灾难性的过拟合，这与实际观察到的良好泛化性能严重不符。弥合这一理论与现实之间的巨大鸿沟是本文的核心动机。

Method: 本文提出了一个统一的理论框架，将信息论（香农熵）、拓扑学（决策边界的拓扑熵）和统计力学（权重空间的冯·诺依曼熵）相结合。核心方法包括：（1）提出熵可学习性界限（ELH）作为基本定律；（2）建立香农-拓扑瓶颈定理，描述信息挫折相变；（3）将顿悟现象解释为熵释放；（4）提出熵梯度下降（EGD）算法来动态管理权重熵。

Result: 理论分析表明，当目标边界的几何复杂度超过信息论界限时，系统会发生突发的熵相变，进入信息挫折状态——一种玻璃态的刚性记忆阶段，此时泛化在热力学上不可能。顿悟现象被重新解释为权重的突然重组，解锁了信息瓶颈（熵释放）。

Conclusion: 本文重新定位了熵的概念，将其从一种跟踪不确定性的工具提升为决定机器能否学习的基本物理“货币”。这项工作不仅从理论上弥合了过参数化网络泛化问题的鸿沟，还提供了实用的优化算法（EGD）来指导实际训练。

Original Abstract: Why overparameterised deep networks generalise so remarkably well remains one of the most stubborn open questions in machine learning theory. Classical frameworks like VC dimension and Rademacher complexity predict catastrophic overfitting in modern models, leaving a massive theoretical gap between theory and reality. In this paper, we bridge this divide by introducing a unified framework that links information theory, topology, and statistical mechanics to map the hard limits of deep learning. Central to our approach is the Entropic Learnability Horizon (ELH): a fundamental law stating that a network can only truly learn a target function if the Shannon entropy of the data manifold outpaces the topological entropy of the function's decision boundary, balanced by the von Neumann entropy of the network's weight space. We establish the Shannon-Topological Bottleneck Theorem, proving that when a target boundary's geometric complexity exceeds this informational horizon, the system undergoes a sudden entropic phase transition. It falls into a state of Informational Frustration - a glassy, rigid memorization phase where generalization becomes thermodynamically impossible. Using this lens, we show that the enigmatic phenomenon of "grokking" is actually an Entropic Release, where weights abruptly reorganise to unlock the bottleneck. Finally, we translate this theory into practice with Entropic Gradient Descent (EGD), an optimization algorithm that dynamically manages weight entropy to keep learning on track. Ultimately, this work repositions entropy not just as a tool for tracking uncertainty but as the fundamental physical currency that dictates whether a machine can learn.

中文摘要翻译: 为什么过参数化的深度网络能够如此出色地泛化，仍然是机器学习理论中最顽固的悬而未决的问题之一。VC维度和Rademacher复杂度等经典框架预测现代模型会出现灾难性的过拟合，导致理论与现实之间存在巨大的鸿沟。在本文中，我们通过引入一个统一框架来弥合这一鸿沟，该框架将信息论、拓扑学和统计力学联系起来，以刻画深度学习的硬极限。我们方法的核心是熵可学习性界限（ELH）：一条基本定律，指出只有当数据流形的香农熵超过函数决策边界的拓扑熵（并由权重空间的冯·诺依曼熵平衡）时，网络才能真正学习一个目标函数。我们建立了香农-拓扑瓶颈定理，证明了当目标边界的几何复杂度超过这一信息论界限时，系统会发生突发的熵相变。系统会陷入一种信息挫折状态——一种玻璃态的刚性记忆阶段，在此阶段泛化在热力学上不可能。通过这一视角，我们展示了神秘的“顿悟”（grokking）现象实际上是一种熵释放，即权重突然重组以解锁瓶颈。最后，我们将这一理论转化为实践，提出了熵梯度下降（EGD），一种动态管理权重熵以保持学习正常进行的优化算法。归根结底，这项工作重新定位了熵，使其不仅作为跟踪不确定性的工具，而且成为决定机器能否学习的基本物理“货币”。

</details>


### [461] [ITSPACE: Monotone Gaussian Optimal Transport Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30523)
*Woojoo Na,Jennifer Dy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ITSPACE方法，通过闭式更新的近端主化-最小化算法直接优化Bures-Wasserstein目标，实现协方差矩阵的快速最优传输对齐，在保持PSD结构的同时显著快于现有方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在许多机器学习任务（如领域自适应、高斯嵌入）中，协方差矩阵是特征分布的紧凑描述符，而Wasserstein-2最优传输距离在协方差上具有Bures-Wasserstein闭式解。现有优化方法收敛慢或需正则化近似，亟需一种能直接优化精确BW目标且高效稳定的算法。

Method: 提出ITSPACE（Iterative Transport for Stable Proximal Alignment of Covariance Embeddings），一种近端主化-最小化方法，通过平方根分解中的闭式更新直接优化精确Bures-Wasserstein目标。每次迭代在精确算术下满足充分下降不等式；在非精确极分解下给出显式证书间隙界控制偏差。该方法天然保持PSD结构并支持秩约束因子。

Result: 在真实协方差对齐基准上，ITSPACE达到低BW间隙解的速度显著快于BW梯度下降、基于其他协方差几何的方法以及熵正则化样本OT基线。

Conclusion: ITSPACE是一种轻量级内循环原语，适用于在严格步数和计算预算下从无标签目标批次进行适配的场景，为协方差对齐提供了高效且结构保持的最优传输优化方案。

Original Abstract: Covariance matrices serve as compact descriptors of feature distributions in many machine-learning pipelines, including domain adaptation and Gaussian embeddings. Under a centered Gaussian approximation, the unregularized Wasserstein-2 optimal-transport (OT) discrepancy admits a closed form on covariances given by the Bures-Wasserstein (BW) objective on the symmetric positive definite (SPD) cone. We propose ITSPACE (Iterative Transport for Stable Proximal Alignment of Covariance Embeddings), a proximal majorization-minimization method that directly optimizes this exact BW objective through closed-form updates in a square-root factorization. In exact arithmetic, each iteration satisfies a sufficient-decrease inequality for the BW objective; under inexact polar computations, we provide an explicit certificate-gap bound controlling deviations from exact descent. The resulting iterations preserve PSD structure by construction and naturally support rank-restricted factors, making ITSPACE well-suited as a lightweight inner-loop primitive in settings where adaptation must be performed from unlabeled target batches under strict step and compute budgets. Across real-world covariance-alignment benchmarks, ITSPACE reaches low-BW-gap solutions substantially faster than BW-gradient descent, methods based on other covariance geometries, and entropically regularized sample-OT baselines.

中文摘要翻译: 协方差矩阵作为许多机器学习流程（包括领域自适应和高斯嵌入）中特征分布的紧凑描述符。在中心高斯近似下，非正则化的Wasserstein-2最优传输（OT）差异在协方差上具有闭式解，即对称正定（SPD）锥上的Bures-Wasserstein（BW）目标。我们提出ITSPACE（协方差嵌入的稳定近端对齐迭代传输法），一种近端主化-最小化方法，通过平方根分解中的闭式更新直接优化该精确BW目标。在精确算术下，每次迭代满足BW目标的充分下降不等式；在非精确极分解下，我们给出了显式的证书间隙界，用于控制对精确下降的偏差。所得迭代自然地保持半正定（PSD）结构，并天然支持秩约束因子，使得ITSPACE非常适合作为轻量级内循环原语，应用于必须在严格步数和计算预算下从无标签目标批次执行适配的场景。在真实世界的协方差对齐基准测试中，ITSPACE达到低BW间隙解的速度显著快于BW梯度下降、基于其他协方差几何的方法以及熵正则化样本OT基线。

</details>


### [462] [Convergence of Continual Learning in Homogeneous Deep Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30559)
*Matan Schliserman,Gon Buzaglo,Itay Evron,Daniel Soudry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过将弱正则化持续分类问题建模为任务间隔集上的顺序投影，统一并推广了先前仅限于静态深度模型或持续线性模型的分析框架。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有持续学习理论分析局限于静态（单任务）深度模型或持续线性模型，缺乏对同构模型中弱正则化持续分类问题的统一理解。

Method: 将弱正则化持续分类刻画为同构模型在任务间隔集上的顺序投影，利用非凸投影理论分析同构深度网络的局部收敛性质。

Result: 全局收敛通常不成立，即使对于数据线性但参数非线性的简单模型也是如此；但同构深度网络在随机和循环任务序列下可保证局部线性收敛。

Conclusion: 将分析扩展到持续回归，从而为同构模型建立了统一的持续学习理论框架。

Original Abstract: We characterize weakly regularized continual classification in homogeneous models as sequential projections onto task margin sets. This result generalizes prior analyses restricted to either stationary (single-task) deep models or continual linear models. We show that global convergence generally fails, even for simple models linear in data but nonlinear in parameters. Nevertheless, by leveraging results from nonconvex projection theory, we identify regularity properties of homogeneous deep networks that guarantee local linear convergence under random and cyclic task sequences. Finally, we extend our analysis to continual regression, unifying the framework for homogeneous models.

中文摘要翻译: 我们在同构模型中，将弱正则化持续分类问题刻画为任务间隔集上的顺序投影。该结果推广了先前仅限于静态（单任务）深度模型或持续线性模型的分析。我们证明，即使对于数据线性但参数非线性的简单模型，全局收敛通常也不成立。然而，通过利用非凸投影理论的结果，我们识别出同构深度网络的规则性性质，这些性质保证了在随机和循环任务序列下的局部线性收敛。最后，我们将分析扩展到持续回归，从而为同构模型建立了统一的框架。

</details>


### [463] [TraceLab: Characterizing Coding Agent Workloads for LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30560)
*Kan Zhu,Mathew Jacob,Chenxi Ma,Yi Pan,Stephanie Wang,Arvind Krishnamurthy,Baris Kasikci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过收集并发布约4,300个编码智能体会话（包含35万LLM步骤和43万工具调用）的真实追踪数据，分析了编码智能体工作负载的特征，发现其具有长自治循环、长上下文短输出、多样且重尾分布的工具调用以及高但不完美的前缀缓存命中率等特点，并据此提出了多项服务优化方向。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 编码智能体正成为智能体LLM的主要应用，但高效服务它们仍具挑战。现有公开追踪数据和基准未捕获真实日常编码智能体使用模式，缺乏多智能体、多模型族的服务系统分析数据，亟需填补这一空白。

Method: 收集并分析了作者团队日常使用Claude Code和Codex产生的约4,300个编码智能体会话的追踪数据（含约35万LLM步骤和43万工具调用），对工作负载特征进行系统性分析。

Result: 编码智能体工作负载具有以下特征：(1) 长自治循环；(2) 长上下文但短输出；(3) 多样且重尾分布的工具调用；(4) 高但不完美的前缀缓存命中率。

Conclusion: 这些发现指出了具体的服务优化方向，包括：降低工具调用开销、基于追加长度的预填充、语义感知的工具延迟预测、以及围绕人类节奏间隙改进KV缓存管理。同时开源了数据集、追踪收集流程和分析代码。

Original Abstract: Coding agents are rapidly becoming a major application of agentic LLMs, but serving them efficiently remains challenging. Progress on this challenge requires understanding real workload patterns, yet the data needed for such analysis is largely absent. Existing public traces and benchmarks do not capture real, day-to-day coding-agent usage across multiple agents and model families for serving-system analysis. To help fill this gap, we collect and release a trace of roughly 4,300 coding-agent sessions, containing about 350,000 LLM steps and 430,000 tool calls from our own day-to-day use of Claude Code and Codex. Our analysis shows that coding-agent workloads feature long autonomous loops, long contexts with short outputs, diverse and heavily-tailed tool calls, and high but imperfect prefix cache hit rates. These findings point to concrete opportunities for optimizing serving, including lower-overhead tool calling, append-length-aware prefill, semantic-aware tool-latency prediction, and improved KV-cache management around human-paced gaps. We release the dataset, trace collection pipeline, and analysis code at https://github.com/uw-syfi/TraceLab.git; the project website is https://tracelab.cs.washington.edu.

中文摘要翻译: 编码智能体正迅速成为智能体LLM的主要应用场景，但高效服务它们仍面临挑战。解决这一挑战需要理解真实工作负载模式，然而用于此类分析的数据却基本缺失。现有的公开追踪数据和基准无法捕获服务于系统分析所需的、跨多个智能体和模型族的真实日常编码智能体使用模式。为填补这一空白，我们收集并发布了自身日常使用Claude Code和Codex产生的约4,300个编码智能体会话的追踪数据，包含约35万LLM步骤和43万工具调用。我们的分析表明，编码智能体工作负载具有长自治循环、长上下文短输出、多样且重尾分布的工具调用，以及高但不完美的前缀缓存命中率等特点。这些发现指出了具体的服务优化方向，包括降低工具调用开销、基于追加长度的预填充、语义感知的工具延迟预测，以及围绕人类节奏间隙改进KV缓存管理。我们在https://github.com/uw-syfi/TraceLab.git 发布了数据集、追踪收集流程和分析代码；项目网站为https://tracelab.cs.washington.edu。

</details>


### [464] [Attractor States Emerge in Multi-Turn LLM Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30571)
*Ting-Wen Ko,Jonas Geiping*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现在开放多智能体对话中，LLM存在模型特定的吸引子行为，自旋对话会收敛到稳定轨迹，而混合辩论中某些模型（如Claude Haiku）会不对称地吸引其他模型，使其风格和立场向其靠拢。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地用于开放多智能体交互，但模型间长期动态交互的行为特性（尤其是是否存在类似吸引子的稳定行为模式）尚未被充分理解。

Method: 使用7种LLM在20个争议性话题上分别进行自旋辩论和混合辩论实验，通过在表示空间中追踪轨迹、分析话语特征和立场，比较模型间相互影响模式。

Result: (1) 自旋辩论中，每种模型存在特异性的吸引子轨迹；(2) 混合辩论中，吸引子会不对称地影响对方模型，如Claude Haiku对GPT-4.1 nano等模型有强吸引作用，使其表现出元评论等风格特征。

Conclusion: 开放多智能体LLM交互部分可预测，受模型特异性吸引子和结构化、非对称的伙伴影响共同塑造，对设计、预测和监控自主智能体系统有指导意义。

Original Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in open-ended multi-agent settings, but the long-run dynamics of model--model interaction remain poorly understood. We study whether open-ended LLM discussions exhibit attractor-like behavior, i.e. topic-independent stable sets of behaviors which conversations settle into. Across 7 LLMs and 20 controversial topics, we compare self-play and mixed-play dyadic debates, tracking trajectories in representation space, discourse traits, and stances. We find self-play trajectories to be model-specific attractors that draw their conversation partners asymmetrically in mixed-play debates, influencing the other models' stylistic choices and behavior. For example, Claude Haiku is a strong attractor of other models in latent space, corresponding to other models taking on its traits like metacommentary, and models like GPT-4.1 nano are especially malleable. Our results suggest that open-ended LLM interactions are partially predictable from model-specific attractors, but shaped by structured and asymmetric partner influence. Overall, our analysis sheds some light on the complex behavior of open-ended multi-agent interaction, which we hope is helpful in designing, predicting, and monitoring autonomous agentic systems in the real world.

中文摘要翻译: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于开放式的多智能体环境中，但模型间交互的长期动态特性仍未被充分理解。我们研究了开放式LLM讨论是否表现出吸引子行为，即对话会稳定收敛到与话题无关的稳定行为集合。我们在7种LLM和20个争议性话题上，比较了自旋辩论和混合辩论中的两两对话，追踪了表示空间中的轨迹、话语特征和立场。我们发现自旋辩论轨迹是模型特异性的吸引子，在混合辩论中这些吸引子会不对称地牵引对话伙伴，影响其他模型的风格选择和行文特征。例如，Claude Haiku在潜在空间中是其他模型的强吸引子，使得其他模型表现出元评论等特征，而GPT-4.1 nano等模型则特别容易被影响。我们的结果表明，开放式LLM交互从模型特异性吸引子的角度是部分可预测的，但同时受到结构化和非对称的伙伴影响。总体而言，我们的分析为开放多智能体交互的复杂行为提供了一些启示，希望能有助于设计、预测和监控现实世界中的自主智能体系统。

</details>


### [465] [SWE-INTERACT: Reimagining SWE Benchmarks as User-Driven Long-Horizon Coding Sessions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30573)
*Mohit Raghavendra,Anisha Gunjal,Aakash Sabharwal,Yunzhong He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SWE-Interact是一个新的测试基准，用于评估编码智能体在多轮、交互式、用户驱动的软件工程任务中的表现。研究发现，在单轮任务中表现良好的模型，其能力并不能可靠地迁移到多轮用户驱动的工作流中。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有SWE基准测试通常提供完整需求并评估智能体的自主实现能力，但现实场景中开发者面临的是模糊、渐进的需求和用户交互反馈。因此需要一个新的测试基准来评估编码智能体在交互式目标发现和迭代优化方面的能力。

Method: 构建SWE-Interact测试基准，包含一个精心设计的用户模拟器，从模糊或不完整的指令开始，逐步揭示需求，检查智能体的工作空间，并提供针对性反馈、修订和新约束，直到任务目标完全传递完成。基于大规模真实编码智能体交互研究设计。

Result: 最强模型（Opus 4.8和GPT 5.5）能解决约50%的单轮基线任务，但仅能解决约25%的SWE-Interact任务。强模型在模糊初始指令下表现良好，能坚持直到所有需求被揭示、更好整合需求并编写整洁代码，但仍存在过度主动编码、忘记需求和技术错误等问题。弱模型在模糊情况下表现差、过早放弃、忘记或忽略指令、更多重写代码。

Conclusion: SWE-Interact衡量了前沿模型开发中一个正交的、真实世界的能力轴：与用户交互的目标发现和迭代优化。强模型在单轮SWE任务上的表现并不能可靠地迁移到多轮用户驱动的工作流中。

Original Abstract: We introduce SWE-Interact, a new testbed for evaluating coding agents on multi-turn, interactive, user-driven software engineering tasks. Existing frontier SWE benchmarks typically provide complete requirements upfront and evaluate agents on autonomous implementation. In contrast, SWE-Interact places agents in a realistic developer workflow: a carefully designed user simulator starts with vague or incomplete instructions, progressively reveals requirements, inspects the agent's workspace, and provides targeted feedback, revisions, and new constraints until the full task goal has been handed off. Grounded in large-scale studies of real coding-agent interactions, this setup tests whether agents can discover user intent, adapt to evolving requirements, and build on their own prior work. Across a suite of frontier and open-weight models, we find that strong performance on single-turn SWE tasks does not reliably transfer to multi-turn, user-driven workflows: the best-performing models solve roughly 50% of single-turn baseline tasks but only 25% of the corresponding SWE-Interact tasks. The strongest models in our evaluation, including Opus 4.8 and GPT 5.5, start strong even in the face of vague initial instructions, persevere until all the requirements are surfaced by the user, integrate them better and write clean code. However, they still suffer from over-agentic coding, forgetting requirements and technical mistakes. Weaker models start poorly under ambiguity, give up early, forget or ignore instructions and rework their code more. Overall, SWE-Interact measures an orthogonal, real-world capability axis for frontier model development: interactive goal discovery and iterative refinement with a user in the loop.

中文摘要翻译: 我们介绍了SWE-Interact，这是一个新的测试基准，用于评估编码智能体在多轮、交互式、用户驱动的软件工程任务中的表现。现有的前沿SWE基准测试通常提前提供完整需求，并评估智能体的自主实现能力。相比之下，SWE-Interact将智能体置于真实的开发者工作流中：一个精心设计的用户模拟器从模糊或不完整的指令开始，逐步揭示需求，检查智能体的工作空间，并提供针对性反馈、修订和新约束，直到完整任务目标被传递完毕。该设置基于大规模真实编码智能体交互研究，测试智能体是否能够发现用户意图、适应不断变化的需求，并在自身先前工作的基础上进行构建。在一系列前沿和开源模型中，我们发现单轮SWE任务上的强性能并不能可靠地迁移到多轮用户驱动的工作流中：表现最佳的模型能解决约50%的单轮基线任务，但仅能解决约25%的对应SWE-Interact任务。在我们评估中最强的模型，包括Opus 4.8和GPT 5.5，即使在模糊的初始指令面前也表现强劲，坚持到用户揭示所有需求，更好地整合需求并编写整洁代码。然而，它们仍然存在过度主动编码、忘记需求和技术错误的问题。较弱的模型在模糊情况下起步差，过早放弃，忘记或忽略指令，并更多重写代码。总的来说，SWE-Interact为前沿模型开发衡量了一个正交的真实世界能力轴：在用户参与下的交互式目标发现和迭代优化。

</details>


### [466] [The Fundamental Limits of Valid Transport Map Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30574)
*Sivaraman Balakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在极小极大框架下形式化了估计任意有效传输映射的任务，揭示了在标准稳定性假设下，估计任意传输映射与估计最优传输映射在统计上同样困难；但在稳定性假设不成立时，次优映射可被更准确地学习。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有生成模型（如扩散模型、归一化流、流匹配）估计的是分布间的传输映射或计划，但并未明确以最优传输（OT）为目标。由于生成建模中传输成本本身无关紧要，因此有必要从统计和计算角度形式化地研究估计任意有效传输映射的理论极限，为理解现代基于传输的生成方法的统计界限提供严格基础。

Method: 本文采用极小极大（minimax）统计决策理论框架，将估计任意有效传输映射的任务形式化为一个严格的统计推断问题。通过引入OT文献中的标准（但较强）稳定性假设，推导估计任意传输映射的样本复杂度下界；并通过反例展示当稳定性假设不成立时，替代传输映射可被更精确地学习。

Result: (1) 在标准稳定性假设下，估计任意有效传输映射与估计OT映射在统计上同样困难（具有相同的样本复杂度下界）；(2) 当稳定性假设失效时，替代（次优）传输映射可以比OT映射学习得显著更准确；(3) 该极小极大框架为流匹配和扩散模型等现代生成方法的统计极限提供了理论依据。

Conclusion: 本文提出的极小极大框架为理解基于传输的现代生成方法的统计极限奠定了严格基础，阐明了在何种条件下以次优映射为目标可以带来真正的统计优势。

Original Abstract: Many modern generative modeling methods, including diffusion models, normalizing flows, and flow matching, estimate transport maps or plans between distributions without explicitly targeting an optimal transport (OT) map. In applications like generative modeling, the transport cost itself is irrelevant, and this makes it natural to target maps which are more tractable from either a statistical or computational standpoint. In this short note, we formalize the task of estimating any valid transport map in a rigorous minimax framework. One consequence of this framing is that it yields sample complexity lower bounds for any method whose learned object is evaluated as a transport map or plan, including flow matching and diffusion-based generative models, in settings where direct analysis would be challenging due to the analytic complexity of the methods and their target maps. We observe that, under standard, though strong, stability assumptions from the OT literature, estimating any valid transport map is statistically as hard as estimating the OT map. We complement these results with some examples showing that when these stability assumptions fail, alternative transport maps can be learned substantially more accurately than the OT map. Our minimax framing provides a rigorous foundation for understanding the statistical limits of modern transport-based generative methods and clarifies when targeting sub-optimal maps can provide real statistical advantages.

中文摘要翻译: 许多现代生成建模方法（包括扩散模型、归一化流和流匹配）估计的是分布之间的传输映射或计划，但并未明确以最优传输（OT）映射为目标。在生成建模等应用中，传输成本本身并不重要，这使得从统计或计算角度关注更易于处理的映射成为自然之选。在这篇短文中，我们在一个严格的极小极大框架下形式化了估计任意有效传输映射的任务。该框架的一个结果是，它为任何以传输映射或计划作为评估对象的估计方法（包括流匹配和基于扩散的生成模型）提供了样本复杂度下界——这些方法及其目标映射因解析复杂性而使得直接分析具有挑战性。我们观察到，在OT文献中标准（尽管较强）的稳定性假设下，估计任意有效传输映射在统计上与估计OT映射同样困难。我们通过一些示例补充了这些结果，表明当稳定性假设不成立时，替代传输映射可以比OT映射学习得显著更准确。我们的极小极大框架为理解现代基于传输的生成方法的统计极限提供了严格基础，并阐明了以次优映射为目标何时能带来真正的统计优势。

</details>


### [467] [C$^{2}$R: Cross-sample Consistency Regularization Mitigates Feature Splitting and Absorption in Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30609)
*Haoran Jin,Xiting Wang,Shijie Ren,Hong Xie,Defu Lian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对稀疏自编码器（SAE）在大规模字典下存在的特征分裂和特征吸收问题，提出跨样本一致性正则化（C²R），通过惩罚批次内方向相似潜变量的共激活，使每个语义特征由统一的潜变量一致表示，有效缓解了上述问题且不损害重建保真度。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 大规模稀疏自编码器在分解语言模型激活时面临两个根本性挑战：特征分裂（feature splitting）将连贯概念碎片化为非原子潜变量，以及特征吸收（feature absorption）在通用特征中产生任意例外，严重损害了潜变量的可靠性。这些问题源于每个样本独立优化时缺少跨样本约束，导致同一概念在不同样本中被不一致地分配到多个冗余或干扰潜变量上。

Method: 提出跨样本一致性正则化（C²R），核心思想是在训练时引入批次级别的约束，通过惩罚方向相似潜变量的共激活，显式鼓励每个语义特征在批次内由统一的潜变量一致地表示，从而在不依赖额外标注的情况下实现跨样本的潜变量分配一致性。

Result: 综合评估表明，C²R有效缓解了特征分裂和特征吸收问题，同时关键的是，保持了重建保真度不受损，即在提升潜变量可解释性的同时不降低模型性能。

Conclusion: C²R提供了一种原则性的解决方案，通过跨样本一致性约束从根本上改善了SAE潜变量的可解释性和可靠性，且不牺牲重建质量。

Original Abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used to interpret large language models by decomposing activations into sparse, human-understandable features, but scaling to large dictionaries exposes fundamental challenges. Systematic studies reveal pervasive feature splitting that fragments coherent concepts into non-atomic latents and widespread feature absorption that creates arbitrary exceptions in general features, severely compromising latent reliability. These issues stem from inconsistent latent assignment across samples: without cross-sample constraints, per-sample optimization often allows a single underlying concept to be inconsistently distributed across multiple redundant or interfering latents. To address this, we introduce C$^2$R (\underline{\textbf{C}}ross-sample \underline{\textbf{C}}onsistency \underline{\textbf{R}}egularization). C$^2$R explicitly encourages that each semantic feature is consistently represented by a unified latent across the batch by penalizing the co-activation of directionally similar latents. Comprehensive evaluation demonstrates that C$^2$R effectively mitigates both splitting and absorption while, crucially, preserving reconstruction fidelity, providing a principled solution that enhances latent interpretability without degrading model performance. Source code is available at https://github.com/hr-jin/Cross-sample-Consistency-Regularization.

中文摘要翻译: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）被广泛用于解释大型语言模型，通过将激活分解为稀疏且人类可理解的特征，但扩展到大规模字典时暴露了根本性挑战。系统性研究揭示了普遍存在的特征分裂（将连贯概念碎片化为非原子潜变量）和广泛的特征吸收（在通用特征中产生任意例外），严重损害了潜变量的可靠性。这些问题源于各样本间潜变量分配的不一致性：由于缺乏跨样本约束，每个样本的独立优化常常导致一个单一潜在概念被不一致地分配到多个冗余或干扰潜变量上。为解决这一问题，我们引入了C²R（跨样本一致性正则化）。C²R通过惩罚方向相似潜变量的共激活，显式鼓励每个语义特征在批次内由统一的潜变量一致表示。综合评估表明，C²R有效缓解了特征分裂和吸收问题，同时关键的是保持了重建保真度，为增强潜变量可解释性而不降低模型性能提供了一种原则性解决方案。源代码可在https://github.com/hr-jin/Cross-sample-Consistency-Regularization获取。

</details>


### [468] [Pessimism's Paradox: Conservative Offline Training Amplifies Reward Hacking During Online Adaptation in Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30627)
*Subramanyam Sahoo,Aman Chadha,Vinija Jain,Divya Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了"离线保守训练能安全支撑后续在线适应"的传统观点，通过DPO训练Qwen3-14B策略并在线适配奖励集成模型，发现更高的离线保守性反而单调地加剧奖励破解（Goodhart差距），机制上源于高β压缩策略熵→降低响应多样性→奖励模型集成分歧增大并被在线优化更快利用。研究拟合出功率律曲线并识别出平衡对齐保真度与破解脆弱性的最优保守水平β*，呼吁学界采用"校准的"而非"最大化的"保守主义。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 挑战离线保守训练（与行为支持良好的策略保持接近）能安全支撑后续在线适应、避免奖励模型缺陷被利用的传统直觉，通过实证和机制分析揭示保守性过高反而加剧奖励破解。

Method: 使用Qwen3-14B策略在三种不同保守程度（β∈{β_lo, β_mid, β_hi}）下进行DPO训练，然后将每个检查点在线适配到由3个Qwen3-1.7B模型组成的奖励集成，在GSM8K任务上测量真实准确率。通过Goodhart差距及其曲线下面积（AUGC）量化奖励破解程度，并分析策略熵、响应多样性与集成分歧之间的因果链。

Result: 更高的离线保守性（β）单调增加奖励破解损害（Goodhart差距和AUGC），Spearman ρ=1.0。机制上：高β DPO压缩策略熵→低熵策略降低响应多样性（更小的余弦距离）→但集成分歧（认知不确定性）反而随β增大，并被在线优化更快利用。拟合出(β, AUGC)的功率律曲线，识别出最优保守水平β*。

Conclusion: 领域需要"校准的"而非"最大化的"保守主义，即存在一个平衡对齐保真度与破解脆弱性的最优保守水平，过犹不及。

Original Abstract: Conservative offline training is widely advocated as a safe foundation for subsequent online adaptation: if a policy stays close to well-supported behaviour, the argument goes, it is less likely to exploit imperfections in a learned reward model. We challenge this intuition empirically and mechanistically. We train a Qwen3-14B policy under Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO) with three levels of conservatism ($β\in \{β_{\mathrm{lo}}, β_{\mathrm{mid}}, β_{\mathrm{hi}}\}$ derived from empirical log-ratio percentiles), then adapt each checkpoint online against a learned reward ensemble (3\,$\times$\,Qwen3-1.7B) while measuring true performance on GSM8K exact-answer accuracy. We find that \emph{higher offline conservatism monotonically increases reward-hacking damage}, measured by the Goodhart gap and its area under the curve (AUGC), with Spearman $ρ= 1.0$ across all three conditions.
